Discover the epitome of modern living in this exquisite villa located in the prestigious Villamartin area of Orihuela Costa. Step into a world of elegance and sophistication with spacious interiors that exude opulence. This stunning villa showcases a sleek and contemporary architectural design that harmoniously blends with its natural surroundings. Every detail has been meticulously crafted to create a sense of modern luxury. Large windows and glass walls flood the interiors with an abundance of natural light, creating a bright and airy atmosphere throughout the villa. Enjoy the beauty of the surrounding landscape from every corner of your home.
No expense has been spared in the selection of high-end finishes and materials. From the premium flooring to the designer fixtures, every element has been carefully chosen to reflect the villa's luxurious ambiance. The open-plan living areas seamlessly integrate the living room, dining area, and gourmet kitchen, providing a perfect space for entertaining guests or relaxing with family.
Step outside to your own private oasis. The villa offers a generous outdoor space featuring a pristine swimming pool, landscaped gardens, and spacious terraces. Enjoy alfresco dining, host gatherings, or simply unwind in the privacy of your own outdoor sanctuary. The prime location of this villa in Villamartin provides easy access to renowned golf courses, golden beaches, shopping centers, and a vibrant nightlife. Experience the best of the Costa Blanca lifestyle right at your doorstep.
Security and privacy are paramount in this exclusive residential community. With gated access and 24/7 security, this villa provides a safe and secure living environment for you and your loved ones. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this modern villa in Villamartin, Orihuela Costa. Embrace a luxurious lifestyle in a prime location. Contact us today to schedule a viewing and make this extraordinary property your own.
Location
Nestled along the stunning Costa Blanca in the province of Alicante, Orihuela Costa is a captivating coastal region. Contrary to its name, it is situated about 20 kilometers away from the main resort of Orihuela, close to the border with Murcia and the enchanting Mar Menor. Offering a diverse coastline spanning 16 kilometers, it is an ideal destination for a family beach holiday. Moreover, Orihuela Costa caters to the needs of all visitors, making it a perfect choice for a golf vacation, boasting a range of amenities, facilities, and leisure activities.
This region encompasses several delightful seaside resorts, each with its own unique charm. One such gem is the southernmost town of Cabo Roig. With its Blue Flag beaches and breathtaking mountain vistas, this enchanting destination, situated just 10 kilometers from Torrevieja, captivates visitors with wide, palm-lined avenues and lush gardens that overlook the Mediterranean Sea, the La Manga Peninsula, and the Mar Menor.
Another inviting urbanization is Playa Flamenca, located in close proximity to the vibrant town of Torrevieja. Here, visitors can revel in magnificent beaches, a golf course, and a host of recreational facilities, including water parks, tennis courts, and go-karting.
For those seeking a renowned resort experience, the bustling town of La Zenia offers everything needed for an unforgettable vacation. Boasting blue flag beaches, a superb golf course, an array of amenities, and a delightful area to explore, La Zenia stands out as one of the most famous destinations on the Costa Blanca.
For those yearning to immerse themselves in authentic Spanish culture, Campoamor presents an idyllic setting. Boasting stunning scenery, verdant forests, and beautiful beaches, Campoamor has become a sought-after tourist destination on the Orihuela Costa.
The prestigious Villamartin golf development, located south of Alicante, impresses visitors with its captivating Mediterranean village ambiance. Comprising apartments, townhouses, and villas, this complex provides all the amenities one could desire, including shops, cafes, bars, restaurants, and, of course, two magnificent 18-hole golf courses. Additionally, the nearby beaches offer tranquility and space, ensuring a delightful seaside experience.
Situated at the southernmost point of the Orihuela Costa, Mil Palmeras presents an attractive and popular resort. Adorned with beautiful sandy beaches, rocky coves, and bays, this destination offers abundant water sports activities and excellent beach facilities.
For golf enthusiasts, Orihuela Costa is an exceptional choice, boasting three outstanding golf courses in the region: Villamartin, Campoamor, and Las Ramblas. These courses offer unparalleled opportunities to enjoy the sport amidst the region's picturesque surroundings.
Embark on a journey to Orihuela Costa, where coastal beauty, rich cultural experiences, and world-class golf converge to create an unforgettable vacation.

properties.title: Modern villa in Los Alcázares
properties.summary: New build villa for sale in Los Alcázares, Murcia: 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 167 m² built, 261 m² plot. €587,800.
properties.description:
Modern Villa for sale in Los Alcázares,
Discover this elegant independent villa in Los Alcázares, located on the beautiful Costa Cálida, just a short walk from the beaches of the Mar Menor. Designed with contemporary architecture and clean, straight lines, the villa combines a sophisticated white façade with natural stone accents, creating a stylish and timeless Mediterranean aesthetic.
The property is thoughtfully distributed over two floors and offers three spacious bedrooms and three modern bathrooms. One of the bedrooms is conveniently located on the ground floor and includes its own en-suite bathroom, making it ideal for guests or comfortable everyday living.
Inside, the villa features bright and open living spaces designed to maximise natural light and provide a seamless connection between the indoor and outdoor areas. The modern kitchen integrates perfectly with the living and dining area, creating an inviting environment for relaxing or entertaining.
One of the distinctive features of this villa is its private rooftop solarium of approximately 40 m², accessed through a unique covered turret staircase that adds architectural character to the property. From the solarium, you can enjoy sunshine throughout the year — perfect for outdoor dining, sunbathing or simply relaxing in the Mediterranean climate.
The exterior spaces are equally impressive. Set on a 283 m² private plot, the villa includes a private swimming pool, landscaped garden areas and private parking with garage, offering both comfort and privacy.
Located in the charming coastal town of Los Alcázares, the property benefits from excellent proximity to local amenities. Shops, restaurants and daily services are just a short walk away, while the beaches of the Mar Menor are only about 10–12 minutes on foot. Golf courses, shopping areas and leisure facilities are also within easy reach, and Murcia International Airport can be reached in approximately 30 minutes by car.
This villa is an excellent choice for those looking for a modern home by the sea, whether as a permanent residence, holiday home or investment property on the Costa Cálida.
Delivery date: Septiembre 2027
Location
The picturesque town of Los Alcázares, located in the charming region of Murcia in Spain, entices with its seaside charm and a host of delightful attractions. Situated along the magnificent Mar Menor, a saltwater lagoon that is renowned for its crystal clear water and medicinal properties, Los Alcázares offers an idyllic location for an unforgettable holiday or a peaceful getaway.
The area is connected by motorway to Cartagena, Murcia and Alicante, as well as the rest of the Costa Cálida and Costa Blanca beaches.
One of the town's greatest assets is its collection of beautiful beaches, each promising moments of bliss and relaxation. Golden sands stretch along the calm shores of the Mar Menor, creating a paradise for sun seekers and water lovers alike. From the lively and family-friendly Playa de Los Narejos beach to the more secluded and tranquil Playa de Las Salinas, you'll find a beach for everyone. Visitors can sunbathe, swim or enjoy a variety of water sports, including sailing, kayaking and windsurfing. The shallow and calm waters of the Mar Menor make it an ideal place for families with children.
Los Alcázares boasts a vibrant culinary scene, offering a diverse range of restaurants, bars and cafes to tempt your taste buds. From traditional Spanish tapas to international dishes, the city's restaurants will satisfy any palate. Enjoy fresh seafood made from local ingredients, savour an authentic paella or sip a refreshing drink at a beachside chiringuito while taking in the magnificent views. The warm and welcoming atmosphere of the city's eateries enhances the overall dining experience, making it a real delight for food lovers.
In addition to the beaches and dining establishments, Los Alcázares offers many attractions to keep visitors entertained. Browse the charming streets in the town centre, dotted with shops, boutiques and artisan shops. Discover local handicrafts, souvenirs and unique treasures to commemorate your visit. For the adventure-seekers, a variety of water sports centres offer opportunities for water skiing, paddleboarding and scuba diving, allowing you to plumb the depths of the Mar Menor's underwater wonders.
Golf lovers will find themselves in paradise, as Los Alcázares is surrounded by a selection of world-class golf courses. Within a short distance, you will discover famous golf courses such as La Serena Golf, Roda Golf and Mar Menor Golf Resort. Immerse yourself in the lush green fairways, perfect your swing and enjoy a Mediterranean climate that allows you to play golf all year round.
To explore the history and culture, a visit to the nearby city of Cartagena is highly recommended. Explore the ancient Roman ruins, wander the charming streets full of colourful buildings and immerse yourself in the rich history of this historic port city.

Luxurious Villa for Sale in Los Balcones, Torrevieja
Are you dreaming of a luxurious lifestyle by the sea? Look no further than this magnificent villa located in Los Balcones, Torrevieja, one of the most desirable residential areas in Torrevieja on the Costa Blanca in Spain. This stunning property boasts high-quality construction, elegant design, and a prime location, making it the perfect place to call home.
This villa is situated on a 400 square meter plot and boasts 119 square meters of interior space, distributed over one level. The property features three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a spacious living and dining area, a fully-equipped kitchen, and several terraces. The living room is bright and airy, with large windows that allow natural light to flood the room. It's a perfect space for relaxation and entertainment, with comfortable seating and elegant decor that creates a cozy yet sophisticated ambiance.
The kitchen is a modern and functional space that is equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, making it the perfect place to cook and entertain. The sleek design and premium materials used in the kitchen create a stylish and inviting atmosphere that is sure to impress.
The bedrooms in this villa are designed to provide maximum comfort and tranquility, with serene decor, and ample storage space. The bathrooms are equally luxurious, with modern fixtures, premium materials, and elegant design that exudes sophistication and style.
One of the standout features of this villa is the private swimming pool, which provides the perfect place to cool off on hot summer days. The solarium with panoramic views over the Pink Lake in Torrevieja is an excellent place to relax and take in the beautiful surroundings. Other notable features of this villa include air conditioning, built-in wardrobes, double glazed windows, and private parking space.
Location
Los Balcones, a serene and lush residential area, is located just a short drive from the town center of Torrevieja and the Mediterranean beaches. It is surrounded by nature and offers a secure and peaceful environment with easy access to all amenities, including the La Mata natural park, Torrevieja salt lakes, golf courses, shopping centers, restaurants, bars, schools, and hospitals.
Torrevieja is a charming town that offers an array of local attractions and things to do. The Torrevieja Salt Lakes are a unique and natural phenomenon located just outside the town of Torrevieja. These lakes are part of a larger saltwater lagoon known as the La Mata-Torrevieja Lagoon and are an important ecological and environmental area. The salt lakes are a stunning sight to behold, with their pink waters caused by the microorganisms living in them. The lakes are surrounded by a unique landscape of salt flats, dunes, and wetlands, which provide a habitat for a diverse range of flora and fauna.
The Museo del Mar y de la Sal is a fascinating museum located in Torrevieja that is dedicated to the history of the town's maritime and salt industries. The museum is housed in a historic building that was once used as a salt storage facility, giving visitors a sense of the area's rich history and culture. The museum features a range of exhibits and displays that showcase the history of Torrevieja's salt industry, which has been an integral part of the town's economy for centuries. Visitors can learn about the process of salt production, the role of salt in local cuisine and culture, and the ways in which the industry has shaped the town's development.
La Mata beach is one of the most popular and picturesque beaches in the Torrevieja area, offering a vast array of amenities and activities for all ages. Located just a few minutes' drive from the town center, La Mata beach offers visitors a wide range of facilities, making it a perfect destination for families, couples, and solo travelers. The beach itself is long and wide, with golden sands that stretch for over two kilometers. The waters are crystal-clear and calm, making it an ideal spot for swimming, sunbathing, and relaxing. The beach is also equipped with showers, toilets, and changing rooms, making it easy for visitors to freshen up after a day in the sun. The beach is also wheelchair accessible, making it an inclusive destination for all.

Finestrat is a charming and picturesque town located in the province of Alicante, in the Valencian Community of Spain. It is just 8 km from the popular, large city of Benidorm and 40 km from Alicante and its international airport. Known for its stunning mountain views, pristine beaches and rich cultural heritage, Finestrat is the perfect destination for anyone looking for a relaxing and memorable experience. There is no shortage of exciting things to do in Finestrat.
Finestrat is located on the slopes of the Puig Campana mountain, offering stunning views of the mountains, coast and Mediterranean Sea. The town has a typical Moorish feel, with colorfully painted houses and narrow cobbled streets. On the other hand, Cala Finestrat is becoming more and more popular, and its development has made it almost an extension of Benidorm itself.
inch Finestrat
Cala Finestrat is a seaside resort just three kilometers from busy Benidorm. The resort offers adequate facilities, a large selection of restaurants, bars and shops. Everything you need is available in Benidorm, which is easily accessible by bus and taxi.
La Cala beach is quite quiet, as most people who want a more upbeat atmosphere head to the beaches surrounding Benidorm. The beach is a clean strip of golden sand, ideal for children and safe for swimming. There are several lovely restaurants along the promenade and there is an arts and crafts market in the afternoon during the summer months.
The place is suitable for families and couples looking for a relaxing beach resort, yet close to many attractions and amenities.
Nearby are the theme parks of Terre Mitica and Terra Natura, the Aqualandia water park and the Mundomar marine and exotic animal park, offering fun for the whole family.
And if you prefer to spend your holiday golfing one or two rounds, Finestrat will be pleased with the nearby Real Faula Golf Club, which offers two excellent golf courses.
Both Finestrat and Cala Finestrat are quiet destinations compared to some of the neighboring resorts. Both offer a selection of local bars and restaurants where you can enjoy good food and a relaxed atmosphere.

Benijofar is located just a short drive away from the coastal towns of Guardamar del Segura and Torrevieja, and is only 30 minutes from the international airport of Alicante. The town has a rich history dating back to the Moorish era, and there are still traces of its past visible in the old town, with narrow streets, whitewashed houses, and a beautiful church.

Walking along the port promenade along the bay, visitors will pass the Gorgos River bed, which is dry for most of the year, and is a natural border between the port district and the Montanar district.
Montanar is the most extensive district of Jávea, and it is where visitors can find the most important beaches in the bay, both sandy and pebbly or rocky. The buildings in this district are mainly representative single-family houses in a traditional style, covered with tiles and arcades, modernly furnished with glass and concrete. Separated by a road from less-frequented rocky beaches, Montanar is a picturesque district that is worth exploring.

On the north side of the city, there are two beaches, Playa de los Locos and Playa del Cura. Both are equipped with full infrastructure and marked with the Blue Flag. In the very center, next to the seaside Paseo Marítimo Juan Aparicio, you can bathe in natural pools that have been created among the rocky coast. You can also see the statue of the Man of the Sea (Monumento al Hombre del Mar) and Beautiful Lola (La Bella Lola) sitting on a bench. It is also worth going to the beaches located in the bays. Cala Ferris and Cala Piteras with great views, palm trees and dunes. You can also go snorkeling on the latter.
Take a walk along the elegant promenade (Vista Alegre). Here you can perfectly feel the atmosphere of the city and relax while admiring the beautiful views.
along the promenade you will find a huge number of bars, restaurants, cafes, ice cream parlors and souvenir and handicraft shops. For those seeking sensations, Torrevieja offers the Aquapark,,Aquopolis,, and an amusement park close to the promenade. In the summer season, summer discos in the open air are also very popular, where thousands of people have fun here.
Torrevieja is an ideal place for people practicing all kinds of sports. There are many sports facilities, football fields, handball, tennis, rugby, swimming pools, as well as gyms and a boxing club.
Although today the city impresses with its architecture and sometimes splendour, until 1802 there was only one building here, i.e. the observation tower, from which the city got its name. Torre vieja means old tower in Polish.
If you add to this the fact that for over 300 days a year there is beautiful and sunny weather here, you get a place that is tempting to stay here for much longer than just a few days of vacation.

After visiting the city center, your next stop is Orito, the pilgrimage district of Monforte del Cid, home to the 16th century church and convent of San Pascual and the Virgin of Orito, as well as the Cueva de Saint Pascual. You can walk there and admire the amazing views of the place. There is a fantastic pilgrimage to this place in May!
In terms of relaxation, in addition to the excellent golf courses, in Monforte del Cid you will have the opportunity to join the wonderful Moorish and Christian festivals taking place in December. Be sure to try the excellent bagged grapes with the Vinalopó designation of origin, anise and liqueurs, also protected by the Regulatory Board, as well as pastas and cakes.

Calpe, located in the north of the Costa Blanca, is a city that really has it all. With beautiful sandy beaches, crystal clear waters and lush vegetation, Calpe is a paradise for nature lovers. The city also boasts a rich cultural heritage, with charming streets, historic monuments and lively local markets.
Take a walk along the promenade and enjoy the stunning views of the Mediterranean or visit the famous Peñon de Ifach rock formation that rises from the sea like a natural fortress. For those who enjoy outdoor activities, Calpe has plenty to offer, from hiking and biking to water sports and fishing.
Calpe is quite well known for its value fish restaurants as well as its amazing surroundings full of diverse vineyards hidden between the mountains.
Swimming in Calpe's turquoise waters, which are well known for their purity, is amazing. There are 14 bays and beaches to choose from along the coastline, which runs for 13 km. This beach, approximately 950 meters long, has clear waters and fine golden sand. It is a long, clean beach with plenty of bars and cafes with Blue Flag status. It is backed by a wide promenade where you can sit and there is a playground for children on the beach.

The museum features a range of exhibits and displays that showcase the history of Torrevieja's salt industry, which has been an integral part of the town's economy for centuries. Visitors can learn about the process of salt production, the role of salt in local cuisine and culture, and the ways in which the industry has shaped the town's development.

Location
Altea in Spain is considered one of the most beautiful cities. Beautiful beaches and promenades, whitewashed houses with colorful pots, narrow cobblestone streets, small craft shops, ice cream parlors and open-air restaurants are not all that this picturesque city has to offer.
Altea is a 10-minute drive north of Benidorm (approximately 10 km), approximately 1 hour from Alicante, and is one of the most memorable coastal towns on the Costa Blanca, retaining its unmistakable Spanish charm despite increasing tourism and popularity. Altea is located directly by the sea, in the middle of a beautiful bay and is surrounded by hilly mountains. The name comes from the Moorish "Althaya", which means "health for all".
The town center is a treasure trove of shops, art galleries, restaurants and small whitewashed buildings adorned with flowers - all waiting to be explored along the winding and cobbled medieval streets.
The old town of Altea is preserved in a typically Spanish, you could say Andalusian atmosphere. The whitewashed houses are a blank canvas for Mediterranean flower beds. No wonder Altea attracts artists and photographers from all over the world who want to experience the city's charm, incredible light and natural beauty. From cobbled streets, stunning sea and mountain views, to historic buildings.
Countless steps of narrow, charming streets lead from the coast to the viewpoint of Altea. In the 16th century, the upper part of the old town of Altea was built to protect the town from attacks. The castle was built on what is now Plaza de la Iglesia, and the upper part of the city was surrounded by a wall with three gates. The icon of the city is the famous Virgin de Consuelo church with its blue dome on top - it's truly remarkable and the view from the top over Altea Bay with the mountains in the background is simply spectacular! The dome is a kind of symbol of the divinity of this city. Altea is a city that is visually beautiful, atmospheric and incredibly charming! The mood here is hard to describe in words. The church was built in the 19th century with a magnificent interior with classic gold and floral motifs.
Altea's location at the foot of the 1,100-meter-high Sierra Bernia mountain, with its highest peak at 1,129 meters, and the 1,500-meter Sierra Aitana to the west, creates a "magical" atmosphere in the area. The mountain protects against the cold winds from the hinterland. The mountainside lies like a green oasis down to the fertile lowlands and the sea. The river that flows through the city and thanks to which it is here is called Algar, which means healing river.
Altea and other towns in the north are among the greenest and most fertile areas of the entire Costa Blanca. Oranges and many exotic fruits are grown here.

Dénia is located on the east coast of Spain, between Valencia and Alicante. To get there by car, take the A7 motorway from Valencia or Alicante. It takes about an hour by car from both cities. Both Valencia and Alicante have international airports.
Among the many tourist resorts on the Costa Blanca, Dénia is one of the most attractive. It is not only the beautiful beaches for which the 'White Coast' is famous, but also a beautiful historic center, an extraordinary artistic heritage, an active yacht port and a spectacular natural environment.
The landscape of Dénia is dominated by the imposing silhouette of the Montgó, a mountain 800 meters high, located a short distance from the coast. Together with the surrounding area, it forms the El Montgó Nature Reserve, where we can meet 650 different species of plants and rich fauna (eagles, peregrine falcons, owls, foxes, wild boars, females). The protected area offers many paths that are worth exploring by bike or on foot.
The city's large and impressive port serves all routes between Dénia and the islands of the Balearic archipelago. It serves ferry connections throughout the year, and in the summer the number of passengers using the services is exceptionally high. For many tourists who spend their holidays in this city, the idea of a day trip to the amazing beaches of Ibiza, Mallorca or Formentera is simply perfect.

There is also a smaller port in the city, Mollet d'Espanya, where smaller boats and private yachts moor.

The interior layout of this modern residence invites you to enjoy the house, both in a private and family way, as well as in a more open and social way. Make your dream come true and live in this modern, timeless villa with an optimal, perfectly designed layout, with the highest utility values and enjoy the Mediterranean climate offered by the Costa Blanca coast.
Location
Cumbre del Sol is located in the town of Benitachell, between Javea (20 minutes) and Moraira (15 minutes), in the north of the province of Alicante. This luxurious district stretches over the coastal cliffs with the famous Morach beach and small coves. Rising majestically atop cliffs, this idyllic residential area reveals breathtaking landscapes and a charming, laid-back charm that captivates all who venture here.
A paradise of pristine beaches awaits you, each exuding its own unique charm. Cala del Moraig tempts with crystal clear waters and dramatic cliffs, a paradise for snorkelers and divers who want to discover underwater wonders. Surrounded by rocky cliffs, Playa de Los Tiestos provides a peaceful escape for those longing for quiet days by the sea. Discover the hidden oasis of Cala Llebeig at the end of a scenic hike, a sanctuary of tranquility and untouched beauty.
For nature lovers, Cumbre del Sol offers a network of hiking trails that invite you to immerse yourself in the rugged beauty of the region. Meanwhile, the Ruta del Faro' (Lighthouse Trail) leads to the iconic Cap d'Or Lighthouse, a symbol of maritime heritage offering a sense of history and wonder.
Water lovers find their happiness amidst the calm waters of the nearby bays, indulging in kayaking, paddleboarding and sailing, adding an extra layer of charm to this seaside haven.

Location
Located on the picturesque Costa Blanca, in the northern part of Alicante province, lies the charming seaside town of Jávea (also known as Xàbia). With its prime location on the Mediterranean coast and a wide bay protected on two sides by stone promontories, Jávea has become a popular destination for tourists, with a significant population of 35,000 foreigners who have made this town their home. In fact, Jávea is renowned for having the world's most favorable microclimate, second only to Rio de Janeiro.
Visitors can enjoy breathtaking views from the village of Jávea, which offers panoramic vistas of the coast of Ibiza, located approximately 90 kilometers away. A visit to the highest point in the area, Mount Montgo, which stands over 750 meters tall, is a must for tourists seeking a bird's-eye view of the city and the surrounding islands of Portichol and Ambolo.
Beach lovers can indulge in the sun and sea at popular beaches such as Arenal, Sardinella, Granadella, and Barraca. In addition to swimming, sunbathing, and diving in the crystal-clear waters, Jávea's city center offers visitors the chance to explore charming historic tenement houses, churches, atmospheric restaurants, and shops, as well as many service points where one can easily communicate in various foreign languages. Don't miss the picturesque seaside passage that offers a stunning panorama of the Mediterranean Sea.
The town's fishing port is also a must-see, offering fresh seafood such as shrimp, squid, and sardines caught daily between Jávea and Ibiza. The nearby sailing club is another popular spot, showcasing impressive yachts and motorboats owned by enthusiasts from all over Europe.
In the extensive Montanar district, visitors can enjoy sandy, pebbly, or rocky beaches, as well as famous chiringuitos beach bars offering exotic drinks throughout the season. The district is dotted with representative single-family houses in traditional style, covered with tiles and furnished with arcades, glass, and concrete. properties.description:
Luxury sea view villa for sale in Altea, Costa Blanca.
Stunning, newly built villa located in the prestigious urbanization of Altea, is an ideal investment
for people who appreciate a great location and beautiful, natural surroundings. The development offers unparalleled views of the mountains, the sea and the stunning panorama of Benidorm. This exquisite home is a fantastic opportunity to live in luxury on the beautiful Costa Blanca, enjoying all the benefits this area has to offer.
Open and bright spaces and large floor-to-ceiling windows with a minimalist design allow access to daylight throughout the day, blurring the boundary between the interior and exterior of the building. All rooms have been designed with attention to detail. The use of natural materials and colors plays an important role in this project, causing that, despite its modernity, the interiors are very cozy and blend in perfectly with the natural surroundings.
This fantastic residence spread over three floors has 4 spacious bedrooms and as many as 5 bathrooms.
On the ground floor there is a large living room with a seating area with an open kitchen and dining area and a large bedroom with a bathroom. At the back of the property you will find a large terrace with an infinity pool, where you can relax in the Spanish sun all day long.
On the first floor of this unique investment there is a night area offering privacy for the household members. There are two main bedrooms, all with private, elegant bathrooms and built-in wardrobes. From all rooms we have direct access to the terrace, from which we can admire beautiful views.
There are two parking spaces in the basement. On the same level there is an additional guest bedroom with a private bathroom and built-in wardrobe. There is also a laundry room and a utility room.
The property has a really large outdoor area with a swimming pool, ideal for cooking and having outdoor parties. There is also a barbecue area and a really large sun terrace where you can enjoy the Spanish sun most of the year. By stairs or lift you can reach the spacious solarium with amazing panoramic views of the mountains and the sea and the hills of Altea.
Location
Altea in Spain is considered one of the most beautiful cities. Beautiful beaches and promenades, whitewashed houses with colorful pots, narrow cobblestone streets, small craft shops, ice cream parlors and open-air restaurants are not all that this picturesque city has to offer.
Altea is a 10-minute drive north of Benidorm (approximately 10 km), approximately 1 hour from Alicante, and is one of the most memorable coastal towns on the Costa Blanca, retaining its unmistakable Spanish charm despite increasing tourism and popularity. Altea is located directly by the sea, in the middle of a beautiful bay and is surrounded by hilly mountains. The name comes from the Moorish "Althaya", which means "health for all".
The town center is a treasure trove of shops, art galleries, restaurants and small whitewashed buildings adorned with flowers - all waiting to be explored along the winding and cobbled medieval streets.
The old town of Altea is preserved in a typically Spanish, you could say Andalusian atmosphere. The whitewashed houses are a blank canvas for Mediterranean flower beds. No wonder Altea attracts artists and photographers from all over the world who want to experience the city's charm, incredible light and natural beauty. From cobbled streets, stunning sea and mountain views, to historic buildings.
Countless steps of narrow, charming streets lead from the coast to the viewpoint of Altea. In the 16th century, the upper part of the old town of Altea was built to protect the town from attacks. The castle was built on what is now Plaza de la Iglesia, and the upper part of the city was surrounded by a wall with three gates. Currently, only two of these gates exist - Vell Portal and Portal Nou.
The icon of the city is the famous Virgin de Consuelo church with its blue dome on top - it's truly remarkable and the view from the top over Altea Bay with the mountains in the background is simply spectacular! The dome is a kind of symbol of the divinity of this city. Altea is a city that is visually beautiful, atmospheric and incredibly charming! The mood here is hard to describe in words. The church was built in the 19th century with a magnificent interior with classic gold and floral motifs.
Altea's location at the foot of the 1,100-meter-high Sierra Bernia mountain, with its highest peak at 1,129 meters, and the 1,500-meter Sierra Aitana to the west, creates a "magical" atmosphere in the area. The mountain protects against the cold winds from the hinterland. The mountainside lies like a green oasis down to the fertile lowlands and the sea. The river that flows through the city and thanks to which it is here is called Algar, which means healing river.
Altea and other towns in the north are among the greenest and most fertile areas of the entire Costa Blanca. Oranges and many exotic fruits are grown here.

properties.title: Luxury apartments 700m from the beach in La Mata, Torrevieja
properties.summary: New build apartment for sale in Torrevieja, Alicante: 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 78 m² built. From €330,000.
properties.description:
Apartament for sale in La Mata.
Welcome to this brand-new haven, where your dream home is nestled amidst a prime location and modern comforts that set a new standard for living.
Just a short 700-meter stroll from the untouched beauty of La Mata beach, this isn't just a place to live—it's your passport to a beachside way of life. And with a vibrant shopping hub right next door, filled with a variety of stores and a big supermarket, everything you need is literally just around the corner.
This community is home to 362 carefully crafted residences, spread over two beautifully planned phases. We're kicking things off with the first block of Phase I, showcasing 50 luxurious apartments, each with 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. And for those who crave a bit more, our penthouses come with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms.
For those on the ground floor, you'll have your very own garden—a perfect little sanctuary for some downtime. Meanwhile, our penthouses offer a taste of the high life, complete with a spacious private solarium, where you can soak in the mesmerizing views of the deep blue sea and the scenic beauty around.
Every home here comes with spacious front terraces that face the southeast, giving you a front-row seat to the sea's magic. Plus, you'll have a view of our lush gardens and tempting swimming pools that are the heart of our community.
Safety and beauty go hand in hand here. Our residential space is safely tucked away, adorned with green patches and the charm of Mediterranean gardens. Dive into one of our two adult pools or let the kids splash around in their own pool. And for those fitness enthusiasts, our state-of-the-art gym awaits.
Thinking green? We've got you covered with dedicated parking spots for both bikes and cars, encouraging eco-friendly travel and building a close-knit community vibe.
Location
La Mata nestled along the sun-kissed coastline of Spain's Costa Blanca, is a picturesque town that promises a blend of natural beauty, rich history, and modern amenities. Just a stone's throw away from the bustling city of Alicante, La Mata offers a serene escape for both residents and visitors.
One of the major advantages of La Mata is its proximity to Alicante Airport. Located just about 40 kilometers away, the journey between the airport and La Mata can be comfortably covered in under an hour. This makes La Mata an easily accessible destination for international travelers, looking for a tranquil beachside retreat.
La Mata boasts some of the best beaches in the region. The main beach, Playa de La Mata, stretches over 2 kilometers and is known for its golden sands and clear waters. It's a perfect spot for sunbathing, building sandcastles, or indulging in water sports. For those who prefer a quieter atmosphere, Cala del Mojón offers a more secluded beach experience, away from the crowds.
Beyond the beaches, the town has plenty to offer. The La Mata Natural Park is a haven for nature lovers. This protected wetland area is home to diverse flora and fauna, and the saltwater lagoons here are a sight to behold, especially during sunset. For those with a penchant for history, the Torre del Moro, a historic watchtower, offers panoramic views of the coastline and serves as a testament to the town's rich past, having once served as a lookout point against pirate invasions. Another architectural marvel is the Church of the Immaculate Conception, located in the heart of the town, which stands as a beautiful example of Spanish architecture and offers a peaceful place for reflection.
Food enthusiasts will not be disappointed either. The town is dotted with numerous restaurants and tapas bars offering local and international cuisines. A visit to La Mata is incomplete without trying the region's specialty dishes and wines. Additionally, the vibrant local culture comes alive at the weekly Wednesday market, where visitors can find everything from fresh produce to handmade crafts.
In conclusion, La Mata is more than just a beach town. It's a destination that offers a rich tapestry of experiences, from its pristine beaches to its historic landmarks. Whether you're a history buff, a nature enthusiast, or someone simply looking to relax by the beach, La Mata has something to offer for everyone.

properties.title: Prestigious gated community of private homes in Finestrat
properties.summary: New build villa for sale in Finestrat, Alicante: 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 160 m² built, 325 m² plot, pool. From €495,000.
properties.description:
For sale exclusive detached villa in Finestrat.
Introducing a brand new residential complex of private villas located in a privileged area of the beautiful city of Finestrat. The investments are located just 5 minutes by car from the beautiful beaches of Benidorm. It is a magical place located between the mountains and the sea - a real paradise for lovers of water sports and mountain trips.
This exclusive estate offers the highest quality security and privacy systems in each property, based on 4 main points:
- Existence of 1 entrance and 1 exit, both guarded 24 hours
- Boundary limited only to the river Alfarelles de la Tapiada, the surrounding pine forest and its own
inner streets; meaning owner access is completely private and all properties are part of a residential complex.
- All houses are designed and built with security cameras and alarm systems
- The resort is equipped with its own security vehicle that monitors the sector 24 hours a day.
This intimate estate has been designed with the privacy of its residents in mind. The minimal building density means that each house has a spacious plot with a private swimming pool, lounge area and parking space. The villas are very characteristic, built of the highest quality materials, including local stone. They are distinguished by their elegance and simplicity, and the innovative architecture of this resort makes nature and comfort come together, giving residents a sense of harmony with the world around them.
Location
Finestrat is a charming and picturesque town located in the province of Alicante, in the Valencian Community of Spain. It is just 8 km from the popular, large city of Benidorm and 40 km from Alicante and its international airport. Known for its stunning mountain views, pristine beaches and rich cultural heritage, Finestrat is the perfect destination for anyone looking for a relaxing and memorable experience. There is no shortage of exciting things to do in Finestrat.
Finestrat is located on the slopes of the Puig Campana mountain, offering stunning views of the mountains, coast and Mediterranean Sea. The town has a typical Moorish feel, with colorfully painted houses and narrow cobbled streets. On the other hand, Cala Finestrat is becoming more and more popular, and its development has made it almost an extension of Benidorm itself.
inch Finestrat
Cala Finestrat is a seaside resort just three kilometers from busy Benidorm. The resort offers adequate facilities, a large selection of restaurants, bars and shops. Everything you need is available in Benidorm, which is easily accessible by bus and taxi.
La Cala beach is quite quiet, as most people who want a more upbeat atmosphere head to the beaches surrounding Benidorm. The beach is a clean strip of golden sand, ideal for children and safe for swimming. There are several lovely restaurants along the promenade and there is an arts and crafts market in the afternoon during the summer months.
The place is suitable for families and couples looking for a relaxing beach resort, yet close to many attractions and amenities.
Nearby are the theme parks of Terre Mitica and Terra Natura, the Aqualandia water park and the Mundomar marine and exotic animal park, offering fun for the whole family.
And if you prefer to spend your holiday golfing one or two rounds, Finestrat will be pleased with the nearby Real Faula Golf Club, which offers two excellent golf courses.
Both Finestrat and Cala Finestrat are quiet destinations compared to some of the neighboring resorts. Both offer a selection of local bars and restaurants where you can enjoy good food and a relaxed atmosphere.

The city of Marbella is a seaside resort synonymous with prestige and luxury. This elite city has been attracting the attention of investors and tourists from all over the world for many years, and its inseparable element are spectacular estates worth over PLN 100 million.
Currently, the most prestigious and therefore most desirable locations include:
Golden Mile The Golden Mile is one of the most beautiful and luxurious avenues in Spain, which is also the symbol of Marbella. Here there are legendary hotels and dazzling properties, including: a scaled-down replica of the White House, built by the late king of Saudi Arabia. The Golden Mile is an over 6-kilometer long avenue lined with classic and modern villas surrounded by lush vegetation. It is an ideal place to invest capital, especially in times of rampant inflation.
La Zagaleta You can't ignore this complex. It is located in an extraordinary setting by the lake, between the sea and the mountains. On a huge area that could accommodate up to 4,000 people. real estate, there are only 400 residences, inhabited, among others, by by people from the front pages of newspapers. However, La Zagaleta's excellent security guarantees full discretion and the comfort of a peaceful holiday at home on the Costa del Sol.
Puerto Banús one of the most luxurious marinas in Spain, located between Marbella and San Pedro Alcantara. People who managed to buy a property in Puerto Banús are undoubtedly real lucky people! Here you will find designer boutiques from all over the world, the best restaurants, spectacular yachts and a sculpture by Salvador Dalí!
Nature fans will also love visiting the Bonsai Museum.
It is the first museum in Spain dedicated to bonsai trees. It was founded in 1992, and its collection includes the most valuable bonsai specimens in Europe, some of which are 200, 300 or even 400 years old! A visit to the Museo del Bonsai is a great opportunity to relax and commune among the most beautiful works created by nature. In addition to the permanent exhibition, the museum also organizes educational workshops to better understand the art of caring for bonsai trees.

For lovers of good cuisine, there are wonderful restaurants, prestigious restaurants offering cuisine from all over the world. Owners who purchase the apartment will be able to enjoy in the residence an HD home theater with the latest image and sound technology, a gym, a Premium wine bar, a social club, a business center and a complete SPA that will have a thermal zone, jacuzzi, sauna, Turkish bath and showers with hydromassage. For those who enjoy outdoor life, they can enjoy two outdoor swimming pools, including one infinity pool with panoramic sea views; second base with a bar.
It is a gated complex with concierge service and security control with cameras monitoring 24 hours a day.
Location
Mijas has the typical appearance of a white Andalusian town, stretching on the slope of a mountain range and its white houses contrast starkly with the green of the pine trees, offering a beautiful picture of the most beautiful on the coast. is located several kilometers from the coast, from the well-known town of Fuengirola. The nearest metropolis is Malaga, approximately 35 km away. It is a similar distance from the city of Marbella. Mijas is about half an hour by car from Malaga airport.
It is one of the largest towns in the province of Malaga consisting of 3 different districts: Mijas Pueblo, Mijas Costa and Mijas la Cala. The most popular, attracting numerous tourists and fans of Andalusian white villages, are Mijas Pueblo.
The white houses located several kilometers from the coast look from a distance as if they were glued to the mountain slope. The town tries to preserve the atmosphere of a traditional, white, Andalusian village.
Mijas la Cala offers many interesting pubs and restaurants where you can refresh yourself with cool sangria or tapas, or eat typical Andalusian dishes, such as gazpacho or seafood dishes. However, La Cale de Mijas does not live only in Andalusian cuisine. You will also find Greek and Chinese restaurants here, as well as one Thai and several Indian restaurants.
One of the more popular places in La Cala de Mijas is Legends Bar La Cala. You can not only drink good drinks and eat something nice here, but above all you can spend a truly fantastic evening listening to live music. It is an intimate place where thematic events are often held. The place has good opinions among tourists and it is worth stopping by at least for a moment.
Mijas Pueblo is a multicultural town whose inhabitants are mostly foreigners. The Andalusian town is also called the kingdom of golf. Mijas Pueblo is famous primarily for its unusual taxis operated by donkeys. The idea was born in the 1960s, when tourists began to accost residents returning from work in quarries, whose transport consisted of donkeys. Their popularity was used to explore the city, which is why it is still one of the forms of 'taking a ride' and viewing the city.
Mijas Pueblo also offers visitors interesting museums: El Carromato de Mijas (collection of miniatures), The Mill, Casa Museo de la Villa (historical-ethnological museum), the interpretation center of the watchtowers of Torreón de La Cala and the Contemporary Art Center Museum (CAC Mijas).
In Mijas, it is worth visiting several observation decks, which offer a beautiful view of the coast and the town itself. One of the most famous is located on Avenida del Compas, right next to the sanctuary of the patron saint of Mijas. The second point with a panorama can be found in the Gardens on the Walls (Jardin de las Murallas).
Another unusual attraction of the town is the Mayan Monkey Mijas Chocolate Factory, called the smallest chocolate factory in the world, at Plaza Virgen de la Peña 15. In addition to producing chocolate from natural, local products, it is also famous for its workshops where you can produce your own chocolate.

For sale luxury villa in La Alqueria, Benahavis.
This wonderful design with a modern style combined with timeless elegance allows you to live close to nature and enjoy its beauty from every corner of your home. Upon entering the property, we find ourselves in a hall with a double ceiling. Passing through the corridor you will enter a large lounge with an amazing view of the infinity pool, facing the golf course. To the right is the dining area and a fully equipped designer kitchen. On this level there is also a guest apartment with access to the garden.
Going to the first floor, you will find three more bedrooms - en suit, including the master bedroom, which has a luxurious bathroom and dressing room. All bedrooms on this level have access to a large terrace overlooking the golf course towards the sea.
On the basement level there is a 2-bedroom guest suite, as well as a spacious gym and games room that can also be used as a home theater. From this level you can also get to the internal garage, where there is a state-of-the-art 9 kW solar battery.
Perhaps the most impressive feature of this residence is the plot of land with an impressive 2,445 m2, which is hard to find in this particular location. Spacious grounds to the east and west.
There is a fully equipped kitchen with barbecue facilities, an outdoor dining area and relaxation areas that can be used all year round.
The infinity pool is an impressive feature of this residence and provides a sense of peace and tranquility in the garden.
The La Alqueria area is very close to popular golf courses such as Atalaya Golf, as well as all the popular destinations in Marbella, Nueva Andalucia, Benahavis and Estepona. The transfer time to Málaga International Airport is just 45 minutes, and local supermarkets and services are less than 5 minutes' drive away.
Location
Benahavís is a mountain town in the province of Málaga, 7 km from the coast. It lies between Marbella, Estepona and Ronda, on the West Coast of the Costa del Sol. It is popular for its wide range of restaurants and as a white city with a typical Arab street layout. Within Benahavis there is one of the most exclusive estates in Spain - La Zagaleta. According to data from the Tax Office, in 2018 Benahavís was the first municipality in the province of Málaga in terms of gross income and the fourth in Andalusia, thanks to La Zagaleta.
Golf courses
The golf courses in Benahavis have been designed by world class golf course designers such as Robert Trent Jones or Severiano Ballesteros or Jack Niclaus. In Benahavis, the golf season lasts all year round. The mild climate, great infrastructure, excellent restaurants attract fans of this sport from all over the world. You can play in 12 clubs, including Los Flamingos Golf Club, La Quinta Golf & Country Club, La Zagaleta and Club de Golf Benahavís. The greenery of the golf courses is an inseparable element of the Benahavis landscape. This is another reason why property investors in Spain choose Benahavis.
Restaurants
Benahavis is also famous for the best restaurants in Andalusia. We recommend visiting one of them: El Abanico, Bodegon Gallery, Rufino or Lemon Grass. El Abanico serves local and European cuisine, including vegetarian dishes. Same with Bodegon Gallery and Rufino. If you feel like Asian cuisine, it's best to visit Lemon Grass - the local Thai chef specializes in Asian Fusion, and the restaurant itself is called the best Asian cuisine on the Costa del Sol.
A place full of possibilities
It is impossible not to like Benahavis, it is a perfect place to relax, meet friends in restaurants and cafes or on the golf course. It is also a great base for hiking, cycling and swimming. Art lovers will also find something for themselves here: in David Marschall's gallery you can buy beautiful sculptures inspired by nature, combined with ready-made items - turning chips, railway sleepers. The artist creates abstract sculptures, figures that are a combination of ceramics, glass and metal, wood and other materials.

Location
Marbella is culture, relaxation and splendor. It is one of the most exclusive cities in the Mediterranean and the pride of the Costa del Sol. Twenty-eight kilometers of coastline, four marinas, fourteen golf courses and a privileged climate make it incomparable to other cities in this region.
A visit to Marbella is a unique experience. From shopping in luxury boutiques to dining in fine restaurants, partying at beach clubs and practicing every type of sport, the possibilities are endless. Although if relaxation is the most important thing, the city has numerous health and beauty centers and a wide and exclusive hotel offer in three main centers: Marbella, San Pedro de Alcántara and Nueva Andalucía-Puerto Banús.
Marbella is not only about luxury and wealth; it also offers green areas to explore. Alameda Park, dating back to the 18th century, covers much of the city center and boasts a variety of plant species, including the impressive Ficus Pandurata and Pinus Pinae. The Bonsai Museum, the first museum in Spain dedicated to bonsai, showcases valuable specimens that are up to 400 years old, providing a tranquil experience amidst the beauty of nature.
Lovers of good food will be delighted by a wide range of excellent restaurants offering cuisine from all over the world. Adventure seekers can try windsurfing, sailing or golf on the best courses, some of which are floodlit for night fun. For hikers, Mount La Concha provides an inspiring challenge, rewarding climbers with breathtaking views of Marbella. As one of the most established destinations, Estepona meets the requirements of almost all homebuyers who are looking for a luxurious lifestyle or simply an excellent investment opportunity.

The course is a jewel among the many courses located in southern Spain. The layout is seamlessly integrated into the natural Andalusian landscape, offering stunning views of both the Mediterranean Sea and the Sierra Bermeja mountain range. The 18 varied holes are accessible to all levels of play, but provide a fair challenge and an unforgettable game that will remain in players' memories for years to come.
Beaches

Some of the area's best beaches include Playa del Cristo, a sheltered cove with calm waters and a relaxing atmosphere, and Playa de la Rada, a vast stretch of golden sand offering a wide range of water sports. Playa del Saladillo is another fantastic option, known for its natural beauty and peaceful surroundings.
Culture
In addition to beautiful beaches, Estepona is also home to many attractions and activities. A must-see is the historic Old Town, known as Casco Antiguo. Wander the charming cobbled streets decorated with colorful flowerpots and learn about the city's rich cultural heritage. Admire traditional Andalusian architecture, visit the Church of San Luis, and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere of the bustling squares and bustling markets.
Sport
Estepona also offers a variety of outdoor activities for nature lovers. The nearby Sierra Bermeja mountain range provides excellent hiking opportunities, allowing you to immerse yourself in stunning natural landscapes and enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the coast. Golf enthusiasts will delight in the numerous world-class golf courses in the area where they can play against the backdrop of lush greenery and azure skies.

Your new investment features elegant design and has been built with pure luxury in mind and maintaining the highest quality standards. Location
Las Colinas Golf in Orihuela Costa is a famous destination that attracts golf enthusiasts and vacationers from all over the world. Situated on the south-east coast of Spain, this stunning location offers world-class golf courses and a range of attractions to suit every taste.
Las Colinas Golf & Country Club offers an idyllic Mediterranean lifestyle, complete with a wonderful climate, first-class facilities and excellent accessibility, which has earned it the title of Leading Villa Resort in Spain and Europe' by the esteemed World Travel Awards on numerous occasions.
In the heart of the valley lies the championship golf course, an award-winning gem that has been awarded 'Best Golf Course in Spain' by the World Golf Awards five times and was named among the 100 best golf courses in Europe by Golf Latest World Magazine's Top 100 rankings.
The luxurious experience of coexisting in perfect harmony with nature while enjoying high-quality services and first-class customer service make Las Colinas Golf & Country Club more than just a residence. Las Colinas Sports and Health Club offers a full range of services, including a gym for a day of exercise, a wonderful swimming pool and a wellness center where you can relax your mind and body.

The resort's four restaurants offer a wide range of gourmet dishes, from traditional Italian cuisine at il Palco to international cuisine with Mediterranean elements at unik and Japanese, Mexican and Peruvian cuisine at ,umawa. A few minutes from Las Colinas Golf & Country Club, on the first line of La Glea beach, there is WOW Beach, a paradise for lovers of sun, sand and sea, with the best Mediterranean cuisine.

The open living room perfectly combined with the modern kitchen create a spacious and bright living area with large sliding windows that connect to the front terrace offering a beautiful view. The bedrooms offer a peaceful refuge from the hustle and bustle of everyday life, with built-in wardrobes providing plenty of space to store all your belongings. The bathrooms are equally impressive, with elegant fixtures and finishes that create a spa-like atmosphere.
In addition to all the amenities of Lake Santa Rosalía, there is also a shared swimming pool with a solarium area just for the apartments. A private parking space is included in the price.
Location
Santa Rosalía Lake & Life Resort Murcia is located 35 km from Murcia and 19 km from La Manga del Mar Menor. The nearest airport is Murcia International Airport, 22 km away.
Mediterranean living at its best: Santa Rosalia Lake & Life Resort seeks to redefine the concept of luxury living, providing fantastic accommodation options for the whole family in a five-star complex with a total area of approximately 700,000 square meters.
Approximately 120,000 m2 of landscaped land with various sports and recreation centers, 16,000 native Mediterranean trees and plants, an impressive swimming lake and a beach with facilities for water sports, paddle boarding and kayaking. Highly secure, has access control and security services.
Beach Club
The Beach Club is the perfect place to meet to hang out or dine at the resort. Santa Rosalia Beach Club offers spectacular views of the lake and beach, a terrace for relaxing and a play and relaxation area for children and adults. It's the perfect place for a good cold beer, lunch, dinner or a glass of wine with friends.
This is where some of the resort's attractions are held, including beach volleyball, kayaking, Adventure Golf and Pentanque tournaments.
Recycling
Santa Rosalía has a waste separation system to collect paper and cardboard, packaging, plastic, glass and other types of waste. Little things mean a lot when it comes to changing the world. In our sales office we use cardboard cups and we make sure to reduce paper consumption and recycle it. This policy is especially important at the Beach Club.
Energy efficiency

properties.description:
Apartment for sale with sea view in Casares.
This amazing residential complex sits on a hillside in what is considered "Europe's Best Golf Resort" - Finca Cortesín in Casares. One of the many advantages of this extraordinary investment is the stunning views of the sea, the bay of Estepona and the Sierra Bermeja natural park.
Discover your new home located just 1 km from the beautiful beach in the prestigious Finca Cortesín urbanization. This intimate housing estate has 6 modern buildings that perfectly harmonize with the natural surroundings. Here you will find 51 wonderful apartments and penthouses, carefully designed, with open spaces and spectacular terraces and gardens. Each property has been finished turnkey with attention to every detail.
The houses on the ground floor have private gardens of up to 210 m², while the upper floors have impressive terraces of up to 168 m². All homes have a spacious, open plan that combines the kitchen and living room into one large, bright space. All apartments include a parking space and a storage room.
The common areas have also been designed to impress, with a large swimming pool for adults of almost 160 m2 and a second smaller one for children. Residents also have a fully equipped gym, spa and coworking area at their disposal.
One of the main features of this elite housing estate is its low population density. Small number of units in a large area; Thanks to this exclusivity, the estate offers apartments with large bedrooms and terraces. It is an innovative and contemporary architectural design, very visually attractive and stylish
and created so that all its residents could enjoy luxury and comfort every day.
Enjoy the peaceful surroundings and experience the privilege of living in Casares between Marbella and Sotogrande.
Location
Casares is one of the most beautiful white villages of Malaga on the Costa del Sol. It is located only 16 kilometers from Estepona and forms a typical postcard of the Andalusian city. The arrangement of the houses, very picturesque, earned it the name of the hanging city.
Casares' origins date back to Iberian and Phoenician times, although its name comes from Roman domination; in fact, the name Casares is influenced by the name of Julio Cesar, who in 61 BC visited the famous Baños Hediondos de Carratraca to cure himself of a skin disease using sulfuric waters, making the place very famous throughout Rome for its healing properties.
The steep and winding streets of Casares are the perfect place to relax, discover corners that don't appear in guidebooks, local craft shops and small town bars to stop at along the way.
Casares Castle
Situated at the top of the city, it towers over the valleys, hills and coastal plains stretching from the Serranía de Ronda to the Bay of Algeciras, providing a wonderful view of part of the provinces of Malaga and Cadiz. It is one of the most picturesque and beautiful corners of the commune, which is a must-see.
Hedionda Baths
They say the devil breathed his last here when he was banished by Santiago. This is one of the legends that the folk imagination keeps alive to justify the smell of sulfur in the waters. Known as Baños de la Hedionda, a resource of cultural importance, they constitute one of the historical landmarks of the Utrera massif and the whole of Casares in general. It is about the Iron Sulfur Baths, located in a beautiful and favorable place that people have been able to use since Roman times. The square spa complex with a hanging vault and two barrel vaults is located on the right bank of the Albarrán stream, very close to the border with the commune of Manilva.

properties.description:
Apartment for sale in Marbella.
Elite World Estates is proud to introduc an exceptional project unlike any other! Located right on the beachfront in Marbella's Las Chapas area, this development offers 96 spacious apartments and villas with stunning sea views. It's one of the last available plots in this prime location.
Situated just 4 kilometers east of Marbella's city center, residents can enjoy easy access to the vibrant gastronomic, cultural, and leisure attractions. Las Chapas is renowned for its beautiful beaches and glamorous beach clubs, making it a sought-after residential area.
The beachfront location of this project is truly special, as it's protected by a valuable dune reserve that acts as a natural barrier. You'll be surrounded by picturesque beaches and trendy beach clubs, creating a glamorous atmosphere.
Not only is the location ideal, but the project also offers convenient access to major transport routes, allowing residents to reach golf courses, sports clubs, and shopping centers within a short 15-minute drive.
The communal areas are equally impressive, with lush landscaping and two outdoor pools nestled amidst carefully manicured gardens. The elevated Social Club boasts innovative architecture and incredible features such as a fully equipped spa, gym, coworking area, outdoor exercise facilities, and a stunning indoor pool. The highlight is the breathtaking suspended infinity pool, offering panoramic views of the sea and mountains, accompanied by a stylish cocktail bar.
The residences themselves have been thoughtfully designed to offer a unique living experience. High-quality materials, spacious kitchens, private swimming pools, smart home features, and underfloor heating are just some of the luxurious amenities. Personalization options are available, allowing residents to customize their homes with the help of renowned interior designers.
Marbella's charm is well-known, attracting people from around the world with its pleasant climate and beautiful surroundings. Nestled at the base of the majestic "La Concha" mountain range, Marbella benefits from protection against cold winds and enjoys moderate summer temperatures thanks to its proximity to the Mediterranean Sea.
Loaction
Marbella, a captivating coastal gem nestled on the southern coast of Spain, is a world-renowned destination that exudes elegance, natural beauty, and a vibrant Mediterranean lifestyle. With its irresistible charm and idyllic location, Marbella has become synonymous with luxury living and a haven for sun-seekers and discerning travelers alike.
Situated along the stunning shores of the Mediterranean Sea, Marbella offers a plethora of pristine beaches that are nothing short of breathtaking. From the famous Golden Mile with its glamorous beach clubs and high-end resorts to the family-friendly beaches of San Pedro Alcántara, there is a beach to suit every preference. Bask in the glorious sunshine, take a refreshing dip in the azure waters, or simply relax on the soft sands while savoring the captivating coastal scenery.
Marbella is conveniently served by Málaga-Costa del Sol Airport, which is approximately a 40-minute drive away. This accessibility makes it an ideal destination for international visitors seeking a quick and seamless getaway.
Beyond its stunning beaches, Marbella offers a diverse range of attractions and activities. Explore the charming Old Town, known as the "Casco Antiguo," with its narrow streets, whitewashed buildings adorned with vibrant flowers, and delightful local shops and eateries. The historic Plaza de los Naranjos (Orange Square) is a must-visit, featuring a picturesque square surrounded by inviting cafes and restaurants.
Golf enthusiasts will be in paradise, as Marbella is a golfer's dream destination with numerous world-class golf courses dotting the landscape. Whether you're a seasoned player or a novice looking to improve your swing, you'll find exceptional golfing opportunities to suit all skill levels.
For those seeking a taste of culture, Marbella offers an array of art galleries, museums, and cultural events throughout the year. Explore the contemporary exhibitions at the Museo Ralli or immerse yourself in the history of Andalusia at the Bonsai Museum.
Indulge in the vibrant nightlife scene, where chic bars, stylish clubs, and trendy beachfront venues come alive after sunset. Experience the infectious energy and dance the night away in the glamorous Puerto Banús area, known for its luxury yachts, designer boutiques, and buzzing nightlife.
Nature enthusiasts can venture into the nearby Sierra de las Nieves Natural Park, a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, where scenic hiking trails lead to breathtaking vistas and hidden waterfalls. The stunning backdrop of the Sierra Blanca mountain range provides a dramatic contrast to the azure waters of the Mediterranean Sea.
Marbella effortlessly blends the charm of a traditional Andalusian town with the sophistication of a cosmopolitan resort. Its world-class restaurants serve up a tantalizing array of international and traditional Spanish cuisine, satisfying even the most discerning palates.

Modern flat for sale in San Miguel de Salinas.
This modern residential complex consists of 165 flats spread over 7 floors of the building. The beautiful sandy beaches for which the San Miguel de Salinas area is famous are just a 10-minute drive from the residence, as is the fantastic Zenia Boulevard shopping centre. This development is ideal for those looking for flats that are affordable yet not far from all the services and the sea they need.
We have a choice of flats with 2 or 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms.
The flats have a spacious living room with access to a sunny terrace or balcony,
master bedroom with fitted wardrobes and en-suite bathroom, a second bedroom with fitted wardrobes
and guest bathroom, and an open-plan kitchen with modern appliances included in the price.
Each property has a private space in the underground car park and a storage room.
This is a very private, fully gated residential complex with extensive common areas.
There are beautiful gardens, swimming pools for adults and children, a green area for relaxing and sunbathing,
playground and an outdoor exercise area.
The upper floors can be accessed by lifts.
Property assets
- furnished kitchen,
- ceramic tiled floors,
- automatic external blinds,
- white wardrobes in the bedrooms,
- pre-installation of split type air-conditioning in the living room and in the bedrooms,
- aerothermal energy used (innovative heating and cooling system that uses ambient air as the main source of energy - 70% energy savings)
- private, gated community,
- extensive communal area with swimming pools and playground
- beautiful views
This complex is located on the Costa Blanca in San Miguel de Salinas close to golf courses,
the beach and all services such as supermarkets, bars, restaurants and shops.
Planned date of delivery : January 2025.
Location
San Miguel de Salinas is located 75 metres above sea level. It is the highest town in this area of the southern Costa Blanca. Several locations in San Miguel offer panoramic views of both the salt lakes of Torrevieja and the beaches of the Mediterranean.
But it is not so much the slightly elevated location as the central location that has prompted many Europeans to buy a home here in recent decades. The relaxed Mediterranean atmosphere makes San Miguel an authentic Spanish town where life moves slowly. The original inhabitants are the vast majority here. Most home buyers have found a home mainly in suburban urbanisations such as El Galan, Blue Lagoon, Blue Hills and Las Filipinas.
San Miguel's central location means it is only a short car ride to bustling Torrevieja, the beaches of the Orihuela Costa or any of the golf courses in the area. The town has many amenities such as restaurants, shops and international sports facilities. For a municipality of such limited size, the town has a very full calendar of festivals each year. The most famous of these is the fiesta in honour of the patron saint San Miguel, after whom the town and church are named. The most famous is the district where dozens of cave houses can still be found. Most of them are now used as shops, art workshops and even restaurants.

properties.description:
Villa for sale 800 m from the beach in Mil Palmeras, Torre de la Horadada.
Mil Palmeras is located in a privileged area of Torre de la Horadada. Its peace and proximity to the beach and all kinds of services make it an ideal location for relaxation and everyday life. It is here, just 800 m from the beautiful beach, that an intimate estate of twin villas in a Mediterranean style is being built. This is an ideal investment for those looking for one
a comfortable and spacious property in a quiet area.
It is a residential area designed to enjoy the Mediterranean climate. In addition, each villa has wonderful terraces, a solarium and a beautiful garden with a designer swimming pool. With an unrivaled orientation, close to the beach and within a consolidated urbanization with sports facilities and recreational areas.
This intimate project consisting of only 12 modern, semi-detached villas. The houses have large rooms spread over 2 floors. On the ground floor, connected to the garden, there is a bright living room with a dining room and kitchen, as well as a double bedroom and a bathroom. On the first floor there are a further 2 double bedrooms, each with its own bathroom. A fantastic solarium is an additional advantage of this unique investment, providing many possibilities for arranging the space.
Outside you will find a seating area with a private swimming pool, where you can enjoy the wonderful weather all year round. Additionally, the property has an external private parking space.
There are many amenities in the immediate vicinity such as: shopping malls, restaurants,
golf courses, beaches, sports areas, etc. From here we have easy access to the airports in Alicante and Murcia (Corvera).
Location
Mil Palmeras is a small coastal resort located between Dehesa de Campoamor and Torre de la Horadada in the south of the Costa Blanca. Mil Palmeras literally means "thousand palm trees" and is a quiet residential area that comes to life in the summer
Pilar de la Horadada is located in a privileged place in Vega Baja in Alicante, on the eastern part of the peninsula. It is the southernmost commune of the Valencian Community, bordering the Region of Murcia.
The coastline of Pilar de la Hordada is over 4 kilometers long along a very diverse scenery. There you will find wide beaches with fine white sand, small stone wall ledges suspended over the water and small and intimate hidden coves with golden sand.
The sea here is usually calm, the beaches are safe, there are no steep slopes, which allows even the smallest children to swim safely. Moreover, clear water and great visibility invite divers to observe the beauty of aquatic life. The cleanliness of the beaches in Pilar de la Hordada has been awarded the blue flag of the European Union, which guarantees a healthy environment.
Inland, you can make various interesting trips near the towns of Sierra and Escalona. There are two marked tourist routes along the Rio Seco riverbed, 19 kilometers long, definitely worth a visit. One of the routes is 4 kilometers long, while the other is 10 kilometers long, stretching from the natural area of Pilar de Campoverde to the mouth of Mil Palmeras beach.
There is also an 18-hole golf course in Lo Romero near the town of Pilar de la Horadada. Both professionals in this field and beginners will find a good place there.
Gastronomy has a privileged place in the culture of this beautiful city. Typical dishes of Pilar de la Hordada include potatoes with meat stew, meatballs, rabbit in garlic and Gachas Migas (flour, garlic pancake), as well as great rice dishes and soups. Sweets and cakes also deserve recognition here, confectionery such as meringue cake called 'milhojas' or almond sweets called 'cordiales' are the most popular.

properties.title: Ready, new appartments in Ciudad Quesada
