Finished, new appartments for sale in Ciudad Quesada.
Live in a modern, private estate and enjoy an excellent location in Ciudad Quesada. This is the perfect place for those wishing to enjoy the Mediterranean lifestyle in a quiet but very developed area, less than 10 minutes drive from the beach and 35 minutes from Alicante airport.
With all available services within walking distance. Whether you are looking for a reasonably priced flat for rent or a holiday residence for you and your family, this development in close proximity to nature and extensive infrastructure is sure to meet your expectations.
The new residential complex is located right in Doña Pepa, an elegant, prestigious urbanisation with wide avenues, magnificent views of the Natural Park and salt lakes. It is a charming place ideal for holidays as well as for everyday life.
Choose between ground floor flats with a private garden or ground floor flats with a spacious sun terrace. The property features a spacious living room with open-plan kitchen, 2 or 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms.
Its high-tech architecture blends perfectly with the predominant white colour, giving a feeling of harmony.
This magnificent residential residence also ofews a fantastic communal area with a beautiful swimming pool, surrounded by lush gardens that encourage relaxation and community.
Location
Ciudad Quesada is located in the south of the Costa Blanca, just 8 km north of the main town, Torrevieja. The nearby towns are Rojales and San Fulgencio. You can get to Ciudad Quesada directly from the nearby airport, where you will find quite a few connections. The city is only a 30-minute drive from Alicante Airport, which is well connected to major cities in Europe. Come and experience the best of the southern Costa Blanca in this vibrant city.
Beaches
The city is within easy walking distance of golden, sandy beaches, including El Moncayo en Guerdanar del Segura, and is surrounded by magnificent nature parks and picturesque landscapes.
La Mata Lagoon
Nature lovers and lovers of tranquillity like nothing more than to grab a rucksack, put on sports or comfortable shoes and head out. In Ciudad Quesada, you can go hiking in amazing places. There are many hiking trails, but one of the most engaging for nature lovers and those who enjoy birdwatching is a visit to the La Mata lagoon.
Golf
Golf enthusiasts can enjoy the prestigious La Marquesa Golf Club, which offers breathtaking views of the surrounding area. Meanwhile, nature lovers can visit the nearby salt lakes of Torrevieja, home to many species of birds. For those who want to .water.
History
The town has a rich history dating back to the early 18th century and has become a vibrant community with a unique mix of Spanish, British and other European cultures. In Ciudad Quesada you can experience the city's rural past in its charming old town, while the modern and cosmopolitan area around the city centre reflects its more recent development.
A ritual of beauty and relaxation
Another plan not to miss in Ciudad Quesada is to head to the spa and let someone take care of your wellbeing for the morning, afternoon or whole day. At the spa of Hotel la Laguna, you can enjoy the so-called ‘Circuit of the Senses’, through which you will gain access to a wellness area full of contrasts of heat and cold, a relaxation area and a jacuzzi with salt water, where you will work on all your senses through different areas: sight, smell, taste, touch and hearing. To relieve tension, you can enjoy a massage with bamboo or chocolate or take advantage of anti-stress therapy. You'll leave feeling as relaxed as ever. The Spa at Hotel La Laguna has an important advantage: you don't have to be a hotel guest to use its facilities.

properties.title: Design villa with amazing sea views in Benissa
properties.summary: New build villa for sale in Benissa, Alicante: 3 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, 770 m² built, 1,570 m² plot, pool, sea views. €4,300,000.
properties.description:
Sea view villa for sale in Benissa.
Make yourself at home in this unique investment, which is a real work of art, ideally suited to the mountain landscape that surrounds it. This is a truly unique, modern property and one of the most impressive new luxury villas available in the Benissa area. The location is ideal for those looking for a privileged position, modern comfort and a luxurious Mediterranean lifestyle.
This cozy design villa consists of 4 floors connected by an internal staircase and a lift.
On the basement level there is a very spacious garage with easy access from the street and a hall leading to an internal staircase and lift that connects all 4 floors.
Upon entering the villa you will be greeted by a bright and airy living and dining area with large windows and glass doors opening onto the terrace. The interior design is sleek and modern with a neutral color palette and high-quality finishes. A fully equipped kitchen is every cook's dream, with modern appliances and plenty of storage space.
The villa has four double bedrooms, each with its own bathroom. The bedrooms are spacious and comfortable with plenty of storage space and air conditioning. The bathrooms are modern and well-appointed with walk-in showers, elegant washbasin cabinets and elegant tiles.
The exterior spaces of the villa are truly stunning, with a large infinity pool (76.80m2) providing the perfect place to relax and soak up the sun. The pool is surrounded by a beautiful terrace with plenty of space to relax and dine al fresco. The well-kept garden is full of mature trees and Mediterranean plants, providing a peaceful and private atmosphere.
Location
Benissa is a picturesque town located in the northern part of the Costa Blanca region in Spain. The city is known for its stunning natural beauty, rich history and cultural heritage, and modern amenities that cater to both tourists and locals.
It is a place that inspires, above all, very well-preserved medieval architecture. While walking around the city, you will discover unique buildings and elegant palaces, see the traditional Lonja (trade exchange), the House of Culture and the Franciscan Monastery. There is also a monument to Riberero in the center of the city, dedicated to the inhabitants who migrated to Ribera Valenciana to harvest rice.
Around Benissa there are wonderful hiking trails that reveal breathtaking panoramas of the Mediterranean Sea. In addition, we also have amusement parks and many sports facilities within easy reach. Concerts and exhibitions await culture lovers. However, if you want to experience a typical Spanish fiesta, this place will not disappoint you either. Local festivals are held here in honor of the patron Purísim Xiquet, and in June, Moorish and Christian festivals are celebrated.
Benissa has four kilometers of coastline with some of the most beautiful bays of the Costa Blanca. Crystal clear waters are ideal for water sports such as diving, sailing, windsurfing and kayaking.
Playa la Fustera is by far the most famous and popular sandy beach of Benissa. The beach was awarded in the Blue Flag programme, which aims to promote environmental protection in seaside resorts, bathing areas and marinas. The beach is ideal for a family holiday: it is very easy to get to - both by car and by bus - there is parking available, as well as numerous showers and toilets. An additional advantage of the beach is the constant care of lifeguards in the season from June 15 to September 15, and two restaurants.
Another famous beach in this seaside town is Cala Baladrar. The picturesque bay offers unearthly views of Calpe and Peñon de Ilfach, while being easily accessible. The water is calm as the beach is sheltered from strong winds. Cala Baladrar is known for its shallow waters and rich marine fauna, so it will be an ideal place for diving enthusiasts. It is a small Mediterranean paradise - in season there is a beach bar where you can dine, drink a cocktail and listen to live music.
Benissa is the perfect place if you want to get away from the hustle and bustle of the coastal cities, but are still looking for an elegant villa or an exclusive apartment near the sea. The views of the Mediterranean Sea in this city speak for themselves, they will take your breath away.

properties.title: Ecological, detached villa in Benahavís, Marbella
properties.summary: New build villa for sale in Benahavís, Málaga: 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 514.71 m² built, 633.27 m² plot, communal pool, sea views. €1,890,000.
properties.description:
Ecological, detached villa for sale in Benahavís, Marbella.
It is an ideal, modern house for the 21st century, designed by a prestigious architectural studio. This detached 4 bedroom villa with panoramic sea views is located in a prestigious private estate in Benahavís.
We will find here only 13 unique, luxurious villas, built of durable and noble materials that perfectly harmonize with the beautiful, natural surroundings. They have a BREEAM certificate, which means that they have much lower operating costs, reduce the negative impact on the natural environment, and create an environment friendly to the health and broadly understood comfort of residents. By choosing to live in this villa, you give yourself the opportunity for a better, healthier and more comfortable life.
This luxurious residence is located on a private plot of 633 m2. It has a modern infinity swimming pool with
an area of 32 m2 and a spacious solarium on the roof with an area of 90 m2. Its big advantage are panoramic sea views from every level of the property. Thanks to the large windows, the property is very bright and well lit.
The villa has 4 spacious bedrooms, 3 fully equipped bathrooms, a modern, also equipped open kitchen
and a large living room with dining area. It is equipped with floor and zone heating
hot/cold air conditioning.
DISTANCES
- Beach 10 min
- Golf 10 min
- Airport 45 min
- Malls 10 min
QUALITIES
Quality is palpable in every detail in this place, its large-scale tile flooring, its Siematic designer kitchens with Neff appliances, bathrooms with free-standing Duravit bathtub, delicate taps or wall-hung toilet, water-heated floors, Wood and natural stones or Domotics are some of the details that make up the essence of your new home.
COMUNAL AREAS
Enjoy its more than 5,000 m2 of green spaces with Mediterranean gardens. orchards and pergolas. 500 m2 of pools and ponds, co-living area, rest and relaxation areas, viewpoints, It is a natural oasis surrounded by woods, fruit trees and flowers but, at the same time, it is located very near the cosmopolitan urban spots with all the services they offer. A return to organic and ecological, where you can enjoy your own garden and grow natural products, advised and managed by expert farmers. Connect your essence with nature.
Location
Benahavís is a mountain town in the province of Málaga, 7 km from the coast. It lies between Marbella, Estepona and Ronda, on the West Coast of the Costa del Sol. It is popular for its wide range of restaurants and as a white city with a typical Arab street layout. Within Benahavis there is one of the most exclusive estates in Spain - La Zagaleta. According to data from the Tax Office, in 2018 Benahavís was the first municipality in the province of Málaga in terms of gross income and the fourth in Andalusia, thanks to La Zagaleta.
Golf courses
The golf courses in Benahavis have been designed by world class golf course designers such as Robert Trent Jones or Severiano Ballesteros or Jack Niclaus. In Benahavis, the golf season lasts all year round. The mild climate, great infrastructure, excellent restaurants attract fans of this sport from all over the world. You can play in 12 clubs, including Los Flamingos Golf Club, La Quinta Golf & Country Club, La Zagaleta and Club de Golf Benahavís. The greenery of the golf courses is an inseparable element of the Benahavis landscape. This is another reason why property investors in Spain choose Benahavis.
Restaurants
Benahavis is also famous for the best restaurants in Andalusia. We recommend visiting one of them: El Abanico, Bodegon Gallery, Rufino or Lemon Grass. El Abanico serves local and European cuisine, including vegetarian dishes. Same with Bodegon Gallery and Rufino. If you feel like Asian cuisine, it's best to visit Lemon Grass - the local Thai chef specializes in Asian Fusion, and the restaurant itself is called the best Asian cuisine on the Costa del Sol.
A place full of possibilities
It is impossible not to like Benahavis, it is a perfect place to relax, meet friends in restaurants and cafes or on the golf course. It is also a great base for hiking, cycling and swimming. Art lovers will also find something for themselves here: in David Marschall's gallery you can buy beautiful sculptures inspired by nature, combined with ready-made items - turning chips, railway sleepers. The artist creates abstract sculptures, figures that are a combination of ceramics, glass and metal, wood and other materials.

For sale a finished flat with a large terrace in Guardamar del Segura.
Your new Spanish residence is located in one of the most beautiful areas of the Costa Blanca - south, in the picturesque village of Guardamar del Segura. This modern development has been built in a beautiful location right next to Las Lagunas de La Mata National Park, a protected natural area, an ideal place for relaxation and hiking.
It is a modern residential complex consisting of 175 extremely spacious flats with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and large terraces. The ground floor flats will have spacious gardens and the penthouses will have a private solarium on the roof of the building.
All flats will have an associated parking space in the underground car park. The flats have a modern finish and are built with the highest quality materials. They are ideal for those looking for a picturesque and unique place to live and relax.
A great asset of the development is the large, exclusive and extensive common areas, where you can relax in the large summer pool or the heated spa. Children will enjoy the large green park with playgrounds and adults will enjoy the gym with bio-healthy machines and ‘Putting Green’ golf.
Location
Guardamar lies in a strategic position in the hills surrounding the Vega Baja region.

and just 25 minutes from Alicante International Airport.
Within walking distance of Guardamar beaches, just a few minutes drive to other beaches,
such as La Marina, El Moncayo, Santa Pola and Torrevieja. Close to all amenities, schools,
shopping centres of Torrevieja, Orihuela Costa and sports centres. Close to major cities,
Such as Alicante, Murcia, Cartagena, Benidorm.
In Guardamar del Segura we not only have beaches, but also a wide range of tourist offers,
such as gastronomy, culture and history with archaeological sites, Phoenician,

all kinds of water sports in the ‘Puerto Marina de las Dunas’

properties.title: Ready penthouse in Guardamar del Segura
properties.summary: New build apartment for sale in Guardamar del Segura, Alicante: 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 101 m² built, 39 m² plot, sea views. €344,900.
properties.description:
Exquisite First Floor Apartment for Sale in Guardamar del Segura
Nestled in one of the most enchanting locations along the sun-kissed Costa Blanca South, the charming town of Guardamar del Segura is about to welcome a new residential gem. This exclusive development is poised in proximity to the pristine Las Lagunas de La Mata National Park, an area of natural beauty and tranquility, perfect for leisurely strolls and unwinding amidst nature's splendor.
This modern residential complex comprises a total of 175 thoughtfully designed apartments, each boasting three bedrooms, two bathrooms, and spacious terraces. The ground-floor residences offer generous gardens, while the penthouses crown the building with private sun terraces, providing breathtaking panoramic views.
Furthermore, every apartment includes the convenience of an underground parking space. The interiors are impeccably finished with a contemporary touch, featuring top-quality materials throughout. These residences are tailor-made for those seeking a unique and picturesque living environment that seamlessly combines aesthetics with relaxation.
One of the standout features of this investment opportunity is the expansive communal areas, meticulously crafted to elevate your lifestyle. Dive into the large summer swimming pool for refreshing dips or indulge in the heated spa for ultimate relaxation. Children will revel in the spacious green park replete with play areas, while adults can maintain their well-being at the well-equipped gym, featuring bio-healthy machines and even a "Putting Green" golf facility.
Anticipated for completion in September 2024, this exceptional residential complex promises a superior quality of life, where natural beauty meets modern convenience. Secure your place in this extraordinary haven today.
Location
Nestled amidst the rolling hills of the Vega Baja region, Guardamar del Segura stands as a beacon of natural beauty and historical significance. Easily accessible via the N-332 and the AP-7 autopista, it's a mere stone's throw away from renowned golf courses like La Marquesa and La Finca. And with Alicante International Airport just 25 minutes away, you're always connected to the world.
Discover Playa Los Viveros
Tucked away in Guardamar del Segura, Playa Los Viveros is a serene escape. Stretching over 1,300 meters and flanked by the region's signature nurseries, this beach is a testament to Guardamar's agricultural heritage. But it's not just about the sands; nearby lies the Rábita Califal, a relic from the Andalusian era. The beach's Blue Flag status is a nod to its pristine environment and commitment to safety.
What truly sets Playa Los Viveros apart is its untouched natural beauty. Set within a protected zone, the beach is a haven of lush greenery, characteristic of the region. The gentle shoals and calm waves make it perfect for a relaxed day out. And the journey to the beach? A tranquil walk through pine forests, with wooden pathways easing the descent onto the sandy shores.
But Guardamar is more than just beaches. Dive into a rich tapestry of history, from Phoenician to Roman eras. Explore the vibrant gastronomy, a blend of traditional flavors and modern twists. For the thrill-seekers, Puerto Marina de las Dunas offers a plethora of water sports, from sailing to windsurfing.
In essence, Guardamar del Segura is the Costa Blanca - South's crown jewel. A place where nature's tranquility meets modern amenities, offering a life that's truly the best of both worlds.

properties.title: Modern apartment near the sea in Estepona, Marbella
properties.summary: New build apartment for sale in Estepona, Málaga: 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 150 m² built, pool, sea views. €745,000.
properties.description:
Unique 3 bedroom apartment for sale in Estepona, Marbella
This innovative residential complex is being built in the prestigious area called "New Golden Mile" between Marbella and Estepona, just 7 minutes from Puerto Banus, on Spain's Costa del Sol. The residence will be just 500 m from the sea and close to golf courses, shops, bars and restaurants.
The estate is characterized by sophisticated architecture, and as standard in each apartment there is a Lutron wireless smart home automation system, the first in residential construction on the Costa del Sol.
Here you will find carefully designed, modern apartments with 2 and 3 bedrooms and penthouses with 3 and 4 bedrooms. Kitchens and bathrooms will be fully equipped with a choice of colors and materials. Flats on the lower floors have spacious gardens from 50 to 60 m2, while private penthouses, spacious sun terraces up to 209 m2. The estate will be closed and will have 24-hour security with monitoring
The extensive common area deserves special attention. Approximately 27,000 m2 of tropical, well-kept gardens with three outdoor swimming pools, one of which is heated. In addition, we will find a club with a coworking lounge, a cafe and an exclusive spa with an indoor swimming pool and a gym.
Additional advantages of the investment
- Traffic protection with a 24/7 control gate with monitoring
- A parking space will be allocated to each apartment (or two for each penthouse)
- One utility room with lighting and double electrical outlet for each unit
- Garage entrance with automatic opening mechanism and motion sensors on both sides
- Each garage has a pre-installed electric cable enabling the installation of charging an electric car
- Entrance doors to all apartments with security hinges
- Aluminum windows and patio doors
- Built-in wardrobes included
- The floors of the apartments will be finished with porcelain tiles
- Heated floor throughout the apartment
- Worktops in the kitchen will be made of natural stone
- Kitchen equipped with Bosch household appliances, including oven, microwave, induction hob, silent hood, dishwasher,
fridge, washing machine and dryer
Distances
Beach - Estepona, 500 m, 10 min
Golf - Los Flamingos, 9 km, 11 min
Shopping center - Estepona Town , 4 km , 8 min
Airport - Málaga, 73 km, 50 min
Location
Estepona is a quiet town in the province of Málaga and one of the tourist resorts of the Costa del Sol. They are characterized by typical Andalusian, low-rise buildings with narrow and patterned streets.
It is a paradise for artists and photographers.
The city is surrounded by the Sierra Bermeja mountains that dominate the entire landscape around Estepona. It is one of the few places in the world where the mountain range is located only 10 km from the sea. You can see how beautiful the views are from the top by setting off on marked hiking trails.
One of the most interesting attractions in this picturesque city is the orchidarium. The local orchid collection is the largest in Spain and is also among the largest in Europe! Even if you are not a fan of botanical gardens, this place is worth seeing if only because of the riot of colors and smells spreading here. A real feast for the senses!
In Estepona, there is the Playa de la Rada beach, which is over 2,600 meters long. We have many amenities in the area, such as: showers, umbrellas, toilets, pedal boats, playgrounds and trampolines for children. For smaller and bigger hunger, seaside restaurants and bars (Spanish: chiringuitos) serving local delicacies and drinks are recommended.

properties.title: Apartment in Torre de la Horadada
properties.summary: New build apartment for sale in Pilar de la Horadada, Alicante: 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 168 m² built, pool. €375,000.
properties.description:
For sale top floor apartment with private solarium in Torre de la Horadada.
We present a new, very interesting project consisting of modern apartments, penthouses, terraced houses and villas. The residence boasts a fantastic location a short distance from the charming beach of Las Higuericas, in Torre de la Horadada. It is an ideal investment for those looking for a comfortable and private residence in a quiet area, near the sea.
The estate gives you the opportunity to choose apartments on the ground floor with a garden or on the first floor with a solarium. The offer also includes terraced houses and villas. All houses have 3 bedrooms with 2 bathrooms (villas 3 bathrooms) and a modern kitchen furnished and equipped with household appliances. In addition, all properties have a private swimming pool and parking.
Villas, terraced houses and penthouses on the top floor also have a summer kitchen located on the roof terrace. All properties are very thoughtful, well laid out and built to a high standard.
The apartments on the top floor offer a bright living room with an open kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms, one of which is en-suite. The living room opens onto a sunny balcony with space for a table and chairs. From here you can reach the amazing rooftop terrace, where you have plenty of space for sun loungers, a barbecue, a relaxation area, a private pool and fantastic views of the countryside.
The investments come with pre-installed ducted air conditioning, floor heating in the living room, kitchen and bathrooms, shower screens in the bathrooms, LED lighting package, household appliances, aerothermal system for hot water and a private swimming pool.
There are several cafes, shops and sports facilities in the area. The town of Pilar de la Horadada, several golf courses and the largest shopping center in the area, La Zenia Boulevard, are within easy reach. The amazing beaches of Torre de la Horadada are a few minutes walk from the project.
Location
Torre de la Horadada is a seaside district located in the municipality of Pilar de la Horadada, in the south of the province of Alicante. The resort is located in the south-eastern part of Spain and borders Murcia (about 15 minutes away). Alicante, on the other hand, is about a 40-minute drive away.
Pilar de la Horadada has everything you need to enjoy the sea, pine forests and the Spanish sun.
The coastline of Pilar de la Hordada is over 4 kilometers long along a very diverse scenery. We will meet there wide beaches with fine white sand, small stone wall ledges suspended above the water and small and intimate, hidden coves with golden sand.
The sea is usually calm here, the beaches are safe, there are no steep slopes, which allows even the smallest children to swim safely. In addition, the clear water and great visibility invite divers to observe the beauty of aquatic life.
The cleanliness of the beaches in Pilar de la Hordada has been awarded the Blue Flag of the European Union, which guarantees a healthy environment.
Inland, you can make various interesting excursions near the cities of Sierra and Escalona. There are two marked hiking trails along the Rio Seco riverbed, 19 kilometers long, definitely worth a visit. One of the routes is 4 kilometers long, while the other is 10 kilometers long, stretching from the natural terrain of Pilar de Campoverde to the mouth of Mil Palmeras beach.
Not far from the town of Pilar de la Horadada, there is also an 18-hole golf course in Lo Romero. Both professionals in this field and beginners will find themselves well there.
Gastronomy has a privileged place in the culture of this beautiful city. Typical Pilar de la Hordada dishes include potatoes with meat stew, meatballs, rabbit in garlic and Gachas Migas (a floury garlic pancake) as well as great rice dishes and soups. Sweets and cakes also deserve a mention here, confectionery products such as meringue cake called ''milhojas'' or almond sweets called ''cordiales'' are the most popular.

properties.title: Modern villa in La Finca Golf, Algorfa
properties.summary: New build villa for sale in Algorfa, Alicante: 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 180 m² built, 480 m² plot, pool. €670,000.
properties.description:
For sale detached villa with swimming pool in La Finca Golf, Algorfa
We present a completely new project of an intimate estate consisting of modern and spacious villas, each of which has a private swimming pool. The investment is located in the small town of Algorfa, about 10 km from the coast, surrounded by citrus orchards. It is an ideal location for people who love peace and beautiful landscapes and fresh mountain air. It is a natural area with excellent road links to the nearby towns of Torrevieja, Guardamar and Orihuela Costa, and the most beautiful beaches are just 20 minutes from the property.
This fantastic villa was built on a plot of 480 m2. It has 3 comfortable bedrooms with built-in wardrobes and 2 bathrooms. In addition, we will find a laundry room and an additional guest toilet. The elegant and fully equipped kitchen perfectly combines with the dining room and the cozy living room. We have direct access to a spacious terrace with a beautiful Mediterranean garden and a swimming pool with an area of 7.5 x 4 m. The investment also has a spacious sun terrace (134 m2) where we can enjoy the Mediterranean climate and beautiful views.
The villa has been carefully designed and built using high quality materials. The key role in the project was the comfort and privacy of the residents. The property also has underfloor heating, an aerothermal system, a complete air-conditioning system and a video intercom.
The parking space is located on the plot. There is an international school and 4 hospitals nearby.
Important objects near this project
Beach: 19 km
Golf resort: 2 km
Shop, bar and restaurants: 200 m
Alicante airport: 43 km
Location
Algorfa located in the Vega Baja del Segura region, has a rich history that dates back to Roman times. The town's name is derived from the Arabic word 'Al-Gorfa,' meaning 'cave,' as the area was known for its numerous natural caves. Today, Algorfa is known for its production of citrus fruits and vegetables.
Algorfa is home to numerous attractions that will appeal to visitors of all ages. Here are just a few of the highlights:
La Finca Golf Course
If you're a fan of golf, then La Finca Golf Course is a must-visit destination. This championship golf course is situated in a beautiful natural setting, with stunning views of the Vega Baja countryside. The course has been designed to provide a challenge for golfers of all levels, and there are plenty of facilities, including a pro shop and a restaurant.
Algorfa Market
For a taste of the local culture, be sure to visit the Algorfa Market, which takes place every Wednesday. Here, you'll find a wide range of goods, including fresh produce, clothing, and souvenirs. It's the perfect place to pick up a unique gift or sample some of the delicious local cuisine.
Plaza de España
The Plaza de España is the main square in Algorfa, and it's a great place to soak up the local atmosphere. Here, you'll find a beautiful fountain, plenty of seating, and a range of restaurants and bars. It's the perfect place to relax with a drink and watch the world go by.

properties.title: Excellent villa with panoramic mountain and sea views in Altea
properties.summary: New build villa for sale in Altea, Alicante: 4 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, 616 m² built, pool, sea views. €2,146,000.
properties.description:
For sale luxury villa with swimming pool in the picturesque town of Altea.
This modern villa with luxurious features and exceptional finishes is located in Altea, one of the most beautiful cities in Spain. The development offers unparalleled views of the mountains, the sea and the stunning panorama of Benidorm. This exquisite home is a fantastic opportunity to live in luxury on the beautiful Costa Blanca, enjoying all the benefits this area has to offer.
Open and bright spaces and large floor-to-ceiling windows with a minimalist design allow access to daylight throughout the day, blurring the boundary between the interior and exterior of the building. All rooms have been designed with attention to detail. The use of natural materials and colors plays an important role in this project, causing that, despite its modernity, the interiors are very cozy and blend in perfectly with the natural surroundings.
The villa has 405 m2, consists of three floors and has a total of 4 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms. All floors are connected by a modern elevator and stairs. On the ground floor we will find a very bright and spacious living area. A fully equipped, pioneer kitchen combines with a dining area and a comfortable living room, creating a perfectly synchronized whole. On the same floor there is also a spacious bedroom with a built-in wardrobe and a fully equipped private bathroom. In addition, we also have a separate toilet for guests.
On the first floor of this unique investment there is a night area offering privacy for the household members. There are three main bedrooms, all with private, elegant bathrooms and built-in wardrobes. From all rooms we have direct access to the terrace, from which we can admire beautiful views.
There are three parking spaces in the basement. On the same level there is an additional guest bedroom with a private bathroom and built-in wardrobe. There is also a laundry room and a utility room.
The property has a really large outdoor area with a swimming pool, ideal for cooking and having outdoor parties. There is also a barbecue area and a really large sun terrace where you can enjoy the Spanish sun most of the year.
Location
Altea in Spain is considered one of the most beautiful cities. Beautiful beaches and promenades, whitewashed houses with colorful pots, narrow cobblestone streets, small craft shops, ice cream parlors and open-air restaurants are not all that this picturesque city has to offer.
Altea is a 10-minute drive north of Benidorm (approximately 10 km), approximately 1 hour from Alicante, and is one of the most memorable coastal towns on the Costa Blanca, retaining its unmistakable Spanish charm despite increasing tourism and popularity. Altea is located directly by the sea, in the middle of a beautiful bay and is surrounded by hilly mountains. The name comes from the Moorish "Althaya", which means "health for all".
The town center is a treasure trove of shops, art galleries, restaurants and small whitewashed buildings adorned with flowers - all waiting to be explored along the winding and cobbled medieval streets.
The old town of Altea is preserved in a typically Spanish, you could say Andalusian atmosphere. The whitewashed houses are a blank canvas for Mediterranean flower beds. No wonder Altea attracts artists and photographers from all over the world who want to experience the city's charm, incredible light and natural beauty. From cobbled streets, stunning sea and mountain views, to historic buildings.
Countless steps of narrow, charming streets lead from the coast to the viewpoint of Altea. In the 16th century, the upper part of the old town of Altea was built to protect the town from attacks. The castle was built on what is now Plaza de la Iglesia, and the upper part of the city was surrounded by a wall with three gates. Currently, only two of these gates exist - Vell Portal and Portal Nou.
The icon of the city is the famous Virgin de Consuelo church with its blue dome on top - it's truly remarkable and the view from the top over Altea Bay with the mountains in the background is simply spectacular! The dome is a kind of symbol of the divinity of this city. Altea is a city that is visually beautiful, atmospheric and incredibly charming! The mood here is hard to describe in words. The church was built in the 19th century with a magnificent interior with classic gold and floral motifs.
Altea's location at the foot of the 1,100-meter-high Sierra Bernia mountain, with its highest peak at 1,129 meters, and the 1,500-meter Sierra Aitana to the west, creates a "magical" atmosphere in the area. The mountain protects against the cold winds from the hinterland. The mountainside lies like a green oasis down to the fertile lowlands and the sea. The river that flows through the city and thanks to which it is here is called Algar, which means healing river.
Altea and other towns in the north are among the greenest and most fertile areas of the entire Costa Blanca. Oranges and many exotic fruits are grown here.

properties.description:
Wonderful two bedroom apartment for sale in Mijas, Málaga.
We are pleased to present you a new project of a prestigious estate located in Mijas, a privileged part of the Costa del Sol. The city stretches on the slope of the mountains, blending perfectly with the greenery of the surrounding pines, creating picturesque landscapes together. Indulge in the Mediterranean lifestyle without resigning from the proximity of extensive infrastructure. Your new home is less than 5 minutes from the best shopping on the coast, in the immediate vicinity of many excellent golf courses and 2 km from beautiful beaches. It is an ideal property for investment with the possibility of renting all year round or as your new Spanish home.
You can choose from 292 comfortable apartments with 1, 2 or 3 bedrooms. It's up to you whether you choose an apartment with a spacious terrace or a penthouse with a private solarium on the roof of the building. A perfectly thought-out arrangement of rooms, open spaces, bright and natural colors as well as attention to the smallest detail make each of these elite properties meet the expectations of even the most demanding customers.
Make yourself comfortable in the elegant and fully equipped kitchen, which perfectly combines with the dining room and the cozy living room. Here you will find high-quality household appliances as well as cabinets and drawers, offering plenty of space to store kitchen utensils. You can enjoy a spacious and comfortable space ideal for cooking, eating and relaxing with friends and family.
The bedrooms are located at the back of the apartment, creating a quiet and peaceful space to relax and sleep. All are equipped with built-in wardrobes that provide plenty of storage space. In addition, each investment has fully equipped bathrooms with underfloor heating.
When designing this prestigious estate, the developer focused on luxury and safety of its future residents. The residence will have a monitoring system, and each property will have a private underground parking space and a storage room. In addition, each investment is fully equipped with air conditioning.
The estate has a number of amenities that make it an ideal choice for people who want to live in a luxurious environment. The Mediterranean garden surrounding the apartment is truly stunning and the vibrant colors and fragrant flowers create a peaceful and relaxing atmosphere. A playground for children is a safe place to play. You can feel like in the best hotel using the luxurious sauna. The modern swimming pool is the perfect place to relax, have fun with your family and cool off on hot days. There will also be plenty of excitement for fans of all kinds of sports. You will find a fully equipped gym, available only to residents.
Location
Mijas is one of the largest towns in the province of Malaga, consisting of 3 different districts: Mijas Pueblo, Mijas Costa and Mijas la Cala. The most popular, attracting numerous tourists and fans of Andalusian white villages, is Mijas Pueblo.
It is a picturesque town located several kilometers from the coast, from the well-known town of Fuengirola. The nearest metropolis is Malaga, about 35 km away. The distance to Marbella is similar. Mijas is approximately half an hour's drive from Malaga Airport.
White houses located several kilometers from the coast, from a distance look as if "glued" to the mountain slope. The town tries to preserve the atmosphere of a traditional, white, Andalusian village.
Mijas la Cala offers many interesting pubs and restaurants where you can refresh yourself with a cool sangria or snack on tapas or eat typical Andalusian dishes such as gazpacho or dishes with seafood. However, La Cale de Mijas does not live only with Andalusian cuisine. You will also find here Greek and Chinese restaurants, as well as one Thai and several Indian restaurants.
One of the most popular places in La Cala de Mijas is Legends Bar La Cala. You can not only drink good drinks and eat something nice here, but above all you can spend a really fantastic evening here to the sounds of live music. It is an intimate place where thematic events are often held. The place has good reviews among tourists and it is worth coming here at least for a moment.
Mijas Pueblo is a multicultural town whose inhabitants are largely foreigners. The Andalusian town is also called the "kingdom of golf". Mijas Pueblo is famous primarily for its unusual taxis, whose functions are performed by donkeys. The idea was born in the 1960s, when tourists started accosting residents returning from work in the quarries, whose transport was donkeys. Their popularity was used to explore the city, so to this day it is one of the forms of "riding" and seeing the city.
In Mijas, it is worth visiting several observation decks, which offer a beautiful view of the coast and the town itself. One of the most famous is located in Avenida del Compas, right next to the sanctuary of the patron saint of Mijas. The second point with a panorama can be found in the Gardens on the Walls (Jardin de las Murallas).
Another unusual attraction of the town is the smallest chocolate factory in the world, Mayan Monkey Mijas Chocolate Factory at Plaza Virgen de la Peña 15. In addition to the production of chocolate from natural, local products, it is also famous for its workshops where you can produce your own chocolate.

Location
Finestrat is a charming and picturesque town located in the province of Alicante, in the Valencian Community of Spain. This idyllic destination is known for its stunning mountain views, pristine beaches, and rich cultural heritage, making it the perfect location for a relaxing and memorable holiday.
Nestled on the slopes of the Puig Campana mountain, Finestrat offers breathtaking views of the mountains, coast, and Mediterranean Sea. The town is situated just 8 km from the bustling city of Benidorm and 40 km from Alicante and its international airport, making it easily accessible to visitors from all over the world.
Finestrat is a town with a typical Moorish feel, featuring colorfully painted houses and narrow cobbled streets that are perfect for exploring. The town is also home to Cala Finestrat, a seaside resort located just three kilometers from Benidorm. Here, visitors can enjoy all the necessary facilities, including a vast selection of restaurants, bars, and shops. La Cala beach is a clean strip of golden sand, ideal for children and safe for swimming. There are several lovely restaurants along the promenade, and an arts and crafts market in the afternoon during the summer months.
For those seeking adventure and fun, the area around Finestrat offers plenty of activities for families and couples alike. Nearby, visitors can enjoy theme parks like Terre Mitica and Terra Natura, the Aqualandia water park, and the Mundomar marine and exotic animal park, all of which offer fun for the whole family. If golf is your game, the nearby Real Faula Golf Club offers two excellent golf courses.

Location
Gran Alacant is a charming town located a short distance from the bustling city of Alicante in Spain. With stunning beaches, natural beauty and a wide range of activities and attractions, Gran Alacant is the perfect place to invest.
Beaches
One of the attractions of Gran Alacant is the beautiful El Carabassi beach, which stretches over 2 km with golden sand and crystal clear waters. Thanks to its calm waters and gentle waves, it is an ideal place for swimming, sunbathing and water sports.
In addition to the beach, Gran Alacant offers a range of other activities and attractions to keep you entertained. The area is renowned for its natural beauty, with miles of hiking and biking trails winding through the nearby mountains and forests.
For nature lovers, the nearby Clot de Galvany Nature Reserve is a must-see destination. This protected area covers over 350 hectares of natural forests and wetlands, home to a wide variety of flora and fauna, including rare birds and wildlife.
For a more cultural experience, be sure to visit the nearby city of Alicante, where you can explore sights such as Castel Sant'Angelo. Barbara and the Museum of Contemporary Art.
Located a short distance from Alicante-Elche Airport, Gran Alacant is easily accessible from anywhere in the world. Whether you're coming from Europe, North America or Asia, you'll find that getting to Gran Alacant is quick, easy and hassle-free.

properties.summary: New build villa for sale in Orihuela, Alicante: 3 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, 332 m² built, 1,254 m² plot. €2,365,000.
properties.description:
Ready-to-move-in villa with a private pool on a large plot
For sale, an exceptional ready-to-move-in villa featuring modern, organic architecture, set on a spacious **1,254 m² plot**. The property stands out for its distinctive design, curved lines, large windows and beautifully landscaped garden, seamlessly integrating the house with its Mediterranean surroundings. The villa is ready for immediate occupancy and is offered with a package of indoor and outdoor furniture.
The property offers **332 m² of built area** and features **3 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms**. An additional **124 m² basement** provides further space. The different levels of the villa are connected by an impressive spiral staircase and a **private lift with three stops**.
At the heart of the villa is a spacious open-plan living area combining the lounge, dining room and modern kitchen. Large-format glazing allows the interior to open almost completely onto the terrace and pool area, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor living space. The kitchen features FENIX cabinetry, a worktop with integrated hob and sink, a Bora extraction system and Bosch appliances.
Outside, the property offers an impressive **120 m² of terraces**, a beautifully landscaped garden and a **40 m² private swimming pool** with an irregular, organic shape. The pool features LED lighting and a saltwater chlorination system. The garden is equipped with irrigation and lighting systems, while the landscaping has been carefully designed to blend naturally with the surrounding environment.
The villa offers a high level of technology and comfort, including **underfloor heating throughout the property, hot and cold air conditioning, geothermal energy, photovoltaic panels and a smart home automation system**. Energy- and water-saving solutions have also been incorporated, including the recovery and reuse of greywater and rainwater.
The property also includes a **72 m² covered parking area**. This is an excellent choice for those looking for a ready-to-move-in villa with distinctive architecture, a large private plot, swimming pool and advanced modern technology.
Location
The villa is located within **Las Colinas Golf & Country Club**, one of the most prestigious and green residential areas on the southern Costa Blanca. The surroundings are characterised by low-density development, Mediterranean vegetation and a high level of privacy, making it an ideal location for both year-round living and holidays.
The resort is home to a renowned golf course, restaurants and leisure facilities. The beaches of **Campoamor and Mil Palmeras** are also within easy reach, while Orihuela Costa, with its wide range of shops, restaurants and services, can be reached within a short drive. **Alicante Airport is approximately 45–50 minutes away**, while Murcia Airport can be reached in around 40 minutes.
The **Racquet Club**, offering tennis, table tennis, football and basketball, together with a scenic trail winding through the Mediterranean forest, provides residents and guests with numerous opportunities for outdoor activities, whether on foot or by mountain bike.
The resort's four restaurants offer a varied gastronomic selection, ranging from traditional Italian cuisine at **il Palco**, to international dishes with a Mediterranean influence at **unik**, as well as Japanese, Mexican and Peruvian cuisine at **umawa**. Just a few minutes from Las Colinas Golf & Country Club, directly on La Glea Beach, is **WOW Beach**, an ideal place to enjoy the sun, sea and Mediterranean cuisine.

Apartment for sale in Marbella
We are pleased to present this elite residential complex that is completely private and situated in a privileged location, surrounded by the prestigious Santa Clara golf course. The area is ideal for those who seek the authentic Mediterranean essence of the Costa del Sol without sacrificing connections to the main towns in the area. Perfect location to enjoy a relaxed and healthy lifestyle with the best beaches on your doorstep.
The residential complex offers 20 exclusive semi-detached villas of 4 and 5 bedrooms with large terraces and swimming pools and 48 apartments in two types: penthouses with solariums and ground floor apartments with gardens, all with a unique layout of 2 to 4 bedrooms. A perfectly thought-out arrangement of rooms, open spaces, bright and natural colors as well as attention to the smallest detail make each of these elite properties meet the expectations of even the most demanding customers.
Make yourself comfortable in the elegant and fully equipped kitchen, which perfectly combines with the dining room and the cozy living room. Here you will find high-quality household appliances as well as cabinets and drawers, offering plenty of space to store kitchen utensils. You can enjoy a spacious and comfortable space ideal for cooking, eating and relaxing with friends and family.
Bedrooms create a quiet and peaceful space for rest and sleep. All are equipped with built-in wardrobes that provide plenty of storage space. In addition, each investment has fully equipped bathrooms with underfloor heating.
Living in this luxurious estate, you can feel like on a tropical holiday in the best hotel every day. A full Resort program will be available to residents and their guests. You will find 5 different swimming pools, a fully equipped gym, an exclusive SPA, a sauna, a coffee and grill zone and a place to work - coworking. In addition, the entire common area is beautifully landscaped with Mediterranean gardens offering a place for walking and picnics. Certainly, everyone will find here the perfect space for rest, fun or relaxation in the company of loved ones.
When designing this prestigious estate, the developer focused on luxury and safety of its future residents. The residence will have a monitoring system, and each property will have a private underground parking space and a storage room. In addition, residents will be able to use the services of a private Concierge.
This complex, surrounded by the Santa Clara golf course, is one of the most prestigious private urbanizations in Marbella. Fully connected to every corner of the world thanks to the international airport and high-speed rail (AVE).
Location
The city of Marbella is the symbol of the Costa del Sol. The resort, synonymous with prestige and luxury, attracts the attention of investors and tourists from around the world, and its inseparable element are spectacular properties worth even over PLN 100 million!
Marbella, thanks to the actions taken by influential people like Ricardo Soriano or Prince Alfonso of Hohenlohe-Langenburg, has become the favorite holiday destination of the cream of society from Spain and Europe.
Today, politicians, athletes, musicians and screen stars have their properties here, and Marbella itself attracts crowds of tourists from around the world. This is confirmed by e.g. results of the plebiscite organized by the popular Belgian travel portal, which awarded Marbella the title of "Best European Destinations 2022".
Currently, the most prestigious and thus the most desirable locations include:
Golden Mile - The "Golden Mile" is one of the most beautiful and luxurious avenues in Spain, which is also the symbol of Marbella. Legendary hotels and stunning properties are located here, including a scaled-down replica of the White House, built by the late King of Saudi Arabia. The Golden Mile is an avenue of over 6 kilometers long, lined with classic and modern villas surrounded by lush vegetation. It is an ideal place to invest capital, especially in times of rampant inflation.
La Zagaleta - you can't pass by this complex indifferently. It is located in an extraordinary scenery - by the lake, between the sea and the mountains. On a huge area that could accommodate up to 4,000. real estate, there are only 400 residences, inhabited, among others, by by people on the front pages of newspapers. The excellent security of La Zagaleta, however, guarantees them full discretion and the comfort of a peaceful holiday at home on the Costa del Sol.
Puerto Banús - one of the most luxurious marinas in Spain, located between Marbella and San Pedro Alcantara. People who have managed to buy a property in Puerto Banús are undoubtedly the lucky ones! Here we will find designer boutiques from around the world, the best restaurants, spectacular yachts and a Salvador Dali sculpture!
When visiting this luxurious resort, you must visit the Parque de Alameda - they are said to be the green lungs of the city. Dating back to the 18th century, Alameda Park occupies an area of 20,000 m2, which is 20% of the area of the entire city center. Alameda Park is a place rich in various species of plants. The ones that attract the most attention are the spreading Ficus Pandurata and Pinus Pinae.
Nature lovers will also be happy to visit the Bonsai Museum.
It is the first museum in Spain dedicated to bonsai trees. It was founded in 1992, and its collection includes the most valuable bonsai specimens in Europe, some of which are 200, 300 and even 400 years old! A visit to the Museo del Bonsai is a great opportunity to calm down and commune among the most beautiful works created by nature. In addition to the permanent exhibition, the museum also organizes educational workshops to better understand the art of caring for bonsai trees.
Regardless of how you like to spend your free time, Marbella will certainly meet your expectations. There are 26 km of beaches waiting for sunbathers. For gourmets of good cuisine - great restaurants, prestigious restaurants offering cuisine from around the world. Those who like active holidays can try their hand at windsurfing, sailing or golf. Regarding the latter, it is worth mentioning that around the city there are unparalleled golf courses of excellent quality, also adapted to play at night (they are specially illuminated for this purpose).
If you like mountain climbing, you cannot miss the La Concha mountain rising majestically above the city. It measures 1,200 meters above sea level, and the best trail to reach it can be found in the town of Istán, located on the other side of the mountain. The trip is not the easiest, but all possible difficulties are compensated by the amazing view that awaits us at the top! It is hard to disagree with the statement that this is the most beautiful panorama of the city of Marbella. However, for even greater mountain challenges, the Sierra Nevada mountain range is recommended.
The most popular, and according to many people also the best beaches in Marbela are: Playa de Guadalmina, Playa de Lindavista, Playa de San Pedro de Alcántara, Cortijo Blanco, Playa de Nueva Andalucía, Rio Verde - Playa de Puerto Banús, Playa de El Ancón, Nagüeles , Fontanilla and Playa del Faro.

Calpe boasts some of the finest sandy shores in the region, including the iconic Playa de la Fossa and Playa de la Arenal-Bol. Immerse yourself in the Mediterranean bliss, bask in the sun, or indulge in water sports and activities that are an integral part of Calpe's coastal landscape.
Beyond its picturesque beaches, Calpe is adorned with historical landmarks and cultural treasures. The emblematic Peñón de Ifach, a massive limestone rock formation, stands as a symbol of Calpe and offers breathtaking panoramic views. Take a hike to the summit and marvel at the natural beauty that unfolds before your eyes. The old town, with its charming narrow streets and historic architecture, invites you to wander and explore its rich heritage.
Calpe's bustling fishing port is a must-visit destination. Watch the fishermen bring in their daily catch, visit the fish market, and savor fresh seafood delicacies in the numerous restaurants that line the harbor. For a taste of local culture, visit the Museum of Archaeology and Ethnography to delve into Calpe's fascinating history.
Nature enthusiasts will find solace in the natural parks that surround Calpe. Explore the Las Salinas Natural Park, a haven for migratory birds such as flamingos and storks, or venture into the Serra Gelada Natural Park to witness its rugged cliffs and captivating trails. For hiking enthusiasts, the Sierra de Bernia and Sierra de Oltà offer exhilarating routes and stunning vistas.
Indulge in the vibrant atmosphere of Calpe's local markets, where you can discover fresh produce, handicrafts, and traditional products. Sample the local gastronomy, renowned for its seafood, rice dishes, and savory tapas.
Beyond the confines of your residence, immerse yourself in the awe-inspiring beauty of Calpe. Located in close proximity to the Mediterranean coast, you'll have the privilege of embracing the gentle caress of the Mediterranean breeze, feeling the fine sand beneath your feet, and admiring the crystal-clear waters at a moment's notice. Calpe's beaches have been certified with the prestigious "Q" for Quality and the Blue Flag, attesting to their exceptional standards. Furthermore, the remarkable microclimate, rich flora, and diverse fauna further enhance the allure of this coastal paradise. Water sports and activities are seamlessly integrated into the landscape, offering endless adventures and opportunities for exploration.
Nature lovers will find solace in the proximity to natural parks, where you can immerse yourself in the wonders of the surroundings. From the enchanting Natural Park of Las Salinas, where migratory birds such as flamingos, coots, Audouin's gulls, and storks grace the skies, to the panoramic views offered from the highest point of the Peñón de Ifach. Prepare to be mesmerized by the vistas that stretch before you, encompassing the Serra Gelada Natural Park, the protected landscape of Puig Campana, the majestic Sierra de Aitana, and even glimpses of the distant island of Ibiza on the clearest of days.

Villa for sale in Finestrat.
Elite World Estates is proud to introduc this modern Villa, a meticulously designed luxury property located within the prestigious residential area Finestrat, on the beautiful Costa Blanca. This villa offers a unique real estate opportunity, perfectly blending the natural beauty of Sierra Cortina and the Mediterranean.
Step into the villa, and you'll be immediately captivated by the seamless connection between the interior and exterior spaces, creating a sense of fluidity and harmony. The architect has skillfully incorporated light to accentuate and transform the architectural perspectives, giving each area a distinct and enchanting essence. The villa offers a truly magical living experience.
On the first floor, you'll discover two suite-style bedrooms, each with their own access to a charming open terrace. These outdoor spaces are perfect for relaxation and enjoyment, allowing you to soak in the stunning surroundings. Imagine waking up to the breathtaking views and embracing the Mediterranean breeze from your own private terrace.
Depending on the chosen model, the villa may also feature a basement and an inside garden. These additional spaces offer versatility and allow for customization according to your preferences. Whether you envision a home gym, a cinema room, or a personal retreat, the basement provides endless possibilities to create your dream space. The inside garden brings nature indoors, providing a serene and refreshing ambiance that complements the villa's design.
Throughout the villa, a careful selection of materials, textures, and colors creates a cohesive and aesthetically pleasing atmosphere. The combination of these elements exudes elegance, making the villa a sanctuary of luxury and comfort. Every detail has been meticulously considered to ensure a visually harmonious living environment.
To meet your specific lifestyle requirements, optional extras are available, allowing you to personalize the house according to your needs. This ensures that the Villa is not just a house but a home that reflects your unique style and preferences. The property represents the perfect blend of modern design, spacious interiors filled with natural light, and luxurious finishes, promising an unparalleled living experience.
Location
Finestrat, a charming town located in the Costa Blanca region of Spain, offers a perfect blend of natural beauty, cultural attractions, and recreational activities. Situated just a short distance from the coastline, Finestrat boasts stunning beaches, a rich history, and easy access to the nearby airport.
One of the main highlights of Finestrat is its beautiful beaches. The town is conveniently located near several sandy shores, including the popular and picturesque Playa de Poniente and Playa de Levante in neighboring Benidorm. These beaches offer pristine turquoise waters, soft golden sands, and excellent facilities, making them ideal for sunbathing, swimming, and water sports enthusiasts.
Beyond the beaches, Finestrat has much to offer in terms of cultural and historical attractions. The historical center of the town is a delight to explore, with its narrow, winding streets, traditional Spanish architecture, and charming squares. Be sure to visit the iconic Church of San Bartolomé, a 14th-century church that stands as a testament to the town's rich heritage.
For those seeking adventure, a visit to the nearby Puig Campana mountain is a must. This impressive peak is a paradise for hikers and climbers, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding landscape. Embarking on a trek to the summit is a thrilling experience and provides an opportunity to connect with nature.
If you're a fan of theme parks and entertainment, you're in luck. Finestrat is conveniently located near Terra Mítica, one of Spain's largest theme parks. This exciting attraction offers a variety of thrilling rides, live shows, and themed areas inspired by ancient civilizations.
In terms of amenities, Finestrat has a wide range of shops, restaurants, and bars that cater to both locals and tourists. You can indulge in traditional Spanish cuisine, sample fresh seafood, or savor international dishes at the numerous dining establishments in the town.
Regarding transportation, Finestrat benefits from its proximity to Alicante-Elche Airport, which is approximately 45 kilometers away. This international airport provides excellent connectivity to major cities in Europe and beyond, making it convenient for travelers to reach Finestrat.

The villa has been designed with comfortable Mediterranean living in mind. The main level features a bright and spacious living and dining area together with an open-plan kitchen with an island or breakfast bar. Large glazed doors open directly onto the terrace, garden and private pool area, creating a natural connection between the interior and outdoor spaces. This level also includes one bedroom and a bathroom.
Upstairs, there is a master bedroom, two additional bedrooms and two bathrooms. The terraces provide further outdoor space for relaxing and enjoying the sunny climate throughout most of the year.

The villa is set on a private plot starting from approximately 440 m², providing plenty of space
for outdoor living. The private pool, terraces and garden create a comfortable area for spending time with family and friends.
Location
One of the main advantages of this property is its location just 300 m from Playa Honda, a peaceful sandy beach on the Mar Menor. The proximity to the sea means you can walk to the beach in just a few minutes and enjoy swimming, seaside walks and water sports throughout the year.

The area offers a wide range of restaurants, shops, marinas, sailing clubs and leisure facilities. The Mar Menor is particularly popular for sailing, windsurfing, kayaking and other water sports.
Cabo de Palos, with its popular marina, restaurants and picturesque coastline, is also within easy reach. The historic city of Cartagena can be reached by car in approximately 25–30 minutes.

properties.description:
For sale apartment in Guadalmina, Marbella
Comfort, elegance, first-class finish and perfect location - this is how you can describe a new project being built in one of the most spectacular corners of the Costa Del Sol. This luxury residential project is located in Guadalmina, Marbella, very close to San Pedro de Alcántara and just 10 minutes from Puerto Banús. The apartments are located on the first line of golf, opposite the famous Real Club de Golf Guadalmina, part of the privileged Golden Triangle
You can choose from 34 luxury apartments and penthouses. There are layouts with 2, 3 or 4 bedrooms to choose from. Each house is equipped with comfort and elegance. Thanks to the spacious, open spaces and a lot of light coming through large, high glazing, the whole space is very bright and cozy.
The open kitchen is fully equipped with top-of-the-line appliances and offers plenty of storage space for all your cooking needs. The layout is functional and modern, allowing you to cook and entertain at the same time.
A perfectly thought-out arrangement of rooms, open spaces, bright and natural colors as well as attention to the smallest detail make each of these elite properties meet the expectations of even the most demanding customers.
This modern investment will provide you with everything you need to comfortably live and relax in a quiet and safe environment and enjoy special moments with family and friends. The urbanization will have pleasant common spaces such as a swimming pool, gardens, co-working space and a fitness area. The complex, which will be fully closed, will also have permanent surveillance cameras and a concierge service.
Do not miss the opportunity to own a wonderful apartment in a privileged location with more than 70 golf courses in the area, 300 sunny days a year, an average annual temperature of 20°C and very close to places of culture, health, sports, beaches, leisure, shopping and gastronomy.
Location
The city of Marbella is the symbol of the Costa del Sol. The resort, synonymous with prestige and luxury, attracts the attention of investors and tourists from around the world, and its inseparable element are spectacular properties worth even over PLN 100 million!
Marbella, thanks to the actions taken by influential people like Ricardo Soriano or Prince Alfonso of Hohenlohe-Langenburg, has become the favorite holiday destination of the cream of society from Spain and Europe.
Today, politicians, athletes, musicians and screen stars have their properties here, and Marbella itself attracts crowds of tourists from around the world. This is confirmed by e.g. results of the plebiscite organized by the popular Belgian travel portal, which awarded Marbella the title of Best European Destinations 2022'.
Currently, the most prestigious and thus the most desirable locations include:
Golden Mile - The Golden Mile is one of the most beautiful and luxurious avenues in Spain, and is also a symbol of Marbella. Legendary hotels and stunning properties are located here, including a scaled-down replica of the White House, built by the late King of Saudi Arabia. The Golden Mile is an avenue of over 6 kilometers long, lined with classic and modern villas surrounded by lush vegetation. It is an ideal place to invest capital, especially in times of rampant inflation.
La Zagaleta - you can't pass by this complex indifferently. It is situated in an extraordinary scenery - by the lake, between the sea and the mountains. On a huge area that could accommodate up to 4,000. real estate, there are only 400 residences, inhabited, among others, by by people on the front pages of newspapers. The excellent security of La Zagaleta, however, guarantees them full discretion and the comfort of a peaceful holiday at home on the Costa del Sol.
Puerto Banús - one of the most luxurious marinas in Spain, located between Marbella and San Pedro Alcantara. People who have managed to buy a property in Puerto Banús are undoubtedly the lucky ones! Here we will find designer boutiques from around the world, the best restaurants, spectacular yachts and a Salvador Dali sculpture!
When visiting this luxurious resort, you must visit the Parque de Alameda - they are said to be the green lungs of the city. Dating back to the 18th century, Alameda Park occupies an area of 20,000 m2, which is 20% of the area of the entire city center. Alameda Park is a place rich in various species of plants. The ones that attract the most attention are the spreading Ficus Pandurata and Pinus Pinae.
Nature lovers will also be happy to visit the Bonsai Museum.
It is the first museum in Spain dedicated to bonsai trees. It was founded in 1992, and its collection includes the most valuable bonsai specimens in Europe, some of which are 200, 300 and even 400 years old! A visit to the Museo del Bonsai is a great opportunity to calm down and commune among the most beautiful works created by nature. In addition to the permanent exhibition, the museum also organizes educational workshops to better understand the art of caring for bonsai trees.
Regardless of how you like to spend your free time, Marbella will certainly meet your expectations. There are 26 km of beaches waiting for sunbathers. For gourmets of good cuisine - great restaurants, prestigious restaurants offering cuisine from around the world. Those who like active holidays can try their hand at windsurfing, sailing or golf. Regarding the latter, it is worth mentioning that around the city there are unparalleled golf courses of excellent quality, also adapted to play at night (they are specially illuminated for this purpose).
If you like mountain climbing, you cannot miss the La Concha mountain rising majestically above the city. It measures 1,200 meters above sea level, and the best trail to reach it can be found in the town of Istán, located on the other side of the mountain. The trip is not the easiest, but all possible difficulties are compensated by the amazing view that awaits us at the top! It is hard to disagree with the statement that this is the most beautiful panorama of the city of Marbella. However, for even greater mountain challenges, the Sierra Nevada mountain range is recommended.
The most popular and, according to many people, also the best beaches in Marbela are: Playa de Guadalmina, Playa de Lindavista, Playa de San Pedro de Alcántara, Cortijo Blanco, Playa de Nueva Andalucía, Rio Verde - Playa de Puerto Banús, Playa de El Ancón, Nagüeles , Fontanilla, Playa del Faro.

In the area you can visit golf courses, eat in one of the many restaurants or go for a walk in nature. If you want to swim in the Mediterranean, Playa de Guadalmina is the closest. It can be reached in 15 to 20 minutes by car. Not far from your future home is Puerto Banus in Marbella, which can be reached by car in about 20-25 minutes. In the area, you can shop, dine or admire the yachts. Estepona is also worth a visit. The city can be reached by car in about 25 to 30 minutes.
This impressive new residential community offers its residents a picture of living with comfort, convenience and style in one place. 56 exclusive investments with three and four bedrooms to choose from and of course each with a panoramic view of the sea. The apartments are spread over 7 blocks with only 2 properties on each floor to make it even more exclusive. Each property is perfectly designed and thought out with your well-being and comfort in mind at all times.
Apartments with an area of 144 to 185 sq m. will have, among others spacious terraces with a wonderful view of the Mediterranean Sea. Each bedroom has direct access to the terrace so you wake up with an amazing view and all have a private bathroom. The kitchens of each house are fully equipped with designer furniture and low-energy household appliances. Some apartments will also have their own swimming pool and garden. The facilities also include a storage room and one or two parking spaces.
The common areas of this luxury complex include 3 swimming pools, a fully equipped gym and spa. In addition, we will also find a co-working space and, of course, beautiful Mediterranean gardens.
All with amazing panoramic sea views, you'll enjoy a fantastic sunset here overlooking Africa and Gibraltar.
Location
Benahavís is a mountain town in the province of Málaga, 7 km from the coast. It lies between Marbella, Estepona and Ronda, on the West Coast of the Costa del Sol. It is popular for its wide range of restaurants and as a white city with a typical Arab street layout. Within Benahavis there is one of the most exclusive estates in Spain - La Zagaleta. According to data from the Tax Office, in 2018 Benahavís was the first municipality in the province of Málaga in terms of gross income and the fourth in Andalusia, thanks to La Zagaleta.
Golf courses
The golf courses in Benahavis have been designed by world class golf course designers such as Robert Trent Jones or Severiano Ballesteros or Jack Niclaus. In Benahavis, the golf season lasts all year round. The mild climate, great infrastructure, excellent restaurants attract fans of this sport from all over the world. You can play in 12 clubs, including Los Flamingos Golf Club, La Quinta Golf & Country Club, La Zagaleta and Club de Golf Benahavís. The greenery of the golf courses is an inseparable element of the Benahavis landscape. This is another reason why property investors in Spain choose Benahavis.
Restaurants
Benahavis is also famous for the best restaurants in Andalusia. We recommend visiting one of them: El Abanico, Bodegon Gallery, Rufino or Lemon Grass. El Abanico serves local and European cuisine, including vegetarian dishes. Same with Bodegon Gallery and Rufino. If you feel like Asian cuisine, it's best to visit Lemon Grass - the local Thai chef specializes in Asian Fusion, and the restaurant itself is called the best Asian cuisine on the Costa del Sol.
A place full of possibilities
It is impossible not to like Benahavis, it is a perfect place to relax, meet friends in restaurants and cafes or on the golf course. It is also a great base for hiking, cycling and swimming. Art lovers will also find something for themselves here: in David Marschall's gallery you can buy beautiful sculptures inspired by nature, combined with ready-made objects - turning chips, railway sleepers. The artist creates abstract sculptures, figures that are a combination of ceramics, glass and metal, wood and other materials.

This apartment is an ideal investment opportunity if you are looking for an apartment for sale in Marbella, located in the upper part of Guadalmina, it is one of the most spectacular corners of the Costa del Sol, very close to places of culture, sports, beaches, leisure, shopping and gastronomy.
Location
First of all, Guadalmina is an exclusive residential area.
This area is divided into two districts: Guadalmina Baja and Guadalmina Alta. The first is south of the highway and runs down to the beach, and the second is north of the highway and runs down to the base of the hills. Both areas consist of tree-lined boulevards, mostly surrounded by large ones
villas.
The center of Marbella is about 15 km from Guadalmina, less than 20 minutes by car. Puerto Banús is even closer and takes about 10 minutes to drive. Estepona, in the east, is 20 km away.

Guadalmina Golf Club, one of the first golf courses on the Costa del Sol, has two 18-hole courses, one in each part of Guadalmina. As a result, many properties in Guadalmina Alta have frontline golf positions.

Large, high windows let natural light into the living spaces, while blending perfectly with the vast outdoor spaces of the terraces. The penthouses have large solarium-type terraces, and the ground floors have private gardens. Some of the luxury features of these properties include underfloor heating throughout the home, state-of-the-art air conditioning, 2 private garage spaces and a large storage room.
A central meeting place with gyms, swimming pools and a spa will be built on the estate. There will also be a bar area and games for children. An exclusive estate for the most demanding residents.

In addition, you will find here
– Five outdoor swimming pools
– Bar, cafe and outdoor cinema
– Gym and Spa
- Croquet and tennis court
– Minimarket
Your new home is ideally located to enjoy the luxury lifestyle of Sotogrande and the Costa del Sol. Local amenities, 5 first class golf courses, polo courts and exclusive beach clubs are all nearby. The Sotogrande Marina is just 2 minutes from the development, while Marbella, Puerto Banús and Estepona are 30 minutes away by car. Gibraltar Airport is a 10-minute drive away and Málaga International Airport is just over an hour's drive away.
The Costa del Sol is considered one of the most famous tourist destinations in Europe. It has fantastic infrastructure, an excellent climate all year round and an extremely safe living environment. Do not miss such a fantastic opportunity to live in this real paradise on earth.
Location
Sotogrande is a small town - an enclave in San Roque in Cadiz. This is a unique location, the place of summer homes of famous and richest families not only in Spain, but also in Great Britain. Sotogrande is visited by movie stars, celebrities and the richest people in Spain.
Sotogrande was founded in 1964 as a luxury resort on the Mediterranean Sea. The originator of the Sotogrande uprising in 1962 was the American Colonel Joseph McMicking. He wanted to create an alternative to the surrounding tourist resorts, being a luxury gem in the whole area. Today, Sotogrande is 5,000 acres of well-maintained land, surrounded by professional golf courses. At the mouth of the Guadiaro River, over which Sotogrande is located, a port was built where today hundreds of luxury yachts moor.
Golf and Polo
In the immediate vicinity you will find top-class golf courses, as well as golf schools. The most famous golf clubs are Valderrama Golf Club and Real Club de Golf. In addition, you will also be able to play polo. This is another sport that has dominated the immediate area of Sotogrande. There are five polo fields in the Sotogrande area, including the Santa Maria Polo Club. In addition to golf and polo, you will definitely be able to play tennis, because in Sotogrande you will also find several tennis courts.
Restaurants
In Sotogrande you will find dozens of interesting eateries. Everyone will find something for themselves in them. Starting with Andalusian cuisine, which you cannot fail to try while in the south of Spain, through various cafes, Chinese and Thai restaurants. You will easily find places with Indian delicacies or Italian cuisine here. If you are going to live in Sotogrande, you will certainly not complain about the monotony in the holiday menu.
Entertainment
Especially for families with children, we recommend Jugarnia Fun Park, a wonderful outdoor square with trampolines and merry-go-rounds. Here, the youngest can enjoy the mini golf course. Children can go crazy in the balls or ride the train. There is a cafe for parents, and special animations for children. Admission to the park is free and it is open all year round.
Beaches
The main beach, not all 300 meters from the port of Sotogrande, is 2,250 meters long and 35 meters wide, it is a beach of dark sand typical of Andalusia. The beach is partly urbanized, you will find here umbrellas and sunbeds, as well as water equipment rental. There are also toilets and showers here.

The magnificent Punta Prima beach is 234 m long and 28 m wide. The beach is sandy with many rocky coves to explore.

Location
