A few kilometers away from Benidorm, Altea or Castell de Guadalest, it boasts a beautiful historic center that you will immediately fall in love with.
The old town of Polop, located on a hill and developed at the foot of an Arab castle, is one of the most interesting and best preserved in the region. Its picturesque, colorful streets full of flowers and carved ornaments are an inspiration for many artists.
The most outstanding building in the historical case is the church of San Pedro Apóstol, in the upper part of the city, just before the path leading to the castle.
Although there are few remains of Polop Castle, it is a must to visit its ruins, located on top of the hill on which the old town is located. Undoubtedly, the path leading to the castle itself is one of the most interesting places to visit in Polop. Impeccably maintained, like the rest of the municipality, the successful surface and its zig-zag route offer us impressive views of the city and the surrounding area.
The colorful fountain - Fuente de los Chorros also deserves a lot of attention. It is decorated with ceramic mosaics with the coats of arms of various cities in the province of Alicante and has as many as 221 springs.
When it comes to hiking trails in Polop, there is one itinerary that stands out from the rest: climbing Mount Ponotx, known as 'Sleeping Lion'. A large limestone mass with vertical walls that rises to a height of 1,183 meters. This is a route with a high degree of difficulty, due to the positive difference of over a thousand meters, which is a route reserved for people with very good physical condition and used to this type of mountain routes.
Polop has a wide variety of restaurants. But if you want an unforgettable dining experience, you need to make a reservation at the Ca l'Àngels restaurant. golf courses

Location
Benalmádena is just 20 km from Málaga and 40 km from Marbela. This city is loved by Spanish tourists. The high quality of services means that guests from all over the world moor to the port of Puerto Marina located here, and the cosmopolitan atmosphere makes it hard to think about anything else than just blissful rest and great fun.
Benalmádena can be divided into three main parts. These will be: Benalmádena Pueblo, the old Andalusian part with characteristic white buildings, the modern and residential Arroyo de la Miel and the wonderful port. Each of them is unique and worth attention.
1.Benalmádena Pueblo
A restored old town (pueblo) with narrow streets and two squares (Plaza de España and Plaza Andalucia). On the first is the La Niña bronze fountain, which is the symbol of Benalmádena Pueblo
2.Benalmádena Costa, the newest part of the city, located along the coast and directly adjacent to the sea. A significant part of its buildings are tourist facilities (hotels, restaurants, discos and the beach).
3. Arroyo de la Miel (Honey Stream) originally a separate settlement, located between the other two districts. It is the main residential area and the most commercially active part of the city.
Benalmádena is especially recommended for families with children, because it abounds in a large number of attractions prepared also for the youngest. Most of the most interesting ones can be found below:
COLUMBA'S FAIRY-TALE CASTLE
Colomares Castle is not really a castle, but a monument to Columbus. Nevertheless, it is beautiful and is one of the major attractions in Benalmádena. It was designed and built by Esteban Marin Martin. Its construction lasted from 1987 to 1994. An interesting fact is that in the castle there is the smallest church in the world, entered in the Guinness Book of Records. Its area is only 1.96 m2.
STUP
A living monument to the enlightened mind, a Buddhist monument to peace and harmony in the world and a place to study, reflect and meditate. A very interesting place, also due to the fact that it is the largest Stupa in Europe. Few people also know that it was designed by the Polish architect Wojciech Kossowski. An additional attraction is the beautiful panorama stretching from the hill.
BENALMADEN PORT
Puerto Marina is a good place for a family walk or dinner with wine. You can admire moored ships and interesting architecture here. The port is full of bars, shops and cafes. This place was twice hailed as the most beautiful port in the world. It has also been called the Andalusian Venice', due to its narrow streets, narrow canals and bridges. One of the attractions you can count on here is the aquarium. In Sea Life, you will find over 2,000 species of sea creatures, including: turtles, sharks and stingrays.
TIVOLI WORLD
An ideal option to spend time for both children and adults. Among the fountains and gardens, you can enjoy not only more than 30 attractions for the whole family, but also a rich gastronomic offer. It's an old-fashioned amusement park with classic attractions like Ferris Wheels, Bumper Cars and the Terror Mansion, as well as new offerings for the more adventurous. The tower, from which you can experience a stunning fall from a height of 60 meters, is undoubtedly one of the most spectacular attractions in the park.
TEREFERICO BENALMADENA - QUEUE
Teleférico Benalmádena is a cable car that will give you a bird's eye view of the whole city. The three-kilometer route leads to the peak of Calamorro in the Sierra de Mijas mountain range. Upon arrival, we can admire the beautiful panorama of the Costa del Sol, nearby Gibraltar, and in good weather, also the coast of Africa. In addition to the magnificent landscapes at the top of Calomorro, there are several other optional attractions waiting for us, such as: bird of prey shows, Andalusian horse training shows, trekking trails and bicycle trails.
BEACHES
Being in this beautiful city, it is certainly worth relaxing on one of the beaches of Benalmádena, and the choice is quite large: Arroyo Hondo, Carvajal, Bonita, Bil Bil, La Morera, Arroyo de la Miel, Benalnatura, Fuente de la Salud, La Perla, Las Viborillas , Playa de las Yucas, Torrebermeja, Santa Ana, Tajo de la Soga, Torremuelle, Torrequebrada y Torrevigía are options that are definitely worth taking when planning a stay in this place.

El Golfo de los Judios,
The Gulf of Jews, popularly known as "La Calita", is distinguished by a combination of fine sand and rocks. Hike through Cabo de la Huerta
One of the attractions of this environment is that we can explore it entirely on foot, using a simple walking route that allows us to go from Playa de la Albufereta to Playa de San Juan, connecting all the coves. You can return by public transport or on foot, following the same route.
It is also an environment of great natural value, being a refuge for many species of birds, plants and marine organisms. Cabo de la Huerta is a "treasure of nature", one of the few unspoilt areas of the Alicante coast.

There is no doubt that the coves located in Cabo de la Huerta in Alicante stand out for their sand, rocks, vegetation, wonderful waters and small size. In addition, they are ideal for diving, snorkeling and other water sports.

Pulpí Geode
In addition to its spectacular beaches and coves, it stands out as a true natural gem that has been transformed into a tourism engine since opening to the public in 2019: Geode. Located in Mina Rica, in Pilar de Jaravía, it is a gigantic geode about eight meters long and two meters high. This new residential project is located in the town of Busot, 20 km from the center of Alicante. Just 10 minutes from your new home are the most beautiful beaches in the area: El Campello and San Juan beaches. The estate will consist of independent villas and semi-detached houses with 2 and 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. This residential complex offers a wide range of luxurious amenities, including a stunning, extensive common area and beautifully landscaped grounds. The urbanization will include a public swimming pool, jacuzzi and green areas. available only to residents.
Planned construction completion date: September 30, 2024
Location
Just 20 kilometers from the capital Alicante, the small and quiet town of Busot is an excellent alternative to enjoy nature and cultural visits. If you don't know it, it's very likely that this small town located on the slopes of the iconic Sierra del Cabeçó d'Or will surprise you.
In the city there are all the services necessary for everyday life, supermarkets, restaurants, banks, schools, etc. In 10 minutes you can drive to the municipalities of Mutxamel, Campello and San Juan. Next to this residential area there are the Municipal Sports Center, a supermarket and cafes, and just 5 minutes away, in the urban area, all city services.
Busot, whose etymological meaning is "a place in the forest", is located in an extremely picturesque natural landscape. The city has a very interesting tourist offer that cannot be ignored, including places and monuments such as:
Cuevas del Canelobre
The Canelobre Caves are Busot's main tourist attraction and are among the most impressive caves in the Valencian Community. These are caves with an area of over 80,000 m2, where you can find stalactites, stalagmites, jellyfish and columns in a karst cave, which are rare in our country. The tour leaves no one indifferent and is the first place you should discover when visiting Busot. The entrance to the caves is located at an altitude of 700 meters, on the western slope of the Sierra del Cabeçó d'Or.
Castillo de Busot
The Muslim-derived Busot Castle was of strategic importance in the area during the conquest of James I, as it became a border point between the kingdoms of Aragon and Castile. The castle was reinforced with the surrounding walls, and there are even remains of the first settlers' houses around it. Unfortunately, not much has survived, but the access is very well prepared and it is worth climbing the mountain, just to admire the views and try to imagine what the life of the soldiers guarding this watchtower would have been like.
Sierra del Cabeçó d'Or
Cabeçó d'Or is a spectacular mountain rising to a height of 1,209 meters, less than ten kilometers from the Mediterranean Sea. This mountain range is characterized by impressive ridges and limestone walls that have been Alicante's climbing school for decades.

Pilar de la Horadada has everything you need to enjoy the sea, pine forests and Spanish sun. The coastline of Pilar de la Hordada is over 4 kilometers long along a very diverse scenery. Location
The charming town of Estepona is a hidden gem located along the stunning Costa del Sol. With its idyllic Mediterranean landscape, Estepona offers a wonderful combination of picturesque beaches, rich cultural heritage and a vibrant atmosphere. Let's check out what this city has to offer.
Estepona is conveniently located a short distance from Malaga Airport, making it easily accessible to travelers. The airport is approximately 80 kilometers away, ensuring a smooth and comfortable journey for visitors.
Estepona boasts a collection of breathtaking beaches that will delight beach lovers and sun seekers alike. Some of the area's best beaches include Playa del Cristo, a sheltered cove with calm waters and a relaxing atmosphere, and Playa de la Rada, a vast stretch of golden sand offering a wide range of water sports. Playa del Saladillo is another fantastic option, known for its natural beauty and peaceful surroundings.
In addition to beautiful beaches, Estepona is also home to many attractions and activities. A must-see is the historic Old Town, known as Casco Antiguo. Wander the charming cobbled streets decorated with colorful flowerpots and learn about the city's rich cultural heritage. Admire traditional Andalusian architecture, visit the Church of San Luis, and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere of the bustling squares and bustling markets.
For art enthusiasts, the Estepona Museum of Contemporary Art is a hidden gem, home to an impressive collection of modern and contemporary works. The Estepona Orchidarium is another unique attraction, offering a mesmerizing display of colorful orchids and tropical flora.
Estepona also offers a variety of outdoor activities for nature lovers. The nearby Sierra Bermeja mountain range provides excellent hiking opportunities, allowing you to immerse yourself in stunning natural landscapes and enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the coast. Golf enthusiasts will delight in the numerous world-class golf courses in the area where they can play against the backdrop of lush greenery and azure skies.
When it comes to dining and entertainment, Estepona boasts a vibrant culinary scene. Explore charming streets lined with traditional tapas bars and seafood restaurants where you can enjoy the region's fresh and aromatic cuisine. The marina area, Puerto Deportivo, is a popular dining spot and offers a wide selection of restaurants and bars overlooking the yachts and the sparkling Mediterranean Sea.
There is always something to see and do in Estepona. Whether you stroll along the promenade, practice water sports, explore the historic streets or simply relax on the pristine beaches, Estepona promises unforgettable experiences for visitors of all ages.
Welcome to Estepona, where an enchanting combination of natural beauty, cultural heritage and coastal charm awaits to captivate your senses and create treasured memories!

All residences in this development have been designed in such a way that each apartment has impressive, panoramic views from spacious terraces and perfectly designed living rooms.

Heated swimming pool, communal pools, children's pool with play areas, panoramic gym, jacuzzi, relaxation areas, Kid's Club room, video games room and various sports fields. A living area designed to enjoy Mediterranean life without limits.
Location
Benidorm is a city located on the east coast of Spain and is one of the most popular holiday destinations in the entire country. Known for its stunning beaches, clear waters and vibrant nightlife, Benidorm attracts millions of tourists every year. Benidorm is the city with the most skyscrapers in Spain and is often called the second New York. Whether you're looking for a place to relax or have fun, Benidorm has something to offer everyone.
El Balcón del Mediterráneo
Benidorm also has a particularly romantic side. We are talking about El Balcón del Mediterráneo, a viewpoint that captivates not only with its appearance, but also with its location. The castle built on the rocks separates the two beaches, and its terrace offers an amazing view of the entire bay. This location used to be of strategic importance - it allowed for the observation of possible threats appearing on the horizon and the rapid organization of defense units. Today, El Balcón del Mediterráneo is one of the most popular tourist attractions in Benidorm and probably the most photographed place in this part of the Iberian Peninsula.
Beaches
Playa de Levante is one of Benidorm's two main beaches and is considered one of the best in the country. This vast beach of golden sand is perfect for sunbathing, swimming and soaking up the Mediterranean sun. You will also find many restaurants, bars and shops along the promenade.
Playa de Poniente is the largest beach in Benidorm: 3,000 meters of white sandy shore, which in some sections is over 100 meters wide! Located south of the center and awarded the Blue Flag, it is less crowded than Playa de Levante (the resort's other large beach) and is a favorite among locals. Playa de Poniente offers all services: umbrellas and deckchairs (available 11 months a year), free showers and toilets, playgrounds for children, lifeguards, easier access for disabled people, and even a public library, located directly on the beach.
Isla de Benidorm
As soon as you arrive in Benidorm and step onto the sandy beach, you will see an islet sticking out of the sea a few kilometers from the beach (exactly two nautical miles from the port of Benidorm). This is an island called Isla de Benidorm. The Spanish use another name for this island, Isla de los Periodistas. There are no people living on the island, it has no permanent inhabitants, although from Benidorm you can buy a trip to the islet, where you can eat a seafood meal in a restaurant.

properties.description:
Villa with sea and mountain views for sale in Jávea
It's hard to imagine a more luxurious lifestyle than that offered by this Mediterranean residence. This wonderful property is located in one of the most beautiful places on the Spanish coast - the seaside town of Jávea and offers breathtaking views of the Mediterranean Sea. Located in an elite residential area and just 8 minutes' drive from the sea, it is the perfect place to enjoy the tranquility and refined life that this area offers.
This licensed project is located on a 1,000 m2 plot in Monte Olimpo, an urbanization providing convenient access to all city services. The villa has two floors and has 4 very large bedrooms and 3 modern bathrooms. The use of natural materials and colors plays an important role in this project, thanks to which the interiors, despite their modernity, are very cozy and blend perfectly with the natural surroundings.
This property is truly spectacular and offers everything you could want in a dream home. On the ground floor you will find a very bright and spacious living area. Open and bright spaces and large, floor-to-ceiling windows with a minimalist design allow for daylight throughout the day, blurring the boundaries between the interior and exterior of the building and offering undeniably beautiful views of the Mediterranean garden, majestic mountains and dazzling sea. The fully equipped, pioneering kitchen combines with the dining room and comfortable living room, creating a perfectly harmonious whole. on the same floor you will also find 3 luxurious bedrooms and two elegant bathrooms.
On the first floor there is a master bedroom with an en-suite bathroom and access to a private terrace with beautiful views. All bedrooms are equipped with wardrobes that provide plenty of storage space. The bathrooms are modern and well-equipped, with a shower cabin, elegant washbasin cabinets and stylish tiles.
The villa is surrounded by a Mediterranean garden, creating a picturesque and peaceful environment in which to relax. Residents also have a large infinity pool with a panoramic view of the sea, perfect for a refreshing swim on a hot summer day.
This unique residence is the perfect holiday home in Spain or as a first residence where you can spend most of your time enjoying the wonderful sunny days and relaxing lifestyle that the Costa Blanca has to offer.
Location
The charming seaside town of Jávea, often called Xàbia, is located on the northern part of the Costa Blanca. With a population of 35,000 inhabitants, Jávea has become a sought-after tourist destination, where more than half of the inhabitants are international expatriates who have chosen this picturesque city as their permanent home. Jávea is famous for its idyllic microclimate and is scientifically recognized as one of the most favorable microclimates in the world, second only to Rio de Janeiro.
From Jávea there are breathtaking views reaching to the coast of Ibiza, approximately 90 kilometers away. Convenient ferry services allow you to travel to Ibiza, a mecca for nightlife lovers and entertainment-seeking tourists.
Mount Montgo, rising to over 750 meters, graces the landscape as the highest point in the area, offering a vantage point for panoramic views of the city and nearby islands, including Portichol and Ambolo. A visit to this spectacular place is an absolute must-see.
For those looking for relaxation, Jávea offers popular beaches such as Arenal, Sardinella, Granadella and Barraca. These sunny shores provide the perfect backdrop for sunbathing, swimming and diving in the crystal clear waters of the Mediterranean Sea.
The historic center of Jávea is a charming mosaic of stone buildings, historic churches and atmospheric restaurants and shops. Here you will find a range of services available in multiple languages, making it accessible to visitors from all over the world. A stroll along the waterfront will allow you to enjoy panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea.
Don't miss the bustling fishing port, where every day you can find fresh shrimp, squid, sardines and other seafood that are tempting to try. The adjoining sailing club showcases an impressive array of yachts and motorboats owned by enthusiasts from across Europe drawn to the region's natural beauty.
As you walk along the harbor promenade, you'll encounter the winding Gorgos River, which forms a natural border between the harbor district and the Montanar district. The latter, the largest district of Jávea, has both sandy and rocky beaches, as well as renowned beach bars (chiringuitos) that serve exotic drinks throughout the season.
Montanar's architecture mainly focuses on charming single-family houses in a traditional style, decorated with characteristic red tiles and modern interiors with elements of glass and concrete. Separated by a road, this area has rarely visited pebbly beaches that provide peaceful escapes from the crowds.

properties.title: Excellent apartment overlooking the sea and 350 m from the beach in Fuengirola
properties.summary: New build apartment for sale in Fuengirola, Málaga: 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 119 m² built, communal pool, sea views. €567,000.
properties.description:
Modern apartment close to the beach for sale in Fuengirola.
We invite you to the presentation of a new residential estate, which is being built in a flawless location in the beautiful seaside city of Fuengirola. Just 350 meters from the residential area is Playa del Carvajal-La Torre, approximately 2 km long. The beach is home to the longest promenade on the Costa del Sol, which starts at the famous Sohail Castle. All apartments in this prestigious residence offer sea views and are oriented south and south-west. Treat yourself to Mediterranean life surrounded by crystal clear sea and majestic mountains.
This pioneering gated community was designed with the luxury and privacy of its residents in mind. You can choose from luxurious penthouses and apartments with 2, 3 and 4 bedrooms. The apartments are arranged on 3 levels, combining excellent orientation with fantastic views of the sea and the beautiful surroundings of the complex. The investments are characterized by very large terraces, as well as very bright interiors with large and modern spaces. The properties are designed to maximize the use of the area and location of the plot.
You will find high-quality amenities such as underfloor heating throughout the building and a modern, energy-saving aerothermal heating system. Each apartment includes 2 parking spaces in the basement and a storage room.
The buildings are surrounded by green areas and gardens, carefully designed to create a sense of peace and harmony around them, and owners can use on-site facilities such as a gym, heated swimming pool, jacuzzi, co-working space and a viewing area from which you can also admire the sea views.
This elite development has a strategic location 15 minutes from Malaga International Airport, 20 minutes from Marbella and 5 minutes from the center of Fuengirola, making it an ideal place to live. Just 30 minutes from your new home you can choose from 8 golf courses: Golf Torrequebrada, Cerrado del Águila Golf, Chaparral Golf, Mijas Golf, Santana Golf, Calanova Golf, Miraflores Golf and La Cala Golf. The complex is located close to the Hilton Hotel & Resort, which has great sports facilities, Nagomi Spa and a rooftop bar.
Location
Fuengirola is a city in the province of Málaga in the Autonomous Community of Andalusia. Currently, it is a large tourist center, with a population of up to 250,000 in the summer. It is located only 25 km from Malaga International Airport and is one of the most popular destinations on the Costa del Sol. Previously a small fishing village, Fuengirola has become a bustling metropolis with character.
The emergence of many upscale tapas bars, good cafes and restaurants, interspersed with chic boutiques and other interesting shops, as well as fabulous beaches make it an ideal holiday destination.
Beaches
The beaches of Fuengirola are one of the most popular tourist destinations on the Costa del Sol. With over 7 kilometers of coastline, Fuengirola is the perfect place to relax and enjoy the sun and sea. Fuengirola offers a wide range of beaches for all tastes and preferences. Whether you're looking for a lively beach with a wide range of services or a quiet and relaxing swimming spot, this city and its surroundings offer many options, depending on what your ideal plan is. Fuengirola's urban beaches are ideal for those looking for proximity and comfort on the beach, with a wide range of services and attractions. E.g.
- Playa del Castillo is perfect for water sports enthusiasts thanks to its calm waters.
- Playa de Los Boliches - this beach with fine sand is one of the longest in Fuengirola and is ideal for families.
- Santa Amalia is a popular beach with a wide stretch of sand and crystal clear sea, making it an ideal destination for tourists and locals.
- Playa de la Morera is for those who are looking for a more intimate beach, away from buildings and in full contact with nature.
Old Town
The old town is centered around the main square, Plaza de la Constitución, which has been redesigned but still retains its unique charm. It looks nice, especially during Christmas, when it is decorated with very attractive lights and decorations. It also looks attractive during the summer fair in Fuengirola, when the entire city takes part in annual street celebrations. The Los Boliches district also stands out in the city, one of the most frequently visited by tourists, where there is a wonderful beach with a family atmosphere. A stroll through the narrow pedestrian streets leading from the main square is a wonderful journey for many visitors, who discover some of the hidden secrets and delightful corners of this friendly Andalusian city.

properties.title: Stunning villa with sea views for sale in Altea
properties.summary: New build villa for sale in Altea, Alicante: 4 bedrooms, 6 bathrooms, 609.74 m² built, 1,431 m² plot, pool, sea views. €2,250,000.
properties.description:
Luxury villa with sea views for sale in Altea.
Elite World Estates presents a new project of a luxurious villa with a sea view located in the most beautiful city on the Costa Blanca - Altea. Luxury properties in this picturesque city have been enjoying unflagging popularity for years among investors who are looking for an ideal place for summer relaxation in an exclusive, convenient location and Mediterranean atmosphere. Real estate in Altea is a great investment and a way to live in the best style.
This exclusive residence will be built on a spacious plot of 1,431 m2 and will be arranged on two floors connected by internal stairs and an elevator. This luxurious house will have, among others: private swimming pool with heated water and automatic water cover with an area of 40 m2. You will find 4 large bedrooms and 4 elegant and fully equipped bathrooms. The project delights with its originality, and combined with a stunning view of the sea and the surrounding greenery, it will meet the requirements of even the most demanding investors. The villa is distinguished by its unique, modern style, the modernist shape of the property and the unique selection of furnishing and decoration details.
The developer offers various housing solutions that adapt to the needs of each client, choose the perfect project for you from a wide range of options. You also have a team of professionals at your disposal who can study, off-plan, any distribution modifications you want to make.
These homes are designed to take advantage of natural light, and with a south-facing orientation and large floor-to-ceiling windows, they provide stunning sea views. On the ground floor you will find a very bright and spacious living area, a living room with a fireplace, an open kitchen with an island fully equipped with household appliances (oven, microwave, ceramic hob, hood, fridge and dishwasher). All this creates a perfectly harmonious whole, offering a luxurious space to relax and spend time with your loved ones.
The perfectly planned external part also deserves great attention, as it perfectly complements the luxurious interior of the villa. The terrace provides a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor living, allowing you to fully enjoy the Mediterranean climate. Here you will find easy-to-maintain designer gardens with automatic irrigation, covered and uncovered terraces of 270 m2 and a covered parking lot for 2 cars. Whether you want to soak up the sun, dine al fresco, or simply relax in your private pool, this deck offers the perfect spot for everyone.
Location
Altea in Spain is considered one of the most beautiful cities. Beautiful beaches and promenades, whitewashed houses with colorful flowerpots, narrow cobbled streets, small handicraft shops, ice cream parlors and open-air restaurants are not all that this picturesque city has to offer.
Altea is located a 10-minute drive north of Benidorm (approximately 10 km), approximately 1 hour from Alicante and is one of the most memorable coastal towns on the Costa Blanca, retaining its unique Spanish charm despite increasing tourism and popularity. Altea is located directly by the sea, in the middle of a beautiful bay and is surrounded by hilly mountains. The name comes from the Moorish Althaya' which means health for all'.
The town center is a treasure trove of shops, art galleries, restaurants and small whitewashed buildings decorated with flowers - all waiting to be discovered on the winding and cobbled medieval streets.
The old town of Altea is preserved in a typically Spanish, or one could even say Andalusian, atmosphere. Whitewashed houses provide a blank canvas for Mediterranean flower beds. It's no wonder that Altea attracts artists and photographers from all over the world who want to experience the city's charm, incredible light and natural beauty. From cobbled streets, stunning views of the sea and mountains, to historic buildings.
Countless steps of narrow, charming streets lead from the coast to the Altea viewpoint. In the 16th century, the upper part of the old town of Altea was built to protect the city from attacks. The castle was built on what is now the Plaza de la Iglesia, and the upper part of the city was surrounded by a wall with three gates. Currently, only two of these gates exist, Vell Portal and Portal Nou.
The icon of the city is the famous Virgin de Consuelo church with a blue dome on the top - it is really worth seeing, and the view from the top of the bay of Altea with the mountains in the background is simply spectacular! The dome is a kind of symbol of the divinity of this city. Altea is a visually beautiful, atmospheric and incredibly charming city! It's hard to describe the mood here in words. The church was built in the 19th century with a magnificent interior with classic gold and floral motifs.
Altea's location at the foot of the 1,100-meter high Sierra Bernia, with its highest peak at 1,129 meters, and the 1,500-meter Sierra Aitana to the west, creates a magical atmosphere in the area. The mountain protects against cold winds from the interior. The mountainside lies like a green oasis all the way to the fertile lowlands and the sea. The river that flows through the city and thanks to which it is here is called Algar, which means healing river.
Altea and other towns in the north are among the greenest and most fertile areas of the entire Costa Blanca. Oranges and many exotic fruits are grown here.

properties.title: Fantastic villa with private pool in the picturesque district of Sucina
properties.summary: New build villa for sale in Campo de Murcia, Murcia: 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 107 m² built, 211 m² plot, pool. €325,900.
properties.description:
Villa with private pool for sale in Murcia
Your new villa with private pool is located in Sucina, a typical Spanish town located just a few kilometers from the beaches of Costa Calida and Mar Menor. It is also an ideal investment for golf lovers, here you have a wide selection of golf courses in the area, the nearest one is only 4 km from the residence. Murcia Airport is just 25 km away, while the AP-7 Pista Mediterraneo motorway connects you to Alicante Airport in just 45 minutes. Live in a privileged location and indulge in the Mediterranean lifestyle you have long dreamed of!
It is a modern villa with a contemporary style, with a clean and elegant design, with a layout oriented towards the Mediterranean light that permeates the entire interior of the house. With open living areas where the kitchen connects to the living room, creating a continuous environment bounded by a central island, it creates an amazing space for enjoying breakfast or a meal every day. The living-dining room connects to the veranda and pool terrace, creating one space.
Bedrooms create a quiet and peaceful space for rest and sleep. All of them are equipped with built-in wardrobes that provide plenty of storage space. The bedrooms and bathrooms are spacious and bright thanks to the orientation and large windows. letting in plenty of natural light.
The amazing solarium at the top of the house makes it unique and perfect to enjoy the sun all year round. It is a perfect place to organize meetings over a delicious dinner and wine with friends and family. There will be enough space (82 m2) to arrange a dining and lounge area, and maybe even a jacuzzi.
Location
About 30 kilometers from the capital of Murcia, in the coastal part of the so-called Campo de Murcia, there is the district of Sucina. It is well connected to the capital Murcia, located 29 km from the city center, and the RM-1 provides a direct connection to San Javier Airport and the beaches of Mar Menor.
One of the most interesting places is La Manga del Mar Menor. You can relax here, enjoying the charms of the sea and the attractions of the marinas. You'll also find vast white beaches like San Pedro del Pinatar, semi-wild coves like those in Cartagena, interesting landscapes like the eroded lands of Mazarrón, and fishing towns like Águilas.
The region is also famous for various properties beneficial to health and beauty. Thanks to the very salty water and mud of the Mar Menor, numerous beaches here are considered a kind of open-air spa. Apart from them, the region boasts real health resorts of very important importance.
Sucina has also gained importance as a "residential tourism" destination due to the presence of several residential golf estates nearby, due to its flat landscape and easy access to the regional airport.
Sucina has a wide range of essential services, including a Cultural Centre, medical center and schools, bank, optician, supermarket, as well as a range of hotel services and shops. Local fiestas are held every October in honor of the Virgen del Rosario, and the city also celebrates Semana Santa (Easter) with processions.

The developer offers apartments with 2 or 3 comfortable bedrooms and 2 fully equipped bathrooms. Open spaces, well-thought-out room layout, bright and natural colors and attention to the smallest detail make each of these elite properties meet the expectations of even the most demanding customers.
Make yourself comfortable in your elegant and fully equipped kitchen, perfectly combined with the dining room and the cozy living room. Here you will find high-quality household appliances as well as cabinets and drawers offering plenty of space for storing kitchen utensils. You can enjoy a spacious and comfortable space perfect for cooking, eating and relaxing with friends and family.

Mediterranean living at its best: Santa Rosalia Lake & Life Resort seeks to redefine the concept of luxury living, providing fantastic accommodation options for the whole family in a five-star complex with a total area of approximately 700,000 square meters.
Approximately 120,000 m2 of landscaped land with various sports and recreation centers, 16,000 native Mediterranean trees and plants, an impressive swimming lake and a beach with facilities for water sports, paddle boarding and kayaking. Highly secure, has access control and security services.

This is where some of the resort's attractions are held, including beach volleyball, kayaking, Adventure Golf and Pentanque tournaments.
Recycling
Santa Rosalía has a waste separation system to collect paper and cardboard, packaging, plastic, glass and other types of waste. Little things mean a lot when it comes to changing the world. In our sales office we use cardboard cups and we make sure to reduce paper consumption and recycle it. This policy is especially important at the Beach Club.
Energy efficiency
LED lighting is installed throughout the facility, controlled by sundials and low energy consumption. Energy efficiency isn't just about saving money. This is an essential measure that will help save our planet.

properties.title: Excellent villa with unobstructed sea views on the first coastline in Torrevieja
properties.summary: Villa for sale in Torrevieja, Alicante: 4 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, 210 m² built, 342 m² plot, pool, sea views. €990,000.
properties.description:
Ready-made villa in the first line to the sea for sale in Torrevieja.
We present a front villa in the seaside town of Torrevieja with wonderful views of the Mediterranean Sea. Immerse yourself in the luxurious lifestyle of Spain's Costa Blanca in this modern, ready-to-move residence located in a unique location. This area combines quiet relaxation surrounded by nature, privacy with the possibility of cultural plans offered by large neighboring cities. Make your dream of a Mediterranean residence come true with us and enjoy unrivaled, unobstructed sea views every day!
This excellent investment is a real gem, boasting ample space that makes entertaining guests an absolute delight. The unique design of the villa, located on a spacious plot of 342 m2, offers 4 luxurious bedrooms, 2 living rooms and 5 luxurious bathrooms. In addition, it also has a spacious basement, parking, a private swimming pool and a jacuzzi.
There will be enough space for a large family and friends. Everyone can enjoy privacy and a place to relax here. The interior is perfectly planned with contemporary open-plan living spaces. The living room has floor-to-ceiling windows that let in plenty of light and offer spectacular sea views. The luxurious and refined kitchen combines stone and oak wood, providing an exclusive finish and is equipped with high-class household appliances.
This villa means living surrounded by nature, taking advantage of all the advantages of peace and proximity to a dynamic city. It is located on a plot very close to the city center, separated only by a pleasant walk from the beach, bars, restaurants and shops in the area.
Location
Torrevieja, located about 40 kilometers from Alicante airport, is a city that never ceases to amaze, being a very desirable destination for many residents and foreigners. It is located on the Costa Blanca, in the province of Alicante and is very well connected to the rest of the country.
One of the reasons why it is worth living or relaxing in Torrevieja is the modernity of this city. This is mainly because it is a city in the development phase, due to its location and the large number of people who visit and live there. It is therefore a modern city, equipped with everything necessary to welcome tourists and residents. Moreover, multiculturalism reigns here, and you can hear different languages on the streets.
Torrevieja is famous for its beautiful beaches, where golden sand meets crystal clear water. Some of the best beaches in the area include La Mata Beach, Playa del Cura and Los Locos Beach. Soak up the sun, take a refreshing swim in the Mediterranean Sea or engage in a variety of water sports. The beautiful promenades along these beaches are perfect for leisurely strolls, full of charming cafes, restaurants and shops.
Beyond the beaches, Torrevieja offers a wealth of activities and attractions to suit all interests. Immerse yourself in local culture and history by visiting the Torrevieja Museum, where you can view fascinating exhibits showcasing the city's heritage. Take a leisurely boat trip from Marina de Torrevieja and admire the stunning coastline from a different perspective.
Golf enthusiasts will delight in the abundance of unique golf courses in the area. Some of the best golf courses near Torrevieja include Las Colinas Golf & Country Club, Villamartin Golf Club and La Marquesa Golf. Enjoy challenging fairways, scenic landscapes and world-class facilities while indulging in your favorite pastime.
When it comes to dining, Torrevieja offers a diverse culinary scene. Discover a wide range of restaurants, from traditional Spanish tapas bars to international cuisine, to suit every palate and preference. Don't forget to taste the fresh seafood dishes, a local specialty not to be missed.
For shopping enthusiasts, Habaneras and Ozone Leisure Center shopping centers are popular. These modern complexes are home to a variety of shops, boutiques and entertainment venues, providing a great shopping experience.
Torrevieja also boasts a nightlife, with numerous bars, clubs and live music venues. Whether you're looking for a relaxing evening with friends or an exciting night of dancing, Torrevieja's nightlife has something for everyone.

properties.title: Modern villa with sea views, only 70 m from La Mata beach in Torrevieja
properties.summary: New build villa for sale in Torrevieja, Alicante: 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 156 m² built, 172.8 m² plot, pool, sea views. €820,000.
properties.description:
Villa with sea views for sale in Torrevieja.
Elite World Estates offers a unique opportunity to purchase an exclusive dream home in a prime location in the La Mata district of Torrevieja. Magnificent sea views and an excellent location, just 70 meters from one of the most beautiful beaches on the entire Costa Blanca, are not all the advantages of this dream residence.
Each of these 3 fantastic homes has been designed to take full advantage of its location on the Mediterranean Sea, benefiting from ideal sunny conditions and beautiful views. The terraces face south, so the sun shines here from morning to evening.
The villas are designed in a modern style and high-quality architecture, using the most modern construction methods and materials. The property consists of two full floors, a private swimming pool (approx. 14 m2) and terraces. The rooftop solarium offers its residents beautiful views of the turquoise Mediterranean Sea and the sandy beach of La Mata. All villas also have a closed parking lot.
On the ground floor there is an open and spacious living area with a large living room, dining room and fully equipped kitchen. From the living room there is direct access to a large terrace and swimming pool, which will certainly make warm days more pleasant.
Each of these luxury homes has four large bedrooms, one on the ground floor and three on the lower level. Two bedrooms have direct access to the outdoor area and swimming pool. You will find three exclusive bathrooms, one on the ground floor and two on the lower level. One of the two with direct entrance from one of the bedrooms.
The villas are completely insulated to ensure an optimal internal climate. Excellent insulation retains heat in summer and cold in winter. The villas will attract attention because they are the first in Spain to be built with the new Nordic wall system.
Location
Torrelamata (officially La Mata) is a district of Torrevieja, in the province of Alicante, in the Valencian Community. It is bordered to the north by Guardamar del Segura and to the west by the Lagunas de La Mata and Torrevieja Natural Park.
This city boasts an extraordinary, healthy microclimate, whose healthy properties come from, among others, from the nearby large salt deposits located in two salty lagoons located in the very center of the city.
La Mata is a privileged area less than 50 meters from the wonderful Playa de la Mata, over 15 km long, and the Lagunas de La Mata Natural Park.
It is an amazing adventure to see these two lakes: pink and green, which are surrounded by natural parks with many species of birds, including flamingos. Laguna de Torrevieja owes its pink color to the high salinity of the water, the crustaceans living here and algae that produce carotenoids. The view is very impressive, no wonder it is one of the biggest tourist attractions of this place.
The second lagoon (La Laguna de la Mata) is green. The park's interpretive center is located here. We can see unusual plants here, such as Aleppo pine, orchid, thyme, seness, saffron and many others.
Also noteworthy are the vineyards where the local de la Mata wine is produced.
The climate in Torrevieja definitely encourages sunbathing and relaxing on one of the many local sandy beaches. There's a lot to choose from, so it's hard to decide which beach to choose for your holiday. Well, one of the most popular is Playa de la Mata, approximately 2.5 km long. This beautiful sandy beach is marked with the Blue Flag and is accessible to people with disabilities. People who like to spend time actively on the beach can play on one of several volleyball courts.

Additionally, the property has a spacious solarium on the roof with an area of approx. 100 m2, from which you can admire beautiful views of the sea. There will be enough space for a large family and friends. Everyone can enjoy privacy and a place to relax here. The interior is perfectly planned with contemporary open-plan living spaces. The living room has floor-to-ceiling windows that let in plenty of light. The luxurious and refined kitchen combines modernity and practicality, ensuring an exclusive finish and is equipped with high-class household appliances.
The perfectly designed outdoor area of the villa is perfect for enjoying the Mediterranean climate all year round. You will experience special moments here with your loved ones using a private swimming pool (6 x 3), a beautiful garden, a sunbathing area and a barbecue area. This villa is the perfect choice for anyone looking for a luxurious and peaceful lifestyle on the beautiful Costa Blanca.
Location
Polop de la Marina, located a few kilometers from Benidorm, Altea and Castell de Guadalest, boasts a beautiful historic center that you will immediately fall in love with. It is located approximately 15 kilometers from the coast and has less than 5,000 inhabitants.
The old town of Polop, located on a hill and developed at the foot of a castle of Arab origin, is one of the most interesting and best preserved in the voivodeship. Its picturesque, colorful streets full of flowers and carved ornaments are an inspiration for many artists.
The most outstanding building in the historical case is the church of San Pedro Apóstol, in the upper part of the city, just before the path leading to the castle.
Although there are few remains of Polop Castle, you must visit its ruins, located on the top of the hill on which the old town is located. Without a doubt, the path leading to the castle itself is one of the most interesting places to visit in Polop. Impeccably well-kept, just like the rest of the commune, the beautiful surface and its zigzag route offer us impressive views of the city and the surrounding area.
The colorful fountain - Fuente de los Chorros - also deserves great attention. It is decorated with ceramic mosaics with the coats of arms of various cities in the province of Alicante and has as many as 221 springs.
If we talk about hiking trails in Polop, there is one route that stands out from the rest: climbing Mount Ponotx known as the Sleeping Lion'. A large limestone mass with vertical walls that rises to a height of 1,183 meters. This is a route with a high degree of difficulty, due to the positive difference of over a thousand meters, and is a route reserved for people in very good physical condition and accustomed to this type of mountain routes.
There are many different restaurants in Polop. But if you want to experience an unforgettable dining experience, you must make a reservation at the Ca l'Àngels restaurant. Vicenta and Paco Teuler, together with other family members, run a restaurant where traditional cuisine with local products (even from their own garden) reigns supreme. An innovative wine list and artisan desserts complete the excellent offer.

The coastline of Pilar de la Hordada is over 4 kilometers long along a very diverse scenery. There you will find wide beaches with fine white sand, small stone wall ledges suspended over the water and small and intimate hidden coves with golden sand.
The sea here is usually calm, the beaches are safe, there are no steep slopes, which allows even the smallest children to swim safely. Moreover, clear water and great visibility invite divers to observe the beauty of aquatic life.
The cleanliness of the beaches in Pilar de la Hordada has been awarded the blue flag of the European Union, which guarantees a healthy environment.
Inland, you can make various interesting trips near the towns of Sierra and Escalona. There are two marked tourist routes along the Rio Seco riverbed, 19 kilometers long, definitely worth a visit. Gastronomy has a privileged place in the culture of this beautiful city. Location
Mijas is one of the largest towns in the province of Malaga, consisting of 3 different districts: Mijas Pueblo, Mijas Costa and Mijas la Cala. The most popular, attracting numerous tourists and fans of Andalusian white villages, are Mijas Pueblo.
It is a picturesque town located several kilometers from the coast, on the side of the well-known town of Fuengirola. The nearest metropolis is Malaga, approximately 35 km away. It is a similar distance from the city of Marbella. Mijas is about half an hour by car from Malaga airport.
The white houses located several kilometers from the coast look from a distance as if they were glued to the mountain slope. The town tries to preserve the atmosphere of a traditional, white, Andalusian village.
Mijas la Cala offers many interesting pubs and restaurants where you can refresh yourself with cool sangria or tapas, or eat typical Andalusian dishes, such as gazpacho or seafood dishes. However, La Cale de Mijas does not live only in Andalusian cuisine. You will also find Greek and Chinese restaurants here, as well as one Thai and several Indian restaurants.
One of the more popular places in La Cala de Mijas is Legends Bar La Cala. You can not only drink good drinks and eat something nice here, but above all you can spend a truly fantastic evening listening to live music. It is an intimate place where thematic events are often held. The place has good opinions among tourists and it is worth stopping by at least for a moment.
Mijas Pueblo is a multicultural town whose inhabitants are mostly foreigners. The Andalusian town is also called the kingdom of golf. Mijas Pueblo is famous primarily for its unusual taxis operated by donkeys. The idea was born in the 1960s, when tourists began to accost residents returning from work in quarries, whose transport consisted of donkeys. Their popularity was used to explore the city, which is why it is still one of the forms of 'taking a ride' and viewing the city.
In Mijas, it is worth visiting several observation decks, which offer a beautiful view of the coast and the town itself. One of the most famous is located on Avenida del Compas, right next to the sanctuary of the patron saint of Mijas. The second point with a panorama can be found in the Gardens on the Walls (Jardin de las Murallas).
Another unusual attraction of the town is the Mayan Monkey Mijas Chocolate Factory, called the smallest chocolate factory in the world, at Plaza Virgen de la Peña 15. In addition to producing chocolate from natural, local products, it is also famous for its workshops where you can produce your own chocolate.

La Mata is a district of Torrevieja, in the province of Alicante, in the Valencian Community. It is bordered to the north by Guardamar del Segura and to the west by the Lagunas de La Mata and Torrevieja Natural Park.
This city boasts an extraordinary, healthy microclimate, whose healthy properties come from, among others, from the nearby large salt deposits located in two salty lagoons located in the very center of the city.
La Mata is a privileged area less than 50 meters from the wonderful Playa de la Mata, over 15 km long, and the Lagunas de La Mata Natural Park.

The climate in Torrevieja definitely encourages sunbathing and relaxing on one of the many local sandy beaches. Location
Casares is a commune in the province of Málaga, in the autonomous community of Andalusia, in southern Spain. It is located on the border with the province of Cadiz, in the western Costa del Sol region. Casares is the prototype of a white Andalusian town: narrow, steep and winding streets and whitewashed houses. It is located only 16 kilometers from Estepona and forms a typical postcard of the Andalusian city.
In fact, the name Casares is influenced by the name of Julio Cesar, who in 61 BC visited the famous Baños Hediondos de Carratraca to cure himself of a skin disease using sulfuric waters, making the place very famous throughout Rome for its healing properties.
The steep and winding streets of Casares are the perfect place to relax, discover corners that don't appear in guidebooks, local craft shops and small town bars to stop at along the way.
Casares Castle
Situated at the top of the city, it towers over the valleys, hills and coastal plains stretching from the Serranía de Ronda to the Bay of Algeciras, providing a wonderful view of part of the provinces of Malaga and Cadiz. It is one of the most picturesque and beautiful corners of the commune, which is a must-see.
Hedionda Baths
They say the devil breathed his last here when he was banished by Santiago. This is one of the legends that the folk imagination keeps alive to justify the smell of sulfur in the waters. Known as Baños de la Hedionda, a resource of cultural importance, they constitute one of the historical landmarks of the Utrera massif and the whole of Casares in general. It is about the Iron Sulfur Baths, located in a beautiful and favorable place that people have been able to use since Roman times. The square spa complex with a hanging vault and two barrel vaults is located on the right bank of the Albarrán stream, very close to the border with the commune of Manilva.

Location
Torrevieja, a city nestled about 45 km from Alicante, is famed for its unique, healthy microclimate. This is largely attributed to the large salt deposits and two remarkable lagoons, Laguna de Torrevieja and La Laguna de la Mata, right in the city's heart. These lagoons, one pink and the other green, are not only a visual marvel but also a habitat for diverse bird species, including flamingos. The pink hue of Laguna de Torrevieja, caused by high salinity, crustaceans, and algae, makes it a standout attraction.
La Laguna de la Mata, with its green waters, is home to the park's interpretative center and a variety of unique flora, including Aleppo pine and orchids. The area's vineyards are also noteworthy, producing the local wine de la Mata.
Torrevieja's climate is perfect for beach lovers. From the 2.5 km long, Blue Flag-awarded Playa de la Mata to the accessible and vibrant beaches of Playa de los Locos and Playa del Cura, there's a beach for every preference. In the city center, the natural pools amidst the rocky coast offer a unique swimming experience, enhanced by nearby statues like the Man of the Sea and Beautiful Lola. Cala Ferris and Cala Piteras, with their stunning views, palm trees, and opportunities for snorkeling, are not to be missed.
Strolling along the Vista Alegre promenade, you'll immerse yourself in the city's lively atmosphere, with a plethora of bars, restaurants, cafes, and shops. For entertainment, Torrevieja boasts the Aquopolis water park and a nearby amusement park, plus open-air summer discos.
Sports enthusiasts will find Torrevieja a haven, with facilities for football, handball, tennis, rugby, swimming, and more. The city, once home to only an observation tower (the 'old tower' or 'torre vieja'), has transformed into an architectural wonder.
With over 300 sunny days a year, Torrevieja is more than a vacation spot; it's a tempting destination for an extended stay or a new home.

Location
Benalmádena is located just 20 km from Málaga and 40 km from Marbella. This city is loved by Spanish tourists. The high quality of services attracts guests from all over the world to the port of Puerto Marina, and the cosmopolitan atmosphere makes it difficult to think about anything other than blissful rest and great fun.
Benalmádena can be divided into three main parts. It will be: Benalmádena Pueblo, the ancient Andalusian part with characteristic white buildings, the modern and residential Arroyo de la Miel, and a wonderful port. Each of them is unique and worth attention.
1.Benalmádena Pueblo
A restored old town (pueblo) with narrow streets and two squares (Plaza de España and Plaza Andalucia). The first one features the La Niña bronze fountain, which is the symbol of Benalmádena Pueblo
2.Benalmádena Costa, the newest part of the city, located along the coast and directly adjacent to the sea. A significant part of its buildings are tourist facilities (hotels, catering outlets, discos and the beach).
3.Arroyo de la Miel (Honey-flowing stream), originally a separate settlement, located between the other two districts. It is the main residential district and the most commercially active part of the city.
Benalmádena is especially recommended for families with children, because it has a lot of attractions also for the youngest. Most of the most interesting ones can be found below:
THE FAIRYTALE CASTLE OF COLUMBUS
Colomares Castle is not actually a castle, but a monument in honor of Columbus. Nevertheless, it is beautiful and one of the biggest attractions in Benalmádena. It was designed and built by Esteban Marin Martin. Its construction lasted from 1987 to 1994. An interesting fact is that the castle houses the smallest church in the world, entered in the Guinness Book of Records. Its area is only 1.96 m2.
STUPA
A living monument to the enlightened mind, a Buddhist monument to peace and harmony in the world, and a place for learning, reflection and meditation. A very interesting place, also due to the fact that it is the largest Stupa in Europe. Few people also know that it was designed by the Polish architect Wojciech Kossowski. An additional attraction is the beautiful panorama stretching from the hill.
PORT OF BENALMADENNA
Puerto Marina is a good place for a family walk or dinner with wine. You can admire the ships moored here and the interesting architecture. The port is full of numerous bars, shops and cafes. This place has been twice named the most beautiful port in the world. It was also called the "Venice of Andalusia" due to its streets, narrow canals and bridges. One of the attractions you can count on here is the aquarium. In Sea Life, you will find over 2,000 species of sea creatures, including turtles, sharks and rays.
TIVOLI WORLD
An ideal way to spend time for both children and adults. Among the fountains and gardens you can enjoy not only over 30 attractions for the whole family, but also a rich gastronomic offer. It's an old-style theme park, with classic attractions such as Ferris wheels, bumper cars and the Mansion of Terror, as well as new offerings for the more adventurous. The tower, from which you can experience a stunning 60-meter fall, is undoubtedly one of the most spectacular attractions in the park.
TEREFERICO BENALMADENA - QUEUE
Teleférico Benalmádena is a cable car that will give you a bird's eye view of the entire city. The three-kilometer route leads to the Calamorro peak in the Sierra de Mijas mountain range. After arriving, we can admire a beautiful panorama of the Costa del Sol, nearby Gibraltar, and, if the weather is good, also the African coast. In addition to the wonderful landscapes at the top of Calomorro, there are several other optional attractions, such as: bird of prey shows, Andalusian horse training shows, trekking trails and bicycle trails.
BEACHES
While in this beautiful city, it is definitely worth relaxing on one of Benalmádena's beaches, and there is a large selection: Arroyo Hondo, Carvajal, Bonita, Bil Bil, La Morera, Arroyo de la Miel, Benalnatura, Fuente de la Salud, La Perla, Las Viborillas , Playa de las Yucas, Torrebermeja, Santa Ana, Tajo de la Soga, Torremuelle, Torrequebrada y Torrevigía are options that are certainly worth using when planning a stay in this place.

The idea was born in the 1960s, when tourists began to accost residents returning from work in quarries, whose transport consisted of donkeys. Their popularity was used to explore the city, which is why it is still one of the forms of 'taking a ride' and viewing the city.
In Mijas, it is worth visiting several observation decks, which offer a beautiful view of the coast and the town itself. Another unusual attraction of the town is the Mayan Monkey Mijas Chocolate Factory, called the smallest chocolate factory in the world, at Plaza Virgen de la Peña 15. In addition to producing chocolate from natural, local products, it is also famous for its workshops where you can produce your own chocolate.

This small municipality of Arab origin is proud of its location on the Mediterranean coast and its very charming landscape, as well as the large number of traces full of history.
The suggestive landscape of Els Poblets has a lot to do with the proximity of the Girona river, which facilitated the development of agriculture, and this in turn changed the land and the way it was inhabited, through rural roads and an urban centre that still preserves farmhouses, oil mills and much more. Villajoyosa has been associated with chocolate since the 19th century. The popular Spanish chocolate factory, Valor, is located here. properties.description:
Villa with sea views for sale in the prestigious Quinta Golf & Country Club.
La Quinta in Benahavís is one of the most luxurious urbanizations in all of Europe. This is a place where luxury construction abounds: clean lines, modern design and technology, maximum energy efficiency, integration with the landscape and the environment. These are just some of the features of real estate in Benahavis that make investing in this area increasingly popular. In Benahavís, luxury is more than a lifestyle, it is a haven in itself.
We are proud to present a new, exclusive project consisting of 18 individually designed villas located on the 200-hectare area of the prestigious La Quinta Golf Club. Surrounded by a wonderful area bordering a UNESCO biosphere reserve. These stunning and ultra-modern villas are located just 15 minutes from Marbella. The views of the Mediterranean Sea, the Strait of Gibraltar and the African coast are simply spectacular.
These designer houses will be very different from all investments previously built in this elite area. The 18 villas, as well as the furniture and accessories they contain, differ from each other. What they have in common, apart from their stunning views, is that they all feature the highest standard of design and feature a level of innovation and creativity rarely seen in residential development.
Home automation and general lighting are of the highest quality, making each villa a truly smart home. All villas are located on separate plots to ensure maximum privacy, with large terraces, large gardens, real infinity pools and spaces that can be used as entertainment rooms, gyms and home offices.
This concept is crucial in the design of any villa, where the living room and terrace seamlessly merge to create one spacious living space. In key parts of the villa, windows hide in the walls, providing unobstructed panoramic views of the idyllic nature.
All the amenities you could need are at your fingertips, including golf, water sports on the lake, a gourmet restaurant, bar and beach bar, exclusive spa, tennis courts and a selection of shops. These amenities, combined with the comprehensive facilities in each villa, mean owners will never have to leave the resort unless they want to.
Building today without jeopardizing tomorrow is the core value of the project, which is undergoing BREEAM certification. Design improvements resulting from this certification result in sustainable homes that improve the well-being of the people who live in them, help protect natural resources and make property investment more attractive.
Location
In Benahavís, nature, gastronomy, high-quality architecture and luxury coexist in perfect harmony. The commune has the most mountainous topography of the entire western Costa del Sol, many golf courses with carefully developed landscapes, a gastronomy that dances between the mountains and the sea and an architecture that simultaneously combines ancient Arabic features with the most modern ones on the market.
This white city is embedded in a landscape of rich flora and fauna both aesthetically, functionally and ecologically, allowing visitors to enjoy the three rivers that cross it: Guadaiza, Guadalmansa and Guadalmina. Read on to learn more about this white city characterized by clean air and modernity. From its height you can see 100 kilometers of the Spanish coast and even the north of the African continent.
Golf courses
The golf courses in Benahavis were designed by world-class golf course designers such as Robert Trent Jones, Severiano Ballesteros, and Jack Niclaus. In Benahavis, the golf season lasts all year round. The mild climate, great infrastructure, and delicious restaurants attract fans of this sport from all over the world. You can play in 12 clubs, including Los Flamingos Golf Club, La Quinta Golf & Country Club, La Zagaleta and Club de Golf Benahavís. The greenery of golf courses is an integral part of the Benahavis landscape. This is another reason why property investors in Spain choose Benahavis.
Restaurants
Benahavis is also famous for the best restaurants in Andalusia. We recommend visiting one of them: El Abanico, Bodegon Gallery, Rufino or Lemon Grass. El Abanico serves local and European cuisine, including vegetarian dishes. Similarly at Bodegon Gallery and Rufino. If you want Asian cuisine, it's best to visit Lemon Grass - the local Thai chef specializes in Asian Fusion, and the restaurant itself is called the best Asian cuisine on the Costa del Sol.
A place full of possibilities
It's impossible not to like Benahavis, it's a perfect place to relax, meet friends in restaurants and cafes or on the golf course. It is also a great base for hiking, cycling and swimming. Art lovers will also find something for themselves here: in the David Marschall gallery you can buy beautiful sculptures, inspired by nature, combined with ready-made objects - lathe chips, railway sleepers. The artist creates abstract sculptures, figures that are a combination of ceramics, glass and metal, wood and other materials.

Golden Mile The Golden Mile is one of the most beautiful and luxurious avenues in Spain, which is also the symbol of Marbella. In the basement there is a bedroom, gym, spa, bathroom, equipment room, large media room and patio with Japanese garden.

An outdoor area with a magnificent garden, plenty of space for sun loungers, patio furniture and a wonderful view of the golf course. It will be straightforwardly the perfect place for you and your loved ones to relax and enjoy the Mediterranean climate that the sunny Costa Blanca offers.
Location
Picturesque Estepona is a hidden gem located along the magnificent Costa del Sol. With an idyllic Mediterranean landscape, Estepona offers a wonderful combination of picturesque beaches, rich cultural heritage and a vibrant atmosphere. Let's take a look at what this town has to offer.
Estepona is conveniently located a short distance from Malaga Airport, making it easily accessible for travellers. The airport is approximately 80 kilometres away, ensuring a smooth and comfortable journey for visitors.
Estepona boasts a collection of breathtaking beaches that will delight beach lovers and sun seekers. Some of the best beaches in the area are Playa del Cristo, a sheltered cove with calm waters and a relaxing atmosphere, and Playa de la Rada, a vast strip of golden sand offering a wide range of water sports. Playa del Saladillo is another fantastic option, known for its natural beauty and tranquil surroundings.
Estepona is also home to many attractions and activities. Be sure to visit the historic Old Town, known as Casco Antiguo. Wander through the charming cobbled streets decorated with colourful pots and explore the city's rich cultural heritage. Admire the traditional Andalusian architecture, visit the Church of San Luis and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere of the bustling squares and lively markets.
Estepona also offers a variety of outdoor activities for nature lovers. The nearby Sierra Bermeja mountain range provides excellent hiking, allowing you to immerse yourself in stunning natural landscapes and enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the coast. Golf enthusiasts will be delighted with the numerous world-class courses in the area, where they can play against a backdrop of lush greens and azure skies.
When it comes to restaurants and entertainment, Estepona boasts a vibrant culinary scene. Explore the charming streets with traditional tapas bars and seafood restaurants, where you can enjoy the fresh and flavoursome cuisine of the region. The marina area, Puerto Deportivo, is a popular dining destination and offers a wide selection of restaurants and bars overlooking the yachts and sparkling Mediterranean Sea.

Location
Benahavís has the most mountainous topography of the entire western Costa del Sol, a number of golf courses with meticulously landscaped gardens, a gastronomy that dances between the mountains and the sea and an architecture that simultaneously combines ancient Arabian features with the most modern on the market.
This white city is integrated into a landscape of rich flora and fauna both aesthetically, functionally and ecologically, allowing visitors to enjoy the three rivers that cross it: the Guadaiza, Guadalmansa and Guadalmina. Read on to find out more about this white city characterised by clean air and modernity. From its heights, you can see 100 kilometres of Spanish coastline and even the north of the African continent.
Golf courses
The golf courses in Benahavis, were designed by world-class golf course designers such as Robert Trent Jones, or Severiano Ballesteros, or Jack Niclaus. At Benahavis, the golf season lasts all year round. The mild climate, great infrastructure and excellent restaurants attract lovers of the sport from all corners of the world. You can play in 12 clubs, including Los Flamingos Golf Club, La Quinta Golf & Country Club, La Zagaleta or the Club de Golf Benahavís. The green of the golf courses is an integral part of the Benahavis landscape. This is another reason why property investors in Spain choose Benahavis.
Restaurants
Benahavis is also famous for the best restaurants in Andalusia. We recommend taking a look at one of them: El Abanico, Bodegon Gallery, Rufino or Lemon Grass. El Abanico serves local and European cuisine, including vegetarian dishes. Likewise at Bodegon Gallery and Rufino. If you fancy Asian cuisine, the best place to look is Lemon Grass - the Thai chef there specialises in Asian Fusion, and the restaurant itself is described as the best Asian cuisine on the Costa del Sol.
A place full of possibilities
Benahavis is impossible not to like, it's a great place to relax, meet friends in the restaurants and cafes or on the golf course. It is also a great base for hiking, cycling and swimming. Art lovers will also find something for themselves here: in the David Marschall gallery, you can buy beautiful sculptures, inspired by nature, combined with readymade objects - turning chips, railway sleepers. The artist creates abstract sculptures, figures that are a combination of ceramics, glass and metal, wood and other materials.

Casares is one of the most beautiful white villages of Malaga on the Costa del Sol. It is located only 16 kilometers from Estepona and forms a typical postcard of the Andalusian city. The arrangement of the houses, very picturesque, earned it the name of the hanging city.
Casares' origins date back to Iberian and Phoenician times, although its name comes from Roman domination; in fact, the name Casares is influenced by the name of Julio Cesar, who in 61 BC visited the famous Baños Hediondos de Carratraca to cure himself of a skin disease using sulfuric waters, making the place very famous throughout Rome for its healing properties.
The steep and winding streets of Casares are the perfect place to relax, discover corners that don't appear in guidebooks, local craft shops and small town bars to stop at along the way.
Casares Castle
Situated at the top of the city, it towers over the valleys, hills and coastal plains stretching from the Serranía de Ronda to the Bay of Algeciras, providing a wonderful view of part of the provinces of Malaga and Cadiz. It is one of the most picturesque and beautiful corners of the commune, which is a must-see.
Hedionda Baths
They say the devil breathed his last here when he was banished by Santiago. This is one of the legends that the folk imagination keeps alive to justify the smell of sulfur in the waters. Known as Baños de la Hedionda, a resource of cultural importance, they constitute one of the historical landmarks of the Utrera massif and the whole of Casares in general. It is about the Iron Sulfur Baths, located in a beautiful and favorable place that people have been able to use since Roman times. The square spa complex with a hanging vault and two barrel vaults is located on the right bank of the Albarrán stream, very close to the border with the commune of Manilva.

Mijas Pueblo is famous primarily for its unusual taxis operated by donkeys. The idea was born in the 1960s, when tourists began to accost residents returning from work in quarries, whose transport consisted of donkeys. Their popularity was used to explore the city, which is why it is still one of the forms of 'taking a ride' and viewing the city.

Calpe, an enchanting seaside town located on the Mediterranean Sea, entices you with its undeniable charm and abundance of attractions. Upon arrival, you will be delighted by the stunning beaches, which have won prestigious Q' certificates for quality and the Blue Flag. Location
On the beautiful Costa Blanca, deep in the province of Alicante, you will find charming towns that are often overshadowed by other coastal or more famous ones. A clear example is Polop de la Marina, located a few kilometers from Benidorm, Altea or Castell de Guadalest, with a beautiful historic center that you will immediately fall in love with.
Located in the Marina Baja region of Alicante, approximately 15 kilometers from the coast, Polop de la Marina is a small town with less than 5,000 inhabitants.
The Polop Old Town, located on a hill and developed at the foot of a castle of Arabic origin, is one of the most interesting and best preserved in the voivodeship. Its picturesque, colorful streets full of flowers and carved ornaments are an inspiration for many artists.
The most outstanding building in the historical case is the church of San Pedro Apóstol, in the upper part of the city, just before the path leading to the castle.
Although there are few remains of Polop Castle, you must visit its ruins, located on the top of the hill on which the old town is located. Without a doubt, the path leading to the castle itself is one of the most interesting places to visit in Polop. Impeccably well-kept, just like the rest of the commune, the beautiful surface and its zigzag route offer us impressive views of the city and the surrounding area.
The colorful fountain - Fuente de los Chorros - also deserves great attention. It is decorated with ceramic mosaics with the coats of arms of various cities in the province of Alicante and has as many as 221 springs.
If we talk about hiking trails in Polop, there is one route that stands out from the rest: climbing Mount Ponotx known as the Sleeping Lion'. A large limestone mass with vertical walls that rises to a height of 1,183 meters. This is a route with a high degree of difficulty, due to the positive difference of over a thousand meters, and is a route reserved for people in very good physical condition and accustomed to this type of mountain routes.
There are many different restaurants in Polop. But if you want to experience an unforgettable dining experience, you must make a reservation at the Ca l'Àngels restaurant. Vicenta and Paco Teuler, together with other family members, run a restaurant where traditional cuisine with local products (even from their own garden) reigns supreme. An innovative wine list and artisan desserts complete the excellent offer.

Location
Benidorm is a city located on the east coast of Spain and is one of the most popular holiday destinations in the entire country. Known for its stunning beaches, clear waters and vibrant nightlife, Benidorm attracts millions of tourists every year. Benidorm is the city with the most skyscrapers in Spain and is often called the second New York. Whether you're looking for a place to relax or have fun, Benidorm has something to offer everyone.
El Balcón del Mediterráneo
Benidorm also has a particularly romantic side. We are talking about El Balcón del Mediterráneo, a viewpoint that captivates not only with its appearance, but also with its location. The castle built on the rocks separates the two beaches, and its terrace offers an amazing view of the entire bay. This location once had strategic importance - it allowed for the observation of possible threats appearing on the horizon and the rapid organization of defense units. Today, El Balcón del Mediterráneo is one of the most popular tourist attractions in Benidorm and probably the most photographed place in this part of the Iberian Peninsula.
Beaches
Playa de Levante is one of Benidorm's two main beaches and is considered one of the best in the country. This vast beach of golden sand is perfect for sunbathing, swimming and soaking up the Mediterranean sun. You will also find many restaurants, bars and shops along the promenade.
Playa de Poniente is the largest beach in Benidorm: 3,000 meters of white sandy shore, which in some sections is over 100 meters wide! Located south of the center and awarded the Blue Flag, it is less crowded than Playa de Levante (the resort's other large beach) and is a favorite among locals. Playa de Poniente offers all services: umbrellas and deckchairs (available 11 months a year), free showers and toilets, playgrounds for children, lifeguards, easier access for disabled people, and even a public library, located directly on the beach.
Isla de Benidorm
As soon as you arrive in Benidorm and step onto the sandy beach, you will see an islet sticking out of the sea a few kilometers from the beach (exactly two nautical miles from the port of Benidorm). This is an island called Isla de Benidorm. The Spanish use another name for this island, Isla de los Periodistas. There are no people living on the island, it has no permanent inhabitants, although from Benidorm you can buy a trip to the islet, where you can eat a seafood meal in a restaurant.
