Casares Costa enjoys a subtropical Mediterranean climate, with hot summers and mild winters. The cooling breeze from the sea makes it possible to cope with the heat in summer, the average temperature is 32°C in summer and 15-16°C in the winter months.

If we talk about hiking trails in Polop, there is one route that stands out from the rest: climbing Mount Ponotx known as the Sleeping Lion'. A large limestone mass with vertical walls that rises to a height of 1,183 meters.
There are many different restaurants in Polop. But if you want to experience an unforgettable dining experience, you must make a reservation at the Ca l'Àngels restaurant. Vicenta and Paco Teuler, together with other family members, run a restaurant where traditional cuisine with local products (even from their own garden) reigns supreme.

The old town of Polop, located on a hill and developed at the foot of a castle of Arab origin, is one of the most interesting and best preserved in the voivodeship. Its picturesque, colorful streets full of flowers and carved ornaments are an inspiration for many artists.
The most outstanding building in the historical case is the church of San Pedro Apóstol, in the upper part of the city, just before the path leading to the castle.
Although there are few remains of Polop Castle, you must visit its ruins, located on the top of the hill on which the old town is located. Without a doubt, the path leading to the castle itself is one of the most interesting places to visit in Polop. Impeccably well-kept, just like the rest of the commune, the beautiful surface and its zigzag route offer us impressive views of the city and the surrounding area.
The colorful fountain - Fuente de los Chorros - also deserves great attention. It is decorated with ceramic mosaics with the coats of arms of various cities in the province of Alicante and has as many as 221 springs.
If we talk about hiking trails in Polop, there is one route that stands out from the rest: climbing Mount Ponotx known as the Sleeping Lion'. A large limestone mass with vertical walls that rises to a height of 1,183 meters. This is a route with a high degree of difficulty, due to the positive difference of over a thousand meters, and is a route reserved for people in very good physical condition and accustomed to this type of mountain routes.
There are many different restaurants in Polop. But if you want to experience an unforgettable dining experience, you must make a reservation at the Ca l'Àngels restaurant. Vicenta and Paco Teuler, together with other family members, run a restaurant where traditional cuisine with local products (even from their own garden) reigns supreme. An innovative wine list and artisan desserts complete the excellent offer.

Location

Among the many tourist resorts on the Costa Blanca, Dénia is one of the most attractive. It is not only the beautiful beaches for which the "White Coast" is famous, but also a beautiful historic center, an extraordinary artistic heritage, an active yacht port and a spectacular natural environment.
The landscape of Dénia is dominated by the imposing silhouette of the Montgó, a mountain 800 meters high, situated a short distance from the coast. Dénia's beaches are a major tourist attraction in the region for many. The city has almost 15 km of coastline, divided into two parts: Las Rotas is characterized by rocky and less frequented coves, while Las Marinas are long, sandy and comfortable beaches.
Both offer plenty of fun activities: you can go scuba diving or snorkeling to explore the wonderful seabed of Las Rotas, and enjoy water sports in the Las Marinas area, including windsurfing, kite surfing, stand up paddle boarding and kayaking.
In 2015, Dénia was named a UNESCO Creative City for Gastronomy. Fantastic local cuisine consists of hard-to-find delicacies, fresh produce and excellent recipes!

Location
Villajoyosa is a hidden pearl on Spain's Costa Blanca.

Villajoyosa seems to literally hang from the rocky, coastal cliffs.Combined with the charming architecture, this gives an amazing impression of the picturesque coastline. What's more, the very name of the village makes a promise of a pleasant stay. Villajoyosa or La Vila Joiosa literally translates as ‘the happy little town’. This is indeed the impression it gives, with its colourful houses in the town centre.
Urban legend has it that the buildings were painted in distinctive colours to help fishermen find their way home. Today, they certainly attract a lot of tourists and are an inspiration for many photographers and artists.
In recent years, this charming little town has become a desirable destination for those looking for a second home in a quiet location.
Villajoyosa has much to offer, from the wide sandy beach to the narrow and colourful streets of the historic centre.
Villajoyosa has been associated with chocolate since the 19th century. It is here that the popular Spanish chocolate factory Valor is located. The Valor, Pérez and Clavileño museums are a must on your sightseeing list. There you will learn all about the chocolate-making process and its history in the area. Tours led by knowledgeable guides are usually combined with a chocolate tasting.
During the holiday season, Villajoyosa hosts a variety of cultural events. The village is well worth a visit in July, when the famous Moorish-Christian festival takes place. The main attraction is the re-enactment of the 1538 battle, as well as concerts, performances and shows.
Villajoyosa contains 3 km of beaches with golden sand and views of the endless clear sea. The most beautiful of these are playa El Paraíso, Xarco and la Caleta. Here you will find both the larger tourist resorts and hidden, secret corners perfect for quiet relaxation. The coastal panorama, Mediterranean climate and soft, hot sand are ideal for an atmosphere of total relaxation. Near the beaches you will find regional restaurants and cafés offering fresh Mediterranean delicacies.
Villajoyosa delights tourists with its idyllic, cheerful atmosphere and colourful houses. There is no shortage of attractions for thrill-seekers and those curious about history and culture. Just walking along the seafront provides stunning views and impressions that are hard to forget.

Finestrat is situated on the slopes of Puig Campana mountain, with stunning views of the mountains, coast and Mediterranean Sea. The town has a typical Moorish atmosphere, with colorfully painted houses and narrow cobblestone streets. On the other hand, Cala Finestrat is becoming increasingly popular, and its development has made it almost an extension of Benidorm itself.
Cala Finestrat
Cala Finestrat is a seaside resort located just three kilometers from busy Benidorm. The resort offers adequate facilities, a large selection of restaurants, bars and shops. Everything you need is available in Benidorm, which is easily accessible by bus and taxi.
La Cala Beach is quite quiet, as most people looking for a more upbeat atmosphere head to the beaches surrounding Benidorm. The location is suitable for families and couples looking for a relaxing beach resort, yet close to many attractions and amenities.

However, if you prefer to spend your holiday with a round or two of golf, Finestrat will enjoy the nearby Real Faula Golf Club, which offers two excellent golf courses.
Both Finestrat and Cala Finestrat are quiet destinations compared to some of the neighboring resorts. Both offer a selection of local bars and restaurants where you can enjoy good food and a relaxed atmosphere.

Location

But it is not so much the slightly elevated location as the central location that has prompted many Europeans to buy a home here in recent decades. The relaxed Mediterranean atmosphere makes San Miguel an authentic Spanish town where life moves slowly. The original inhabitants are the vast majority here. Most home buyers have found a home mainly in suburban urbanisations such as El Galan, Blue Lagoon, Blue Hills and Las Filipinas.
San Miguel's central location means it is only a short car ride to bustling Torrevieja, the beaches of the Orihuela Costa or any of the golf courses in the area. The town has many amenities such as restaurants, shops and international sports facilities. For a municipality of such limited size, the town has a very full calendar of festivals each year. Location
Guardamar del Segura is a Mediterranean paradise , a beautiful town located in the province of Alicante, in the Region of
Valencia in Spain. Situated right by the sea on the picturesque Costa Blanca, this Mediterranean gem is known for its beautiful beaches, rich, diverse wildlife and fascinating history. Over 1,800 years old, Guardamar del Segura has witnessed the passing of civilisations that have left a lasting mark on this wonderful corner of the world. Discover the beauty of its beaches, experience the lush countryside and learn about the traditions that have made Guardamar del Segura a truly unparalleled destination.
The town boasts a unique and unparalleled natural landscape: The Guardamar Dunes. Located to the south of the town, the dunes are a protected area that is home to a valuable natural diversity.
This particular ecosystem is home to protected species such as the common short-toed lizard and the Greek tortoise, and its conservation is crucial to the ecological balance of the region. Visitors can explore the dunes by following paths through the native vegetation, providing an opportunity to get in touch with nature.
The Alfonso XIII Park is also worth a visit. This urban park is an oasis of shade and greenery, providing the ideal place to relax or enjoy sports.
The beaches of Guardamar del Segura are the main attraction for visitors who want to enjoy the warm Mediterranean sun. Along eleven kilometres of coastline, there are several beaches that offer endless opportunities for enjoying the sea and sunbathing. Guardamar beach, considered the symbol of the area, is famous for its fine golden sand and crystal clear waters. It has the prestigious Blue Flag, which guarantees a high standard of quality and safety for bathers. La Roqueta beach, located right next to the marina, is another popular choice. With impressive dunes surrounding it, it offers a quieter and less crowded atmosphere for sun seekers who want to relax and enjoy nature
The cuisine of Guardamar del Segura is a feast for the palate, where the flavours of the sea combine with the richness of the land. Fresh seafood dishes are a feast for the senses and reflect the fishing tradition of the region. ‘Caldero’ is one of the main dishes, a tasty fish soup with rice typical of the area. Local bars and pubs entice visitors through a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere, where they can sample delicious local cocktails and drinks.
Guardamar del Segura is also the ideal place for lovers of active tourism and outdoor sports. The beaches and sea are home to many water activities such as diving, sailing, kayaking and snorkelling. Hiking and cycling are popular in the region due to the beauty of the surrounding countryside. The Vía Verde del Segura is a former railway line converted into a route for cyclists and pedestrians that runs through beautiful countryside and allows visitors to explore the area in a sustainable way

Contact us today and don't miss the unique opportunity to buy an investment right by the sea at such a favourable price ! The number of flats at this price is very limited !
Location
Santa Pola is a seaside town located in the southern part of the Costa Blanca. It is only 19 km from the beautiful city of Alicante and only 14 km from El Altet Alicante airport, where you can easily reach it by public transport, both from the airport and from the centre of Alicante.
The city is famous for its beautiful beaches, monuments and diverse culture, making it a popular tourist destination for people from all over the world. It is the ideal place to spend a family holiday or a seaside getaway for two, where you can relax and enjoy the local seafood, the atmosphere and the impressive natural environment, which includes salt marshes with flamingos and sand dunes.
Beaches
Santa Pola is a real paradise for beachgoers. Here you will find long stretches of fine white sand, varied by more intimate, picturesque coves. Many of these beaches are close to the town centre, so you don't need to take any transport, you can walk from your flat in Santa Pola.
A beach worth going to is Playa Levante, awarded the Blue Flag. Here you can relax with all the amenities of a beach that is considered comfortable and well-equipped. Another place where we recommend spending a sunny day is Playa de Varadero, located in the more urbanised eastern part of Santa Pola. These are two ideal places for a family break in the sun, on the warm sand enjoying the sea breeze of the Costa Blanca.
If you prefer quieter, less crowded places with a more homely feel, then Playa de la Ermita, Playa de la Gola, or the coves of Calas del Cuartel and Calas de L'Aljub should be on your list.
Water sports
Santa Pola is a great place for water sports enthusiasts. The beaches here offer ideal conditions for this type of sport. Both the weather conditions and the infrastructure of the beaches are favourable for windsurfing and kitesurfing. It is in Santa Pola that the world windsurfing championships are held.
The best beaches for windsurfing in Santa Pola are Gran Playa, Playa Lisa, Playa Tamarit and Playa de la Gola. What's more, near these beaches you will find clubs and sports centres where you can rent equipment and sign up for windsurfing or kitesurfing classes. Other suggestions for water sports in Santa Pola include sailing, paddle boarding, kayaking, scuba diving and snorkelling.
Salinas de Santa Pola
In the western part of Santa Pola, the Salinas de Santa Pola (salt pans of Santa Pola) have been protected as a nature reserve and this is the zone where the numerous wild birds in the area find refuge. In the reserve there is the Museo de la Sal (Salt Museum) where you can learn all about the salt extraction process and its history. Huge ‘icebergs’ of salt remind us that we are in Santa Pola, the salt kingdom.
Salinas is the perfect place to relax and spend a day with the children in nature. There are several walking trails leading through the park, allowing you to observe the unique, extremely interesting and diverse flora and fauna. The undisputed stars of the salt reserve are the resident flamingos. These elegant birds, with their pink plumage, look spectacular.
Isla Tabarca
Isla Tabarca (Tabarca Island) is the closest from Santa Pola, the two places being only 9 kilometres apart. Isla Tabarca is the smallest island in Spain. It is inhabited all year round.
The story of Tabarca reads like an adventure novel starring pirates. It was the highwaymen, the sea wolves who sought refuge on the island for hundreds of years. There are several transport companies in Santa Pola that will take you to the island. The journey takes no longer than 15 minutes! Don't forget to bring your snorkelling gear, as the pebbly beaches and picturesque little coves make for an ideal place to practice this type of sport.

In the reserve there is the Museo de la Sal (Salt Museum) where you can learn all about the salt extraction process and its history. Huge ‘icebergs’ of salt remind us that we are in Santa Pola, the salt kingdom.
Salinas is the perfect place to relax and spend a day with the children in nature. There are several walking trails leading through the park, allowing you to observe the unique, extremely interesting and diverse flora and fauna. The undisputed stars of the salt reserve are the resident flamingos. These elegant birds, with their pink plumage, look spectacular.
Isla Tabarca
Isla Tabarca (Tabarca Island) is the closest from Santa Pola, the two places being only 9 kilometres apart. Isla Tabarca is the smallest island in Spain. It is inhabited all year round.
The story of Tabarca reads like an adventure novel starring pirates. It was the highwaymen, the sea wolves who sought refuge on the island for hundreds of years. There are several transport companies in Santa Pola that will take you to the island. The journey takes no longer than 15 minutes! Don't forget to bring your snorkelling gear, as the pebbly beaches and picturesque little coves make for an ideal place to practice this type of sport.

Location
Casares is located just 16 kilometres from Estepona and forms a typical postcard of an Andalusian town. It is one of the more beautiful white villages of Malaga on the Costa del Sol. The layout of the houses, very picturesque, has earned it the nickname of the hanging town.
Casares' origins date back to Iberian and Phoenician times, although its name comes from Roman domination; in fact, the name Casares is influenced by the name of Julio Cesar, who in 61 BC visited the famous Baños Hediondos de Carratraca to cure himself of a skin disease using sulphurous waters, making the place very famous throughout Rome for its healing properties.
The steep and winding streets of Casares are the perfect place to relax, discover corners that don't appear in guidebooks, local craft shops and small bars in the city to stop at along the way.
Casares Castle
Situated at the top of the town, it overlooks the valleys, hills and coastal plains stretching from Serranía de Ronda to the Bay of Algeciras, allowing a magnificent view of parts of the province of Málaga and Cadiz This is one of the most picturesque and beautiful corners of the municipality and a must-visit.
Hedionda Baths
They say that the devil gave his last breath here when he was banished by Santiago. This is one of the legends that the popular imagination perpetuates to justify the smell of sulphur in the waters. These known as the Baños de la Hedionda, a resource of cultural significance, are one of the historical landmarks of the Utrera massif and of Casares in general. It is all about the Iron Sulphur Baths, located in a beautiful and advantageous place that man has been able to use since Roman times.

Make yourself comfortable in your new luxury property located in a prestigious neighbourhood in Sierra Cortina, considered the most elite place to live in Finestrat. It is located just 8 km from the popular town of Benidorm, which offers a wide range of all kinds of services and wide, sandy beaches. The project is in a perfect location right next to Asia Gardens Hotel & Thai Spa.
You are sure to fall in love with the beautiful landscape that Finestrat offers. The combination of mountains and sea not only offers breathtaking views, but also allows you to spend active time both hiking and doing water sports.
This new project consists of large 450 m2 to 650 m2, landscaped plots with modern buildings and independent swimming pools. All of them, together with one of the most prestigious hotels in the area, offer a delightfully pleasant and intimate setting.
All villas have a main south-facing facade and huge windows that let in natural light throughout the day. Large pergolas allow you to enjoy the incredible outdoor experience that is at the heart of Spanish life, enhancing the indoor living area and connecting it to the outside.
This is a luxurious house with spacious and bright rooms designed for living, an open concept on the ground floor with breathtaking views, which is also located in an exclusive and gated residential complex, just a step away from the sea and the mountains.
Location
Finestrat is a charming and picturesque town located in the province of Alicante, in the Community of Valencia, Spain. It is located just 8 kilometres from the popular large city of Benidorm and 40 kilometres from Alicante and its international airport. Known for its stunning mountain views, unspoilt beaches and rich cultural heritage, Finestrat is the ideal destination for anyone looking for a relaxing and unforgettable experience. There is no shortage of exciting things to do in Finestrat.
Finestrat is situated on the slope of the Puig Campana mountain, offering magnificent views of the mountains, the coast and the Mediterranean Sea. The town has a typical Moorish atmosphere, with colourfully painted houses and narrow cobbled streets. Cala Finestrat, on the other hand, is becoming increasingly popular and its development has almost made it an extension of Benidorm itself.
Cala Finestrat
Cala Finestrat is a seaside resort located just three kilometres from busy Benidorm. The resort offers adequate facilities, a large selection of restaurants, bars and shops. Everything you need is available in Benidorm, which is easily accessible by bus and taxi.
La Cala beach is fairly quiet, as most of those craving a more upbeat atmosphere head for the beaches surrounding Benidorm. The beach is a clean stretch of golden sand, ideal for children and safe for swimming. There are several charming restaurants along the promenade and during the summer months there is an arts and crafts market in the afternoon.
The location is suitable for families and couples looking for a relaxing beach resort, yet close to many attractions and amenities.
The Terre Mitica and Terra Natura theme parks, Aqualandia water park and Mundomar marine and exotic animal park are all nearby, offering fun for the whole family.
Meanwhile, if you prefer to spend your holiday enjoying a round or two of golf, Finestrat will be pleased with the nearby Real Faula Golf Club, which offers two excellent courses.
Both Finestrat and Cala Finestrat are quiet destinations compared to some of the neighbouring resorts. Both offer a selection of local bars and restaurants where you can enjoy good food and a relaxed atmosphere.

properties.description:
For sale apartment overlooking the sea in Marbella
We present you the perfect place to live and relax in the prestigious city of Marbella. Only 5 minutes separates you from your new home to the center of Marbella, which is teeming with life all year round, offering a range of services and amenities at the highest level. Your new property offers exceptional views of the golf course and the Mediterranean Sea. The area is ideal for those who seek the authentic Mediterranean essence of the Costa del Sol without sacrificing connections to the main towns in the area. Perfect location to enjoy a relaxed and healthy lifestyle with the best beaches on your doorstep.
The residential complex offers 20 exclusive semi-detached villas of 4 and 5 bedrooms with large terraces and swimming pools and 48 apartments in two types: penthouses with solariums and ground floor apartments with gardens, all with a unique layout of 2 to 4 bedrooms. A perfectly thought-out arrangement of rooms, open spaces, bright and natural colors as well as attention to the smallest detail make each of these elite properties meet the expectations of even the most demanding customers.
Make yourself comfortable in the elegant and fully equipped kitchen, which perfectly combines with the dining room and the cozy living room. Here you will find high-quality household appliances as well as cabinets and drawers, offering plenty of space to store kitchen utensils. You can enjoy a spacious and comfortable space ideal for cooking, eating and relaxing with friends and family.
Bedrooms create a quiet and peaceful space for rest and sleep. All are equipped with built-in wardrobes that provide plenty of storage space. In addition, each investment has fully equipped bathrooms with underfloor heating.
Living in this luxurious estate, you can feel like on a tropical holiday in the best hotel every day. A full Resort program will be available to residents and their guests. You will find 5 different swimming pools, a fully equipped gym, an exclusive SPA, a sauna, a coffee and grill zone and a place to work - coworking. In addition, the entire common area is beautifully landscaped with Mediterranean gardens offering a place for walking and picnics. Certainly, everyone will find here the perfect space for rest, fun or relaxation in the company of loved ones.
When designing this prestigious estate, the developer focused on luxury and safety of its future residents. The residence will have a monitoring system, and each property will have a private underground parking space and a storage room. In addition, residents will be able to use the services of a private Concierge.
This complex, surrounded by the Santa Clara golf course, is one of the most prestigious private urbanizations in Marbella. Fully connected to every corner of the world thanks to the international airport and high-speed rail (AVE).
Location
The city of Marbella is the symbol of the Costa del Sol. The resort, synonymous with prestige and luxury, attracts the attention of investors and tourists from around the world, and its inseparable element are spectacular properties worth even over PLN 100 million!
Marbella, thanks to the actions taken by influential people like Ricardo Soriano or Prince Alfonso of Hohenlohe-Langenburg, has become the favorite holiday destination of the cream of society from Spain and Europe.
Today, politicians, athletes, musicians and screen stars have their properties here, and Marbella itself attracts crowds of tourists from around the world. This is confirmed by e.g. results of the plebiscite organized by the popular Belgian travel portal, which awarded Marbella the title of "Best European Destinations 2022".
Currently, the most prestigious and thus the most desirable locations include:
Golden Mile - The "Golden Mile" is one of the most beautiful and luxurious avenues in Spain, which is also the symbol of Marbella. Legendary hotels and stunning properties are located here, including a scaled-down replica of the White House, built by the late King of Saudi Arabia. The Golden Mile is an avenue of over 6 kilometers long, lined with classic and modern villas surrounded by lush vegetation. It is an ideal place to invest capital, especially in times of rampant inflation.
La Zagaleta - you can't pass by this complex indifferently. It is located in an extraordinary scenery - by the lake, between the sea and the mountains. On a huge area that could accommodate up to 4,000. real estate, there are only 400 residences, inhabited, among others, by by people on the front pages of newspapers. The excellent security of La Zagaleta, however, guarantees them full discretion and the comfort of a peaceful holiday at home on the Costa del Sol.
Puerto Banús - one of the most luxurious marinas in Spain, located between Marbella and San Pedro Alcantara. People who have managed to buy a property in Puerto Banús are undoubtedly the lucky ones! Here we will find designer boutiques from around the world, the best restaurants, spectacular yachts and a Salvador Dali sculpture!
When visiting this luxurious resort, you must visit the Parque de Alameda - they are said to be the green lungs of the city. Dating back to the 18th century, Alameda Park occupies an area of 20,000 m2, which is 20% of the area of the entire city center. Alameda Park is a place rich in various species of plants. The ones that attract the most attention are the spreading Ficus Pandurata and Pinus Pinae.
Nature lovers will also be happy to visit the Bonsai Museum.
It is the first museum in Spain dedicated to bonsai trees. It was founded in 1992, and its collection includes the most valuable bonsai specimens in Europe, some of which are 200, 300 and even 400 years old! A visit to the Museo del Bonsai is a great opportunity to calm down and commune among the most beautiful works created by nature. In addition to the permanent exhibition, the museum also organizes educational workshops to better understand the art of caring for bonsai trees.
Regardless of how you like to spend your free time, Marbella will certainly meet your expectations. There are 26 km of beaches waiting for sunbathers. For gourmets of good cuisine - great restaurants, prestigious restaurants offering cuisine from around the world. Those who like active holidays can try their hand at windsurfing, sailing or golf. Regarding the latter, it is worth mentioning that around the city there are unparalleled golf courses of excellent quality, also adapted to play at night (they are specially illuminated for this purpose).
If you like mountain climbing, you cannot miss the La Concha mountain rising majestically above the city. It measures 1,200 meters above sea level, and the best trail to reach it can be found in the town of Istán, located on the other side of the mountain. The trip is not the easiest, but all possible difficulties are compensated by the amazing view that awaits us at the top! It is hard to disagree with the statement that this is the most beautiful panorama of the city of Marbella. However, for even greater mountain challenges, the Sierra Nevada mountain range is recommended.
The most popular, and according to many people also the best beaches in Marbela are: Playa de Guadalmina, Playa de Lindavista, Playa de San Pedro de Alcántara, Cortijo Blanco, Playa de Nueva Andalucía, Rio Verde - Playa de Puerto Banús, Playa de El Ancón, Nagüeles , Fontanilla and Playa del Faro.

properties.title: A dream villa with perfect sea views in Altea Hills
properties.summary: New build villa for sale in Altea, Alicante: 4 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, 412 m² built, 979 m² plot. €2,370,000.
properties.description:
For sale a luxury villa with sea views in Altea Hills.
Located in the prestigious Altea Hills area, this modern villa offers the perfect opportunity for those seeking a combination of comfort and spectacular sea views. This exceptional property is located on a magnificent plot in a luxury residential resort close to the Mediterranean coast. The area is characterised by huge green areas, wooded areas and pine trees, with the most magnificent views of the open sea.
The villa is located in the Altea Hills resort and enjoys 24-hour security. Altea Hills has a hotel, bars, restaurants and is located moments from the beautiful town of Altea, the sporty Marina Campomanes and has easy access to the motorway. Less than 10 minutes drive from the beach and Altea, 15 minutes from Calpe and about 1 hour from Alicante or Valencia airport.
The property is built on a plot of 979 m2 and is distributed over 2 floors, connected by a staircase. It has 4 spacious bedrooms, 5 bathrooms a garage for 4 cars with automatic gate.
On the ground floor of this extraordinary residence, there is 1 double bedroom with en-suite bathroom, 1 guest toilet and a living space of 66 m2: the kitchen and living room open onto a covered terrace and a relaxation area with an amazing edgeless pool. The first floor is the sleeping and relaxing area: 3 bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, including the master bedroom with a large open terrace.
Outside, there is your private edgeless pool with a large terrace and barbecue and lounging area from where you can enjoy the best views. You will certainly not lack anything here to feel like you are in your own kingdom.
Location
Altea in Spain is considered one of the most beautiful towns. Beautiful beaches and promenades, whitewashed houses with colourful pots, narrow cobbled streets, small craft shops, ice cream parlours and outdoor restaurants are not all that this picturesque town has to offer.
Altea is a 10-minute drive north of Benidorm (about 10 km), about 1 hour from Alicante and is one of the most memorable seaside towns on the Costa Blanca, retaining its unmistakable Spanish charm despite growing tourism and popularity. Altea is located directly on the sea, in the middle of a beautiful bay and is surrounded by hilly mountains. The name comes from the Moorish Althaya‘, meaning health for all’.
The town centre is a treasure trove of shops, art galleries, restaurants and small whitewashed buildings decorated with flowers - all waiting to be discovered on the winding and cobbled medieval streets.
The old town of Altea is preserved in a typically Spanish, one might say Andalusian, atmosphere. The whitewashed houses provide a blank canvas for the Mediterranean flower beds. No wonder Altea attracts artists and photographers from all over the world who want to experience the city's charm, incredible light and natural beauty. From the cobbled streets, stunning views of the sea and mountains, to the historic buildings.
Countless steps of narrow, charming streets lead from the coast to Altea's viewpoint. In the 16th century, the upper part of the old town of Altea was built to protect the town from attacks. The castle was built on the current Plaza de la Iglesia and the upper part of the town was surrounded by a wall with three gates. Today, only two of these gates exist - Vell Portal and Portal Nou.
The icon of the town is the famous Virgin de Consuelo church with its blue dome on top - it is truly remarkable, and the view from the top over Altea bay with the mountains in the background is simply spectacular!
Altea's location at the foot of the 1100-metre-high Sierra Bernia mountain, with its highest peak of 1129 metres, and the 1500 Sierra Aitana to the west, creates a magical' climate in the area. The mountain protects from cold winds from inland. The mountainside lies like a green oasis down to the fertile lowlands and the sea. The river that flows through the town and thanks to which it is located here is called Algar, which means healing river.
Altea and other towns in the north are among the greenest and most fertile areas of the entire Costa Blanca. Oranges and many exotic fruits are grown here.

Completion date : Dicembere 2027
Location
Pilar de la Horadada has everything you need to enjoy the charms of the sea, the pine forests and the Spanish sun. The coastline of Pilar de la Hordada is more than 4 kilometres long along very varied scenery. You will encounter wide beaches with fine white sand, small stone wall shelves suspended above the water and small and intimate hidden coves with golden sand.
The resort is located in the south-east of Spain and borders Murcia (about 15 minutes away). Alicante, on the other hand, is about a 40-minute drive away.
The sea here is generally calm, the beaches are safe and there are no steep slopes, allowing even the smallest children to swim safely. In addition, the clear water and excellent visibility invites divers to observe the beauty of the aquatic life.
The cleanliness of the beaches in Pilar de la Hordada has been awarded the distinction of a European Union Blue Flag, which provides guarantees of a healthy environment.
Inland, various interesting excursions can be made near the towns of Sierra and Escalona. There are two signposted hiking trails, along the Rio Seco riverbed with a length of 19 kilometres, definitely worth a visit. One route is 4 kilometres long, while the other is 10 kilometres stretching from the natural area of Pilar de Campoverde to the mouth of Mil Palmeras beach.
Not far from the town of Pilar de la Horadada is also the 18-hole golf course at Lo Romero. Professionals in the field as well as novice players will find a good match there.
Gastronomy has a privileged place in the culture of this beautiful town. Among the typical dishes of Pilar de la Hordada are potatoes with meat stew, meatballs, rabbit in garlic and Gachas Migas (a floury, garlicky pancake) as well as great rice dishes and soups. Sweets and cakes also deserve a mention here, confectionery such as the meringue cake called ‘’milhojas‘’ or the almond sweets called ‘’cordiales‘’ being the most popular.

Location
Lo Pagan is part of San Pedro Del Pinatar, a coastal town on the Costa Calida. Its shores are bathed by both the Mar Menor and the Mediterranean Sea. Warm temperatures with an average of 18 degrees throughout the year and more than 315 days of natural light make it an ideal place to holiday and live. The Mar Menor has calm, warm waters and the Mediterranean Sea is open and natural thanks to the Las Salinas de San Pedro del Pinatar nature reserve.
San Pedro del Pinatar has 14 km of beaches scattered over two seas, the Minor Sea (Mar Menor) and the Mediterranean. Its strategic location on the coast and environmental advantages have made it a highly sought-after residential area.
In addition to its well-maintained beaches, harbour and full commercial and service infrastructure, San Pedro del Pinatar has a unique natural space - the Las Salinas y Arenales de San Pedro del Pinatar Protected Landscape Area. It is a wetland area where flamingos, gulls, albatrosses, herons and owls can be seen; it also has moving dunes, with characteristic vegetation: sea lilies, rushes and reeds.
The municipality of San Pedro del Pinatar, in addition to the main town, is made up of seventeen small towns, such as El Mojón, Las Salinas, Los Sáez and Lo Pagán. This last area, Lo Pagán, occupies the most important place thanks to the great development of tourism.
The most famous beach in Lo Pagán is La Puntica beach, which offers picturesque amenities such as booths and a swimming area with access to the sea, as well as a wide range of leisure activities.

properties.description:
Apartments for Sale in San Juan de Alicante
Discover your new home in a brand-new residential complex in San Juan de Alicante, offering 32 stylish units designed to meet diverse needs. These apartments are thoughtfully crafted with high-quality finishes and modern amenities, ensuring both comfort and elegance.
Your new home features a centrally designed kitchen, complete with a porcelain countertop island and spacious cabinetry. The kitchen comes fully equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, including an oven, induction hob, extractor hood, microwave, and an integrated refrigerator. Each apartment boasts an outdoor terrace, perfect for enjoying the Mediterranean climate. The bedrooms are designed with ample storage in mind, offering spacious wardrobes that seamlessly blend with the modern design. For year-round comfort, the apartments are equipped with air conditioning, distributing warm and cool air through ducts in the living room and bedrooms.Each apartment is designed with unique features, such as panoramic views from the terraces, private gardens in ground-floor units, and cutting-edge technological solutions. Large windows flood the interiors with natural light, while expansive terraces provide an ideal space for relaxation and outdoor enjoyment.
The complex includes a swimming pool, a state-of-the-art gym, coworking spaces, and beautifully landscaped gardens perfect for relaxation. Additional conveniences such as private parking spaces and storage units are available for an extra fee. The garage is also pre-equipped for electric vehicle charging, catering to modern needs.
The complex’s prime location offers easy access to numerous shops, restaurants, and essential services, ensuring that everything you need is within reach. Proximity to the beach and recreational areas makes it easy to lead an active, outdoor lifestyle, with excellent transport links simplifying travel around the area.
Location
San Joan is a coastal city located in the province of Alicante. Located on the Costa Blanca, it borders the cities of Alicante (7 km) and El Campello (3 km). Thanks to the unique, fine-sand beach, colorful streets, green parks, atmospheric restaurants and great pubs, it attracts tourists practically at any time of the year.
Recognized as one of the most beautiful beaches in the province of Alicante, San Juan beach is located near the fishing village of El Campello on Cape Cabo de las Huertas. San Juan Beach is 7 kilometers of golden sand combined with an intimate promenade, surrounded by pubs and restaurants. It is ideal both for people who like passive recreation on the sand and for fans of water sports - in the area you can easily find several sports centers that rent water equipment.
San Juan is also adjacent to the Alicante Golf course. The beach receives the Blue Flag, a special certificate of the European Union, every year, so it is very clean and safe.
The beach is just 25 km from Alicante International Airport. This convenience attracts not only Spanish families looking for a weekend getaway.
Legend has it that in ancient times, when Spain was ruled by the Moors, the beautiful Moorish queen used to bathe in the local beach cove among the rocks. This story is certainly an additional attraction for tourists who are always happy to listen to legends and tales about the visited place.
It's no secret that Spaniards love to party and celebrate, and the magical St. Jana, or Fiesta de San Juan, is one of the most awaited holidays in this country.
Hogueras de San Juan is celebrated from June 19-24. We can expect various dance parties, parades, fireworks shows, tasting traditional dishes. The most important role here, however, is played by fire, which is a symbol of this festival of immense importance.
Hogueras de San Juan begins on June 19, when colorful sculptures made of paper, cardboard or wood appear on the streets. The constructions are represented by every district of Alicante. Then the fun, dancing and singing begins and the city does not sleep at this time. The Feast of the Fire of St. John is also accompanied by the traditional bullfights at the Korrida in Alicante. There is also no shortage of specially prepared dishes for this occasion. These are, for example, brevas and cocas, i.e. cakes stuffed with tuna, onions and nuts.
The culminating moment is the Midsummer Night from 23 to 24 June. After impressive parades through the streets of the city, the sculptures are burned, creating an incredible effect. Each district prepares its sculpture, which very often are figures from the world of culture or politics. Also, the inhabitants of the city dress up in traditional folk costumes to give even more value and great fun to this holiday.

San Juan is a picturesque coastal town situated in the province of Alicante, nestled on the Costa Blanca. It is conveniently located just 7 km from Alicante and 3 km from El Campello. Known for its stunning fine-sand beaches, vibrant streets, lush parks, and atmospheric restaurants and pubs, San Juan attracts visitors throughout the year.
One of the area’s highlights is the renowned San Juan Beach, considered one of the most beautiful beaches in the Alicante province. Located near the fishing village of El Campello on Cape Cabo de las Huertas, this 7-kilometer stretch of golden sand is accompanied by a charming promenade lined with pubs and restaurants. The beach caters to both those who enjoy relaxing on the sand and water sports enthusiasts, with several sports centers nearby offering equipment rentals.
San Juan is also adjacent to the Alicante Golf course, and its beach consistently earns the Blue Flag certification for its cleanliness and safety. The beach is just 25 km from Alicante International Airport, making it a convenient destination for Spanish families seeking a weekend escape.
Legend has it that in ancient times, a beautiful Moorish queen would bathe in the cove among the rocks at this very beach—a story that adds a layer of intrigue and allure for visitors.
San Juan is also famous for its vibrant celebrations, particularly the Fiesta de San Juan, one of Spain’s most anticipated festivals. Celebrated from June 19-24, this festival features dance parties, parades, fireworks displays, and traditional food tastings, with fire playing a central symbolic role.
The festivities kick off on June 19 with the appearance of colorful sculptures made from paper, cardboard, or wood, representing each district of Alicante. The city comes alive with dancing, singing, and celebrations that continue through the night. The festival also includes traditional bullfights at the Alicante Korrida, and the culinary delights of the season, such as brevas and cocas—savory cakes filled with tuna, onions, and nuts.
The highlight of the celebration is the Midsummer Night from June 23 to 24, when the sculptures are set ablaze in a spectacular display. Each district prepares its own sculpture, often depicting figures from the world of culture or politics. Residents also dress in traditional folk costumes, adding to the festive atmosphere and making the Fiesta de San Juan a truly unforgettable experience.

In this new project you will find spacious flats with terraces that rise up the hill to feel the world at your feet. in your new Spanish flats in Manilva on the Costa del Sol you will be able to enjoy magnificent sea views, a warm climate and gastronomy that you will fall in love with.
The project is surrounded by green areas and the best golf courses in Europe. Only 5 minutes from your new home is the La Reserva Club in Sotogrande, a wonderful recreational area that includes golf, horse riding and a resort with restaurant facilities, a white sandy beach and a lagoon for sports.
All developments have a parking space included in the price. This modern development offers its new residents magnificent communal areas with an edgeless pool, a clubhouse with spa and a state-of-the-art gym.
Each flat exudes an unparalleled sense of elegance, perfectly complementing the breathtaking views to the horizon. Kitchens blend seamlessly with the living area, creating a harmonious space for relaxing and entertaining. High-quality finishes adorn the bathrooms and bedrooms, adding elegance to every corner of your new home. Large terraces provide magnificent views of the Mediterranean and an ideal space for relaxing and dining together.
Gibraltar airport is just a 15-minute drive away, as well as proximity to urban centres such as Estepona, Puerto Banús and Marbella.
Location
Manilva is a picturesque town located on the Costa del Sol, 97 kilometres from Malaga. The town is divided into two parts: a tourist beach resort and an urban area with beautiful white townhouses. This beautiful town is surrounded by impressive vineyards, where mainly the moscatel grape variety is grown. This variety is mainly used to produce sweet wine, which is the signature drink during the Feria de Malaga. The Manilva grapes are also used to produce delicious sultanas, which are dried in autumn.
Manilva has retained the atmosphere and style of an old Spanish village. It is situated close to the Strait of Gibraltar, making it a geographically and culturally rich area. Here you can experience a peaceful holiday, away from the hustle and bustle of the big cities. The nearest airport is 41 kilometres from the town of Manilva.
The undeniable attraction of the town and its surroundings are the beaches - some of the best on the Costa del Sol. Almost 8 kilometres of sandy areas are available here. Some beaches are rocky and are surrounded by coves, while others are wide and sandy. The rocky beaches are located in Punta Chullera and the sandy beaches are located next to Castillo, the port of Puerto del la Duquesa and the town of Sabinillas. You can swim, snorkel, fish and enjoy water sports in the waters of the surrounding beaches.
In addition to the beaches and marinas, Manilva offers tourists an interesting historical and cultural heritage. So you will find many things to see and do in Manilva. In Manilva, you can also see the castle of La Duquesa, several churches and archaeological remains on display at the Municipal Archaeological Museum.

The residence has an excellent common area with a large elongated swimming pool, as well as a large and well landscaped green area. In addition, each property comes with a private parking space and a storage room.
Start dreaming of your new home in Dolores, because with us your dream can quickly become a reality!

Location
Dolores is a small town located in the province of Vega Baja, in its southern part, about 50 kilometres from Alicante. We can easily get here via the AP7 motorway, and by road from Elche if travelling by plane, from Alicante International Airport, which is only 25 minutes from Dolores.
Dolores has the advantage of an open and hospitable population, a high quality of life, a pleasant and healthy climate and its proximity to the sea (about 10 kilometres). All this places the area at the top of the quality of life Mediterranean style.
The proximity to the El Hondo nature reserve provides a wonderful space for relaxation and the enjoyment of many paths to walk in the interesting company of the various types of birds that live in the reserve, which is their refuge).
Beaches
Guardamar del Segura Beach: Located about 15 minutes' drive from Dolores, Guardamar del Segura Beach is a vast beach with golden sand and crystal clear waters. It has a wide range of services such as beach bars, restaurants and children's playgrounds.
La Marina Beach: Located to the south of Guardamar del Segura, La Marina Beach is another nearby option. This is a quieter and less crowded beach, surrounded by natural dunes and pine forests. Here you can enjoy a more natural and relaxing environment.

Location
Picturesque Algorfa, located in the Vega Baja del Segura region, has a rich history dating back to Roman times. The town's name comes from the Arabic word Al-Gorfa‘, meaning cave’, as the area was known for its numerous natural caves. Today, Algorfa is known for its citrus fruit and vegetable production.
Algorfa is home to many attractions that will appeal to residents of all ages. Here are just a few of the most important ones and:
La Finca golf course
If you are a fan of golf, La Finca Golf Course is a must-visit destination. This championship golf course is set in a beautiful natural setting, with stunning views of the Vega Baja countryside. Algorfa Market
For a taste of the local culture, be sure to visit the Algorfa Market, which takes place every Wednesday. Here you will find a wide selection of goods including fresh local produce, clothing and souvenirs. This is the perfect place to buy a unique gift or sample the delicious local cuisine.
Plaza de España
Plaza de España is the main square in Algorfa and is the perfect place to soak up the local atmosphere. Here you'll find a beautiful fountain, plenty of places to sit and many restaurants and bars. It's the perfect place to relax with a drink and enjoy the local culture.

Discover with Elite World Estates a new project in an unbeatable location with the best sea views ! Be the new owner of a superb luxury flat located on the captivating coast of La Manga. Your unique new flat is in a prime location right next to a bay of fine sand, in a quiet and exclusive setting. It offers unparalleled sea views and top-notch living. The aim is to provide a luxurious retreat for holidaymakers, whether for longer stays or a weekend holiday. With a dedicated reception and management office, organising the rental is child's play.
Each property is delivered turnkey, not only equipped with kitchen appliances and air conditioning, but also fully furnished and decorated, ready for immediate use and rental returns.
The interior design of these elite flats is defined by refined spaces of warm minimalism, where white, natural colours and textures create a comfortable and calm atmosphere. The aim was to convey the feeling of fresh air, the tranquillity of an unprecedented Mediterranean oasis. A perfect balance between modernity and simplicity was achieved. Enjoy the harmony and feel at home.
The residence has a range of amenities including extensive common areas. The Mediterranean garden surrounding the flats is truly stunning, with vibrant colours and fragrant flowers creating a peaceful and relaxing atmosphere. In addition, impressive communal areas include :
A large 246 m2 edgeless swimming pool
A 103 m2 children's pool
A 62 m2 heated pool to extend the swimming season
Areas equipped with sun loungers around the pools
Minigolf
Bike parking
Open-air showers by the beach

On-site reception and accommodation for maintenance staff
Health and wellness area with hydrotherapy, saunas, Turkish bath and more

In addition, blocks 1 and 2 ground floor flats have private gardens with 20 m2 swimming pools and direct access to the promenade. Whereas the penthouses in block 3 have shallow rooftop pools.
The unrivalled location of these luxury flats allows you to enjoy a peaceful and restorative environment, but close to recreational areas and seafood restaurants. Just minutes away are also places of great scenic value, such as the Calblanque Nature Park, and historical and cultural sites such as Cartagena. It is also easy to discover a typical fishing village and interesting diving at Cabo de Palos, with its marine reserve with its famous rocks and coral seabed.
Don't miss the opportunity to live in this unique place right by the sea !
Planned completion date: 2nd half of 2025
Location
In the south of Spain in the beautiful Region of Murcia lies the peninsula of La Manga del Mar Menor. There you will find everything you expect from a holiday in this country: sunny and sandy beaches, blue sea, amazing views and tasty food.
It is an ideal holiday destination, flanked on one side by the Minor Sea, or Mar Menor, which is technically a bay, and on the other by the Mediterranean Sea.
La Manga, which means ‘sleeve’ in Spanish, is located on the Costa Calida in the Region of Murcia. It is 24 kilometres long and at its narrowest point less than 40-50 metres wide. It is a bit like Spain's Hel Spit, of course, with a warmer and saltier sea and less lush vegetation.
The peninsula's location means that already in June there is heat and warm sea water. Not surprisingly, the region is popular with water sports enthusiasts - windsurfers and kite surfers - as well as fans of snorkelling or diving.
Some of the more popular beaches on both the Mediterranean and the Lesser Sea include Cala del Pino, Playa Mistral, Playa del Barco Perdido, Playa del Pudrimel, Mahalo Beach, Cala Reona, Playa la Gola, Playa del Pudrimel, Playa del Estacio, Playa de Cavanna, Playa del Banco del Tabal, Playa de Puerto Bello or Playa Paraíso.
Diving fans, on the other hand, should visit Isla Grossa, El Fallon Cabo de Palos, and the Isla Hormigas Marine Reserve. The latter is one of the best diving sites in all of Spain.
There is something for everyone here. Fans of historic architecture can visit the Faro Cabo de Palos lighthouse or the nearby town of Cartagena with its Roman buildings.
The La Manga peninsula can be reached by arriving at San Javier Airport in Murcia, but there are no direct flights from Poland to this airport yet.
The nearest airport with flights from the country on the Vistula is El Altet in Alicante. The drive to La Manga from Alicante will take about 1.5 hours.

For sale a new appartment in San Pedro del Pinatar.
The San Pedro del Pinatar neighbourhood is a traditional Spanish town on the Costa Cálida, with plenty of bars and restaurants, as well as banks, lawyers, doctors, supermarkets and schools. It is here in an ideal location that you will find a new development that offers spacious flats in a great location. Don't hesitate any longer and visit your future home in sunny Spain with us !
This new development is just a 7-minute drive from the nearby beautiful beaches, a 55-minute drive from Alicante airport and a 35-minute drive from the Murcia region airport. In front of the Mar Menor there is a long promenade, extensive beaches and a marina with many water sports such as sailing, diving and windsurfing. There are several pedestrian walkways and cycle paths, ideal for a leisurely stroll or a longer circular route stretching for several kilometres.
From the footpath at Lo Pagán, you can take advantage of the therapeutic properties of the famous mud found at the bottom of the sea, particularly useful for treating bone and skin ailments.
In total, the project will consist of 51 flats arranged in three different buildings. Ground floor, first, second, third and penthouses with private solariums will be available.
Each of these elite flats will be very cosy and designed with the comfort and relaxation of its occupants in mind. Bathrooms will be sleek and modern, with high-quality finishes and fittings. The kitchens, on the other hand, will be practical and fully equipped, blending perfectly with the dining area and living room. In the bedrooms, you will find built-in wardrobes, where you will be able to store all your most necessary belongings.
Most of the investments are flats with three bedrooms and two bathrooms, although there are also flats with two bedrooms and two bathrooms. Each residence also includes a garage space with a car charging station and utility room.
Each residence also includes, among other things;
* LED interior and exterior lighting
* aerothermal water heater
* electric roller shutters
* fully equipped kitchen
* fully equipped bathrooms
* Underfloor heating in bathrooms
* Air-conditioning
Parking space with charging station * Electric appliances (Bosch/Siemens) * Electric appliances (Bosch/Siemens)
Electrical appliances (Bosch/Siemens) * Electrical appliances (Bosch/Siemens)
A great asset of the development is the extensive communal areas where you can relax in the large summer pool.
Planned completion date : December 2024
Location
San Pedro del Pinatar is a small town located in the province of Murcia, Spain, situated on the shores of the saltwater lagoon of the Mar Menor. The town has a rich history that dates back to the Roman Empire, and traces of Roman salt factories can still be seen today.
There are several beautiful beaches in the town, including Playa de la Llana, Playa de Villananitos and Playa de la Torre Derribada. These beaches are ideal for water sports, sunbathing and relaxation. Playa de la Mota is a beach popular with locals, offering calm waters and excellent facilities.
San Pedro del Pinatar is also home to a fascinating natural park, the Salinas y Arenales de San Pedro del Pinatar Regional Park. This natural park offers a unique environment where a salt water lagoon meets the Mediterranean Sea, creating a diverse ecosystem that supports a wide variety of flora and fauna. Visitors can go on guided tours, bird and wildlife watching and walk along the park trails.
The town has several attractions worth visiting, including the Fish Market, which offers a wide selection of fresh seafood caught the same day, and the Sea and Salt Museum, which showcases the town's rich history of salt production. Molino de Quintin is a historic windmill that has been restored and gives a glimpse into the town's agricultural past.
San Pedro del Pinatar is also home to a number of restaurants, cafés and bars where visitors can sample local cuisine and enjoy a relaxed atmosphere. The town has a vibrant cultural scene, with several festivals throughout the year, including the Carnival of San Pedro del Pinatar and the International Festival of Habaneras and Polyphony.

properties.description:
For sale luxury villa with sea views in Jávea
We present an extremely luxurious villa project with a modern and avant-garde design, which is located in the beautiful village of Javea.
This magnificent masterpiece of modern architecture is located in the prestigious urbanisation of Monte Olimpo in Jávea. This privileged enclave offers proximity to idyllic beaches, a varied gastronomic offer and renowned golf courses, providing an unparalleled Costa Blanca lifestyle.
Your new villa stands out for its avant-garde design and meticulous attention to detail. This impressive two-storey residence includes three spacious bedrooms and three bathrooms, all designed to maximise comfort and elegance. An open-plan living room with dining area, along with a fully equipped kitchen, offers the perfect space for entertaining and daily living.
Abundant natural light floods every corner of the villa, enhancing the harmonious connection between the indoor spaces and the lush garden, which includes a spectacular swimming pool. In addition, the property includes a carport for two cars, providing optimum comfort and security.
This magnificent residence is delivered turnkey, equipped with the most advanced amenities, including air conditioning, underfloor heating and an alarm system, combining luxury and functionality in every aspect of the house. Using the highest quality materials, every detail of this villa reflects an unwavering commitment to excellence and sophistication.
Don't miss the opportunity to purchase this gem of a property. Contact us today for more information on this or any other villa and discover a luxurious lifestyle in the heart of Monte Olimpo.
Location
Jávea, often referred to as Xàbia, is located in the northern part of the Costa Blanca. Jávea has become a sought-after tourist destination, where more than half of the residents are international expats who have chosen this picturesque town as their permanent home. Jávea is renowned for its idyllic microclimate and is scientifically recognised as having one of the most favourable microclimates in the world, second only to Rio de Janeiro.
From Jávea there are breathtaking views reaching the coast of Ibiza, some 90 kilometres away. Convenient ferry services make the journey to Ibiza, a mecca for nightlife lovers and fun-seeking tourists.
Mount Montgo, rising to more than 750 metres, adorns the landscape as the highest point in the area, offering a vantage point to enjoy a panoramic view of the town and nearby islands, including Portichol and Ambolo. A visit to this spectacular site is an absolute must-see.
For those seeking relaxation, Jávea offers popular beaches such as Arenal, Sardinella, Granadella and Barraca. These sun-soaked shores provide the perfect backdrop for sunbathing, swimming and snorkelling in the crystal clear waters of the Mediterranean.
The historic centre of Jávea is a charming patchwork of stone buildings, historic churches and atmospheric restaurants and shops. Here you will find a range of services available in many languages, making it accessible to visitors from all over the world. A stroll along the waterfront will allow you to enjoy the panoramic views of the Mediterranean.

Location
On the picturesque Costa Blanca, in the northern part of the province of Alicante, lies the charming seaside village of Jávea (also known as Xàbia). With its prime location on the Mediterranean coast and a wide bay protected on two sides by stone headlands, Jávea has become a popular tourist destination, with a significant population of 35,000 foreigners who have made this town their home. In fact, Jávea is renowned for having the most favourable microclimate in the world, second only to Rio de Janeiro.
Visitors can enjoy breathtaking views from the village of Jávea, which offers panoramic views of the Ibiza coastline, some 90 kilometres away. A visit to the highest point in the area, Mount Montgo, which is more than 750 metres high, is a must for tourists wanting a bird's-eye view of the town and the surrounding islands of Portichol and Ambolo.
Beach lovers can enjoy the sun and sea at popular beaches such as Arenal, Sardinella, Granadella and Barraca. In addition to swimming, sunbathing and diving in the crystal clear waters, the centre of Jávea offers visitors the opportunity to explore the charming historic townhouses, churches, atmospheric restaurants and shops, as well as the many service outlets where various foreign languages can be easily learned. Don't miss the picturesque coastal walkway, which offers a magnificent panorama of the Mediterranean.
A must-see is the town's fishing harbour, which offers fresh seafood such as prawns, squid and sardines, caught daily between Jávea and Ibiza. The nearby sailing club is another popular venue, showcasing impressive yachts and powerboats owned by enthusiasts from all over Europe.
In the sprawling Montanar district, visitors can enjoy sandy, pebbly or rocky beaches, as well as the famous chiringuitos beach bars offering exotic drinks throughout the season. The district is dotted with stately single-family houses in a traditional style, tiled and fitted with arcades, glass and concrete. The area is separated by a road from the less frequented rocky beaches.

For sale apartament with private pool in San Pedro del Pinatar
We are pleased to offer you this new and high quality project being built in picturesque San Pedro del Pinatar. San Pedro del Pinatar is located 46 km from Murcia and 87 km from Alicante. It is a small town located on the Mar Menor coast, Costa Cálida in the province of Murcia. It is also located near the natural lagoon formed by the La Manga strip. The town is a fishing port and has many amenities such as bars, restaurants and shops. There are several great beaches in and around the town, including Playa de la Torre Derribada and Llana beach, where there are many bars and restaurants.
The project consists of modern flats with three bedrooms and two bathrooms and a private swimming pool, with a choice of ground floor with garden or top floors with terraces and private solarium with outdoor kitchen.
All will have open-plan, fully-equipped kitchens with high built-ins and therefore plenty of storage space.
Duplexes on the ground floor have large terraces with a private pool and private parking and storage on the plot, while duplexes on the upper floors include a private balcony and roof terrace with a private pool, guest toilet and parking and storage on the complex.
The upper duplexes offer a fully equipped outdoor kitchen, electric barbecue, hot water shower and a designer metal pergola that provides more usable space all year round and shade during the hot summer months.
It's up to you to choose whether you prefer a modern penthouse with private solarium or a charming ground floor flat with luxurious pool access.
Planned completion date: December 2025
Location
San Pedro del Pinatar is a small town located in the province of Murcia, Spain, situated on the shores of the saltwater lagoon of the Mar Menor. The town has a rich history that dates back to the Roman Empire, and traces of Roman salt factories can still be seen today.
There are several beautiful beaches in the town, including Playa de la Llana, Playa de Villananitos and Playa de la Torre Derribada. These beaches are ideal for water sports, sunbathing and relaxation. Playa de la Mota is a beach popular with locals, offering calm waters and excellent facilities.
San Pedro del Pinatar is also home to a fascinating natural park, the Salinas y Arenales de San Pedro del Pinatar Regional Park. This natural park offers a unique environment where a salt water lagoon merges with the Mediterranean Sea, creating a diverse ecosystem that supports a wide variety of flora and fauna. Visitors can go on guided hikes, birdwatching and wildlife watching, and walk the park's trails.
Several attractions are worth a visit, including the fish market, which offers a wide selection of fresh seafood caught the same day, and the Sea and Salt Museum, which showcases the town's rich history of salt production. Molino de Quintin is a historic windmill that has been restored and provides a glimpse into the town's agricultural past.
San Pedro del Pinatar is also home to a number of restaurants, cafés and bars where visitors can sample local cuisine and enjoy a relaxed atmosphere. The town has a vibrant cultural scene, with several festivals throughout the year, including the Carnival of San Pedro del Pinatar and the International Festival of Habaneras and Polyphony.

Location
La Manga or La Manga del Mar Menor - a peninsula in Spain lying between the Mediterranean Sea and the Minor Sea (Mar Menor) near Murcia. La Manga is located by the city of Cartagena. It is 22 km long and about 100 m wide. Here you will find everything you expect from a holiday in this country: sunny and sandy beaches, blue sea, amazing views and tasty food.
It is an ideal holiday destination, flanked on one side by the Minor Sea, or Mar Menor, which is technically a bay, and on the other by the Mediterranean.
La Manga, which means ‘sleeve’ in Spanish, is located on the Costa Calida in the Region of Murcia. It is 24 kilometres long and at its narrowest point less than 40-50 metres wide. It is a bit like Spain's Hel Spit, of course, with a warmer and saltier sea and less lush vegetation.
The peninsula's location means that already in June there is heat and warm sea water. Not surprisingly, the region is popular with water sports enthusiasts - windsurfers and kite surfers - as well as fans of snorkelling or diving.
Some of the more popular beaches on both the Mediterranean and the Lesser Sea include Cala del Pino, Playa Mistral, Playa del Barco Perdido, Playa del Pudrimel, Mahalo Beach, Cala Reona, Playa la Gola, Playa del Pudrimel, Playa del Estacio, Playa de Cavanna, Playa del Banco del Tabal, Playa de Puerto Bello or Playa Paraíso.
Diving fans, on the other hand, should visit Isla Grossa, El Fallon Cabo de Palos, and the Isla Hormigas Marine Reserve. The latter is one of the best diving sites in all of Spain.
There is something for everyone here. Fans of historic architecture can visit the Faro Cabo de Palos lighthouse or the nearby town of Cartagena with its Roman buildings.
The La Manga peninsula can be reached by arriving at the San Javier airport in Murcia, but there are no direct flights from Poland yet.
The nearest airport with flights from the country on the Vistula is El Altet in Alicante. The drive to La Manga from Alicante will take about 1.5 hours.

Location
Calpe, an enchanting seaside town located on the Mediterranean Sea, entices with its undeniable charm and abundance of attractions. Located in the province of Alicante, Spain, Calpe offers a delightful blend of natural beauty, historic sites and vibrant attractions. Located approximately 75 kilometres from Alicante Airport, Calpe provides a convenient commute for travellers wishing to explore its wonders.
On arrival, you will be delighted by the stunning beaches, which have won prestigious Q' certificates for quality and the Blue Flag. Calpe boasts some of the most beautiful sandy coastlines in the region, including the iconic Playa de la Fossa and Playa de la Arenal-Bol. Immerse yourself in Mediterranean bliss, bask in the sun or enjoy the water sports and activities that are an integral part of Calpe's coastal landscape.
In addition to its picturesque beaches, Calpe is adorned with historical and cultural treasures. The distinctive Peñón de Ifach, a massive limestone rock formation, is a symbol of Calpe and offers breathtaking panoramic views. Take a hike to the top and admire the natural beauty unfolding before your eyes. The old town with its charming narrow streets and historic architecture invites you to stroll around and discover its rich heritage.
Calpe's bustling fishing port is a must-visit destination. Watch the fishermen bring in their daily catch, visit the fish market and enjoy fresh seafood in the many restaurants along the harbour. To learn about the local culture, visit the Museum of Archaeology and Ethnography to delve into Calpe's fascinating history.
Nature lovers will find solace in the nature parks surrounding Calpe. Explore Las Salinas Nature Park, a paradise for migratory birds such as flamingos and storks, or head to Serra Gelada Nature Park to see its rugged cliffs and enchanting trails. For hikers, the Sierra de Bernia and Sierra de Oltà offer exciting trails and stunning views.
Immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of Calpe's local markets, where you can discover fresh produce, handicrafts and traditions. Savour the local gastronomy, which is famous for its seafood, rice dishes and spicy tapas.

The development will consist of several construction phases. The first includes 24 2 and 3 bedroom flats, as well as 12 charming bungalows with 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Each property has been designed with exceptional attention to detail and the highest quality materials, providing an atmosphere of luxury and comfort. The spacious interiors are complemented by large terraces that invite you to enjoy the Mediterranean climate.
The state-of-the-art penthouse flat consists of an open-plan living room with doors leading to the sun terrace, a dining area, a modern kitchen with appliances including oven, hob, extractor, fridge-freezer, washing machine, dishwasher and microwave, a master bedroom with built-in wardrobes and en-suite bathroom, a second bedroom also with built-in wardrobes and a guest bathroom. A staircase leads up to a private rooftop solarium where you can enjoy the sun all day long.
Residents will also be able to enjoy the extensive gardens, ideal for relaxing and connecting with nature. In addition, parking and communal pools for adults and children are available, ensuring an active and social lifestyle.
Don't miss the opportunity to live in this privileged environment.
Planned completion date : 2nd half of 2026
Location
Mil Palmeras is a seaside neighbourhood located in the municipality of Pilar de la Horadada, in the south of the province of Alicante. The resort is located in the south-east of Spain and borders Murcia (about 15 minutes away). Alicante, on the other hand, is approximately 40 minutes' drive away. Mil Palmeras literally means ‘a thousand palm trees’.
Pilar de la Horadada has everything you need to enjoy the delights of the sea, pine forests and the Spanish sun. The coastline of Pilar de la Hordada is more than 4 kilometres long along very diverse scenery. You will encounter wide beaches with fine white sand, small stone wall shelves suspended above the water and small and intimate hidden coves with golden sand.
The sea here is generally calm, the beaches are safe and there are no steep slopes, allowing even the smallest children to swim safely. In addition, the clear water and excellent visibility invites divers to observe the beauty of the aquatic life.
The cleanliness of the beaches in Pilar de la Hordada has been awarded the distinction of a European Union Blue Flag, which provides guarantees of a healthy environment.
Inland, various interesting excursions can be made near the towns of Sierra and Escalona. There are two signposted hiking trails, along the Rio Seco riverbed with a length of 19 kilometres, definitely worth a visit. One route is 4 kilometres long, while the other is 10 kilometres stretching from the natural area of Pilar de Campoverde to the mouth of Mil Palmeras beach.
Not far from the town of Pilar de la Horadada is also the 18-hole golf course at Lo Romero. Professionals in the field as well as novice players will find a good match there.
Gastronomy has a privileged place in the culture of this beautiful town. Among the typical dishes of Pilar de la Hordada are potatoes with meat stew, meatballs, rabbit in garlic and Gachas Migas (a floury, garlicky pancake) as well as great rice dishes and soups. Sweets and cakes also deserve a mention here, confectionery such as the meringue cake called ‘’milhojas‘’ or the almond sweets called ‘’cordiales‘’ being the most popular.

Location
Villajoyosa is a charming Mediterranean coastal town, located between Alicante and Benidorm, about 30 minutes drive from Alicante airport. Villajoyosa or La Vila Joiosa literally translates as a happy town. Indeed, this is also the impression it gives, with its colourful houses in the town centre. This traditional fishing village is considered one of the most beautiful in the province of Alicante.
