Apartment with sea view for sale in Casares Costa, Malaga.
Explore with us a new, exclusive project of a private urbanization that offers spectacular panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea. Your new apartment is located in Casares Costa, between Marbella and Sotogrande, next to Estepona. Enjoy a privileged location on the Costa del Sol that invites you to experience the Mediterranean life you have long dreamed of!
This luxurious residential estate has been designed in a modern way, but fits perfectly into the natural surroundings. Its well-thought-out, sophisticated design blends seamlessly into its surroundings, creating intelligent spaces that make the most of natural light, reducing the need for artificial lighting and allowing you to live in a more sustainable way.
You can choose from modern 1, 2, 3 and 4 bedroom apartments, offering ground floors with private gardens, first floors with sea views and topped with exclusive penthouses with terraces with open views of the Mediterranean Sea. It's up to you to choose which of these new apartments you will call your Spanish home!
The south-eastern orientation of the residential building not only provides plenty of natural light for most of the day, but also provides an ideal climate at any time of the year. A feeling of spaciousness and brightness pervades every space in this building. Large windows connect the interior and exterior spaces with the beauty of the surroundings, allowing natural light to flow freely. All houses have large terraces, a garage and a storage room.
High-quality materials with exceptional durability and versatility have been selected for the interior of each investment, as well as a combination of other exclusive details that will turn your house into a luxurious apartment. A selection of the best brands, underfloor heating in the main bathroom, a designer kitchen equipped with modern household appliances and an innovative thermal and acoustic insulation system that will make your home an oasis of peace and comfort, indifferent to outside noise, which will be cool in summer, and warm in winter. To produce hot water, the house is also equipped with a state-of-the-art aerothermal system, which reduces energy consumption by at least 75%.
In addition, the residence has luxurious common areas available only to residents. Here you will find two impressive swimming pools, both with night lighting, inviting you to relax and cool off in the warm Mediterranean sun. The area is surrounded by large gardens where residents can relax, stroll and enjoy the pleasant and quiet surroundings. The common areas also feature sustainable solutions, such as low-energy LED lighting systems. In addition, the coworking zone, which shares space with the gourmet room, gives you the opportunity to work in an inspiring and very comfortable environment. Additionally, you can exercise your body and mind every day without going outside. The gym will allow you to stay in shape and relax later in the relaxation zone. Meanwhile, the youngest also have their own entertainment zone on the playground.
Planned construction completion date: 2026.
Location
Casares is divided into two urban areas: Casares Costa, which is a residential strip on the beach, a shopping center with bars and restaurants, and the old historic village of Casares, located a few kilometers in the mountains at an altitude of 430 meters above sea level.
Casares Costa is a small stretch of coast forming part of the commune of Casares in the province of Malaga in Andalusia. The beachfront area is ideal for a family beach holiday, set in a fairly peaceful setting whilst still enjoying local amenities and within easy reach of Estepona, Sotogrande and Gibraltar.
Places to visit
Casares Costa is well situated for exploring the western end of the Costa del Sol, from Marbella and Estepona, through to Sotogrande, Gibraltar and the province of Cadiz. The area offers many facilities and amenities for those who want to take part in recreational activities such as water sports, jeep safaris, inland excursions, trekking or simply sit back and relax at the beach bar and taste sardines al espeto (sardines on spit). and a glass of wine or sangria.
Golf
Casares Costa is a great place for a golf holiday or for those who want to take part in a round or two while away. There are many world-class golf courses nearby, including La Duquesa Golf & Country Club, Estepona Golf, Valderrama (Sotogrande) and Alcaidesa Links Golf in San Roque.
Beaches
The golden sand beaches stretch from Estepona to Casares to Sotogrande and Gibraltar and are never too crowded. You can walk to the beach from anywhere in Casares Costa, and there are great chiringuitos (beach restaurants) along the way.
Climate
Casares Costa enjoys a subtropical Mediterranean climate, with hot summers and mild winters. The cooling breeze from the sea makes it possible to cope with the heat in summer, the average temperature is 32°C in summer and 15-16°C in the winter months.

San Pedro del Pinatar is a small town located in the province of Murcia, Spain, situated on the shores of the saltwater lagoon of the Mar Menor. The town has a rich history that dates back to the Roman Empire, and traces of Roman salt factories can still be seen today.
There are several beautiful beaches in the town, including Playa de la Llana, Playa de Villananitos and Playa de la Torre Derribada. These beaches are ideal for water sports, sunbathing and relaxation. Playa de la Mota is a beach popular with locals, offering calm waters and excellent facilities.
San Pedro del Pinatar is also home to a fascinating natural park, the Salinas y Arenales de San Pedro del Pinatar Regional Park. This natural park offers a unique environment where a salt water lagoon meets the Mediterranean Sea, creating a diverse ecosystem that supports a wide variety of flora and fauna. Visitors can go on guided tours, bird and wildlife watching and walk along the park trails.
The town has several attractions worth visiting, including the Fish Market, which offers a wide selection of fresh seafood caught the same day, and the Sea and Salt Museum, which showcases the town's rich history of salt production. Molino de Quintin is a historic windmill that has been restored and provides a glimpse into the town's agricultural past.
San Pedro del Pinatar is also home to a number of restaurants, cafés and bars where visitors can sample local cuisine and enjoy a relaxed atmosphere. The town has a vibrant cultural scene, with several festivals throughout the year, including the Carnival of San Pedro del Pinatar and the International Festival of Habaneras and Polyphony.

Location
Benalmádena is located just 20 km from Malaga and 40 km from Marbella. This town is loved by Spanish tourists. The high quality of services means that visitors from all parts of the world dock at the Puerto Marina located here, and the cosmopolitan atmosphere that it is difficult to think of anything other than blissful relaxation and great fun.
We can divide Benalmadena into three main parts. These will be: Benalmadena Pueblo - the old Andalusian part with its characteristic white buildings, the modern and residential Arroyo de la Miel and the magnificent harbour. Each is unique and worth seeing.
1.Benalmádena Pueblo
A restored old town (pueblo) with narrow streets and two squares (Plaza de España and Plaza Andalucia). The first one features the bronze fountain La Niña, which is the symbol of the Benalmádena Pueblo
2.Benalmádena Costa - the newest part of the town, located along the coast and directly adjacent to the sea. Much of its development is made up of tourist facilities (hotels, food outlets, discos and the beach).
3.Arroyo de la Miel (Creek flowing with honey':)- originally a separate settlement, located between the other two districts. It is the main residential and most commercially active district.
Benalmádena is particularly recommended for families with children, as it abounds in a large number of attractions prepared also for the youngest. Most of the most interesting ones can be found below:
THE FAIRYTALE CASTLE OF COLOMARES
Colomares Castle, is not really a castle but a monument to Columbus. Nevertheless, it is beautiful and is one of the biggest attractions in Benalmadena. It was designed and built by Esteban Marin Martin. Its construction lasted from 1987 to 1994. It is interesting to note that in the castle, there is the smallest church in the world, listed in the Guinness Book of Records. Its surface area is just 1.96 m2.
STUPA
A living monument to the enlightened mind, a Buddhist monument to peace, and harmony in the world, and a place for study, reflection and meditation. A very interesting place, not least because it is the largest Stupa in Europe. Few people also know that it was designed by the Polish architect Wojciech Kossowski. An additional attraction is the beautiful panorama stretching from the hill.
BENALMADENA HARBOUR
Puerto Marina, is a good place for a family stroll or dinner with wine. You can admire the ships moored here and the interesting architecture. The harbour is full of bars, shops and cafés. It has twice been voted the most beautiful harbour in the world. It is also known as the ‘Venice of Andalusia’ because of its streets, narrow canals and bridges. One of the attractions you can count on here is the aquarium. At Sea Life, you will find more than 2,000 species of sea creatures including: turtles, sharks and stingrays.
TIVOLI WORLD
An ideal activity option for children and adults alike. Among the fountains and gardens, you can enjoy not only more than 30 attractions for the whole family, but also a wide range of food and drink options. This is an old-style amusement park, with classic attractions such as Ferris wheels, bumper cars and a mansion of terror, as well as new offerings for the more adventurous. The tower, from which you can experience a stunning fall from a height of 60 metres, is undoubtedly one of the most spectacular attractions in the park.
TEREFERICO BENALMADENA - THE QUEUE
The Teleférico Benalmádena is a cable car that will give you a bird's eye view of the entire city. The three-kilometre route takes you to the top of Calamorro in the Sierra de Mijas mountain range. Once reached, we can enjoy a beautiful panoramic view of the Costa del Sol, nearby Gibraltar and, in good weather, the African coastline. In addition to the magnificent landscapes at the summit of the Calomorro, several other optional activities await us, such as bird of prey shows, Andalusian horse training demonstrations, trekking trails and cycling routes.
BEACHES
While in this beautiful city it is certainly worth relaxing on one of Benalmadena's beaches, and there is plenty of choice: Arroyo Hondo, Carvajal, Bonita, Bil Bil, La Morera, Arroyo de la Miel, Benalnatura, Fuente de la Salud, La Perla, Las Viborillas, Playa de las Yucas, Torrebermeja, Santa Ana, Tajo de la Soga, Torremuelle, Torrequebrada y Torrevigía are all options that are certainly worth taking advantage of when planning a stay here.

On the beautiful Costa Blanca, in the interior of the province of Alicante, there are charming little towns that are often overshadowed by other coastal or more well-known towns. A clear example is Polop de la Marina, located a few kilometres from Benidorm, Altea or Castell de Guadalest, with a beautiful historic centre that will make you fall in love at first sight.
Located in the Marina Baja region of Alicante, about 15 kilometres from the coast, Polop de la Marina is a small town with less than 5,000 inhabitants.
Polop's old town, located on a hill and developed at the foot of the Arab castle, is one of the most interesting and best-preserved in the province. Its picturesque, colourful streets full of flowers and carved ornaments are an inspiration for many artists.
The most outstanding building in historical terms is the church of San Pedro Apóstol, in the upper part of the town, just before the path leading to the castle.
Although few remains of Polop Castle have survived, it is well worth visiting the ruins, located at the top of the hill on which the old town is situated. The path leading to the castle is undoubtedly one of the most interesting places to visit in Polop. Impeccably maintained, like the rest of the municipality, the successful surface and its zigzag route offer impressive views of the city and the surrounding area.
The colourful fountain, Fuente de los Chorros, is also worth a visit. It is decorated with ceramic mosaics depicting the coats of arms of various towns in the province of Alicante and has 221 jets.
When it comes to hiking trails in Polop, one route stands out from the rest: the ascent of Mount Ponotx, known as the Sleeping Lion. A large limestone mass with vertical walls that rises to a height of 1,183 metres. It is a very difficult route, due to the positive difference of over a thousand metres, and is reserved for people with very good physical condition and who are used to this type of mountain route.
There are many different restaurants in Polop. But if you want to experience an unforgettable culinary experience, you should make a reservation at the restaurant Ca l'Àngels. Known for its beautiful mountain views, unspoilt beaches and rich cultural heritage, Finestrat is the ideal place for anyone looking for a relaxing and unforgettable experience. There is no shortage of exciting things to do in Finestrat.
Finestrat is located on the slope of the Puig Campana mountain, from where you have a wonderful view of the mountains, the coast and the Mediterranean Sea. On the other hand, Cala Finestrat is becoming increasingly popular and its development has made it almost an extension of Benidorm itself.

Cala Finestrat is a beach resort located just three kilometres from the busy Benidorm. The resort offers adequate facilities, a large selection of restaurants, bars and shops. Everything you need is available in Benidorm, which can be easily reached by bus and taxi.
La Cala beach is fairly quiet, as most people looking for a more upbeat atmosphere head for the beaches surrounding Benidorm. However, if you prefer to spend your holiday on one or two rounds of golf, Finestrat will be happy with the nearby Real Faula Golf Club, which offers two excellent golf courses.
Both Finestrat and Cala Finestrat are peaceful destinations compared to some of the neighbouring resorts. Both offer a selection of local bars and restaurants where you can enjoy good food and a relaxed atmosphere.

Location
Pilar de la Horadada is a charming town located in the southern part of the province of Alicante, in the Community of Valencia, Spain. This town is famous for its picturesque landscapes, fascinating cultural heritage and crystal clear water, making it the perfect place for those seeking relaxation and tranquillity.
Pilar de la Horadada has everything you need to enjoy the sea, pine forests and the Spanish sun. Pilar de la Hordada's coastline is over 4 kilometres long and offers a wide variety of scenery. There are wide beaches with fine white sand, small stone ledges hanging over the water and small, intimate, hidden coves with golden sand.
The sea is usually calm here, the beaches are safe, and there are no steep slopes, so even the youngest children can bathe safely. Furthermore, the clear water and excellent visibility invite divers to observe the beauty of aquatic life.
The cleanliness of the beaches in Pilar de la Hordada has been awarded the blue flag of the European Union, which guarantees a healthy environment.
Inland, you can take various interesting trips near the towns of Sierra and Escalona. There are two signposted hiking trails along the 19-kilometre-long Rio Seco, which are definitely worth a visit. One of the trails is 4 kilometres long, while the other is 10 kilometres long and extends from the natural area of Pilar de Campoverde to the mouth of the river at Mil Palmeras beach.
There is also an 18-hole golf course in Lo Romero near the town of Pilar de la Horadada. It is a great place for both professionals and beginners.
Gastronomy has a privileged place in the culture of this beautiful city. Typical dishes of Pilar de la Hordada include potatoes with meat stew, meatballs, rabbit in garlic and Gachas Migas (a floury, garlicky pancake) as well as excellent rice dishes and soups. The desserts and pastries are also worth mentioning. The most popular are the meringue cake called ‘milhojas’ and the almond sweets called ‘cordiales’.

Apartment for sale in Xeresa, Gandia.
This incredible new residential complex is located just 4 km from the beaches of Gandia, surrounded by mountains and with total and maximum privacy.
Here you will find magnificent and spacious one, two and three bedroom apartments with spectacular terraces, exceptional orientation and the highest standards of construction quality. The properties have been designed so that all the main rooms have maximum direct light. The open-plan concept and kitchen allow for socialising inside the property.
All apartments have a parking space and storage room.
The architectural design of the complex combines the elements of space, mountains, views and a natural park to create a unique environment where sociability and the Mediterranean lifestyle are a way of life. The terraced structure, which adapts to the typography of the natural environment, makes the resort a unique complex.
The complex has gardens with lawns and trees native to the area, three swimming pools, a social club and other features that will make your stay in your new apartment unique and wonderful.
The resort is located on a hillside in the Mondúver nature park, in a natural environment with a dreamlike view. The beaches of Gandía and Xeraco can be seen at the foot of the hill. Among the 7.5 km of Gandía beaches, Ahuir beach is worth mentioning, which is almost 2 km long and 70 metres wide, where the municipality's dunes, with golden sand, can be found; a secluded and protected beach, equipped with rescue and monitoring equipment, it has blue flag status, as well as access to pavements and car parks.
There are three large golf courses nearby in Oliva Nova, just a 34-minute drive away. La Galiana is also just a 34-minute drive away, and El Saler is about a 50-minute drive from the property.
Xeresa del Monte is located in the town of Xeresa, 30 minutes from Valencia and 70 km from the airport, next to the AP7 motorway.
If you are looking for an investment at a favourable price and in a great location, you cannot miss this offer!
Planned completion date: depending on the apartment chosen, ready or December 2025.
Location
What to do
Xeresa is located in the region of La Safor (Community of Valencia). Surrounded by mountains, Xeresa stands on a plain 30 metres above sea level.
With beaches 2 km away (Playa virgen de l'Auir (Gandia) and Playa de Xeraco) and Monte Mondúver to the west, Xeresa is the perfect place for a trip to the sea and the mountains.
A stroll through the oldest and most charming streets of Xeresa is wonderful. The route starts at Calle La Verge, which is decorated with flowers, and ends with stairs that lead to ‘la muntanyeta’.
A little further on, we pass through Plaza del Tossal, Fuente de la Pila, Calle Mayor, one of the longest streets in the old town, Palacio de los Vic, Ermita de la Santísima Trinidad and the old laundry, which is a must-see.
To round off your trip to Jerez, we recommend some of its festivals:
Fiesta de la Virgen del Carmen. Takes place in the Barriada Boltesar neighbourhood in the third week of July. There is dancing, various competitions, correfocs, the moving of the Virgin through the neighbourhood and her return to the church.
Ravalet Festival. Takes place on the second weekend in August. Includes a popular street dinner, dancing with a band, mass and procession in honour of the Holy Trinity, a concert and other leisure and festive activities.
Patron Saint's Day. In the third week of August, in honour of San Isidro, San Rafael, La Virgen de los Dolores and San Antonio de Padua, the patron saint of Jerez.

It is also possible to build a private swimming pool for an additional fee.

Location
Located on the southern coast of Spain, Costa Blanca, Rojales is a charming town with a mix of traditional Spanish architecture and modern amenities. The area is known for its beautiful mountain views and proximity to the salt lakes of Torrevieja, known for their healing properties. Rojales offers a range of amenities including supermarkets, shops, restaurants and bars, as well as sports facilities such as golf courses and tennis courts. Its proximity to the beaches of Guardamar del Segura and the historic city of Orihuela makes Rojales an attractive location for both holidaymakers and permanent residents.
Located just a 45-minute drive from Alicante and Murcia airports, Rojales offers convenient access for travellers looking for a great holiday. Don't miss the Cuevas del Rodeo, an extraordinary cave complex transformed into an art gallery. Admire the intricate wall paintings and sculptures, and appreciate the city's thriving artistic community. For nature lovers, the nearby Parque Natural de la Mata invites you to discover stunning landscapes, ideal for walks and bird watching.
When it's time to relax, head to the beautiful Blue Flag beaches of Guardamar del Segura, just a 10-minute drive from the property. Dip your toes in the golden sand, soak up the Mediterranean sun and cool off in the crystal-clear water.
Golf enthusiasts will appreciate the presence of La Marquesa Golf and other prestigious courses nearby, offering a fantastic golfing experience in breathtaking surroundings.
After a day of sightseeing, treat yourself to the culinary delights of Rojales. In the many charming restaurants and cafés, you can savour traditional Spanish tapas, fresh seafood and local specialities, complemented by regional wines.
All in all, Rojales offers a captivating combination of history, natural beauty, great beaches, golfing opportunities and delicious cuisine. Whether you are looking for a short getaway or considering making Rojales your permanent home, this charming town offers a truly unforgettable experience.

Fulfil your dream of investing in Spain with us and experience life at the highest level on the northern Costa Blanca.

A parking space and storage room are included in the price.
Planned completion date: early 2028
Location
Located on the south-eastern coast of Spain, Alicante is the jewel of the Costa Blanca region, offering a perfect combination of natural beauty, rich history and warm Mediterranean climate. The wonderful beaches and calm waters of the Mediterranean are ideal for water sports and sunbathing, making it a favourite spot for both locals and tourists.
Golf enthusiasts from all over the world come to Alicante for its famous golf courses, and Alicante Golf is one of the best. Located just a few kilometres from the city centre, this 18-hole course was designed by Seve Ballesteros and offers breathtaking views of the Mediterranean Sea. It is known for its challenging layout and is a must for golf enthusiasts.
Alicante's rich history is evident in many magnificent monuments, such as the Castle of Saint Barbara. This historic fortress is located at the top of Mount Benacantil and offers panoramic views of the city and the Mediterranean Sea. The castle is a testament to the many civilisations that have settled in Alicante over the centuries, including the Romans, Moors and Christians, and is a popular destination for history buffs and tourists alike.
When it comes to recreation, the Alicante coast is undoubtedly a favourite spot for locals and tourists alike. The Explanada de España, located opposite the port, is a lively boulevard with palm trees, colourful flowers and charming street vendors. Here you can enjoy a cup of coffee or a delicious meal while taking in the magnificent views of the sea and the city.

The boutique character of the development, combined with its contemporary architecture, offers an ideal setting for enjoying life on the Spanish coast.

Approx. 1 km from the promenade and marina in Santiago de la Ribera
Shops, supermarkets, restaurants and cafés within a few minutes' walk

This picturesque destination is renowned for its authentic Spanish atmosphere, relaxed Mediterranean lifestyle and beautiful palm-lined promenade stretching along sandy beaches, making it the perfect setting for leisurely walks, cycling or enjoying spectacular sunsets.
Santiago de la Ribera has long been a favourite destination for both Spanish residents and international property owners. The area offers excellent infrastructure, with everything needed for comfortable everyday living just a short walk away. Residents can enjoy a wide selection of restaurants serving fresh seafood and traditional Mediterranean cuisine, charming tapas bars, cafés, supermarkets, pharmacies, banks and local markets offering fresh regional produce.
The nearby marina and extensive range of water sports make this an ideal destination for sailing, paddleboarding, kayaking and windsurfing enthusiasts. Combining a pleasant Mediterranean climate, beautiful beaches, excellent gastronomy and comprehensive local amenities, Santiago de la Ribera is an outstanding location for both permanent living and a holiday home investment.

This is a small development consisting of five modern villas located in the heart of the Spanish town of San Pedro del Pinatar.
These magnificent, spacious villas have been carefully designed to provide the perfect home for individual needs, with spacious ground floor terraces with off-road parking, private swimming pool, summer kitchen and large sliding glass windows.
They feature a living room with a modern open-plan kitchen and sliding windows connecting to the garden and sunbathing area. There is one bedroom on the ground floor and two on the first floor. The master bedroom on the first floor has a private terrace with access to the rooftop solarium. There is a private parking space on the plot.
All amenities are within walking distance, including numerous restaurants, tapas bars, cafés, shops and beautiful beaches. Planned completion date: 2026
Location
San Pedro del Pinatar is located in the north of Mar Menor, on the Costa Cálida. Although traditionally considered a tourist area, more and more people are moving here, attracted by the pleasant winter weather. The benefits of the mud baths, typical of this region, or the calm waters of the Mar Menor, have contributed to the development of this area, which now offers all kinds of amenities. Corvera Murcia Airport is 30 minutes away and Alicante Airport is 45 minutes away.
Contact us to find out how to make this dream a reality.
The city has a rich history dating back to the Roman Empire, and traces of Roman salt production facilities can still be seen today.
The town has several beautiful beaches, including Playa de la Llana, Playa de Villananitos and Playa de la Torre Derribada. These beaches are ideal for water sports, sunbathing and relaxation. Playa de la Mota is a beach popular with locals, offering calm waters and excellent facilities.
San Pedro del Pinatar is also home to a fascinating nature park, the Salinas y Arenales de San Pedro del Pinatar Regional Park. This natural park offers a unique environment where a saltwater lagoon meets the Mediterranean Sea, creating a diverse ecosystem that supports a wide range of flora and fauna. Visitors can take a guided tour, observe birds and wildlife, and walk along the park's trails.
The town has several attractions worth visiting, including the Fish Market, which offers a wide selection of fresh seafood caught that same day, and the Sea and Salt Museum, which showcases the town's rich history of salt production. Molino de Quintin is a historic windmill that has been restored and provides insight into the town's agricultural past.
San Pedro del Pinatar also has many restaurants, cafés and bars where visitors can sample the local cuisine and enjoy the relaxed atmosphere. The city has a vibrant cultural scene, with several festivals throughout the year, including the San Pedro del Pinatar Carnival and the International Festival of Habaneras and Polyphony.

Bungalow for sale in San Fulgencio

Planned completion date: December 2026
Location
San Fulgencio is a town in the south of the province of Alicante. It borders Daya Vieja, Dolores, Elche, Formentera del Segura, Guardamar del Segura and Rojales. It belongs to the Vega Baja region.
Although it is inland, it has numerous residential areas (La Marina, El Oasis, La Escuera, Bonavista, Las Pesqueras, etc.) that are located by the sea and are mostly inhabited by foreigners, giving it a cosmopolitan atmosphere.
Located in the middle of the Vega Baja of the Segura river, between fields of vegetables, cereals and orange trees, San Fulgencio is a completely flat town, except for the north, where it is protected by the Sierra del Molar. It is only 2 km from the coast.
Although the municipality has traditionally been dedicated to agriculture, today its most important activities are the service sector and tourism.
San Fulgencio is located 15 km from Elche and 36 km from Alicante.
WHAT TO SEE
- Church of San Fulgencio. A parish church built in the 18th century. Although it is Baroque in style, it stands out for its austerity and simplicity. Its interior has a Greek cross plan, with a dome in the centre, and three naves, the narrowest and longest of which in the centre reaches up to the head where the main altar, tabernacle and image of the patron saint are located. . Fulgencio.

It is located in the Vega Baja region, bordering the Murcia region, and is the southernmost municipality in the province of Alicante. Alicante is about 40 minutes away by car.
The origin of the name ‘Torre de la Horadada’ is related to the construction of numerous watchtowers, which were very common in coastal municipalities during the conquest to detect sea approaches and avoid Berber pirate raids. One of these towers, Torre Horadada, was named after the rock on which it was built because it had a hole in it and was called Peña Horadada.
The Pilar de la Hordada coastline is over 4 kilometres long and has a wide variety of scenery. There are wide beaches with fine white sand, small stone ledges hanging over the water and small, intimate, hidden coves with golden sand. The sea is usually calm, the beaches are safe, there are no steep slopes, so even the youngest children can bathe safely. In addition, the clear water and excellent visibility invite divers to observe the beauty of aquatic life. The cleanliness of the beaches in Pilar de la Hordada has been awarded the blue flag of the European Union, which guarantees a healthy environment.
Inland, you can take various interesting trips near the towns of Sierra and Escalona. There are two signposted hiking trails along the 19-kilometre-long Rio Seco, which are definitely worth a visit. One of the trails is 4 kilometres long, while the other is 10 kilometres long and extends from the natural area of Pilar de Campoverde to the mouth of the river at Mil Palmeras beach.
There is also an 18-hole golf course in Lo Romero near the town of Pilar de la Horadada. It is a great place for both professionals and beginners.
Gastronomy has a privileged place in the culture of this beautiful city. Typical dishes of Pilar de la Hordada include potatoes with meat stew, meatballs, rabbit in garlic and Gachas Migas (a floury, garlicky pancake) as well as excellent rice dishes and soups. The desserts and pastries are also worth mentioning. The most popular are the meringue cake called ‘milhojas’ and the almond sweets called ‘cordiales’.

properties.title: Great apartment close to the golf course in Campoamor

New apartment for sale in Campoamor, Orihuela Costa.
Your new apartment is in a great location close to shops, supermarkets, the La Zenia Boulevard shopping centre, restaurants and even the amazing beaches of La Zenia and Cabo Roig. There are several golf courses in the area, such as Villamartin Golf, La Rambla and Dehesa de Campoamor Golf Club.
The residence is located in one of the best areas of the Costa Blanca, in a quiet place, ideal for holidays as well as for permanent residence in Spain. Within walking distance:
4 golf courses within walking distance;
Zenia Boulevard shopping centre;
prestigious El Limonar English language school;
Lidl and Mercadona supermarkets;
various restaurants and bars;
beautiful sandy beaches within a 5-minute drive.
The complex has an underground car park with a lift, a large swimming pool with a seating area and a children's playground.
Planned completion date - September 2025.
Location
Orihuela Costa is a coastal region located on the Costa Blanca in the province of Alicante. It is close to the border with Murcia, near La Manga and the beautiful Mar Menor. Despite its name, it is actually about 20 kilometres from the main resort of Orihuela.
It is the ideal place for those looking for a family beach holiday, with 16 kilometres of varied coastline. It is also an excellent choice for a golfing holiday; in fact, Orihuela Costa is well equipped for all needs, with many amenities, facilities and leisure activities.
The region includes several coastal resorts, including Punta Prima, Playa Flamenca, La Zenia, Cabo Roig, Villamartin, Campoamor and Mil Palmeras.
The coastal resort of Cabo Roig is located at the southern end of the Costa Blanca in Orihuela Costa. This charming town has several Blue Flag beaches and spectacular mountain scenery. The town itself, just 10 kilometres from Torrevieja, has wide palm-lined avenues and delightful, lush gardens, overlooking the Mediterranean Sea, the La Manga peninsula and the Mar Menor.
The quiet urbanisation of Playa Flamenca is located near the lively town of Torrevieja on the Costa Blanca. The area has wonderful beaches, a golf course and many leisure facilities such as water parks, tennis, go-karting and tennis.
Again, not far from Torrevieja is the popular holiday resort of La Zenia. The town has everything you need to enjoy the perfect holiday: blue flag beaches, a golf course, good amenities, many Spanish and international restaurants and a beautiful surrounding area to explore. La Zenia is one of the most famous holiday resorts on the Costa Blanca.
The local beaches around Punta Prima have been awarded 67 European Blue Flags and stretch from natural sand dunes with a pine forest backdrop to long stretches of golden, sandy beaches. Punta Prima is actually an urbanisation rather than a town; it consists of apartments, townhouses and villas, located about 5 kilometres southwest of Torrevieja.
Campoamor is the perfect location for people who want to appreciate the true Spanish culture. Stunning scenery, green forests and beautiful beaches make Campoamor a major tourist destination on the Orihuela Costa.
The prestigious Villamartin golf development is located south of Alicante on the Orihuela Costa. The complex has the feel of a charming Mediterranean village with apartments, townhouses and villas and all the amenities you could wish for including shops, cafes, bars and restaurants and of course two 18-hole golf courses. Nearby beaches which are never too crowded.
Mil Palmeras is the southernmost resort on the Orihuela Costa. It is an attractive and popular seaside resort that boasts beautiful sandy beaches, rocky coves and bays, and a wealth of water sports and beach facilities.
Orihuela Costa is an excellent choice for a golfing holiday, with three great golf courses in the region - Villamartin, Campoamor and Las Ramblas.

properties.title: New apartment with large terrace 2 km from the beach in Los Alcázares
properties.area: Las Lomas de Rame - Bahía Bella
properties.summary: New build apartment for sale in Los Alcázares, Murcia: 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 100 m² built. €320,000.
properties.description:
New bungalow for sale in Los Alcázares.
Welcome to this new development of picturesque bungalows with large terraces, located in Los Alcázares close to beaches and all amenities.
Phase 1 of this wonderful project comprises 12 well-designed apartments. There is a choice of 6 ground floor units with private gardens or 6 top floor residences with roof terraces and solariums.
Each apartment has three bedrooms, two bathrooms (including one en-suite) and an open plan kitchen with living and dining area.
As a special incentive, the first five buyers will receive a free comfort package*, including a fully equipped kitchen and air conditioning.
Each property has an underground car park and storage room. Residents can also use the communal swimming pool.
Completion is planned for the second quarter of 2026.
Location
The picturesque town of Los Alcázares, located in the charming region of Murcia in Spain, tempts with its seaside charm and a multitude of delightful attractions. Located along the magnificent Mar Menor, a saltwater lagoon famous for its crystal-clear water and healing properties, Los Alcázares offers an idyllic place for an unforgettable holiday or a peaceful getaway.
The area is connected by motorway to Cartagena, Murcia and Alicante as well as the other beaches of the Costa Cálida and Costa Blanca.
One of the town's greatest assets is its collection of beautiful beaches, each promising moments of bliss and relaxation. The golden sands stretch along the calm shores of the Mar Menor, creating a paradise for sun seekers and water lovers. From the lively and family-friendly Playa de Los Narejos to the more secluded and peaceful Playa de Las Salinas, there is a beach for everyone. Visitors can sunbathe, swim or enjoy a variety of water sports including sailing, kayaking and windsurfing. The shallow and calm waters of the Mar Menor make it an ideal place for families with children.
Los Alcázares boasts a lively culinary scene, offering a diverse range of restaurants, bars and cafés to tempt your taste buds. From traditional Spanish tapas to international cuisine, the town's restaurants cater to every palate. Savour fresh seafood made with local ingredients, enjoy authentic paella or have a refreshing drink at a chiringuito on the beach while taking in the stunning views. The warm and welcoming atmosphere of the city's eateries enhances the overall dining experience, making it a real treat for food lovers.
As well as beaches and eateries, Los Alcázares offers many attractions to keep visitors entertained. Explore the charming streets in the town centre, dotted with shops, boutiques and craft stores. Discover local handicrafts, souvenirs and unique treasures to commemorate your visit. For the adventurous, a variety of water sports centres offer opportunities for jet skiing, paddleboarding and diving, allowing you to immerse yourself in the depths of the Mar Menor's underwater wonders.
Golf enthusiasts will find themselves in paradise, as Los Alcázares is surrounded by a selection of world-class golf courses. You will discover famous golf courses such as La Serena Golf, Roda Golf and Mar Menor Golf Resort just a short distance away. Immerse yourself in lush green fairways, perfect your swing and enjoy the Mediterranean climate that allows you to play golf all year round.
To experience history and culture, we highly recommend a visit to the nearby city of Cartagena. Explore ancient Roman ruins, wander through charming streets full of colourful buildings and immerse yourself in the rich history of this historic port city.

properties.title: Excellent villa with pool 1 km from the beach in San Javier
properties.summary: New build villa for sale in San Javier, Murcia: 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 85 m² built, 164 m² plot. €399,900.

Villa with pool for sale in San Javier.
Your new property is located in San Javier, a town distinguished by its proximity to all essential services, such as supermarkets, health centres and schools. The area also offers a wide range of leisure activities, with numerous restaurants, shops and recreational areas. In addition, San Javier is close to several golf courses, ideal for lovers of this sport. The proximity of the beaches, only 1 km from the Sea of Menor and the Mediterranean Sea, is an additional attraction, providing access to calm waters and a wide range of water sports.
Each villa has a private swimming pool and a spacious sun terrace, providing the perfect outdoor space to enjoy the good weather all year round. The layout of the villas includes three bedrooms and three bathrooms, with a built area of 86 m² on a plot ranging from 165 m² to 179 m². They also have a 15 m² swimming pool and a 77 m² solarium, offering large spaces for outdoor relaxation.
The open-plan kitchen and living room in the villa provide a cohesive and stylish living space. The modern kitchen is equipped with all the necessary appliances, plenty of storage space and an elegant design that is both functional and aesthetic. The spacious living area offers a comfortable and inviting atmosphere, ideal for relaxing with family and friends.
With three spacious bedrooms and two modern bathrooms, this villa offers the perfect combination of comfort and functionality. Whether you are looking for a permanent residence or a holiday home, this property reflects excellent value for money. The large windows and strategic location of the villa ensure that you can enjoy magnificent views from various rooms, creating a sense of peace and tranquillity.
You will also find a beautifully designed outdoor area that perfectly complements the interior of the villa. The terrace provides a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor living, allowing you to fully enjoy the Mediterranean climate. Whether you want to soak up the sun, enjoy a meal al fresco or simply relax in your private pool, this terrace offers the perfect spot for everyone.
Planned completion date from May 2026.
Location
San Javier is a coastal town with a lively shopping centre in its heart and a beautiful church square surrounded by bars and restaurants. It is located on the northern corner of the Mediterranean coast known as Costa Calida Murcia. San Javier is famous for its golden sandy beaches, warm climate and wide range of tourist attractions, including water sports, restaurants, bars and shops. In addition, the town has a rich history and culture, which is reflected in its historic buildings and monuments, such as the Church of San Francisco Javier and the Town Museum.
How to get there
From Murcia International Airport, you can reach the town of San Javier via the RM 19 motorway (35 km), and the journey takes about 25 minutes by car. From Alicante International Airport, you can reach the town via the AR-7 motorway (87 km) - 56 minutes by car.
Golf
Costa Calida is a mecca for golf lovers. There are many high-class golf courses here. The Nicklaus complex includes six courses designed by Nicklaus Design, including La Torre, El Valle, Alhama and Mar Menor. Mar Menor is a more difficult golf course with three holes, surrounded by large lakes. La Torre is a favourite among locals, as it is easier and more forgiving to play. Valle Golf Resort is located in a natural valley with spectacular views of the surrounding mountains. It is a course more suited to intelligent players with a strategy than players with a strong swing.
Alhama is considered by many to be the most difficult course in the Nicklaus Complex. It is a long, spectacular course, considered one of the best in Spain.
Beaches
San Javier has dozens of beaches in the area where you can spend your free time. The beaches are mainly located in the Santiago de La Ribera and La Manga del Mar Menor areas, i.e. the Mar Menor spit. One of the beaches of La Manga del Mar Menor is Playa Las Antillas.
Another interesting beach in the area is Playa de Hita, which is quite unusual as it is a protected area considered to be the habitat and breeding ground of many valuable migratory bird species. Most beaches are well equipped, with water and beach equipment available for hire, as well as a number of restaurants and beach bars. Toilets and showers are standard on the beaches. Other beaches in the San Javier area include Playa El Castillico and Banco del Tabal, both of which have been awarded blue flags.
Protected areas
There are many beautiful protected areas in the vicinity of San Javier. La Mayor o del Barón and Isla Perdiquera are two volcanic islands that are also home to protected bird species.
Other protected islands include La Isla Grosa and El Islote del Farallón, also of volcanic origin, which are home mainly to Roman gulls, but also other birds. All these places are accessible to tourists, but they are not as popular as the standard beaches, so perhaps they are a good idea for spending your holiday in San Javier?
Isla Grosa is an ideal place for scuba divers who come here from all over Spain.

Your new flat represents an excellent investment opportunity for those looking for premium Spanish properties, new builds on the Costa Calida and investment properties in Spain. Demand for quality coastal properties in the region continues to grow, making it the perfect time to invest.
Experience the art of sophisticated coastal living in a haven that effortlessly combines grandeur with the timeless charm of the Mediterranean.
This luxury residential development has been designed in a modern way, but blends in perfectly with its natural surroundings. You can choose from modern flats with 1, 2 or 3 bedrooms, offering ground floors with private gardens, a middle floor with a large terrace and a penthouse with a rooftop solarium. The planned completion date is March 2027
Location
Lo Pagán is a major tourist resort in the municipality of San Pedro del Pinatar on the Costa Calida. The beaches of La Puntica and Villananitos, with fine sand and shallow waters, quality services and the existence of an outdoor mud therapy area are just some of the tourist attractions of this district.
At the end of the 19th century, Lo Pagán was an estate owned by Don Pedro Pagán y Ayuso, which was frequented by intellectuals and politicians for literary meetings on summer evenings.
Warm temperatures with an average of 18 degrees throughout the year and more than 315 days of natural light make it an ideal place to holiday and live. The Mar Menor has calm, warm waters and the Mediterranean Sea is open and natural thanks to the Las Salinas de San Pedro del Pinatar nature reserve.
San Pedro del Pinatar has 14 km of beaches scattered over two seas, the Minor Sea (Mar Menor) and the Mediterranean. Its strategic location on the coast and environmental advantages have made it a highly sought-after residential area.
In addition to its well-maintained beaches, harbour and full commercial and service infrastructure, San Pedro del Pinatar has a unique natural space - the Las Salinas y Arenales de San Pedro del Pinatar Protected Landscape Area. It is a wetland area where flamingos, gulls, albatrosses, herons and owls can be seen; it also has moving dunes, with characteristic vegetation: sea lilies, rushes and reeds.
The municipality of San Pedro del Pinatar, in addition to the main town, is made up of seventeen small towns, such as El Mojón, Las Salinas, Los Sáez and Lo Pagán. This last area, Lo Pagán, occupies the most important place thanks to the great development of tourism.
The most famous beach in Lo Pagán is La Puntica beach, which offers picturesque amenities such as booths and a swimming area with access to the sea, as well as a wide range of leisure activities.

properties.title: Furnished, new apartment for sale in San Miguel de Salinas

properties.description:
New apartment for sale in San Miguel de Salinas.
We are delighted to present an amazing new development in the up-and-coming area of San Miguel de Salinas. This is a beautifully designed residential development offering a total of 112 modern apartments, all built to the highest standards and finished with high-quality materials.
Each apartment has a modern, open-plan layout that seamlessly connects the kitchen, dining area and living room, creating a spacious and bright space ideal for modern living. The apartments include two spacious bedrooms with built-in wardrobes and two elegant bathrooms, one of which is en-suite.
These apartments are located in a 7-storey building and are part of a gated and secure community that offers fantastic communal amenities: beautiful green areas, swimming pools for adults and children, a petanque court and plenty of outdoor space to enjoy the Mediterranean lifestyle.
All apartments are fully furnished and equipped, including ducted air conditioning, high-quality appliances, indoor and outdoor lighting, electric blinds and a private parking space.
Thanks to its ideal location near the centre of San Miguel de Salinas, the development is within walking distance of a wide range of services and amenities, including supermarkets, schools, pharmacies and restaurants. In addition, a short drive will take you to several prestigious golf courses, the fantastic beaches of Guardamar del Segura, Torrevieja and Orihuela Costa, as well as large shopping centres.
This is a unique opportunity to acquire a modern turnkey property in one of the most promising locations on the Costa Blanca.
Planned completion date: December 2026.
Location
San Miguel de Salinas is located 75 metres above sea level. It is the highest town in this area of the southern Costa Blanca. Several places in San Miguel offer panoramic views of both the salt lakes of Torrevieja and the beaches of the Mediterranean Sea.
But it is not so much the slightly elevated location as the central location that has attracted many Europeans to buy a home here in recent decades. The relaxed Mediterranean atmosphere makes San Miguel an authentic Spanish town where life moves at a leisurely pace. The original inhabitants make up the vast majority of the population. Most home buyers have found their homes mainly in suburban developments such as El Galan, Blue Lagoon, Blue Hills and Las Filipinas.
San Miguel's central location means that it is only a short drive to the bustling town of Torrevieja, the beaches of Orihuela Costa or any of the golf courses in the area. The town has many amenities, such as restaurants, shops and international sports facilities. For a municipality of such limited size, the town has a very full calendar of festivals each year. The most famous of these is the fiesta in honour of the patron saint of San Miguel, from whom the town and church take their name. The most famous is the neighbourhood where you can still find dozens of cave houses. Most of them are now used as shops, art studios and even restaurants.

properties.title: New exclusive apartments in Finestrat

Apartment for sale in Finestrat.

An excellent location on the Costa Blanca, where the Mediterranean Sea and its unparalleled light become your best ally to enjoy life to the fullest, with high quality and all amenities.
Located in one of the most sought-after areas of Alicante, this new property development in Finestrat is designed for those looking for more than just a home: an experience of living. Surrounded by nature, the sea and amenities, this enclave offers the perfect balance between tranquillity, entertainment and connection to major cities and transport links.
The development offers 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartments, all with a functional layout, spacious and with high-end finishes. Open-plan kitchens, bright living rooms and carefully selected materials ensure a modern and sophisticated atmosphere.
The development has complete communal areas with a swimming pool, a solarium with panoramic views, landscaped gardens and areas for relaxation and rest. All this in a gated, secure and family-friendly environment, ideal for year-round living or holidays.
The development is very well connected to the main access roads and is close to Benidorm's best beaches, golf courses such as Puig Campana Golf and shopping centres. In addition, its proximity to the centre of Benidorm, Alicante airport, the AVE and TRAM stations makes it an excellent option for those looking to invest in property on the Costa Blanca with a high rate of return.
Location
Finestrat is a town in the province of Alicante on the Costa Blanca. It is located just 8 km from the popular large town of Benidorm and 40 km from Alicante and its international airport. Known for its beautiful mountain views, pristine beaches and rich cultural heritage, Finestrat is the perfect place for anyone looking for a relaxing and unforgettable experience. There is no shortage of exciting things to do in Finestrat.
The town is located on the slopes of Puig Campana, offering magnificent views of the mountains, the coast and the Mediterranean Sea. The town has a typical Moorish atmosphere, with colourfully painted houses and narrow cobbled streets. On the other hand, Cala Finestrat is becoming increasingly popular, and its development has made it almost an extension of Benidorm itself.
Cala Finestrat
Cala Finestrat is a seaside resort located just three kilometres from the bustling town of Benidorm. The resort offers adequate facilities, a wide selection of restaurants, bars and shops. Everything you need is available in Benidorm, which is easily accessible by bus and taxi.
La Cala beach is quite quiet, as most of those seeking a more upbeat atmosphere head for the beaches surrounding Benidorm. The beach is a clean stretch of golden sand, ideal for children and safe for swimming. There are several charming restaurants along the promenade, and in the summer months there is an arts and crafts market in the afternoon.
The place is suitable for families and couples looking for a relaxing beach resort, yet close to many attractions and amenities. Nearby are the Terre Mitica and Terra Natura theme parks, the Aqualandia water park and the Mundomar marine and exotic animal park, which offer fun for the whole family.
If you prefer to spend your holiday on a round or two of golf, Finestrat will delight you with the nearby Real Faula golf club, which offers two excellent golf courses.
Both Finestrat and Cala Finestrat are quiet destinations compared to some of the neighbouring resorts. Both offer a selection of local bars and restaurants where you can enjoy good food and a relaxed atmosphere.

Apartment for sale near the beach in the town of Denia.

You can enjoy a peaceful life while living in a place with close access to extensive infrastructure. Only 20 minutes separate you from the huge port and the centre of Denia, which offers countless attractions and extensive infrastructure.
Choose from a wide range of 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments with spacious terraces, in a development with extensive green areas and complete communal services that will make you enjoy every day. Located in El Vergel, in a quiet and well-connected area, this new development combines the tranquillity of open spaces with the convenience of having all amenities within easy reach.
Just 200 metres from the beach, you can enjoy the sea just a few steps away, breathing in the tranquillity of the natural and relaxing surroundings!
Location
Dénia is a picturesque port town located on the Costa Blanca, just above Jávea. This seaside resort is located off the coast of the Balearic Islands (Ibiza, Majorca, Minorca), between Valencia and Alicante. To get there by car, take the A7 motorway from Valencia or Alicante. The journey by car from both cities takes about an hour. There are international airports in both Valencia and Alicante.
Among the many tourist resorts on the Costa Blanca, Dénia is one of the most attractive. It is not only the beautiful beaches for which the “White Coast” is famous, but also a beautiful historic centre, an extraordinary artistic heritage, an active yacht harbour and a spectacular natural environment.
Dénia is a very cosmopolitan city with an interesting mix of buildings reflecting its colourful history. Its main attraction is the 16th-century castle located above the city on a small hill. The castle has been thoroughly restored and houses a small archaeological museum. It also has pleasant gardens. The castle offers magnificent views of the sea and the town.
The landscape of Denia is dominated by the impressive silhouette of Montgó, an 800-metre-high mountain located a short distance from the coast. Together with the surrounding area, it forms the El Montgó Nature Reserve, where you can find 650 different species of plants and a rich fauna (eagles, peregrine falcons, owls, foxes, wild boars, genets). The protected area offers many trails that are worth exploring by bike or on foot.
The gastronomic sector draws inspiration from the Mediterranean diet and concepts such as Slow Food, promoting healthy food based on local resources and products to ensure more sustainable development. Dénia also emphasises the importance of a cross-cutting approach and the collaboration of multiple stakeholders in promoting gastronomy through the development of a wide range of activities and events involving both local and international players, such as the International Red Prawn Creative Cuisine Competition in Dénia, which attracts 50 chefs from around the world every year.
The city's large and impressive port, which serves all routes between Dénia and the Balearic Islands, deserves special attention. It offers ferry connections throughout the year, and in the summer the number of passengers using the service is exceptionally high. For many tourists who spend their holidays in this city, the idea of a day trip to the amazing beaches of Ibiza, Majorca or Formentera is simply perfect.
The beaches of Dénia are the main tourist attraction of the region for many. The city has almost 15 km of coastline, divided into two parts: Las Rotas is characterised by rocky and uncrowded coves, while Las Marinas has long, sandy and comfortable beaches.
Both offer many opportunities for fun: you can dive or snorkel, discovering the magnificent seabed of Las Rotas, as well as enjoy water sports in the Las Marinas area, including windsurfing, kitesurfing, stand-up paddleboarding and kayaking.

This seaside resort is located off the coast of the Balearic Islands (Ibiza, Majorca, Minorca), between Valencia and Alicante. To get there by car, take the A7 motorway from Valencia or Alicante. The journey by car from both cities takes about an hour. There are international airports in both Valencia and Alicante.
Among the many tourist resorts on the Costa Blanca, Dénia is one of the most attractive. It is not only the beautiful beaches for which the “White Coast” is famous, but also a beautiful historic centre, an extraordinary artistic heritage, an active yacht harbour and a spectacular natural environment.
Dénia is a very cosmopolitan city with an interesting mix of buildings reflecting its colourful history. Its main attraction is the 16th-century castle located above the city on a small hill. The castle has been thoroughly restored and houses a small archaeological museum. It also has pleasant gardens. The castle offers magnificent views of the sea and the town.
The landscape of Denia is dominated by the impressive silhouette of Montgó, an 800-metre-high mountain located a short distance from the coast. Together with the surrounding area, it forms the El Montgó Nature Reserve, where you can find 650 different species of plants and a rich fauna (eagles, peregrine falcons, owls, foxes, wild boars, genets). The protected area offers many trails that are worth exploring by bike or on foot.
The gastronomic sector draws inspiration from the Mediterranean diet and concepts such as Slow Food, promoting healthy food based on local resources and products to ensure more sustainable development. Dénia also emphasises the importance of a cross-cutting approach and the collaboration of multiple stakeholders in promoting gastronomy through the development of a wide range of activities and events involving both local and international players, such as the International Red Prawn Creative Cuisine Competition in Dénia, which attracts 50 chefs from around the world every year.
The city's large and impressive port, which serves all routes between Dénia and the Balearic Islands, deserves special attention. It offers ferry connections throughout the year, and in the summer the number of passengers using the service is exceptionally high. For many tourists who spend their holidays in this city, the idea of a day trip to the amazing beaches of Ibiza, Majorca or Formentera is simply perfect.
The beaches of Dénia are the main tourist attraction of the region for many. The city has almost 15 km of coastline, divided into two parts: Las Rotas is characterised by rocky and uncrowded coves, while Las Marinas has long, sandy and comfortable beaches.
Both offer many opportunities for fun: you can dive or snorkel, discovering the magnificent seabed of Las Rotas, as well as enjoy water sports in the Las Marinas area, including windsurfing, kitesurfing, stand-up paddleboarding and kayaking.

Location
Alicante - officially called Alacant in Valencian - is the capital of the province of the same name, located in the Valencia region. Originally called Lucentum, its name comes from the Greek Akra Leuké, which translates as ‘white promontory’ or ‘white fortress’. Later, under the name Al-Laqant in Moorish times, it grew into a commercial and agricultural centre, evolving into the city and name we know today. From ancient times, it was a strategic point on the Mediterranean coast.
Located in south-eastern Spain, on the distinctive Costa Blanca, Alicante has become one of the most popular tourist destinations in Spain. What's more, it stands out not only for its majestic beaches and Mediterranean climate, but also for its rich heritage, natural coves and golf courses. The castle of Santa Bárbara - built on the Benacanti mountain - is proof of this, with the remains of the town's first settlements.
In addition, the city hosts many festivities and a vibrant nightlife that seduces locals and tourists alike. Alicante's economy is based on tourism, but it also has a strong industrial and commercial component. Its port is one of the most active in the region. It serves not only as a trading post, but also as a departure point for ferries that connect to nearby islands and other Mediterranean destinations.
Golf
Alicante is home to some of the most beautiful golf courses in the region, making it a popular destination for golf enthusiasts. Alicante Golf is one of the most famous courses, offering 18 challenging holes designed by the legendary Seve Ballesteros. The course offers magnificent views of the Mediterranean and is a true paradise for golf lovers.
History
Alicante's rich history is evident in its magnificent monuments, such as the Castle of St Barbara. This historic fortress, rising from the top of Benacantil mountain, offers breathtaking views of the city and the sea. The castle's walls and towers have stood for centuries, and the site bears witness to the many civilisations that have settled in Alicante over the years, including Romans, Moors and Christians.
Beaches
Of course, no trip to Alicante is complete without a visit to its beautiful beaches. The city's warm climate and crystal clear waters make it the ideal place for water sports and beachcombing. Playa del Postiguet is one of the most popular beaches in the region, located in the heart of Alicante. The beach is a favourite with tourists and locals alike, offering stunning views of the city and the Mediterranean Sea.
Promenada
The Explanada de España Promenade is another must-visit place in Alicante. Located opposite the harbour, this lively boulevard is surrounded by terraces and pavement cafés, providing the perfect place to enjoy a cup of coffee or a delicious meal. The promenade is a popular meeting place for locals and tourists and an ideal place to enjoy the magnificent views of the sea and the city.

Location
Santa Pola is a coastal town located in the southern part of the Costa Blanca. It is only 19 km from the beautiful city of Alicante and only 14 km from El Altet Alicante Airport, which can be easily reached by public transport from both the airport and the centre of Alicante.
The town is famous for its beautiful beaches, historical monuments and diverse culture, making it a popular tourist destination for people from all over the world. It is the perfect place for a family holiday or a romantic getaway by the sea, where you can relax and enjoy the local seafood, the atmosphere and the impressive natural environment, which includes salt flats with flamingos and sand dunes.
Beaches
Santa Pola is a true paradise for beach lovers. Here you will find long stretches of fine white sand, interspersed with more intimate, picturesque coves. Many of these beaches are located near the town centre, so you don't need to use any means of transport to get there, just take a short walk from your apartment in Santa Pola.
One beach worth visiting is Playa Levante, which has been awarded a Blue Flag. Here you can relax and enjoy all the amenities of a beach that is considered comfortable and well-equipped. Another place where we recommend spending a sunny day is Playa de Varadero, located in the more urbanised eastern part of Santa Pola. These are two ideal places for a family holiday in the sunshine, on warm sand, enjoying the sea breeze of the Costa Blanca.
If you prefer quieter, less crowded places with a homely atmosphere, Playa de la Ermita, Playa de la Gola, or the coves of Calas del Cuartel and Calas de L'Aljub should be on your list.
Water sports
Santa Pola is a great place for water sports enthusiasts. The local beaches offer ideal conditions for this type of activity. Both the weather conditions and the beach infrastructure are perfect for windsurfing and kitesurfing. Santa Pola is the venue for the world windsurfing championships.
The best beaches for windsurfing in Santa Pola are Gran Playa, Playa Lisa, Playa Tamarit and Playa de la Gola. What's more, near these beaches you will find clubs and sports centres where you can rent equipment and sign up for windsurfing or kitesurfing lessons. Other water sports on offer in Santa Pola include sailing, paddle boarding, kayaking, scuba diving and snorkelling.
Salinas de Santa Pola
In the western part of Santa Pola, you will find the Salinas de Santa Pola (salt flats of Santa Pola), which have been protected as a nature reserve and are a refuge for the numerous wild birds that inhabit the area. The reserve is home to the Museo de la Sal (Salt Museum), where you can learn all about the salt extraction process and its history. The huge “icebergs” of salt remind us that we are in Santa Pola, the salt kingdom.
Salinas is a great place to relax and spend a day with your children in the countryside. There are several walking trails through the park, allowing you to observe the unique, extremely interesting and diverse flora and fauna. The flamingos that inhabit the salt reserve are its undisputed stars. These elegant birds with their pink plumage are a spectacular sight.
Tabarca Island
Isla Tabarca (Tabarca Island) is closest to Santa Pola, with only 9 kilometres separating the two places. Isla Tabarca is the smallest island in Spain. It is inhabited all year round.
The history of Tabarca sounds like an adventure novel with pirates in the lead role. It was pirates, sea wolves, who sought refuge on the island for hundreds of years. There are several transport companies in Santa Pola that will take you to the island. The journey takes no more than 15 minutes! Don't forget to bring your diving equipment, as the pebble beaches and picturesque little coves are ideal for this type of sport.

With over 1,800 years of history, Guardamar del Segura has witnessed the passing of civilisations that have left a lasting mark on this wonderful corner of the world. Visitors can explore the dunes by following paths through the native vegetation, providing an opportunity to get in touch with nature.

The road that connects the central part of Punta Prima with the beach is about a 10-minute walk away. At the end of this road is the famous Nautilus restaurant. RESTAURANTE PUNTA PRIMA on the southern coast of the Costa Blanca has been delighting locals and tourists for over 25 years with its exquisite approach to traditional Spanish and Western Mediterranean cuisine. This area of the southern Costa Blanca is home to many championship and award-winning golf courses. The closest to Punta Prima, just a 10-minute drive away, are Villamartin Golf, Las Ramblas Golf, Campoamor Golf and the famous Las Colinas Golf and Country Club. All have 18 holes and all have restaurants where you can enjoy a cold drink and a bite to eat after a round of golf.
A little further away are Romero Golf, Vistabella Golf, La Finca Golf, La Marquesa Golf and the famous La Manga Golf Club. Whether you are an avid golfer or a beginner, you are sure to find a golf course to suit your skills.

Location
San Miguel de Salinas is located 75 metres above sea level. It is the highest town in this area of the southern Costa Blanca. Several places in San Miguel offer panoramic views of both the salt lakes of Torrevieja and the beaches of the Mediterranean Sea.
But it is not so much the slightly elevated location as the central location that has attracted many Europeans to buy a home here in recent decades. The relaxed Mediterranean atmosphere makes San Miguel an authentic Spanish town where life moves at a leisurely pace. The original inhabitants make up the vast majority of the population. Most home buyers have found their homes mainly in suburban developments such as El Galan, Blue Lagoon, Blue Hills and Las Filipinas.
San Miguel's central location means that it is only a short drive to the bustling Torrevieja, the beaches of Orihuela Costa or any of the golf courses in the area. The town has many amenities, such as restaurants, shops and international sports facilities. For a municipality of such limited size, the town has a very full calendar of festivals each year. The most famous of these is the fiesta in honour of the patron saint of San Miguel, from whom the town and church take their name. The most famous is the neighbourhood where you can still find dozens of cave houses. Most of them are now used as shops, art studios and even restaurants.

Luxury villa with panoramic sea views for sale in Raco de Galeno, Benissa Costa.
Located in a prestigious urbanisation, this luxury villa offers the perfect combination of modern design and Mediterranean charm. It is situated in the mountainous, green town of Benissa. In this peaceful area, you can definitely relax and unwind from the hustle and bustle of city life. Fresh air, the scent of pine forests and panoramic sea views can be your everyday life when you live in this villa.
The property is located just 2 km from the nearest beaches and only 5 km from the AP-7 motorway, providing quick access to Moraira, Calpe and other well-known towns on the Costa Blanca. Alicante International Airport is approximately 80 km away, and prestigious golf courses such as Club de Golf Ifach and Altea Golf are within 10-15 km.
Designed to maximise natural light and spectacular sea views, the villa features contemporary architecture with large floor-to-ceiling windows and a seamless transition between the interior and exterior. Spread over several levels and connected by a private lift, the house offers four spacious bedrooms, each with an en-suite bathroom, and an additional guest toilet. The master suite has direct access to a private terrace with sweeping views of the Mediterranean Sea.
The open-plan living area with dining room is complemented by a fully equipped designer kitchen with top-of-the-range appliances, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The property is surrounded by extensive terraces, creating plenty of space for relaxation and outdoor entertainment.
The highlight of this villa is the infinity pool with panoramic views of the coast. The spacious pool terrace is the perfect place for sunbathing, al fresco dining or enjoying unforgettable sunsets with family and friends.
This newly built villa is equipped with advanced smart home technology, underfloor heating and ducted air conditioning for year-round comfort. The property also has an underground floor with ample space for additional use.
With full building licence and expected completion within 18 months of reservation, this villa represents a unique opportunity to own a contemporary masterpiece in one of the most sought-after locations on the Costa Blanca. The proximity of sandy beaches, charming coastal towns, marinas, shopping centres and outdoor sports facilities adds to its appeal as both a permanent residence and an exclusive holiday retreat.
Choose your dream villa in Raco de Galeno, Benissa Costa with us and enjoy the best Mediterranean lifestyle with breathtaking sea views and unparalleled comfort.
Location
Benissa is a picturesque town located in the northern part of the Costa Blanca region in Spain. The town is famous for its stunning natural beauty, rich history and cultural heritage, and modern amenities that cater to the needs of both tourists and residents.
It is a place that inspires above all with its well-preserved medieval architecture. While strolling through the town, you will discover unique buildings and elegant palaces, see the traditional Lonja (trade exchange), the Cultural Centre and the Franciscan monastery. In the centre of the town, there is also the Riberero monument, dedicated to the inhabitants who emigrated to the Ribera Valenciana to harvest rice.
Around Benissa, there are wonderful hiking trails that reveal breathtaking views of the Mediterranean Sea. In addition, amusement parks and many sports facilities are also within easy reach. Culture lovers can enjoy concerts and exhibitions. If you want to experience a typical Spanish fiesta, this place will not disappoint you either. Local festivals are held here in honour of the patron saint Purísima Xiqueta, and in June the Moors and Christians festival is celebrated.
Benissa has four kilometres of coastline with some of the most beautiful bays on the Costa Blanca. The crystal-clear waters are ideal for water sports such as diving, sailing, windsurfing and kayaking.
Playa la Fustera is by far the most famous and popular sandy beach in Benissa. The beach has been awarded the Blue Flag, which aims to promote environmental protection in coastal towns, bathing areas and marinas. The beach is ideal for family holidays: it is very easy to get to, both by car and by bus, and there is parking available, as well as numerous showers and toilets. An additional advantage of the beach is the permanent lifeguard service during the season from 15 June to 15 September and two restaurants.
Another well-known beach in this coastal town is Cala Baladrar. The picturesque bay offers breathtaking views of Calpe and Peñon de Ilfach, while being easily accessible. The water is calm as the beach is sheltered from strong winds. Cala Baladrar is famous for its shallow waters and rich marine life, making it an ideal spot for diving enthusiasts. It is a small Mediterranean paradise with a beach bar open during the season where you can enjoy lunch, a cocktail and live music.
Benissa is the perfect place if you want to escape the hustle and bustle of coastal towns but are still looking for an elegant villa or exclusive apartment near the sea. The views of the Mediterranean Sea in this town speak for themselves and are truly breathtaking.

This property is a unique opportunity to live in a modern, newly built villa in an excellent location, ideal for both permanent residence and as a holiday rental investment.
Location
The charming coastal town of Calpe (officially Calp) is located in the Marina Alta region, northeast of the province of Alicante, and is widely known for the mighty rock formation Peñón de Ifach (or penyal d'Ifac), reaching a height of 327 metres, with long rocky walls and an interesting profile, depending on the point on the coast from which it is viewed. But there is much more to see in and around Calpe, even in winter, as it has a beautiful old town where you can see part of the reconstructed wall.
Among other things, you can visit the remains of a Roman fish farm known as Baños de la Reina, take a walk through the old salt mines in Calpe, now known as Saladar, or go on a hike through the nearby Oltà mountain range.
You will also be delighted by the magnificent beaches that have been awarded the Blue Flag. Calpe boasts some of the most beautiful sandy coastlines in the region, including the iconic Playa de la Fossa and Playa de la Arenal-Bol. Soak up the sun or enjoy water sports and activities that are an integral part of Calpe's coastal landscape.
Calpe's magnificent fishing port is also a must-see. Watch the fishermen bring in their daily catch, visit the fish market and enjoy fresh seafood in the many restaurants along the harbour. To learn about the local culture, visit the Archaeology and Ethnography Museum to delve into Calpe's fascinating history.
Explore the Las Salinas Nature Park, a paradise for migratory birds such as flamingos and storks, or head to the Serra Gelada Nature Park to see its rugged cliffs and enchanting trails. For hiking enthusiasts, the Sierra de Bernia and Sierra de Oltà offer exciting trails and spectacular views. Immerse yourself in the lively atmosphere of Calpe's local markets, where you can discover fresh produce, handicrafts and traditions. Sample the local cuisine, which is renowned for its seafood, rice dishes and spicy tapas.

Location
Torre de la Horadada is a coastal district located in the municipality of Pilar de la Horadada, in the south of the province of Alicante. The resort is located in the south-east of Spain and borders Murcia (about 15 minutes away). Alicante is about a 40-minute drive away.
Pilar de la Horadada has everything you need to enjoy the sea, pine forests and Spanish sun.
The coastline of Pilar de la Hordada is over 4 kilometres long and offers a variety of scenery. There are wide beaches with fine white sand, small stone ledges hanging over the water and small, intimate, hidden coves with golden sand.
The sea is usually calm here, the beaches are safe, and there are no steep slopes, allowing even the smallest children to swim safely. In addition, the clear water and excellent visibility invite divers to observe the beauty of aquatic life.

Not far from the town of Pilar de la Horadada is also an 18-hole golf course in Lo Romero. Both professionals and beginners will find it suitable.

Benissa is a small town located in the province of Alicante. The town has won the hearts of many tourists thanks to its amazing views - the sea and mountains meet each other, making Benissa a unique place in this part of the Iberian Peninsula.

While walking around the town, you will discover unique buildings and elegant palaces, see the traditional Lonja (market hall), the Cultural Centre and the Franciscan monastery.
