Playa la Fustera is by far the most famous and popular sandy beach in Benissa. The beach has been awarded the Blue Flag, which aims to promote environmental protection in coastal towns, bathing areas and marinas. The beach is ideal for family holidays: it is very easy to get to, both by car and by bus, and there is parking available, as well as numerous showers and toilets. An additional advantage of the beach is the permanent lifeguard service during the season from 15 June to 15 September and two restaurants.
Another well-known beach in this coastal town is Cala Baladrar. The picturesque bay offers breathtaking views of Calpe and Peñon de Ilfach, while being easily accessible. The water is calm as the beach is sheltered from strong winds. Cala Baladrar is famous for its shallow waters and rich marine life, making it an ideal spot for diving enthusiasts. It is a small Mediterranean paradise with a beach bar open during the season where you can enjoy lunch, a cocktail and live music.
Benissa is the perfect place if you want to escape the hustle and bustle of coastal towns but are still looking for an elegant villa or exclusive apartment near the sea. The views of the Mediterranean Sea in this town speak for themselves and are truly breathtaking.

Apartment for sale near the sea in Villajoyosa.
Invest in a prime location between the intimate town of Villajoyosa and modern Benidorm!
This is where this new project is located, an exclusive residential complex that combines contemporary design, nature and the sea. Situated on top of a hill, it offers panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea and the tranquillity of a protected environment. Just outside the door is a path leading directly to the beach, allowing you to fully enjoy the Mediterranean lifestyle. Transport links are excellent, with easy access to Alicante, the international airport and the main attractions of the Costa Blanca.
The complex has been designed to blend in with its surroundings, surrounded by extensive green areas and oriented to take advantage of natural light. The buildings, with their modern and elegant lines, are strategically positioned to ensure privacy and sea views from most of the flats. The communal roof terrace becomes a unique meeting place thanks to the social club and infinity pool with unrivalled views.
Apartments and penthouses with 1, 2 and 3 bedrooms, all with private terraces overlooking the sea. Spacious, bright and functional rooms, with high-quality finishes that focus on comfort and aesthetics. The connection between the interior and the exterior is enhanced by large windows that allow you to enjoy the views and sea breeze from inside your home.
The development offers a full range of wellness and leisure services: a communal swimming pool surrounded by green areas, a fully equipped gym, a spa with jacuzzi and sauna, as well as gardens where you can stroll and relax. On the top floor, a social club and swimming pool with sea views create an exclusive and sophisticated atmosphere, conducive to socialising or simply contemplating the horizon.
Location
Villajoyosa is a charming Mediterranean seaside town located between Alicante and Benidorm, about a 30-minute drive from Alicante Airport. Villajoyosa, or La Vila Joiosa, literally means ‘joyful town’. Indeed, it gives that impression with its colourful houses in the town centre. This traditional fishing village is considered one of the most beautiful in the province of Alicante.
Urban legend has it that the buildings were painted in bright colours to help fishermen find their way home. Today, they certainly attract crowds of tourists and are an inspiration for many photographers and artists.
Just take a stroll through the picturesque streets to realise that Villajoyosa is full of joy (as its name suggests) and charm. There are many reasons why this municipality is the perfect place to spend an unforgettable holiday: good weather all year round, idyllic beaches and coves, history and culture everywhere, and an environment that encourages relaxation.
Villajoyosa has been associated with chocolate since the 19th century. It is home to the popular Spanish chocolate factory Valor. The Valor, Pérez and Clavileño museums are must-see attractions. There you will learn everything about the chocolate-making process and its history in the area. Tours led by knowledgeable guides are usually combined with chocolate tasting.
Villajoyosa has 3 km of golden sandy beaches with views of the endless clear sea. The most beautiful ones are Playa El Paraíso, Xarco and La Caleta. Here you will find both larger tourist resorts and hidden, mysterious corners perfect for peaceful relaxation. The coastal panorama, Mediterranean climate and soft, hot sand are ideal for complete relaxation. Near the beaches, you will find regional restaurants and cafés offering fresh Mediterranean delicacies.

Culinary delights are also abundant. The resort boasts a stylish restaurant, where you can enjoy exquisite Spanish cuisine and local wines on the sunny terrace with panoramic views.

The location is also excellent: a short distance from Alicante city center and the airport, and close to the white, sandy beaches of the Costa Blanca. The region enjoys over 300 days of sunshine a year and an average annual temperature of 18°C ​​– ideal for an active and relaxing lifestyle.
Discover countless Blue Flag beaches, natural parks, a rich cultural offering, and vibrant local festivals in the province.
Location
Monforte del Cid is a municipality in the Valencian Community of Spain. It is located in the interior of Alicante province, in the Medio Vinalopó region.
Monforte del Cid in Alicante is the perfect town for those who enjoy playing golf in a natural setting with a mild climate, as well as for those seeking small towns brimming with history, culture, and heritage, along with fantastic museums.
In Monforte del Cid, you can start by walking through the old town, which has preserved its medieval layout and houses from the 16th to 20th centuries, with facades decorated with typical Manises tiles depicting religious scenes.
Highlights include the town hall with its 16th-century arches and coat of arms, the Gothic Church of Our Lady of Nieves, and the San Pascual and San Roque hermitages. You'll definitely love walking and admiring these buildings!
We recommend stopping at the Ibero, the Villa de Monforte del Cid History Museum, where you can admire Iberian-era bull sculptures and even a Roman tombstone. In fact, near Monforte del Cid and Novelda is Finca el Campet, where the remains of a large Roman villa have been discovered.
After exploring the town center, your next stop is Orito, a district of Monforte del Cid that is a pilgrimage site and home to the 16th-century Church and Monastery of San Pascual and the Virgin of Orito, as well as the Cueva de Saint Pascual. You can stroll there and admire the incredible views. A fantastic pilgrimage to this site takes place in May!
For leisure, in addition to excellent golf courses, Monforte del Cid offers the opportunity to participate in the wonderful Moorish and Christian festivals held in December. Be sure to sample the excellent grapes in Vinalopó Designation of Origin bags, aniseed and liqueurs, also protected by the Regulatory Council, as well as pasta and cakes.

After exploring the city center, the next stop is Orito, a district of Monforte del Cid, a pilgrimage site, home to the 16th-century Church and Monastery of San Pascual and the Virgin of Orito, and the Cueva de Saint Pascual. You can stroll there and admire the incredible views. A fantastic pilgrimage to this site takes place in May!
For leisure, in addition to excellent golf courses, Monforte del Cid offers the opportunity to participate in the wonderful Moorish and Christian festivals held in December. Located in the middle of the Vega Baja of the Segura River, between fields of vegetables, cereals and orange trees, San Fulgencio is a town with a completely flat terrain, except for the north, where it is protected by the Sierra del Molar. It is only 2 km from the coast.

WHAT TO SEE
- San Fulgencio Church. A parish church built in the 18th century. Although it retains its Baroque style, it stands out for its austerity and simplicity. Fulgencia.
- Archaeological Museum. Created in 1993, this museum houses a number of objects found in the municipality. It mainly collects Iberian and Greek ceramics.
LOCAL EVENTS
- Celebrations of San Fulgencio and San Antonio Abad. On 16 and 17 January, there are processions in honour of both saints, the blessing of animals and bread, and a traditional fraternal meal for all the town's inhabitants.

- Celebration of Our Lady of Peace. The summer festivities took place on the first weekend of August in the La Marina Urbanisation.

Villa with swimming pool for sale in San Javier.
Your new villa with private swimming pool is located in San Javier, a town distinguished by its proximity to all essential services, such as supermarkets, health centres and schools. The area also offers a wide range of leisure activities, with numerous restaurants, shops and recreational areas. In addition, San Javier is close to several golf courses, ideal for lovers of this sport. The proximity of beaches, only 1.5 km from the Mar Menor and the Mediterranean Sea, is an added attraction, providing access to calm waters and a wide range of water sports.
These elegant villas have 3 bedrooms and 2 or 3 bathrooms, a large garden with a private swimming pool, a terrace on the first floor adjacent to one of the bedrooms and, depending on the model, a solarium on the roof.
All villas are fully finished, with ceramic tile floors with skirting boards, plastered and painted walls, and large sliding windows that provide plenty of natural light. Electric blinds provide greater comfort and security.
The master bedroom on the first floor has a spacious and luxurious custom-made wardrobe. The other bedrooms also have custom-made built-in wardrobes. All bathrooms are fully tiled and ready to move into, equipped with modern furniture, mirrors and glass shower enclosures.
The kitchen is equipped with custom-designed furniture and built-in appliances: a refrigerator, induction hob, oven and microwave in a column, extractor hood and dishwasher.
The LED lighting plan, both internal and external, is fully adapted to the design and layout of the villa.
The private swimming pool is equipped with an outdoor shower. The solarium has a summer kitchen with a sink and tap, as well as sockets for installing a minibar.
Planned completion date from May 2027.
Location
San Javier (Xavier) is located in Murcia in south-eastern Spain. It is located on the northern corner of the Mediterranean coast known as Costa Calida Murcia. San Javier is famous for its golden sandy beaches, warm climate and wide range of tourist attractions, including water sports, restaurants, bars and shops. In addition, the town has a rich history and culture, which is reflected in its historic buildings and monuments, such as the Church of San Francisco Javier and the Town Museum.
Getting there
From Murcia International Airport, you can reach the town of San Javier via the RM 19 motorway (35 km), and the journey takes about 25 minutes by car. From Alicante International Airport, you can reach it via the AR-7 motorway (87 km) - 56 minutes by car.
Beaches
San Javier has dozens of beaches in the area where you can spend your free time. The beaches are mainly located in the Santiago de La Ribera and La Manga del Mar Menor areas, i.e. the Mar Menor spit. One of the beaches of La Manga del Mar Menor is Playa Las Antillas.
Another interesting beach in the area is Playa de Hita, which is quite unusual because it is a protected area recognised as a habitat and breeding ground for many valuable species of migratory birds. Most beaches have good facilities, with the possibility of renting water and beach equipment, as well as taking advantage of the many restaurants and beach bars. Toilets and showers are standard at the beaches. The other beaches in the San Javier area are Playa El Castillico and Banco del Tabal, both of which have been awarded blue flags.
Protected areas
There are many beautiful protected areas in the San Javier area. La Mayor o del Barón and Isla Perdiquera are two islands of volcanic origin, which are also habitats for protected birds.
Other islands that are protected areas are La Isla Grosa and El Islote del Farallón, also of volcanic origin, which are mainly home to Roman gulls, but also other birds. All these places are accessible to tourists, but they are not as popular as standard beaches, so perhaps this is a good idea for spending your holiday in San Javier?
Isla Grosa is the perfect place for scuba divers, who come here from all over Spain.

Apartment for sale near the beach in Vera.
The development is located in Vera Playa (Almería), in an exclusive, luxury complex surrounded by green areas and amenities, parks and sports facilities, just a 20-minute walk or 2 km from the beach.
The residential complex consists of 60 flats and 18 bungalows in phase 1.
The flats have 2 or 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, distributed in 5 modern blocks equipped with 2 communal swimming pools and an additional heated indoor pool.
Each property has an underground parking space and a storage room. All floors have spacious terraces, and the apartments on the top floor have a private solarium with impressive sea views, ideal for enjoying the sun all year round.
The bungalows also offer 2 or 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, a parking space and storage room in the communal garage, as well as a communal swimming pool. The ground floor flats have a terrace, while those on the first floor have a solarium and summer kitchen, ensuring maximum comfort in a prime location.
All homes have been designed in a contemporary style and based on the concept of open spaces, combining a fully equipped kitchen and living room with a dining area.
Planned completion date: mid-2027
Location
Vera, located on the Mediterranean coast of Almeria and 92 km from Almeria, has everything to become your dream summer holiday destination or a place to live all year round. It is a family-friendly place where you can get away from the routine and discover all the possibilities the municipality has to offer for an unforgettable summer full of unique and unforgettable experiences.
A paradise with five kilometres of beaches
Those looking for a holiday to relax, sunbathe and swim at the beach have a variety of areas with fine sand and crystal-clear water at their disposal. This year, Vera is also celebrating the renewal of the Q for Quality award for Las Marinas-Bolaga beach, a large area covering 1,350 square metres with an average width of 200 metres, along which there is an attractive promenade; as well as the Blue Flag for El Playazo, a beach known worldwide for offering a large area for naturism. They are joined by the beaches of Puerto Rey and Cala Marqués. All of them offer the possibility of having a drink in bars, beach bars or exclusive beach clubs.
Nature, leisure and outdoor sports
Vera is also a place that offers the opportunity to enjoy nature in its surroundings, and in particular to get to know the ecosystem of two wetlands, Salar de los Canos, next to El Playazo, which covers more than 57 hectares and is a refuge and feeding lagoon especially for water birds; and the Puerto Rey lagoon, next to the beach of the same name, where many birds migrating between Africa and Europe rest and nest.
In addition to enjoying nature, Vera offers many opportunities for various outdoor sports, from golf, on a course where you can even play croquet, to water activities such as windsurfing, paddle surfing, kitesurfing, kayaking, catamaran sailing or sailing, to rugby, beach volleyball and tennis, among others, hiking.
Heritage, culture and gastronomy
This Mediterranean municipality has more than two millennia of history, and one of the remnants of its heritage is the Cerro del Espíritu Santo (CES), the ancient Nasrid city of Barya, declared a cultural asset. Other characteristic places that are also worth visiting are the Plaza Mayor of Vera, where the unique church of Nuestra Señora de la Encarnación, with its Mudejar-Andalusian structure, is located; the Fuente de los Cuatro Caños, of Arab origin; or the Plaza de Toros, considered the oldest bullring in Almería.
The history of the municipality is also reflected in its gastronomy, through aromas, colours and flavours that reveal the Hispano-Arabic heritage of Al-Andalus, which still survives in spices, dishes and the most avant-garde recipes, such as ajo colorado or gurullos with rabbit.
A family trip to remember
Fun on the beach, practising all kinds of sports, spending the day at the water park, enjoying local products and, in short, enjoying special moments with the family in a pleasant climate, Vera is what makes the municipality a destination for travelling with children, not only in summer but also at any time of the year.
Vera has been awarded the Family Tourism Seal by the National Federation of Large Families, a distinction that honours the most child-friendly destinations for leisure, services and the ideal tourist offer for family holidays.
A place to stay and live
In addition to all the possibilities that Vera offers for spending a few days that will remain in your memory forever, it also offers a quality of life that encourages you to stay and live there. This option is already appreciated by many people who spend long periods of time or stay to live there thanks to the advantages offered by teleworking and the comforts of the destination.
The municipality is also one of those with the highest per capita income in the province and shares with the capital of Almeria a good climate, landscapes and services that have distinguished the city of Almeria as the happiest in Spain, according to the Spain Happy Index 2024 survey.
Added to all this is the good nature of the local population, whose human value makes tourists feel welcome, thus contributing to the fact that the stories they experience in Vera will remain in their memory forever.

Location
Águilas is a beautiful port city located on the Costa Cálida. It is 35 km from Lorca, 105 km from Murcia and 75 km from Cartagena. It is about a 2-hour drive from Alicante International Airport.
Its seafaring tradition is now combined with a wide range of tourist attractions, one of the main ones being its extensive coastline.
The town of Águilas has 28 kilometres of coastline with 35 beaches of different types of sand and thickness, located in different landscapes, from coves and unspoilt beaches in a natural environment to the urban beaches of the town of Águilas. The warm desert climate is present throughout the year with an average annual temperature of 22°, with mild temperatures in winter and very hot in summer.
Águilas is surrounded by the Sierra de la Carrasquilla, Lomo de Bas and Sierra de la Almenara mountain ranges, which are linked by a network of trails that converge in the Cabo Cope and Puntas de Calnegre nature parks. It is an ideal place for diving, water sports, hiking and golf.
In the centre of Águilas, it is worth visiting the beautiful gardens with centuries-old ficus trees in the Plaza de España, the town hall (19th century) and the parish church of San José, which houses a painting of the patron saint from the Salzillo school. At the top of the old quarter, on a promontory, stands the castle-fortress of San Juan de Águilas, built in 1579 for defensive purposes. At its foot is the port and the characteristic lighthouse, in operation since the mid-19th century, with black and white stripes.
Depending on the date you choose to visit, you can enjoy unique celebrations such as the Águilas Carnival, recognised as an event of international tourist interest. It usually takes place during the carnival season (February). You will be able to experience several days full of colour, joy, music, dance and fantasy.
With its varied Mediterranean cuisine based on seafood and garden produce, Águilas is the place for those palates that want to enjoy high-quality products. Among its standard products are red prawns, sea bream, sea bass, sea bream, tomatoes and capers.

Location
Dolores is a small town in the province of Vega Baja, in its southern part, about 50 kilometers from Alicante. We can easily get here by the AP7 motorway, and by the road leading from Elche if traveling by plane, from the international airport of Alicante, which is only 25 minutes from Dolores.
Certainly, the great advantage of the town of Dolores are open and hospitable inhabitants, high quality of life, pleasant and healthy climate as well as close proximity to the sea (about 10 kilometers). All this makes this area at the top of the quality of life of the Mediterranean style.

golf courses

Monuments
The Church of the Archduke Dolores is one of the greatest architectural icons of the 18th century with great purity of style and excellent quality. Paintings showing the local Saint Nuestra Senora de los Dolores (the most beautiful sculpture ever created by Salzillo) and Saint San Pascual Bailón together with frescoes further show the majesty of this temple. The city promenade is a place showing a bronze bust, a tribute to the founder of the city - Cardinal Luis Belluga y Moncada.
Kitchen
Dolores' traditional cuisine is always a big surprise for visitors, an explosion of intense flavors that alludes to complex dishes featuring classic local produce. We will especially highlight here artichokes, which are the main ingredient, homemade sausages and salted fish, as well as very sophisticated desserts created using traditional recipes. The proximity of the Mediterranean coast allows you to taste many fish and seafood: sea bream, grouper, shrimps and sardines. We can try gray berweons and eels in the El Hondo nature reserve.

Algorfa, located in the Vega Baja del Segura region, has a rich history dating back to Roman times. The town's name comes from the Arabic word “Al-Gorfa”, meaning “cave”, as the area was known for its numerous natural caves. Today, Algorfa is known for its production of citrus fruits and vegetables.
Algorfa is home to many attractions that will appeal to visitors of all ages. Here are just a few of the highlights:
La Finca Golf Course
If you are a golf enthusiast, La Finca Golf Course is a must-visit. This championship golf course is set in beautiful natural surroundings, with stunning views of the Vega Baja countryside. The course is designed to challenge golfers of all levels, and there are plenty of amenities, including a pro shop and restaurant.
Algorfa Market
To get a taste of the local culture, be sure to visit the Algorfa Market, which takes place every Wednesday. Here you will find a wide selection of goods, including fresh local produce, clothing and souvenirs. It's the perfect place to buy a unique gift or sample the delicious local cuisine.
Plaza de España
Plaza de España is the main square in Algorf, which is a great place to soak up the local atmosphere. Here you will find a beautiful fountain, plenty of seating and many restaurants and bars. It is the perfect place to relax with a drink and admire the local culture.

Apartment for sale near the beach in Pulpí, Costa de Almería
Elite World Estates presents a new residential development located next to the spectacular Mundo Aguilón Golf course in Pulpí, Almería province, in a unique location between the sea and the mountains, which encourages relaxation and an active lifestyle all year round.
This modern complex consists of 54 flats with 1, 2 and 3 bedrooms, all with a parking space and storage room. The flats have been designed in a contemporary and functional style and feature spacious terraces overlooking the golf course and the sea, ideal for enjoying the Mediterranean climate and natural surroundings.
The development offers complete communal areas designed for the well-being and enjoyment of the whole family, including a communal swimming pool, ideal for sunny days on the Levante coast of Almeria, and a space for a gym to keep fit without leaving home.
Surrounded by a consolidated environment of nature, sport and tranquillity, this new project is located in a unique location on the Almeria coast. Nearby are some of the best unspoilt beaches in the Mediterranean, and for golf lovers, the prestigious Mundo Aguilón Golf, considered one of the most attractive golf courses in the region due to its design integrated into the mountainous landscape.
The flats in this new development have been designed using modern materials, bright spaces and an optimal layout, ideal both as a main residence and as a second home or holiday rental investment.
Location
Pulpí, the first coastal town in Andalusia, located on the border between Murcia and Almería, is one of the most picturesque and idyllic landscapes in Spain and offers many different reasons to visit. The municipality, located in the north-eastern part of the province, has three clearly differentiated areas within its territory: the coastal area, the inland basin and the small chain of mountain ranges separating them.
Pulpí Geode
In addition to its spectacular beaches and coves, there is a real natural gem here, which since its opening to the public in 2019 has become a tourist attraction: the Geode. Located in Mina Rica, in Pilar de Jaravía, it is a giant geode approximately eight metres long and two metres high. It is the second largest in the world after the Chihuahua Crystal Cave in Mexico and the largest of the geodes that can be visited.
Other places to visit
There is much more to visit in Pulpí. The town of Pulpí is home to the Church of San Miguel, the second oldest building in the municipality, dating from 1801, and also the tallest, with a spectacular altar. Also noteworthy are the Benzal Picnic and Ethnographic Area and the Apartadero Viewpoint.
Also worth visiting are the Scenic Space with the Pintor Pedro Antonio Martínez Room, which houses a collection of paintings by the influential Pulpileño painter, and the Black Room, the largest of its kind in Europe, which houses a spectacular collection of 1,000 luminescent minerals.
Beaches
Almería also boasts a catalogue of spectacular beaches and coves. The 13 beaches in Pulpí run along the coastline from north to south: Los Cocedores Beach, Las Palmeras Beach, La Carolina Beach, Invencible Cove, Costa Tranquila Cove, Cuartel Cove, Tía Antonia Cove, Rincón de los Nudos Cove, Mar Rabiosa Beach, Mar Serena Beach, Calypso Beach, La Entrevista Beach and Los Nardos Beach. Four of the five beaches located further south are Blue Flag beaches due to the quality of their services and their crystal-clear waters, which are excellent at all of them. These are Mar Serena, Mar Rabiosa, Calypso and Los Nardos.

Apartment with sea views for sale in Águilas.
Imagine the perfect place on earth, where you wake up every morning in an oasis of comfort and convenience, in your new luxury apartment with 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, where all your daily needs are at your fingertips. This unrivalled project is being built in a prime location, just 800 metres from the beach and close to all the necessary amenities!
Discover with us this new development located in picturesque Águilas, Murcia, which offers magnificent views and excellent contact with nature, while at the same time providing easy access to key amenities.
This exclusive offer includes 36 two- and three-bedroom apartments spread over four modern blocks, equipped with two communal swimming pools and a communal basement with parking spaces and storage rooms.
In addition, the development offers 10 elegant villas with 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, each with a private swimming pool and almost all with direct access to the garage.
This picturesque project has been designed with excellence in mind, offering spacious terraces on the ground and first floors and a solarium on the upper floors, where the views are mesmerising.
The excellent location, just 800 metres from the sea and right next to a shopping centre, will make your holiday here extremely easy.
The flats have fully equipped kitchens and bathrooms and ducted air conditioning.
The development is located in Águilas (Murcia), in an exclusive and luxurious complex close to green areas, surrounded by amenities, parks, sports facilities, and close to the beach and several golf courses.
Do not miss the opportunity to live in this unique place right by the sea!
Planned completion date: December 2026
Location
Águilas is a beautiful port city located on the Costa Cálida. It is 35 km from Lorca, 105 km from Murcia and 75 km from Cartagena. It is about a 2-hour drive from Alicante International Airport.
Its seafaring tradition is now combined with a wide range of tourist attractions, one of the main ones being its extensive coastline.
The town of Águilas has 28 kilometres of coastline with 35 beaches of different types of sand and thickness, located in different landscapes, from coves and unspoilt beaches in a natural environment to the urban beaches of the town of Águilas. The warm desert climate is present throughout the year with an average annual temperature of 22°, with mild temperatures in winter and very hot in summer.
Águilas is surrounded by the Sierra de la Carrasquilla, Lomo de Bas and Sierra de la Almenara mountain ranges, which are linked by a network of trails that converge in the Cabo Cope and Puntas de Calnegre nature parks. It is an ideal place for diving, water sports, hiking and golf.
In the centre of Águilas, it is worth visiting the beautiful gardens with centuries-old ficus trees in the Plaza de España, the town hall (19th century) and the parish church of San José, which houses a painting of the patron saint from the Salzillo school. At the top of the old quarter, on a promontory, stands the castle-fortress of San Juan de Águilas, built in 1579 for defensive purposes. At its foot is the port and the characteristic lighthouse, in operation since the mid-19th century, with black and white stripes.
Depending on the date you choose to visit, you can enjoy unique celebrations such as the Águilas Carnival, recognised as an event of international tourist interest. It usually takes place during the carnival season (February). You will be able to experience several days full of colour, joy, music, dance and fantasy.
With its varied Mediterranean cuisine based on seafood and garden produce, Águilas is the place for those palates that want to enjoy high-quality products. Among its standard products are red prawns, sea bream, sea bass, sea bream, tomatoes and capers.

properties.title: Exclusive apartment with sea views in Benidorm
properties.summary: New build apartment for sale in Benidorm, Alicante: 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 110 m² built. €699,000.
properties.description:
Luxury flat for sale 150 metres from the beach in Benidorm.
Elite World Estates is proud to present a spectacular new project with fantastic views of the Mediterranean Sea, located in the centre of the popular city of Benidorm.
The Spanish ‘Manhattan’, Benidorm, will once again break its boundaries by striving to create the tallest residential skyscraper in Europe, with 64 floors and a height of 230 metres!
We present the new design for the tallest skyscraper in Spain, which will accommodate 260 flats and will be completed by the end of 2028.
The new building will surpass its neighbouring building in Benidorm, Intempo, which is 204 metres high, and will be second only to a few skyscrapers in Moscow on the old continent.
In addition to 260 flats, this exclusive building will have over 10,000 m2 of communal areas, including heated swimming pools, a gym, a cinema room, sports facilities and a sky bar on the 63rd floor with an astronomical observatory, created in collaboration with the Jesús Carnicer Museum of Science and Technology (MUDIC).
This new real estate colossus rises just 150 metres from Poniente Beach in Benidorm, the best location in the whole of southern Spain.
The development offers 1, 2, 3 and 4-bedroom properties of various types and standards, tailored to individual needs and lifestyles. This magnificent building not only breaks height records, but also redefines the concept of comfort in luxury urban living.
This unique residence will offer an exceptional set of amenities that will make every day an extraordinary experience. The tower will not only be a place to live, but a space carefully designed to ensure the well-being and enjoyment of its residents in every room.
The architectural design was developed by two renowned studios and "is inspired by the organic form of sea coral, paying homage to the Mediterranean Sea and the international character of Benidorm.
In technical terms, the building will have a high-rigidity reinforced concrete structure, approved after wind tunnel testing at the Madrid Polytechnic University, guaranteeing safety and comfort. It will also be equipped with ‘seven ultra-fast lifts, reaching a speed of 6 metres per second, offering residents an experience characteristic of large metropolises’.
Planned completion date: end of 2028
Location
Benidorm is a city located on the east coast of Spain and is one of the most popular holiday destinations in the entire country. Known for its magnificent beaches, clear waters and lively nightlife, Benidorm attracts millions of tourists every year. Benidorm has the highest number of skyscrapers in Spain and is often referred to as the second New York. Whether you are looking for a place to relax or have fun, Benidorm has something to offer everyone.
El Balcón del Mediterráneo
Benidorm also has a particularly romantic side. We are talking about El Balcón del Mediterráneo, a viewpoint that captivates not only with its appearance but also with its location. Built on rocks, the castle separates two beaches, and its terrace offers an amazing view of the entire bay. In the past, this location was of strategic importance, allowing for the observation of potential threats on the horizon and the rapid organisation of defensive units. Today, El Balcón del Mediterráneo is one of the most popular tourist attractions in Benidorm and probably the most photographed place in this part of the Iberian Peninsula.
Beaches
Playa de Levante is one of Benidorm's two main beaches and is considered one of the best in the country. This vast beach with golden sand is ideal for sunbathing, swimming and basking in the Mediterranean sun. Along the promenade, you will also find many restaurants, bars and shops.
Playa de Poniente is Benidorm's largest beach: 3,000 metres of white, sandy shore, which is over 100 metres wide in some sections! Located south of the centre and awarded the Blue Flag, it is less crowded than Playa de Levante (the resort's other large beach) and is a favourite spot for locals. Playa de Poniente offers all amenities: parasols and sun loungers (available 11 months a year), free showers and toilets, children's playgrounds, lifeguard service, easy access for disabled people, and even a public library located directly on the beach.
Isla de Benidorm
As soon as you arrive in Benidorm and step onto the sandy beach, you will see an island rising out of the sea a few kilometres from the beach (exactly two nautical miles from the port of Benidorm). This is an island called Isla de Benidorm. The Spanish use another name for this island, Isla de los Periodistas. No one lives on the island, it has no permanent residents, but you can buy a trip to the island from Benidorm, where you can enjoy a seafood meal in a restaurant.

Apartment for sale in Torrevieja.
In the heart of the charming town of Orihuela Costa, a new residential complex is being built, which, like no other, focuses on the comfort, privacy and safety of its future residents. This modern residential complex will consist of fully furnished, modern flats, each with large terraces.
The development is being built in a privileged natural environment, very close to the Lagunas de La Mata and Laguna Rosa de Torrevieja Nature Reserve, as well as the Lo Albentosa natural area, ideal for cycling and hiking. A 10-minute drive separates you from your new home to the beautiful La Mata beach with the Molino del Agua park and Cabo Cervera beach. Be one of the first to visit this unique project with us and reserve your dream flat in sunny Spain.
Discover with us this exclusive residential development in Torrevieja, designed for maximum comfort, functionality and security. All flats comply with current building regulations and have been built with high-quality materials and finishes.
Features of the flats
Solid construction: Reinforced concrete foundations and structure with thermal and acoustic insulation.
Modern façade: External brick wall with thermal and acoustic insulation. Finished with single-layer cladding combined with natural stone details.
Exterior carpentry: PVC windows with Climalit double glazing, electric roller blinds with remote control.
Entrance doors: Advanced security features.
Interiors designed with your comfort in mind
Brick partition walls and white lacquered doors.
Built-in wardrobes fully lined and equipped.
Bathrooms with top-quality ceramic tiles, wall-mounted sanitary ware, shower cubicles, washbasin cabinets and mirrors.
Porcelain or stoneware floors and walls painted with smooth paint.
Kitchen equipped with upper and lower cabinets, Silestone or similar worktop and stainless steel under-counter sink.
Ducted air conditioning installed.
Electrical, plumbing, television, ADSL and fibre optic installations compliant with standards.
The development will feature impressive communal areas designed for leisure and enjoyment:
Communal swimming pools with a children's area.
Gardens with natural lawns and palm trees.
Playground, paddle tennis court, petanque area and barbecue area.
Underground car park with vehicle access.
Lifts adapted for people with reduced mobility.
Planned completion date: March 2027
Location
Torrevieja is a Spanish town located 40 km from Alicante, famous for its pink lake. The pink lake is part of the Las Lagunas de La Mata y Torrevieja Natural Park, where, in addition to its unusual colour, the flamingos that live there are protected. The lake is the largest in Europe and one of the few of its kind in the world, and owes its colour to the crustaceans that live there, which also make the flamingos pink.
The city is located on the Costa Blanca, in the province of Alicante, and is very well connected to the rest of the country.
One of the reasons why it is worth living or holidaying in Torrevieja is the modernity of this city. This is mainly because it is a city in the process of development, due to its location and the large number of people who visit and live there. It is therefore a modern city, equipped with everything necessary to welcome tourists and residents. What is more, multiculturalism reigns here, and you can hear different languages spoken on the streets.
Torrevieja is also famous for its beautiful beaches, where golden sand meets crystal clear water. Some of the best beaches in the area are La Mata Beach, Playa del Cura and Los Locos Beach. The beautiful promenades along these beaches are ideal for leisurely walks, full of charming cafés, restaurants and shops.
Golf enthusiasts will be delighted by the abundance of exceptional golf courses in the area. Some of the best golf courses near Torrevieja include Las Colinas Golf & Country Club, Villamartin Golf Club, and La Marquesa Golf. Enjoy challenging water courses, picturesque landscapes, and world-class facilities while indulging in your favourite pastime.
When it comes to dining, Torrevieja offers a diverse culinary scene. Discover a wide range of restaurants, from traditional Spanish tapas bars to international cuisine, catering to every palate and preference. Be sure to sample the fresh seafood, a local speciality that is not to be missed.
For shopping enthusiasts, the Habaneras and Ozone Leisure Centre shopping centres are popular. These modern complexes feature a variety of shops, boutiques and entertainment venues, providing a wonderful shopping experience.
Torrevieja also boasts a lively nightlife, with numerous bars, clubs and live music venues. Whether you are looking for a relaxing evening with friends or an exciting night of dancing, Torrevieja's nightlife has something for everyone.

properties.description:
Villa for sale near the sea in Pulpí, Costa de Almería.
Elite World Estates presents an exclusive development of new-build homes located in San Juan de los Terreros, Almería, just 300 metres from the beach. A place where light, space and tranquillity come together to offer a unique living experience on the coast of Almería.
Located in the privileged area of San Juan de los Terreros, it offers everything you need for a comfortable and fulfilling life: local amenities, recreational areas, schools, health centre, supermarkets, local shops and a nearby golf course, creating an ideal environment for both families and those looking for a high-quality second home.
The development consists of a total of 18 carefully designed homes:
•10 villas with 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms
•8 bungalows with 2 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms
Each property has spacious outdoor areas, terraces and leisure areas, ensuring open and sunny spaces. The communal swimming pool with integrated jacuzzi becomes the centre of the community's social life, while the bungalows on the upper floors have a private jacuzzi for enjoying moments of relaxation in complete privacy.
Each residence has a private garage, and many of them have direct access from the property. The interiors stand out for their elegant and functional design, with fully equipped kitchens with high-end appliances and bathrooms with underfloor heating, ensuring comfort throughout the year.
Expected completion date: December 2026
Location
Pulpí, the first coastal town in Andalusia, located on the border between Murcia and Almería, is one of the most picturesque and idyllic landscapes in Spain and offers many and varied reasons to visit. The municipality, located in the north-east of the province, has three clearly differentiated areas within its territory: the coastal area, the inland basin and the small mountain range that separates them.
Pulpí Geode
In addition to its spectacular beaches and coves, there is a real natural gem that, since its opening to the public in 2019, has become a tourist attraction: the Geode. Located in Mina Rica, in Pilar de Jaravía, it is a gigantic geode about eight metres long and two metres high. It is the second largest in the world after the Crystal Cave in Chihuahua, Mexico, and the largest of the geodes that can be visited.
Other places to visit
There is much more to visit in Pulpí. In the town of Pulpí, the church of San Miguel stands out. It is the second oldest building in the municipality, dating back to 1801, and also the tallest, with a spectacular altar. The Benzal Recreational and Ethnographic Area and the Apartadero Viewpoint are also worth a visit.
Also worth visiting is the Espacio Escénico, with the Pintor Pedro Antonio Martínez room, which houses a collection of paintings by the influential Pulpí painter, and the Sala Negra, the largest of its kind in Europe, which houses a spectacular collection of 1,000 luminescent minerals.
Beaches
Almería also has a catalogue of spectacular beaches and coves. The 13 beaches of Pulpí stretch along the coast from north to south: Los Cocedores beach, Las Palmeras beach, La Carolina beach, Invencible cove, Costa Tranquila cove, Cuartel cove, Tía Antonia cove, Rincón de los Nudos cove, Mar Rabiosa beach, Mar Serena beach, Calypso beach, La Entrevista beach and Los Nardos beach. Four of the five southernmost beaches have been awarded blue flags for the quality of their services and their crystal-clear waters, which are excellent at all of them. These are Mar Serena, Mar Rabiosa, Calypso and Los Nardos.

properties.title: Elegant villa with private pool near the golf course in Los Alcázares
properties.area: Las Lomas de Rame - Bahía Bella
properties.summary: New build villa for sale in Los Alcázares, Murcia: 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 140 m² built, 354 m² plot. €689,900.
properties.description:
Villa with private pool for sale in La Serena Golf.
We are pleased to present a new villa project with a very elegant design, located within the La Serena Golf Resort in Los Alcázares.
The villas are laid out on one level and have a private roof terrace with ample space for sun loungers, a barbecue, a jacuzzi and, of course, beautiful views of the surrounding area. There is also the possibility of having a villa arranged on two levels, if desired, as the developer is flexible and can provide different villa models.
The villa has an open-plan living room, kitchen and dining room, three spacious bedrooms with fitted wardrobes and two or three bathrooms, depending on the type of villa chosen.
The villas are equipped with white goods, external and internal LED lighting, shower cubicles in the bathroom, ducted air conditioning and a private swimming pool.
The development is located on the La Serena golf course, a few minutes from the centre of the charming Spanish town of Los Alcázares and its beaches, where you can find all the necessary amenities, such as restaurants, pharmacies, supermarkets, shops and banks. Within a few minutes' drive, you can reach the Dos Mares shopping centre or the magnificent city of Cartagena.
Location
Los Alcázares is located in the Murcia region of Spain. The town tempts visitors with its seaside charm and a host of delightful attractions. Located along the magnificent Mar Menor, a saltwater lagoon famous for its crystal clear waters and healing properties, Los Alcázares offers an idyllic setting for an unforgettable holiday or a peaceful retreat.
The area is connected by motorway to Cartagena, Murcia and Alicante, as well as the other beaches of the Costa Cálida and Costa Blanca.
One of the town's greatest assets is its collection of beautiful beaches, each promising moments of bliss and relaxation. Golden sands stretch along the tranquil shores of the Mar Menor, creating a paradise for sun seekers and water lovers. From the lively and family-friendly Playa de Los Narejos to the more secluded and peaceful Playa de Las Salinas, there is a beach for everyone. Visitors can sunbathe, swim or enjoy a variety of water sports, including sailing, kayaking and windsurfing. The shallow and calm waters of the Mar Menor make it an ideal destination for families with children.
Los Alcázares boasts a vibrant culinary scene, offering a diverse range of restaurants, bars and cafés to tempt your taste buds. From traditional Spanish tapas to international cuisine, the town's restaurants cater to every palate. Sample fresh seafood made with local ingredients, savour authentic paella or enjoy a refreshing drink at a beachside chiringuito while taking in the stunning views. The warm and welcoming atmosphere of the town's eateries enhances the overall dining experience, making it a real treat for food lovers.
In addition to beaches and eateries, Los Alcázares offers many attractions to keep visitors entertained. Explore the charming streets of the town centre, dotted with shops, boutiques and craft stores. Discover local handicrafts, souvenirs and unique treasures to commemorate your visit. For the adventurous, a variety of water sports centres offer opportunities for water skiing, paddleboarding and diving, allowing you to immerse yourself in the underwater wonders of the Mar Menor.
Golf enthusiasts will find themselves in paradise, as Los Alcázares is surrounded by a selection of world-class golf courses. Within a short distance, you will discover famous golf courses such as La Serena Golf, Roda Golf and Mar Menor Golf Resort. Immerse yourself in lush green fairways, perfect your swing and enjoy the Mediterranean climate that allows you to play golf all year round.

properties.title: Excellent, ready-to-move-in flat with sea views in Finestrat
properties.summary: New build apartment for sale in Finestrat, Alicante: 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 208 m² built, pool, sea views. €550,000.
properties.description:
Magnificent sea view apartment for sale in Finestrat.
Introducing a brand new residential complex that offers mesmerizing sea views, located in the heart of the Costa Blanca, Finestrat. It is an ideal location for people who appreciate the proximity of both nature and extensive infrastructure.
The residential complex faces south and offers breathtaking views of Benidorm and the Mediterranean Sea. The low-rise buildings have cascading terraces, thanks to which the apartments resemble penthouses. Attention is drawn to the beautiful vegetation of the common areas, integrated into the stone facades and blooming Buganvillas, characteristic of the Mediterranean climate. The complex offers a large outdoor infinity pool, a heated indoor pool, a Finnish sauna, a gym and paddle tennis courts. In addition, a coworking space for remote work is available in a separate area.
We can choose from three models of apartments with 2 bedrooms, 2 or 3 bathrooms, including two two-level apartments with a garden or solarium and one single-level apartment with spacious terraces. All apartments have been designed with high quality materials, with underfloor heating in the bathrooms and bright kitchens. Spacious and bright interiors with a home automation system provide a comfortable and modern apartment. Each apartment comes with a private parking lot and a storage room.
Residents have access to Benidorm's developed infrastructure, including hospitals, clinics, nurseries, kindergartens and schools. The city is surrounded by attractive places to spend free time, such as restaurants, discos, shopping centers. For those who prefer an active lifestyle, the area offers several amusement parks, including Aqua Natura, Terra Mítica, Terra Natura, Aqualandia and Mundomar, as well as Sierra Cortina and Villaitana golf courses.
Location
Finestrat is a charming and picturesque town located in the province of Alicante, in the Valencian Community of Spain. It is just 8 km from the popular, large city of Benidorm and 40 km from Alicante and its international airport. Known for its stunning mountain views, pristine beaches and rich cultural heritage, Finestrat is the perfect destination for anyone looking for a relaxing and memorable experience. There is no shortage of exciting things to do in Finestrat.
Finestrat is located on the slopes of the Puig Campana mountain, offering stunning views of the mountains, coast and Mediterranean Sea. The town has a typical Moorish feel, with colorfully painted houses and narrow cobbled streets. On the other hand, Cala Finestrat is becoming more and more popular, and its development has made it almost an extension of Benidorm itself.
inch Finestrat
Cala Finestrat is a seaside resort just three kilometers from busy Benidorm. The resort offers adequate facilities, a large selection of restaurants, bars and shops. Everything you need is available in Benidorm, which is easily accessible by bus and taxi.
La Cala beach is quite quiet, as most people who want a more upbeat atmosphere head to the beaches surrounding Benidorm. The beach is a clean strip of golden sand, ideal for children and safe for swimming. There are several lovely restaurants along the promenade and there is an arts and crafts market in the afternoon during the summer months.
The place is suitable for families and couples looking for a relaxing beach resort, yet close to many attractions and amenities.
Nearby are the theme parks of Terre Mitica and Terra Natura, the Aqualandia water park and the Mundomar marine and exotic animal park, offering fun for the whole family.
And if you prefer to spend your holiday golfing one or two rounds, Finestrat will be pleased with the nearby Real Faula Golf Club, which offers two excellent golf courses.
Both Finestrat and Cala Finestrat are quiet destinations compared to some of the neighboring resorts. Both offer a selection of local bars and restaurants where you can enjoy good food and a relaxed atmosphere.

The location of your new investment is one of the best in Benidorm, with all services at your fingertips. You will have access to a wide selection of international restaurants, shops, bars and a sandy beach. The area is also easily accessible from Alicante Airport, which is just 30 minutes by car. Don't wait any longer and enjoy the Mediterranean life!
Location
Benidorm is a city located on the east coast of Spain and is one of the most popular holiday destinations in the entire country. Known for its stunning beaches, clear waters and vibrant nightlife, Benidorm attracts millions of tourists every year. Benidorm is the city with the most skyscrapers in Spain and is often called the second New York. Whether you're looking for a place to relax or have fun, Benidorm has something to offer everyone.
El Balcón del Mediterráneo
Benidorm also has a particularly romantic side. We are talking about El Balcón del Mediterráneo, a viewpoint that captivates not only with its appearance, but also with its location. The castle built on the rocks separates the two beaches, and its terrace offers an amazing view of the entire bay. This location once had strategic importance - it allowed for the observation of possible threats appearing on the horizon and the rapid organization of defense units. Today, El Balcón del Mediterráneo is one of the most popular tourist attractions in Benidorm and probably the most photographed place in this part of the Iberian Peninsula.
Beaches
Playa de Levante is one of Benidorm's two main beaches and is considered one of the best in the country. This vast beach of golden sand is perfect for sunbathing, swimming and soaking up the Mediterranean sun. You will also find many restaurants, bars and shops along the promenade.
Playa de Poniente is the largest beach in Benidorm: 3,000 meters of white sandy shore, which in some sections is over 100 meters wide! Located south of the center and awarded the Blue Flag, it is less crowded than Playa de Levante (the resort's other large beach) and is a favorite among locals. Playa de Poniente offers all services: umbrellas and deckchairs (available 11 months a year), free showers and toilets, playgrounds for children, lifeguards, easier access for disabled people, and even a public library, located directly on the beach.
Isla de Benidorm
As soon as you arrive in Benidorm and step onto the sandy beach, you will see an islet sticking out of the sea a few kilometers from the beach (exactly two nautical miles from the port of Benidorm). This is an island called Isla de Benidorm. The Spanish use another name for this island, Isla de los Periodistas. There are no people living on the island, it has no permanent inhabitants, although from Benidorm you can buy a trip to the islet, where you can eat a seafood meal in a restaurant.

The picturesque town of Los Alcázares, located in the charming region of Murcia in Spain, tempts with its seaside charm and a multitude of delightful attractions. Situated along the magnificent Mar Menor, a saltwater lagoon renowned for its crystal clear waters and healing properties, Los Alcázares offers an idyllic setting for an unforgettable holiday or a peaceful retreat.
The area is connected by motorway to Cartagena, Murcia and Alicante, as well as the other beaches of the Costa Cálida and Costa Blanca.
One of the town's greatest assets is its collection of beautiful beaches, each promising moments of bliss and relaxation. Golden sands stretch along the tranquil shores of the Mar Menor, creating a paradise for sun seekers and water lovers. From the lively and family-friendly Playa de Los Narejos to the more secluded and peaceful Playa de Las Salinas, there is a beach for everyone. Visitors can sunbathe, swim or enjoy a variety of water sports, including sailing, kayaking and windsurfing. The shallow and calm waters of the Mar Menor make it an ideal destination for families with children.
Los Alcázares boasts a vibrant culinary scene, offering a diverse range of restaurants, bars and cafés to tempt your taste buds. From traditional Spanish tapas to international cuisine, the town's restaurants cater to every palate. Sample fresh seafood made with local ingredients, savour authentic paella or enjoy a refreshing drink at a beachside chiringuito while taking in the stunning views. The warm and welcoming atmosphere of the town's eateries enhances the overall dining experience, making it a real treat for food lovers.
In addition to beaches and eateries, Los Alcázares offers many attractions to keep visitors entertained. Explore the charming streets of the town centre, dotted with shops, boutiques and craft stores. Discover local handicrafts, souvenirs and unique treasures to commemorate your visit. For the adventurous, a variety of water sports centres offer opportunities for water skiing, paddleboarding and diving, allowing you to immerse yourself in the underwater wonders of the Mar Menor.
Golf enthusiasts will find themselves in paradise, as Los Alcázares is surrounded by a selection of world-class golf courses. Within a short distance, you will discover famous golf courses such as La Serena Golf, Roda Golf and Mar Menor Golf Resort. Immerse yourself in lush green fairways, perfect your swing and enjoy the Mediterranean climate that allows you to play golf all year round.
To learn about history and culture, we highly recommend a visit to the nearby city of Cartagena. Explore ancient Roman ruins, wander through charming streets lined with colourful buildings, and immerse yourself in the rich history of this historic port city.

The swimming pool and children's area have pleasant outdoor surroundings that complement the infrastructure.
The apartments have very high-quality finishes and wooden carpentry elements in the wardrobes and doors. The kitchen is fully furnished but does not include appliances. The bathrooms are fully equipped with sanitary ware, furniture, shower cubicles and fittings. The lighting is energy-efficient LED, and the flats are equipped with central air conditioning with an Air Zone system and a heat pump, as well as mechanical ventilation to ensure high air quality.
The communal areas have been designed with well-being and relaxation in mind and include a fully equipped gym and sauna for relaxation. The communal swimming pool with children's area and outdoor beach area are ideal for year-round relaxation. The building also has an 8-person lift for easy access to all flats.
This development is not just a place to live; it is a community where life offers a harmonious blend of comfort, convenience and modern urban living in one of the most desirable locations in Torrevieja.
Planned completion date: early 2027.
Location
Torrevieja, a town located about 45 km from Alicante, is famous for its unique, healthy microclimate. This is largely attributed to the large salt deposits and two remarkable lagoons, Laguna de Torrevieja and La Laguna de la Mata, in the heart of the town. These lagoons, one pink and the other green, are not only a visual wonder but also a habitat for various species of birds, including flamingos. The pink hue of Laguna de Torrevieja, caused by high salinity, crustaceans and algae, makes it a unique attraction.
La Laguna de la Mata, with its green waters, is home to a park interpretation centre and a variety of unique flora, including Aleppo pines and orchids. Also noteworthy are the vineyards in the area, which produce the local wine de la Mata.
Torrevieja's climate is ideal for sunbathers. From the 2.5-kilometre-long, Blue Flag-awarded Playa de la Mata to the accessible and lively beaches of Playa de los Locos and Playa del Cura, there is a beach for everyone here. In the city centre, natural pools among the rocky coastline offer a unique swimming experience, enhanced by nearby statues such as the Man of the Sea and the Beautiful Lola. Cala Ferris and Cala Piteras, with their stunning views, palm trees and snorkelling opportunities, are not to be missed.
Strolling along the Vista Alegre promenade, you'll immerse yourself in the lively atmosphere of the city with its abundance of bars, restaurants, cafés and shops. When it comes to entertainment, Torrevieja boasts the Aquopolis water park and nearby amusement park, as well as summer open-air discos.
Sports enthusiasts will find Torrevieja a paradise, with facilities for football, handball, tennis, rugby, swimming and more. The city, which once had only an observation tower (“old tower” or “torre vieja”), has been transformed into an architectural marvel.
With over 300 days of sunshine a year, Torrevieja is more than just a holiday destination; it is an enticing place for a longer stay or a new home.

Located in the province of Alicante in Spain, Calpe offers a stunning blend of natural beauty, historical sites and vibrant attractions. Located approximately 75 kilometres from Alicante Airport, Calpe provides convenient access for travellers from all over the world.

It is a similar distance from the city of Marbella. Mijas is about half an hour by car from Malaga airport. Mijas consists of 3 different neighborhoods: Mijas Pueblo, Mijas Costa and Mijas la Cala. The most popular, attracting numerous tourists and fans of Andalusian white villages, is Mijas Pueblo.
The well-known Mijas la Cala offers many interesting pubs and restaurants where you can refresh yourself with cool sangria or tapas or eat typical Andalusian dishes, such as gazpacho or seafood dishes. However, La Cale de Mijas does not live only in Andalusian cuisine. You will also find Greek and Chinese restaurants here, as well as one Thai and several Indian restaurants.
Mijas Pueblo is a multicultural town whose inhabitants are mostly foreigners. The Andalusian town is also called the kingdom of golf. Mijas Pueblo is famous primarily for its unusual taxis operated by donkeys. The idea was born in the 1960s, when tourists began to accost residents returning from work in quarries, whose transport consisted of donkeys. Their popularity was used to explore the city, which is why it is still one of the forms of 'taking a ride' and viewing the city.
Moreover, in Mijas it is worth visiting several observation decks, which offer a beautiful view of the coast and the town itself. One of the most famous is located on Avenida del Compas, right next to the sanctuary of the patron saint of Mijas. The second point with a panorama can be found in the Gardens on the Walls (Jardin de las Murallas).

Be part of this unique community and find time for yourself every day, relax and use the services of the best hotel.
Acceptance is scheduled for: second half of 2025.
Location
Casares is one of the most charming Andalusian white villages, located between the sea and the mountains. It perfectly combines over 2,000 meters of sandy beach, azure water, and is surrounded by golf courses and the Sierra Bermeja mountain range.
Casares' origins date back to Iberian and Phoenician times, although its name comes from Roman domination; in fact, the name Casares is influenced by the name of Julio Cesar, who in 61 BC visited the famous Baños Hediondos de Carratraca to cure himself of a skin disease using sulfuric waters, making the place very famous throughout Rome for its healing properties.
The steep and winding streets of Casares are the perfect place to relax, discover corners that don't appear in guidebooks, local craft shops and small town bars to stop at along the way.
Casares Castle
Situated at the top of the city, it towers over the valleys, hills and coastal plains stretching from the Serranía de Ronda to the Bay of Algeciras, providing a wonderful view of part of the provinces of Malaga and Cadiz. It is one of the most picturesque and beautiful corners of the commune, which is a must-see.
Hedionda Baths
They say the devil breathed his last here when he was banished by Santiago. This is one of the legends that the folk imagination keeps alive to justify the smell of sulfur in the waters. Known as Baños de la Hedionda, a resource of cultural importance, they constitute one of the historical landmarks of the Utrera massif and the whole of Casares in general. It is about the Iron Sulfur Baths, located in a beautiful and favorable place that people have been able to use since Roman times.

Embrace the perfect blend of style and comfort as you unwind in your own private haven.
Indulge in the utmost luxury within our meticulously designed bathrooms. Adorned with top-quality porcelain tiles, these spaces exude refinement. The vitrified porcelain wall-hung sanitary ware adds a touch of elegance, while the large-format white resin showers offer a sanctuary of relaxation. Complete with a stylish shower screen, these showers redefine the art of bathing.
At this residential complex, falling in love with the remarkable views and landscapes of Calpe becomes a daily occurrence. Allow yourself to be enchanted by the breathtaking panoramas that unfold before your eyes, offering glimpses of the Morro de Toix, the Sierra de Bernia, the Sierra de Oltà, Pedramala, the Montgó Natural Park, the Puig de la Llorença, and the captivating Cape of Moraira. Each day presents an opportunity to discover new wonders and embark on unforgettable adventures.
Location
Calpe, a captivating coastal town nestled on the Mediterranean, beckons with its undeniable charm and an array of attractions. Located in the province of Alicante, Spain, Calpe offers a delightful blend of natural beauty, historical landmarks, and vibrant activities. Situated approximately 75 kilometers from Alicante Airport, Calpe provides convenient access for travelers seeking to explore its wonders.
Upon arrival, you'll find yourself captivated by the stunning beaches that have earned the prestigious "Q" for Quality and the Blue Flag certifications. Calpe boasts some of the finest sandy shores in the region, including the iconic Playa de la Fossa and Playa de la Arenal-Bol. Immerse yourself in the Mediterranean bliss, bask in the sun, or indulge in water sports and activities that are an integral part of Calpe's coastal landscape.
Beyond its picturesque beaches, Calpe is adorned with historical landmarks and cultural treasures. The emblematic Peñón de Ifach, a massive limestone rock formation, stands as a symbol of Calpe and offers breathtaking panoramic views. Take a hike to the summit and marvel at the natural beauty that unfolds before your eyes. The old town, with its charming narrow streets and historic architecture, invites you to wander and explore its rich heritage.
Calpe's bustling fishing port is a must-visit destination. Watch the fishermen bring in their daily catch, visit the fish market, and savor fresh seafood delicacies in the numerous restaurants that line the harbor. For a taste of local culture, visit the Museum of Archaeology and Ethnography to delve into Calpe's fascinating history.
Nature enthusiasts will find solace in the natural parks that surround Calpe. Explore the Las Salinas Natural Park, a haven for migratory birds such as flamingos and storks, or venture into the Serra Gelada Natural Park to witness its rugged cliffs and captivating trails. For hiking enthusiasts, the Sierra de Bernia and Sierra de Oltà offer exhilarating routes and stunning vistas.
Indulge in the vibrant atmosphere of Calpe's local markets, where you can discover fresh produce, handicrafts, and traditional products. Sample the local gastronomy, renowned for its seafood, rice dishes, and savory tapas.
Beyond the confines of your residence, immerse yourself in the awe-inspiring beauty of Calpe. Located in close proximity to the Mediterranean coast, you'll have the privilege of embracing the gentle caress of the Mediterranean breeze, feeling the fine sand beneath your feet, and admiring the crystal-clear waters at a moment's notice. Calpe's beaches have been certified with the prestigious "Q" for Quality and the Blue Flag, attesting to their exceptional standards. Furthermore, the remarkable microclimate, rich flora, and diverse fauna further enhance the allure of this coastal paradise. Water sports and activities are seamlessly integrated into the landscape, offering endless adventures and opportunities for exploration.
Nature lovers will find solace in the proximity to natural parks, where you can immerse yourself in the wonders of the surroundings. From the enchanting Natural Park of Las Salinas, where migratory birds such as flamingos, coots, Audouin's gulls, and storks grace the skies, to the panoramic views offered from the highest point of the Peñón de Ifach. Prepare to be mesmerized by the vistas that stretch before you, encompassing the Serra Gelada Natural Park, the protected landscape of Puig Campana, the majestic Sierra de Aitana, and even glimpses of the distant island of Ibiza on the clearest of days.

properties.description:
Apartment for sale 500 metres from the sea in Pulpí, Costa de Almería
Join us as we visit the next phase of this magnificent project in Pulpí, a small corner of Andalusia that seduces with its joie de vivre, Andalusian culture and Mediterranean cuisine. Your new dream investment is within walking distance of the beautiful beaches of Nardos and Entrevista, and the spectacular sea views are not its only asset. Live in a beautiful part of the world bathed by the waves of the Mediterranean Sea, illuminated by the Spanish sun, guarded by mountains and surrounded by coves and incredible landscapes.
Take a walk along the coast whenever you feel like it. Enjoy the beaches of La Entrevista and Los Nardos, with their crystal-clear waters, ideal for diving, just a few steps from your home.
A privileged location, by the sea and with a variety of services in an exclusive residential area (restaurants, supermarket, sports centre), allowing you to enjoy a comfortable holiday and year-round living.
The apartments in this new seaside residence will have spectacular sea views and a traditional and characteristic Mediterranean Andalusian design. The flats will be designed with the utmost attention to detail, using high-quality materials. Perfectly laid out and very spacious, they will satisfy even the most demanding customers.
When designing this prestigious development, the developer focused on luxury and the safety of its future residents. The gated community will consist of 2-bedroom properties with 1 and 2 bathrooms and 3-bedroom properties with 2 bathrooms.
The elegant kitchen blends perfectly with the dining room and cosy living room with direct access to the terrace. It features high-quality appliances, cabinets and drawers, offering plenty of storage space for kitchen utensils and appliances. You can enjoy a spacious and comfortable space ideal for cooking, eating and relaxing with friends and family.
The bedrooms are located in a quiet and peaceful area, perfect for rest and sleep. All are equipped with built-in wardrobes, which provide plenty of storage space. In addition, each property has fully equipped and elegant bathrooms.
The residence has a range of amenities, including extensive communal areas, making it the ideal choice for those who want to live in luxurious surroundings. The Mediterranean garden surrounding the apartments is truly stunning, with vibrant colours and fragrant flowers creating a peaceful and relaxing atmosphere. In addition, the impressive communal areas include: adult swimming pools, children's pools, jacuzzis, children's playgrounds, a central square and landscaped green areas.
Don't miss the opportunity to live in this unique location right by the sea!
Planned completion date: July 2026
Location
Pulpí, the first coastal town in Andalusia, located on the border between Murcia and Almería, is one of the most picturesque and idyllic landscapes in Spain and offers many different reasons to visit. The municipality, located in the north-eastern part of the province, has three clearly differentiated areas within its territory: the coastal area, the inland basin and the small chain of mountain ranges separating them.
Pulpí Geode
In addition to its spectacular beaches and coves, there is a real natural gem here, which since its opening to the public in 2019 has become a tourist attraction: the Geode. Located in Mina Rica, in Pilar de Jaravía, it is a giant geode approximately eight metres long and two metres high. It is the second largest in the world after the Chihuahua Crystal Cave in Mexico and the largest of the geodes that can be visited.
Other places to visit
There is much more to visit in Pulpí. The town of Pulpí is home to the Church of San Miguel, the second oldest building in the municipality, dating from 1801, and also the tallest, with a spectacular altar. Also noteworthy are the Benzal Picnic and Ethnographic Area and the Apartadero Viewpoint.
Also worth visiting are the Scenic Space with the Pintor Pedro Antonio Martínez Room, which houses a collection of paintings by the influential Pulpileño painter, and the Black Room, the largest of its kind in Europe, which houses a spectacular collection of 1,000 luminescent minerals.
Beaches
Almería also boasts a catalogue of spectacular beaches and coves. The 13 beaches in Pulpí run along the coastline from north to south: Los Cocedores Beach, Las Palmeras Beach, La Carolina Beach, Invencible Cove, Costa Tranquila Cove, Cuartel Cove, Tía Antonia Cove, Rincón de los Nudos Cove, Mar Rabiosa Beach, Mar Serena Beach, Calypso Beach, La Entrevista Beach and Los Nardos Beach. Four of the five beaches located further south are Blue Flag beaches due to the quality of their services and their crystal-clear waters, which are excellent at all of them. These are Mar Serena, Mar Rabiosa, Calypso and Los Nardos.

properties.description:
Bungalow apartment for sale in Rojales.
We are delighted to present this new, exclusive development comprising 14 newly built, spacious apartments located in Rojales on the southern Costa Blanca.
Rojales offers the perfect combination of Mediterranean authenticity and top-class services: a town with real character, inhabited all year round, located just 10 minutes from the beaches of Guardamar del Segura, surrounded by four top-class golf courses (La Marquesa, La Finca, Vistabella and Las Colinas).
All essential services are within walking distance, including Mercadona and Consum supermarkets, pharmacies, a health centre, international schools, banks and a wide selection of restaurants and bars.
This new offer has been designed to be enjoyed every day of the year:
- Launch offer: private jacuzzi + underground parking space
- 2 bedrooms, 2 fully equipped bathrooms – ideal for couples, families or as a home suitable for remote working
- Private outdoor areas of up to 46 m² (ground floor with garden) or private solarium of up to 69 m² (first floor): spaces designed for spending time outdoors for up to 320 days a year
- Fully equipped kitchen, including integrated refrigerator, oven, hob, extractor hood, washing machine and dishwasher
- 1 kW photovoltaic system + installation ready for charging electric vehicles: energy efficiency and sustainable living
- Underfloor heating in bathrooms, built-in wardrobes and electric blinds: comfort and quality in every detail
This is a secure investment with rental potential.
For investor clients, Rojales offers high demand for tourist rentals thanks to its excellent location and excellent services. The possibility of generating rental income when the property is not being used for personal use significantly increases the value of the investment.
The calendar of cultural and leisure events is rich throughout the year: Cuevas del Rodeo (a museum unique in Europe), a weekly street market, walking routes along the Segura River, local festivals and a vibrant international community.
Transport links are excellent, with direct access to the AP-7 motorway, 35 minutes from Alicante Airport and 25 minutes from Murcia-Corvera Airport.
Planned completion date: January 2027.
Location
Rojales is a picturesque town in the province of Valencia, in south-eastern Spain. Lemon and orange groves surround the town, and the Segura River flows through Rojales. The beaches of Guardamar del Segura are just 7 kilometres from Rojales. With its rich cultural heritage, picturesque landscapes and many attractions, Rojales is a must-visit destination.
Located just a 45-minute drive from Alicante and Murcia airports, Rojales offers convenient access for travellers seeking a wonderful holiday. Upon arrival, immerse yourself in the town's history by exploring the charming historic centre, where traditional architecture and vibrant flowers create an enchanting atmosphere.
Don't miss Cuevas del Rodeo, a remarkable cave complex converted into an art gallery. Admire the intricate murals and sculptures while appreciating the town's thriving artistic community. Nature lovers will enjoy exploring the stunning landscapes of the nearby Parque Natural de la Mata, perfect for walking and bird watching.
When it's time to relax, head to the beautiful Blue Flag beaches of Guardamar del Segura, just a 10-minute drive from the property. Dip your toes in the golden sand, soak up the Mediterranean sun and refresh yourself in the crystal-clear waters.
Golf enthusiasts will appreciate the presence of La Marquesa Golf and other prestigious courses nearby, offering a fantastic golfing experience in breathtaking surroundings.
After a day of sightseeing, treat yourself to the culinary delights of Rojales. In the many charming restaurants and cafés, you can enjoy traditional Spanish tapas, fresh seafood and local specialities, complemented by regional wines.
In short, Rojales offers a captivating combination of history, natural beauty, magnificent beaches, golfing opportunities and exquisite cuisine. Whether you are looking for a short break or considering making Rojales your permanent home, this charming town offers a truly unforgettable experience.
