properties.description:
New apartment near the sea for sale in Torrevieja.
We present a new project of excellent apartments located only 600 metres from the sea in the centre of the bustling city of Torrevieja!
The development will have only 12 apartments of the highest quality. It is located in a very developed area, just a stone's throw from the sea and parks, very well connected to all the infrastructure of the coastal city.
The 12 flats, including studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom flats, and penthouses with one and two bathrooms respectively, are recommended not only for tourist use during the holiday season, but also for year-round living. Each property is fully finished and ready to move into.
The apartments have been designed with contemporary living in mind, offering high-quality finishes and modern amenities. The living room is spacious and comfortable, providing an excellent space for relaxation and entertainment. The kitchen is fully equipped with top-of-the-range appliances. The bedrooms are cosy and well-designed, with comfortable beds and plenty of storage space. The bathrooms are luxurious and modern, with showers and high-quality fittings.
The entire complex is well maintained, offering a range of amenities for residents. The building has a communal roof terrace with a swimming pool, where residents can enjoy magnificent views of the city and relax in the sun.
Location
Torrevieja, a town located about 45 km from Alicante, is famous for its unique, healthy microclimate. This is largely attributed to the large salt deposits and two remarkable lagoons, Laguna de Torrevieja and La Laguna de la Mata, in the heart of the town. These lagoons, one pink and the other green, are not only a visual wonder but also a habitat for various species of birds, including flamingos. The pink hue of Laguna de Torrevieja, caused by high salinity, crustaceans and algae, makes it a unique attraction.
La Laguna de la Mata, with its green waters, is home to a park interpretation centre and a variety of unique flora, including Aleppo pines and orchids. Also noteworthy are the vineyards in the area, which produce the local wine de la Mata.
Torrevieja's climate is ideal for sunbathers. From the 2.5-kilometre-long, Blue Flag-awarded Playa de la Mata to the accessible and lively beaches of Playa de los Locos and Playa del Cura, there is a beach for everyone here. In the city centre, natural pools among the rocky coastline offer a unique swimming experience, enhanced by nearby statues such as the Man of the Sea and the Beautiful Lola. Cala Ferris and Cala Piteras, with their stunning views, palm trees and snorkelling opportunities, are not to be missed.
Strolling along the Vista Alegre promenade, you'll immerse yourself in the lively atmosphere of the city with its abundance of bars, restaurants, cafés and shops. When it comes to entertainment, Torrevieja boasts the Aquopolis water park and nearby amusement park, as well as summer open-air discos.
Sports enthusiasts will find Torrevieja a paradise, with facilities for football, handball, tennis, rugby, swimming and more. The city, which once had only an observation tower (“old tower” or “torre vieja”), has been transformed into an architectural marvel.
With over 300 days of sunshine a year, Torrevieja is more than just a holiday destination; it is an enticing place for a longer stay or a new home.

The promenade is a popular meeting place for locals and tourists alike and the perfect place to enjoy magnificent views of the sea and the city.

Location
Algorfa, located in the Vega Baja del Segura region, has a rich history dating back to Roman times. The town's name comes from the Arabic word “Al-Gorfa”, meaning “cave”, as the area was known for its numerous natural caves. Today, Algorfa is known for its production of citrus fruits and vegetables.
Algorfa is home to many attractions that will appeal to visitors of all ages. Here are just a few of the highlights:
La Finca Golf Course
If you are a golf enthusiast, La Finca Golf Course is a must-visit. This championship golf course is set in beautiful natural surroundings, with stunning views of the Vega Baja countryside. The course is designed to challenge golfers of all levels, and there are plenty of amenities, including a pro shop and restaurant.
Algorfa Market
To get a taste of the local culture, be sure to visit the Algorfa Market, which takes place every Wednesday. Here you will find a wide selection of goods, including fresh local produce, clothing and souvenirs. It is the perfect place to buy a unique gift or sample the delicious local cuisine.
Plaza de España
Plaza de España is the main square in Algorf, which is a great place to soak up the local atmosphere. Here you will find a beautiful fountain, plenty of seating and many restaurants and bars. It is the perfect place to relax with a drink and admire the local culture.

Location
Torrevieja, located about 40 kilometres from Alicante airport, is a city that never ceases to amaze, being a highly desirable destination for many locals and foreigners. The city is located on the Costa Blanca, in the province of Alicante, and is very well connected to the rest of the country.
One of the reasons why it is worth living or holidaying in Torrevieja is the modernity of this city. This is mainly because it is a city in development, due to its location and the large number of people who visit and live there. It is therefore a modern city, equipped with everything necessary to welcome tourists and residents. What's more, multiculturalism reigns supreme here, and you can hear different languages spoken on the streets.
Torrevieja is famous for its beautiful beaches, where golden sand meets crystal clear water. Some of the best beaches in the area are La Mata Beach, Playa del Cura and Los Locos Beach. Bask in the sun, take a refreshing dip in the Mediterranean Sea or enjoy various water sports. The beautiful promenades along these beaches are perfect for leisurely strolls, full of charming cafés, restaurants and shops.
Beyond the beaches, Torrevieja offers a wealth of activities and attractions to suit all interests. Immerse yourself in the local culture and history by visiting the Torrevieja Museum, where you can see fascinating exhibits showcasing the town's heritage. Take a leisurely boat trip from Marina de Torrevieja and admire the stunning coastline from a different perspective.
Golf enthusiasts will be delighted by the abundance of exceptional golf courses in the area. Some of the best golf courses near Torrevieja include Las Colinas Golf & Country Club, Villamartin Golf Club and La Marquesa Golf. Enjoy challenging water courses, picturesque landscapes and world-class facilities while indulging in your favourite pastime.
When it comes to dining, Torrevieja offers a diverse culinary scene. Discover a wide range of restaurants, from traditional Spanish tapas bars to international cuisine, catering to every palate and preference. Be sure to sample the fresh seafood, a local speciality that is not to be missed.
For shopping enthusiasts, the Habaneras and Ozone Leisure Centre shopping centres are popular. These modern complexes feature a variety of shops, boutiques and entertainment venues, providing a wonderful shopping experience.
Torrevieja also boasts a lively nightlife, with numerous bars, clubs and live music venues. Whether you are looking for a relaxing evening with friends or an exciting night of dancing, Torrevieja's nightlife has something for everyone.

Villa with swimming pool for sale in Los Montesinos.
We present a carefully designed development comprising modern villas located in La Herrada, Los Montesinos, a quiet residential area on the Costa Blanca.
An ideal project designed to enjoy the Mediterranean lifestyle, where modern architecture combines with bright spaces, delicate lines and a natural connection between indoor and outdoor living.

The homes stand out for their sustainable and functional design, open interiors, large windows and thoughtful choice of materials that ensure tranquillity, comfort and elegance.
The interiors have been designed to adapt to different lifestyles, offering a modern, light-filled and cosy home experience.
As the project is in its early stages, it is possible to customise the layouts and finishes, creating a truly personalised home.
Located in La Herrada, Los Montesinos, the villas enjoy a prime location close to all amenities, natural areas, golf courses and just a few minutes' drive from the best beaches of the Costa Blanca.
This is a unique opportunity for those seeking design, quality and a Mediterranean lifestyle in an exclusive setting.
Location
Los Montesinos is a municipality in the Valencian Community of Spain. It is located in the south of the province of Alicante, in the Vega Baja del Segura region. It has a population of 4,921 (INE 2015). The town of Los Montesinos has a rich history dating back to the 16th century when it was founded by the Marquis of Beniel. The town's name comes from the surrounding mountains, which were once covered with monte, or shrubs. Over the centuries, the town has been inhabited by various cultures, including Romans, Moors and Christians, each of which has left its mark on the town's architecture and culture.
One of the most striking features of Los Montesinos is its unique location, situated between two salt lakes, Laguna de Torrevieja and Laguna de La Mata. These two lakes, which are part of a nature park, are home to a variety of bird species, making them an ideal destination for birdwatchers.
Today, Los Montesinos is a lively and friendly community with a range of amenities to suit all tastes and budgets. The town has many shops and restaurants, including several supermarkets, bakeries and butchers where you can buy fresh local produce. There are also extensive sports facilities, including a modern sports centre, several tennis and paddle tennis courts, and a public swimming pool.
The nearest beach to Los Montesinos is Playa El Moncayo, just a 15-minute drive away. This long and wide sandy beach is known for its clear blue waters and sand dunes, which provide a natural backdrop to the beach. It is a popular spot for both locals and tourists and offers a range of amenities, including showers, toilets and a selection of beach bars and restaurants.
Other nearby beaches include La Mata, which is just a 20-minute drive away and is renowned for its natural beauty and crystal-clear waters, and Torrevieja, which is a little further away, about a 25-minute drive. Torrevieja is a lively resort town with several beaches, including the popular Playa del Cura and the more secluded Cala Ferris.

properties.title: An exquisite villa with the best sea views in Benissa
properties.summary: New build villa for sale in Benissa, Alicante: 4 bedrooms, 6 bathrooms, 770 m² built, 1,510 m² plot. €3,410,000.
properties.description:
Luxury villa with sea views for sale in Benissa.
This unique and luxurious villa is located in the extraordinary town of Benissa, 73 km from the city of Alicante.
It is the essence of elegance, quality and design, more precisely located in the exclusive area of Racó de Galeno in Benissa.
This property combines the warmth of Mediterranean style with a modern architectural approach, offering impressive sea views and a perfect blend of interior and exterior. Thanks to the IN&OUT design, each space has been created with exceptional functionality and constant contact with the surroundings in mind, providing a unique, sophisticated and open-to-the-Mediterranean living experience.
The design takes full advantage of the natural slope of the plot, creating a terraced development that opens up to the landscape and the sea.
Each level has been designed to ensure privacy and comfort, with spacious interior rooms connected to sun-drenched terraces, gardens, relaxation areas and a spectacular infinity pool that visually blends into the horizon. The use of noble materials such as natural stone, wood and glass further emphasises the elegance and modernity of the whole, making this villa a benchmark for luxury and architecture on the Costa Blanca.
The exterior of the villa is a true extension of the interior, designed for year-round enjoyment of the outdoors. Large sliding windows connect the interiors to the main terrace, which combines different areas designed for pleasure and comfort: an elegant infinity pool with sun loungers for sunbathing by the sea, a cosy outdoor lounge with sofas for relaxation, and a dining area with a barbecue under the veranda, ideal for gatherings with family or friends. In addition, an open English patio, decorated with native plants, provides freshness, light and a sense of a private oasis, complementing the outdoor living experience so characteristic of the contemporary Mediterranean lifestyle.
The interior of the house reflects the perfect balance between modernity, warmth and functionality. Its spacious and open spaces, bathed in the natural light of the Mediterranean, enhance the visual connection with the landscape thanks to large windows that open completely to the outside.
The living room and dining room form a single versatile and elegant space, ideal for both everyday use and special occasions, always with the sea in the background.
The kitchen, on the other hand, is a combination of design, functionality and sophistication. It is fully equipped with high-end appliances and features natural wood, marble and neutral tones that give it warmth and elegance. The central island with a bar not only facilitates spending time together but also serves as a meeting place in everyday life. Next to it, the dining room is strategically located opposite large floor-to-ceiling windows that open completely to the outside, allowing the kitchen and dining room to extend onto the main terrace.
The villa enjoys a prime location that allows you to admire the endless Mediterranean Sea without obstruction. From the spectacular terrace with an infinity pool, the view stretches from the sculpted coastline to the majestic Peñón de Ifach, the natural icon of Marina Alta, and the elegant panorama of Calpe. After dark, this scenery turns into a spectacle of lights: the city glows under the starry sky, reflecting in the sea and creating a magical, mesmerising atmosphere that makes every sunset and every night a unique experience.
Location
Benissa is located between Valencia and Alicante. Manises Airport in Valencia is an hour's drive away, and L'Altet Airport in Alicante is 50 minutes away. Both airports are major
international airports served by many airlines.
Benissa is a small town located in the province of Alicante. The town has won the hearts of many tourists thanks to its incredible views - the sea and mountains meet here, making Benissa a unique place in this part of the Iberian Peninsula.
It is a place that inspires above all with its very well-preserved medieval architecture. While walking around the town, you will discover unique buildings and elegant palaces, see the traditional Lonja (trade exchange), the Cultural Centre and the Franciscan monastery. In the town centre, there is also the Riberero monument, dedicated to the inhabitants who emigrated to Ribera Valenciana to harvest rice.
Around Benissa, there are wonderful hiking trails that reveal breathtaking panoramas of the Mediterranean Sea. In addition, amusement parks and many sports facilities are also within easy reach. Concerts and exhibitions await culture lovers. If you want to experience a typical Spanish fiesta, this place will not disappoint you either. Local festivals are held here in honour of the patron saint Purísima Xiqueta, and in June the Moors and Christians festival is celebrated.
Benissa has four kilometres of coastline with some of the most beautiful bays on the Costa Blanca. The crystal clear waters are ideal for water sports such as diving, sailing, windsurfing and kayaking.
Playa la Fustera is by far the most famous and popular sandy beach in Benissa. The beach has been awarded the Blue Flag, which aims to promote environmental protection in coastal towns, bathing areas and marinas. The beach is ideal for family holidays: it is very easy to get to, both by car and by bus, and there is parking available, as well as numerous showers and toilets. An additional advantage of the beach is the constant supervision of lifeguards during the season from 15 June to 15 September and two restaurants.
Another well-known beach in this coastal town is Cala Baladrar. The picturesque bay offers unearthly views of Calpe and Peñon de Ilfach, while being easily accessible. The water is calm because the beach is sheltered from strong winds. Cala Baladrar is famous for its shallow waters and rich marine fauna, making it the perfect place for diving enthusiasts. It is a small Mediterranean paradise - during the season, there is a beach bar where you can have lunch, drink a cocktail and listen to live music.
Benissa is the perfect place if you want to escape the hustle and bustle of coastal towns but are still looking for an elegant villa or exclusive apartment near the sea. The views of the Mediterranean Sea in this town speak for themselves and are truly breathtaking.

Your new flat is just 2 km from the sandy beach and close to the town centre, this new development offers the perfect balance between coastal living and urban convenience. Pilar de la Horadada is renowned for its beautiful beaches, vibrant community and rich local amenities. All this makes it the perfect place for families who want to spend the summer or live permanently by the sea, close to all kinds of services.
You can choose from luxury houses with swimming pools, single-storey bungalows with private gardens, middle apartments with terraces or top floor bungalows with roof solariums, where you can install a private jacuzzi, for example. The offer includes modern two-bedroom apartments, all with large terraces and finished with attention to the smallest details.
The open-plan kitchen and living room provide a modern and spacious living environment. The contemporary design allows for a smooth transition between the living and kitchen areas, providing the perfect place to entertain guests or spend time with your family.
This exclusive, gated development boasts magnificent landscaped gardens with a swimming pool, outdoor gym, children's playground, jacuzzi and children's pool.
Each property is finished to the highest standard and includes a modern kitchen with built-in appliances, LED lighting, pre-installation for air conditioning and a secure parking space in the underground garage.
For those who want to personalise their home, the developer offers:
- Personalisation option: Depending on the stage of construction, you may still be able to choose materials and finishes.
- Jacuzzi and outdoor kitchen: Prepare your solarium for luxury with the pre-installation of a jacuzzi and outdoor kitchen.
Imagine pleasant walks within the urbanisation along its large, tree-lined avenues, warm evenings in the moonlight, strolls along the seafront promenade or discovering the secrets of the still wild nature of the surrounding area - all this awaits you in Spain!
Location
Pilar de la Horadada has everything you need to enjoy the sea, pine forests and Spanish sun. The coastline of Pilar de la Horadada is over 4 kilometres long and offers a wide variety of scenery. There are wide beaches with fine white sand, small stone ledges suspended over the water and small, intimate, hidden coves with golden sand.
The resort is located in the south-eastern part of Spain and borders Murcia (about 15 minutes away). Alicante is about a 40-minute drive away.
The sea here is usually calm, the beaches are safe, and there are no steep slopes, which allows even the smallest children to swim safely. In addition, the clear water and excellent visibility invite divers to observe the beauty of aquatic life.
The cleanliness of the beaches in Pilar de la Hordada has been recognised with the European Union's Blue Flag, which guarantees a healthy environment.
Inland, there are various interesting excursions to be had near the towns of Sierra and Escalona. There are two marked hiking trails along the Rio Seco riverbed, 19 kilometres long, which are definitely worth visiting. One of the routes is 4 kilometres long, while the other is 10 kilometres long, stretching from the natural area of Pilar de Campoverde to the mouth of the Mil Palmeras beach.
Not far from the town of Pilar de la Horadada, there is also an 18-hole golf course in Lo Romero. Both professionals and beginners will feel at home there.
Gastronomy has a privileged place in the culture of this beautiful town. Typical dishes of Pilar de la Horadada include potatoes with meat stew, meatballs, rabbit in garlic and Gachas Migas (a flour and garlic pancake), as well as excellent rice dishes and soups. Sweets and cakes also deserve a mention here, with confectionery such as meringue cake called ‘milhojas’ or almond sweets called ‘cordiales’ being the most popular.

Although it is inland, it has numerous residential areas (La Marina, El Oasis, La Escuera, Bonavista, Las Pesqueras, etc.) that are located by the sea and are mostly inhabited by foreigners, giving it a cosmopolitan atmosphere.
Located in the middle of the Vega Baja of the Segura river, between fields of vegetables, cereals and orange trees, San Fulgencio is a completely flat town, except for the north, where it is protected by the Sierra del Molar. It is only 2 km from the coast.
Although the municipality has traditionally been dedicated to agriculture, today its most important activities are the service sector and tourism.
San Fulgencio is located 15 km from Elche and 36 km from Alicante.
WHAT TO SEE
- Church of San Fulgencio. A parish church built in the 18th century. Although it is Baroque in style, it stands out for its austerity and simplicity. Its interior has a Greek cross plan, with a dome in the centre, and three naves, the narrowest and longest of which in the centre reaches up to the head where the main altar, tabernacle and image of the patron saint are located. . Fulgencio.
- Archaeological Museum. Founded in 1993, this museum collects a range of objects found in the municipality. It mainly collects Iberian and Greek ceramics.
LOCAL EVENTS
- Celebrations of San Fulgencio and San Antonio Abad. On 16 and 17 January, there are processions in honour of the two saints, the blessing of animals and bread, and a traditional meal shared by all the town's inhabitants.
- Pilgrimage of San Isidro Labrador On the Sunday after 15 May, a pilgrimage is held in honour of the patron saint of farmers. The saint is transported in a cart pulled by oxen to Paraje El Oasis, where a mass is celebrated.
- Celebration of Our Lady of Peace. Summer festivities were held on the first weekend of August in the Urbanisation La Marina.
Fiestas de la Virgen del Remedio In October, there are fiestas in honour of the patron saint. Street decorations, parades, floral offerings to Mary and fireworks.

A restored old town (pueblo) with narrow streets and two squares (Plaza de España and Plaza Andalucia). The first one features the bronze fountain of La Niña, the symbol of Benalmádena Pueblo.
2. Benalmádena Costa, the newest part of the city, located along the coast and directly adjacent to the sea. A significant portion of its development consists of tourist facilities (hotels, restaurants, discos, and the beach).
3. Arroyo de la Miel (Honey Stream), originally a separate settlement, located between the other two districts. It is the main residential area and the most commercially active part of the city.

FAIRYTALE COLOMBO'S CASTLE
Colomares Castle is not actually a castle, but a monument to Columbus. Nevertheless, it is beautiful and one of the major attractions in Benalmádena. It was designed and built by Esteban Marin Martin. Its construction lasted from 1987 to 1994. Interestingly, the castle houses the smallest church in the world, listed in the Guinness Book of Records. Its area is a mere 1.96 square meters.
STUPA

Location
Casares is one of the most charming Andalusian white villages, located between the sea and the mountains. It perfectly combines over 2,000 meters of sandy beach, azure water, and is surrounded by golf courses and the Sierra Bermeja mountain range.
Casares' origins date back to Iberian and Phoenician times, although its name comes from Roman domination; in fact, the name Casares is influenced by the name of Julio Cesar, who in 61 BC visited the famous Baños Hediondos de Carratraca to cure himself of a skin disease using sulfuric waters, making the place very famous throughout Rome for its healing properties.
The steep and winding streets of Casares are the perfect place to relax, discover corners that don't appear in guidebooks, local craft shops and small town bars to stop at along the way.
Casares Castle

It is one of the most picturesque and beautiful corners of the commune, which is a must-see.
Hedionda Baths
They say the devil breathed his last here when he was banished by Santiago. This is one of the legends that the folk imagination keeps alive to justify the smell of sulfur in the waters. Known as Baños de la Hedionda, a resource of cultural importance, they constitute one of the historical landmarks of the Utrera massif and the whole of Casares in general. It is about the Iron Sulfur Baths, located in a beautiful and favorable place that people have been able to use since Roman times.

Location
Pulpí, the first coastal town in Andalusia, situated on the border between Murcia and Almería, boasts one of the most picturesque and idyllic landscapes in Spain and offers a wealth of reasons to visit. The municipality, situated in the north-eastern part of the province, comprises three distinctly different areas: the coastal zone, an inland basin, and a small chain of hills separating them.
Pulpí Geode
In addition to spectacular beaches and coves, the area boasts a true natural gem which, since opening to the public in 2019, has become a major tourist attraction: the Geode. Located in Mina Rica, in Pilar de Jaravía, it is a gigantic geode approximately eight metres long and two metres high. It is the second largest in the world after the Crystal Cave of Chihuahua in Mexico and the largest of the geodes open to visitors.
Other places to visit
There is much more to see in Pulpí. The town of Pulpí is home to the Church of San Miguel, the second oldest building in the municipality, dating from 1801, and also the tallest, housing a spectacular altar. Also worth noting are the Benzal Picnic and Ethnographic Area and the Apartadero Viewpoint.
Also worth a visit is the Scenic Space, featuring the ‘Pintor Pedro Antonio Martínez’ room, which houses a collection of works by the influential Pulpileño painter, and the ‘Black Room’, the largest of its kind in Europe, housing a spectacular collection of 1,000 luminescent minerals.

Almería also boasts a range of spectacular beaches and coves. Location
Los Montesinos is a municipality in the Valencian Community of Spain. Located in the south of the province of Alicante, in the region of Vega Baja del Segura. It has a population of 4921 inhabitants (INE 2015). The town of Los Montesinos has a rich history dating back to the 16th century, when it was founded by the Marquis of Beniel. The town's name comes from the surrounding mountains, which were once covered with monte, or shrubs. Over the centuries, the city has been inhabited by different cultures, including Romans, Moors and Christians, each of which has left its mark on the city's architecture and culture.
One of the most striking features of Los Montesinos is its unique location, nestled between two salt lakes, the Laguna de Torrevieja and the Laguna de La Mata. This long and wide sandy beach is known for its clear blue waters and sand dunes, which provide a natural backdrop to the beach. It is popular with locals and tourists alike and offers a range of facilities including showers, toilets and a selection of beach bars and restaurants.
Other nearby beaches include La Mata, which is only a 20-minute drive and is renowned for its natural beauty and crystal clear waters, and Torrevieja, which is a little further afield, around 25 minutes by car. Torrevieja is a lively resort town with several beaches, including the popular Playa del Cura and the more secluded Cala Ferris.

For sale detached villa in Polop.
Elite World Estates is proud to present a new project of detached villas located in the picturesque village of Polop. These luxurious, modern villas have been designed to combine contemporary architecture with the beauty of the natural surroundings, offering residents a peaceful location with stunning mountain views. This is an extraordinary design of luxury homes tailored to suit the requirements of every client. You have a choice of 6 interesting designs with the possibility of also building a private pool. The developer offers the possibility to have up to 4 bedrooms and a garden of approximately 200 m2. The configuration of the houses will be ‘à la carte’, i.e. the client will propose, among other things, the design, finishes and layout. The aim is to offer a development where the owner has more freedom to determine how they want their home, within the parameters set by the development project.
Each home will be constructed with high-quality materials such as stone facades, spacious terraces and private gardens. Spacious outdoor areas with private gardens and terraces will be ideal for relaxing and welcoming guests.
Whether you are looking for a permanent home, a holiday home or an investment property, this new development in Polop offers something special.
Location
On the beautiful Costa Blanca, in the hinterland of the province of Alicante, you will find charming towns that are often overshadowed by other seaside or more famous ones. A clear example is Polop de la Marina, located a few kilometres from Benidorm, Altea or Castell de Guadalest, with a beautiful historic centre that you will immediately fall in love with.
Located in the Marina Baja region of Alicante, about 15 kilometres from the coast, Polop de la Marina is a small town of less than 5,000 inhabitants.
The old town of Polop, perched on a hill and developed at the foot of a castle of Arab origin, is one of the most interesting and best preserved in the province. Its picturesque, colourful streets full of flowers and carved ornaments are the inspiration for many artists.
The most outstanding building in the historical case is the church of San Pedro Apóstol, in the upper part of the town, just before the path leading to the castle.
Although there are few remains of Polop Castle, a trip to its ruins, located at the top of the hill on which the old town is located, is a must. Without a doubt, the path leading to the castle itself is one of the most interesting points to visit in Polop. Impeccably groomed, like the rest of the community, the successful pavement and its zigzagging route offer us impressive views of the town and the surrounding area.
The colourful fountain - Fuente de los Chorros - also deserves much attention. It is decorated with ceramic mosaics with the coats of arms of the various towns in the province of Alicante and has as many as 221 springs.
If we are talking about hiking trails in Polop, there is one route that stands out: the climb up Ponotx mountain known as the Sleeping Lion'. A large limestone mass with vertical walls that rises to a height of 1183 metres. It is a route with a high degree of difficulty, due to the positive difference of more than a thousand metres, being a route reserved for those in very good physical condition and accustomed to this type of mountain route.
There is a wide variety of restaurants in Polop. But if you want an unforgettable culinary experience, you must make a reservation at the Ca l'Àngels restaurant. Vicenta and Paco Teuler, together with other family members, run a restaurant where traditional cuisine with local products (even from their own garden) reigns supreme. An innovative wine list and artisanal desserts crown the excellent offer.

The town has a vibrant cultural scene, hosting various festivals throughout the year, including the San Pedro Carnival and the International Festival of Habaneras and Polyphony.

Villa for sale in Polop.
Elite World Estates is proud to present this modern villa, located in the picturesque town of Polop. This interesting investment is a fantastic opportunity to live in luxury near the popular city of Benidorm, enjoying all the benefits that the area has to offer.
When you enter the house, you will be welcomed by the spacious open-plan living room, dining room and kitchen. Large windows provide plenty of natural light and offer direct access to the garden, which features a refreshing pool, perfect for relaxing and playing on sunny days.
This beautiful villa has a well-thought-out layout, with one bedroom conveniently located on the ground floor, accompanied by a stylish bathroom. Upstairs, there are two additional bedrooms, each with its own bathroom. One of these bedrooms also provides access to a charming terrace where you can enjoy your morning coffee or relax while taking in the surrounding views.
If you are looking for an elevated experience, there is the option to include a roof terrace for an additional fee. Imagine basking in the sun or organising gatherings with friends and family while enjoying panoramic views of the resort and beyond.

The villa's location provides easy access to a range of amenities. Whether you're playing golf on the famous course, visiting nearby shops and restaurants, or simply enjoying the tranquillity of the resort, everything is conveniently within reach.
Don't miss the opportunity to call this unique villa your home. Experience the perfect combination of modern living, comfort and relaxation in this magnificent residence in the mountains of picturesque Polop.
Planned completion date: 12 - 18 months from signing the contract
Location
On the beautiful Costa Blanca, in the interior of the province of Alicante, there are charming little towns that are often overshadowed by other coastal or more well-known towns. A clear example is Polop de la Marina, located a few kilometres from Benidorm, Altea or Castell de Guadalest, with a beautiful historic centre that will make you fall in love at first sight.
Located in the Marina Baja region of Alicante, about 15 kilometres from the coast, Polop de la Marina is a small town with less than 5,000 inhabitants.
Polop's old town, located on a hill and developed at the foot of the Arab castle, is one of the most interesting and best-preserved in the province. Its picturesque, colourful streets full of flowers and carved ornaments are an inspiration for many artists.
The most outstanding building in historical terms is the church of San Pedro Apóstol, in the upper part of the town, just before the path leading to the castle.
Although few remains of Polop Castle have survived, it is well worth visiting the ruins, located at the top of the hill on which the old town is situated. The path leading to the castle is undoubtedly one of the most interesting places to visit in Polop. Impeccably maintained, like the rest of the municipality, the successful surface and its zigzag route offer impressive views of the city and the surrounding area.
The colourful fountain, Fuente de los Chorros, is also worth a visit. It is decorated with ceramic mosaics depicting the coats of arms of various towns in the province of Alicante and has 221 jets.
When it comes to hiking trails in Polop, one route stands out from the rest: the ascent of Mount Ponotx, known as the Sleeping Lion. A large limestone mass with vertical walls that rises to a height of 1,183 metres. It is a very difficult route, due to the positive difference of over a thousand metres, and is reserved for people with very good physical condition and who are used to this type of mountain route.
There are many different restaurants in Polop. But if you want to experience an unforgettable culinary experience, you should make a reservation at the restaurant Ca l'Àngels. Vicent and Paco Teuler run the restaurant together with other family members. Traditional cuisine with local products (even from their own garden) is the order of the day. An innovative wine list and homemade desserts round off the excellent offer.

We are pleased to present a new villa project with a very elegant design.
The villas are laid out on one level and have a private roof terrace with ample space for sun loungers, a barbecue, a jacuzzi and, of course, beautiful views of the surrounding area.

The development is located in San Javier, a few minutes from the centre of the charming Spanish town of and its beaches, where you can find all the necessary amenities, such as restaurants, pharmacies, supermarkets, shops and banks. Within a few minutes' drive, you can reach the Dos Mares shopping centre or the magnificent city of Cartagena.
Location
San Javier is a coastal town with a lively shopping centre at its heart and a beautiful church square surrounded by bars and restaurants. It is located on the northern corner of the Mediterranean coast known as Costa Calida Murcia. San Javier is famous for its golden sandy beaches, warm climate and wide range of tourist attractions, including water sports, restaurants, bars and shops. In addition, the town has a rich history and culture, which is reflected in its historic buildings and monuments, such as the Church of San Francisco Javier and the Town Museum.
Getting there
From Murcia International Airport, you can reach the town of San Javier via the RM 19 motorway (35 km), and the journey takes about 25 minutes by car. From Alicante International Airport, you can reach it via the AR-7 motorway (87 km) - 56 minutes by car.
Golf
Costa Calida is a mecca for golf lovers. There are many high-class golf courses here. The Nicklaus complex includes six courses designed by Nicklaus Design, including La Torre, El Valle, Alhama and Mar Menor. Mar Menor is a more difficult golf course with three holes, surrounded by large lakes. La Torre is a local favourite, as it is easier and more forgiving to play. Valle Golf Resort is located in a natural valley with spectacular views of the surrounding mountains. It is a course more suited to intelligent, strategic players than those with a powerful swing.
Alhama is considered by many to be the most difficult of the Nicklaus Complex courses. It is a long, spectacular course, considered one of the best in Spain.
Beaches
San Javier has dozens of beaches in the area where you can spend every free moment. The beaches are mainly located in the Santiago de La Ribera and La Manga del Mar Menor areas, i.e. the Mar Menor spit. One of the beaches of La Manga del Mar Menor is Playa Las Antillas.
Another interesting beach in the area is Playa de Hita, which is quite unusual because it is a protected area considered to be the habitat and breeding ground of many valuable species of migratory birds. Most beaches have a good standard of facilities, with the possibility of renting water and beach equipment, as well as taking advantage of the offer of more than one restaurant or beach bar. Toilets and showers are standard at the beaches. The other beaches in the San Javier area are Playa El Castillico and Banco del Tabal, both of which have been awarded blue flags.
Protected areas
There are many beautiful protected areas in the San Javier area. La Mayor o del Barón and Isla Perdiquera are two islands of volcanic origin, which are also habitats for protected birds.
Other islands that are protected areas are La Isla Grosa and El Islote del Farallón, also of volcanic origin, which are mainly home to Roman gulls, but also other birds. All these places are accessible to tourists, but they are not as popular as standard beaches, so perhaps this is a good idea for spending your holiday in San Javier?
Isla Grosa is the perfect place for scuba divers, who come here from all over Spain.

The coastline of Pilar de la Horadada stretches for more than 4 kilometres and offers a wonderfully diverse landscape. Here you will find wide beaches with fine white sand, small rocky coves by the crystal-clear water, and intimate hidden bays with golden sand.

Location

This is where some of the resort's attractions are held, including beach volleyball, kayaking, Adventure Golf and Pentanque tournaments.
Recycling
Santa Rosalía has a waste separation system to collect paper and cardboard, packaging, plastic, glass and other types of waste. Little things mean a lot when it comes to changing the world. In our sales office we use cardboard cups and we make sure to reduce paper consumption and recycle it. This policy is especially important at the Beach Club.
Energy efficiency
LED lighting is installed throughout the facility, controlled by sundials and low energy consumption. Energy efficiency isn't just about saving money. This is an essential measure that will help save our planet.

Location
Casares is a charming municipality in the province of Málaga, within the autonomous region of Andalusia in southern Spain. Situated on the border with the province of Cádiz, it forms part of the western Costa del Sol. Casares is considered one of the finest examples of a traditional Andalusian white village, famous for its narrow winding streets, steep alleys, and whitewashed houses. Located just 16 kilometres from Estepona, it offers visitors an authentic Andalusian atmosphere and breathtaking scenery.
According to local history, the name Casares is linked to Julius Caesar, who is believed to have visited the nearby sulphur baths in 61 BC to treat a skin condition. The healing properties of these mineral-rich waters became renowned throughout the Roman Empire.
Walking through the picturesque streets of Casares is a wonderful way to discover hidden corners, local artisan shops, traditional tapas bars, and the authentic charm of Andalusian life.
Casares Castle
Perched on the highest point of the village, Casares Castle overlooks valleys, rolling hills, and the Mediterranean coastline stretching from the Serranía de Ronda to the Bay of Algeciras. The castle offers breathtaking panoramic views across the provinces of Málaga and Cádiz and is one of the municipality's most iconic landmarks.
Hedionda Thermal Baths
Legend has it that this was the place where the devil took his last breath after being defeated by Saint James. This local legend explains the distinctive sulphur scent of the waters. The famous Baños de la Hedionda are a protected cultural heritage site and one of the most important historical landmarks of Casares. These ancient iron-sulphur thermal baths, located beside the Albarrán stream near the border with Manilva, have been used since Roman times for their therapeutic properties. The historic bathhouse, with its vaulted ceilings and unique architecture, remains one of the area's most fascinating attractions.

Located in the exclusive area of La Fustera in Benissa Costa, this new development is a complex of four independent villas designed for those seeking the perfect balance between contemporary architecture, comfort and the charm of the Costa Blanca.
These homes have been carefully designed with our experience and in-depth understanding of our clients' needs and desires in mind. 139.61 m² of living space on one level

High-quality finishes and energy-efficient design
Open-plan living space, maximising space and natural light

Location
Benissa is located between Valencia and Alicante. Manises Airport in Valencia is an hour's drive away, and L'Altet Airport in Alicante is 50 minutes away. Both airports are major
international airports served by many airlines.
Benissa is a small town in the province of Alicante. The town has won the hearts of many tourists thanks to its incredible views - the sea and mountains meet, making Benissa a unique place in this part of the Iberian Peninsula.
It is a place that inspires above all with its well-preserved medieval architecture. While walking around the town, you will discover unique buildings and elegant palaces, see the traditional Lonja (market hall), the Cultural Centre and the Franciscan monastery. In the centre of the town, there is also the Riberero monument, dedicated to the inhabitants who emigrated to the Ribera Valenciana to harvest rice.
Around Benissa, there are wonderful hiking trails that reveal breathtaking views of the Mediterranean Sea. In addition, amusement parks and many sports facilities are within easy reach. Culture lovers can enjoy concerts and exhibitions. If you want to experience a typical Spanish fiesta, this place will not disappoint you either. Local festivals are held here in honour of the patron saint Purísima Xiqueta, and in June the Moors and Christians festival is celebrated.
Benissa has four kilometres of coastline with some of the most beautiful bays on the Costa Blanca. The crystal-clear waters are ideal for water sports such as diving, sailing, windsurfing and kayaking.
Playa la Fustera is by far the most famous and popular sandy beach in Benissa. The beach has been awarded the Blue Flag, which aims to promote environmental protection in coastal towns, bathing areas and marinas. The beach is ideal for family holidays: it is very easy to get to, both by car and by bus, and there is parking available, as well as numerous showers and toilets. An additional advantage of the beach is the permanent lifeguard service during the season from 15 June to 15 September and two restaurants.
Another well-known beach in this coastal town is Cala Baladrar. The picturesque bay offers breathtaking views of Calpe and Peñon de Ilfach, while being easily accessible. The water is calm as the beach is sheltered from strong winds. Cala Baladrar is famous for its shallow waters and rich marine life, making it an ideal spot for diving enthusiasts. It is a small Mediterranean paradise with a beach bar open during the season where you can enjoy lunch, a cocktail and live music.
Benissa is the perfect place if you want to escape the hustle and bustle of coastal towns but are still looking for an elegant villa or exclusive apartment near the sea. The views of the Mediterranean Sea in this town speak for themselves and are truly breathtaking.

One lagoon is famous for its striking pink waters, while the other is known for its green hues. Together they form a protected natural park and provide a habitat for numerous bird species, including flamingos. Las Colinas Golf & Country Club is one of the most distinctive locations in the southern Costa Blanca — a private, carefully designed resort set within an approximately 330-hectare valley, surrounded by hills and Mediterranean nature. This is a location for those looking for more than just an apartment on the Costa Blanca — privacy, nature, space, security and a high standard of living, while still remaining close to beaches, services and the region’s main transport connections.

The apartments have been designed in a bright, contemporary style. The specifications include large-format porcelain flooring, aluminium exterior carpentry with thermal break, double glazing, reinforced entrance doors and practical fitted wardrobes in the bedrooms.
The kitchens will be fitted with cabinetry, a COMPAC-type or similar worktop, sink and extractor hood, as well as pre-installation for household appliances. The apartments also include pre-installation for ducted air conditioning, an aerothermal system for hot water and an individual photovoltaic solution designed to help reduce energy consumption.
Estimated completion: September 2028.
Location
The location is very convenient both for year-round living and as a holiday property. The development is situated in a well-established area of Santa Pola, allowing residents to enjoy the town’s infrastructure without needing to rely on a car every day. The beach is approximately 800 m away and Santa Pola port around 900 m away, placing the promenade, marina and town centre within easy walking distance.
Santa Pola is a lively coastal town throughout the year and remains active outside the summer season. It offers a full range of services including shops, supermarkets, restaurants, schools, healthcare facilities and public transport. The town is known for its wide sandy beaches, long seafront promenade, port and pleasant Mediterranean climate.
Another important advantage is the proximity to everyday services. The bus station is approx
imately 50 m from the building, the health centre around 400 m away, while supermarkets, cafés and restaurants can be found in the immediate surroundings.
Santa Pola also enjoys excellent connections with Alicante. Alicante-Elche Airport is approximately 15 km away, while Alicante city centre is around 20 km away. This makes the location particularly convenient for people who travel frequently between Spain and other European countries.
The combination of proximity to the sea, wide beaches, urban infrastructure and easy access to Alicante makes this an attractive location for year-round living, a holiday apartment or seasonal stays.

properties.title: New Apartments with Private Garden or Solarium in San Miguel de Salinas
properties.summary: New build apartment for sale in San Miguel de Salinas, Alicante: 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 75 m² built. From €251,900.
properties.description:
New apartments with private garden or solarium in San Miguel de Salinas
New apartments for sale in a peaceful area of San Miguel de Salinas on the Costa Blanca. The residential complex offers modern 2-bedroom properties, with the possibility of creating a 3rd bedroom, as well as attractive communal areas with a swimming pool, spa area, children’s playground and landscaped gardens.
Buyers can choose between ground-floor apartments with a private garden and upper-floor properties with a spacious private solarium. Ground-floor apartments feature gardens finished with artificial grass, while the upper-floor homes offer a large private rooftop space, ideal for relaxing and enjoying the Mediterranean climate. Each property also includes a parking space within the residential complex.
The interiors have been designed in a modern and functional style. The kitchen is fitted with contemporary cabinetry with a choice of finishes and a quartz worktop. The apartments also feature built-in wardrobes with sliding doors, fully lined interiors and drawers.
For added comfort, the properties are equipped with ducted inverter air conditioning, an aerothermal system for domestic hot water, LED lighting and modern aluminium exterior carpentry with thermal insulation and Climalit-type glazing.
The bathrooms include bathroom furniture, mirrors and shower screens. In the 3-bedroom properties, the price also includes a kitchen appliance package with a fridge-freezer, oven, dishwasher, ceramic hob, extractor hood and microwave.
One of the main advantages of the development is its well-maintained communal area with a swimming pool, spa, children’s area and extensive landscaped gardens with palm trees and Mediterranean vegetation.
Currently available are, among others, upper-floor apartments of approximately 73.5 m² with a terrace/solarium of around 67.5 m², as well as a ground-floor apartment with a private garden of approximately 59 m².
The earliest completion dates are scheduled for December 2026, with further properties due for completion in April 2027.
Location
San Miguel de Salinas is a peaceful town located in the south of the Costa Blanca, surrounded by Mediterranean scenery and within a short distance of the Orihuela Costa coastline. It is a good choice for those looking for a quieter place to live while still enjoying easy access to beaches, golf courses and larger towns in the region.
The centre of San Miguel de Salinas offers shops, supermarkets, restaurants, cafés, pharmacies, banks and other everyday services. The area is well connected with Torrevieja and popular coastal destinations on Orihuela Costa, including Punta Prima, Playa Flamenca, La Zenia and Campoamor.
Golf enthusiasts will find several well-known courses nearby, including Las Colinas Golf & Country Club, Campoamor Golf and Las Ramblas Golf. Zenia Boulevard, one of the largest shopping centres in the southern Costa Blanca, is also within easy reach.
The nearest beaches of Orihuela Costa offer wide sandy stretches, picturesque coves and promenades lined with restaurants and bars. The location also provides convenient access to Torrevieja, known for its seafront promenade, marina and the pink lagoons of the Lagunas de La Mata y Torrevieja Natural Park.
San Miguel de Salinas is therefore an attractive option both for year-round living and as a holiday base on the Costa Blanca — away from the busiest resorts, yet still close to the sea, services, golf and the main attractions of the region.

New apartments with a swimming pool for sale in the centre of Torrevieja
New apartments for sale in the centre of Torrevieja on the southern Costa Blanca, approximately 1.2 km from the sea. The intimate residential building offers only 12 apartments with 2 bedrooms, as well as attractive communal areas with a swimming pool, jacuzzi, sauna and a rooftop relaxation area.

The standard specification also includes fitted wardrobes, high-quality PVC windows with solar-control glazing, mechanical ventilation and pre-installation for central air conditioning with a heat pump and Air Zone system. An energy-efficient aerothermal system will provide domestic hot water.
One of the main advantages of the development is its approximately 206 m² of communal areas. Residents will have access to a swimming pool of approximately 33 m², a jacuzzi, sauna and a landscaped rooftop solarium with chill-out areas and greenery. Location
The property is located in the urban area of Torrevieja, with shops, restaurants, cafés, supermarkets and all essential everyday services available nearby. The sea is approximately 1.2 km away, allowing convenient access to both the beaches and the seafront promenade.
Torrevieja is one of the most popular coastal towns on the southern Costa Blanca, appreciated for its well-developed infrastructure, pleasant climate and suitability for year-round living. The apartment can be an attractive option both as a second home in Spain and as a property for permanent residence.

properties.title: New bungalow less than 2 km from the sea in San Pedro

properties.description:
For sale: new bungalows with garden or solarium in San Pedro del Pinatar.
Modern bungalows for sale in San Pedro del Pinatar, in the Murcia region, in a peaceful area close to Lo Pagán, the salt lagoons and the beaches of the Mar Menor. This intimate residential development consists of only 12 properties with 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, designed for comfortable holidays as well as year-round living in the Mediterranean climate.
Buyers can choose between ground-floor properties with private outdoor space and upper-floor homes with a balcony and a large private solarium of approximately 56 m². This makes it possible to select a property that best suits your lifestyle – with a garden ideal for relaxing or a spacious rooftop terrace offering plenty of room for sunbathing, unwinding and creating a private chill-out area.
Each bungalow offers a bright living area with lounge, dining space and open-plan kitchen, 2 comfortable bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Contemporary architecture, a functional layout and large glazed areas provide plenty of natural light and create a pleasant connection between the interior and outdoor spaces.
The properties will be delivered with high-quality finishes. The standard specification includes a fully fitted kitchen with appliances, equipped bathrooms with furniture and shower screens, built-in wardrobes, LED lighting and central air conditioning with heat pump and Air Zone system. Depending on the selected property, there is also the possibility of adding a private swimming pool.
Each property includes a private parking space.
Planned completion of the development: 2028.
Location
San Pedro del Pinatar is a popular coastal town located between the Mediterranean Sea and the Mar Menor. The area is known for the Salinas y Arenales de San Pedro Natural Park, its salt lagoons, promenades and wide range of leisure opportunities.
Nearby there are shops, restaurants, supermarkets, schools, sports facilities and all services needed for everyday living. The coastal area of Lo Pagán offers a promenade, marina, restaurants and sandy beaches along the Mar Menor. The sea is approximately 1.7 km away.
San Pedro del Pinatar is a small town in the Murcia region of Spain, located on the shores of the saltwater lagoon of the Mar Menor. The town has a rich history dating back to the Roman Empire, and traces of Roman salt-production facilities can still be found today.

properties.title: Modern Townhouses for Sale in Mutxamel, Alicante

New Townhouses for Sale in Mutxamel, Alicante.
Elite World Estates presents an attractive residential development of contemporary townhouses located in Mutxamel, on the northern Costa Blanca. Location: Mutxamel, Alicante | A Comfortable Mediterranean Lifestyle
Mutxamel is a well-connected residential town in the province of Alicante, on Spain’s northern Costa Blanca. It offers a pleasant combination of a quieter residential atmosphere, everyday amenities, and convenient access to the coast and the city of Alicante.
The L’Alluser area provides a residential setting with schools, supermarkets, shops, sports facilities, and other essential services nearby. This makes the location suitable for families and those who want to enjoy the Mediterranean lifestyle while having practical amenities within easy reach.
One of the main advantages of the location is its proximity to the beaches of Muchavista and San Juan, two well-known coastal destinations where residents can enjoy sandy beaches and the Mediterranean climate.
Thanks to its road connections, Mutxamel also provides convenient access to Alicante and other destinations along the Costa Blanca, as well as Alicante-Elche International Airport.
The combination of modern homes, communal leisure facilities, nearby services, and access to the coast makes this development an appealing choice for permanent living or a second home in Spain.

properties.title: New apartments with a pool approximately 1 km from the sea in Torrevieja

New Apartments with a Pool in Torrevieja
New apartments for sale in Torrevieja, on the southern Costa Blanca, in a quiet residential area close to beaches, shops and local amenities.
